dpe skrun gsal bshad/mes po'i byung ba zhes pa'i rtsom yig 'di ni nag chu 'bri ru rdzong gi lo rgyus dang / rjes shul/ yul goms gshis srol/ 'khor ra 'khor yugaganas chen khag grags che'i mi sna sogs kyi skor ngo sprod byas pa'i phyag deb cig yin pa dang / lhag par du 'bri ru rdzong 'di nyid la gna' bo nas nags shod ces brjod kyi yod pa dang / nags shod ces pa'i yul lung de'i khongs su yod pa'i dgon pa khag phug pa khag mchod rten khag de bzhin yul srol gyi byed sgo khag sogs re re bzhin ngo sprod zhib par gnang 'dug pas tang gi chos dad rang mos srid jus lag bstar byed pa dang / rang byung 'khor yug srung skyob/ yul skor bya gzhag 'phel rgyas gtong ba sogs kyi dus rabs nyer gcig pa 'di'i nang mi rnams la dgos nges kyi cha 'phrin mang dag cig ngo sprod gnang 'dug pas/ zhib 'jug gi cha nas zhus na'ang 'dra/ chos dad kyi ngos nas dang yul skor gyi cha sogs phyogs gang thad nas deb 'dis rgya che'i klog pa po tshor phan thogs chen po yong nges red 'dug pa la gzhigs nas da lam nged dpe skrun khang nas par du bskrun pa la/ dus thung brel ches bskyar zhus zhib tshags po zhig gtong khom ma byung bas 'di'i nang 'gal skyon chad nor sogs mi nyung tsam yod nges pas rgya che'i klog pa po rnams nas legs nyes blang dor 'chug med dang rtsa che'i bslab bya gang mang gnang rgyu'i re smon dang bcas/mi rigs dpe bskrun khang nas/

༄༅//'go brjod/bkra shis kha ba'i ljongs kyi zhing khams 'dir/ /bkra shis yab mes bzang po'i mdzad bzang rnams/ /bkra shis lo dus bzang ba'i skal bzang 'dir/ /bkra shis gtam gyis drangs te snyan du 'bul/ /btsan po'i bar gyi dpa' sde nags shod stong bu chung dang 'gom sde leng drug gam 〈mes po'i byung ba 〉zhes pa'i deb 'di nyid 'dzam gling spyi dang bod khab can gyi yul phyogs dang mdo khams shod chen bco brgyad kyi nang gsal bod kyi btsan po'i bar gyi dpa' sde nags shod stong bu chung gi sngon byung nas da lta'i bar gyi lo rgyus rags rim tsam dang / lhag par du bdag gi tshe rabs las kyi 'brel bas nang bstan spyi dang dpal 'bri gung bka' brgyud pa'i chos sde chen mo nags shod 'gom dgon chos 'khor byams pa gling dgon pa'i chos brgyud gnas dgon bcas 'brel yod khag gi lo rgyus rnams thun mong ltar dngos thog bden 'tshol gyi lam nas bris pa shig yin/ dgos pa ni/ rang re'i lung pa lta bu'i lung tshan nas byung ba'i mkhas dang grub pa'i yon tan/ ya rabs kyi mdzangs ma/ dgra 'dul gnyen skyong gi dpa' bo sogs kyi lo rgyus mi nyung ba zhig yod nges kyang da lta re gnyis las ma bzhugs/ yun ring song ba'i sa chu dang ri lung gi ming bsgyur ba ni lo rgyus la gnod tshab de las che ba gang yang med de/ sngon gyi sa ming da lta bed spyod ma byas pas kun gyi nags shod bya ba mtha' khul zhig tu yod par bsam nas sngar 1

gyi lo rgyus khag tu yod kyang gsar rtsom deb ther khag tu gsal ba nyung / bod khams spyi dang rang re rnams chos dang 'jig rten gang ci'i thog nas gzhan yul la khungs gtugs gang thub las/ rang yul gyi 'byung khams rig gnas dang mkhas grub rnams la 'ding de tsam mi 'dzin pa'i goms srol zhig sngar nas chags yod/ gzhan gyi lo rgyus du nags shod zhes 'khod kyang phyogs khag gi mkhas pa ga ge mo zhig gis blang dor gang yang mi shes pa'i yul la chos kyi sgron me sbar ba dang / gnas dgon bzhengs ba'i lo rgyus bcas 'chi ba las bskyabs pa lta bu'i mtshar gtam sna tshogs dang / 'jig rten phyogs la ya rabs gna' srol 'dzugs skrun tho gang yod pa ma bris pa 'di cis lan pa yin/da lta bod kyi gnas chen khag rnams rang rang gis srung skyob dang dril bsgrags byas pa dang / gnas kyi yon tan brjod pas 'dzam gling skye bo kun kyang ma bos mgron du phebs pa dang gnas der bzhugs pa pos kyang spro ba brtas pa bcas kyi dge mtshan ldan/ de rnams dang rang re'i gnas dgon dang mi rigs rig gnas bcas gang gi cha nas skyo ba gang yang med/ da lta spyir bod kyi lo rgyus cha tshang ba'i rnam pa ru slebs kyang / rang re lta bu'i lung tshan khag la lo rgyus yan ring ldan zhing snod bcad kyi bkod pa phan sam tshogs po yod pas riring ra rgyu ra rgya rasmi3cha ma tshang ba'i snang ba de tsam med/ lung tshan gzhan dang bsdur na 7skyabs rje mchog sprul rin po che don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos na ri dbang dkon mchog bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po mchog gis brtsams pa 〈nags shod 'bri ru'i lo rgyus 〉zhes pa de ha cang gi phun sum tshogs pas bdag gi gtsos phyi rabs rnams kyi dpyad gzhi dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i nor bu zhig gnang ba dang gnyis su ma mchis pas snying thag pa nas dka' drin che zhu gā yin/ 'on kyang tsho sde re dang bla dgon gyi byung rabs rnams bod yongs

su lung tshan rnams kyi rig gnas lo rgyus re byung na bsam nas bris pa las/phyogs ris kyis sam yang na nags shod lung pa dang rang nyid kyi gnas yul lo rgyus gcig pur yod na bsam nas ma bris par/ da lta bod spyi'i rgyal rabs sogs rtsa ba'i cha nas lo rgyus legs grub byung kyang / lung tshan rnams kyi lo rgyus la mkhas dbang gang zhig yin kyang zhib phra yong mi thub pa dang nor 'dzol mang po yong nges pas rang sa rang yal rang sde rang dgon nas yin pa'i skyes ༄bus bris pa yin na kha gsal la gting zab pa zhig yong re'i kun slongs kyis bris pas nags shod pa'i sde dang dgon pa rnams kyis mtshon bod yongs la de don lam slong yong ba'i smon 'dun zhu/lo rgyus 'di 'dra zhig 'bri rkyen ni phyogs gzhan la 'gro skabs khyod pha yul ga nas yin/ lung der gnas dgon gang 'dra yod/ mkhas grub gang 'dra byon/ de rnams lo rabs ga dus red zhes dris pas/ rang gi pha yul dngaganas dgon yid la 'char bzhin du smra ba med par sdod pa las thabs shes ma byung bas lo rgyus 'bri ba'i 'dun pa shar/ de don bdag la bka' drin bla na med pa 7skyabs rje rin po che mchog la zhus pas/ khong gis ngas dgon pa'i lo rgyus shig 'bri 'dun yod kyang ma grub pas khyod kyi de ltar bya dgos zhes pa'i gnang ba bstsal bas dpyad gzhi'i yig rigs dang 'brel yod sa cha khag na rgan gras la bka' 'dri zhu ba'i 'go tshugs/ kha gcig gis rang lung pa'i rgyan gos dang skad dang goms gshis 'byung khams bcas la snang chung shor nas bod kyi sa cha dngos dang ma mthun par smra ba 'ga' yang byung / dmigs bsal gyi khyad chos med na mi rigs dang yul lung bya ba'i dgos pa med pa dang / lhag tu rang re'i skad ni brda rnying dang brda sprod rig pa dang mthun pa dang / bod yul stod smad bar gsum kun gyis go bde ༵ la

sogs khyad chos mang po 'dug pas rjes su 'god rgyu yin/ rgyan gos ni bod gna' rabs kyi goms srol ma nyams pas thang bris rnying pa dang 'jim bzo bcas dang mthun pa/ dgon gnas mang zhing sa babs bzang ba'i ri chu'i bkod pa sogs ngo mtshar rnams 'ud sgrog tsam ma yin par don la gnas/spyir bod kyi gna' srol goms gshis dang srol rgyun rig gnas rnams rang re lta bu'i lung tshan khag la gnas thub pa las/ grong khyer dang 'dus sdod mang ba'i sar nyin bzhin skad goms gshis gsum 'gyur ba 'gro ste/bod min sog min/ rgya min bod min/ grwa min skya min/ skad yang ra ma lug lta bu spyod bzhin pa 'di rnams lags/'dir nor 'khrul dang tshig don ma mthun pa yong nges pas rgya che'i gzigs pa po rnams kyis brtse ba'i yul du mkhyen par mdzod/gangs can lha ldan zhing du 2rkyaX7zla 6tshes 20nyin/ rtsom pa pos/

༄7//dkar chagamachod par brjod pa dang rtsom par dam bca' ba (1)snod bcudatpa skor/ (4)phyi snod kyi 'jig rten gyi chags tshul/ (4)nang bcud kyi sems can gyi gnas tshul/ (6)'gro ba mi'i rigs ji ltar byung tshul/ (9)bskal bzang sangs rgyas rnams byon nas dam chos dar tshul/ (12)ston pa'i gtad rabs/ (1ṭwāṃ)bka' bsdu rim pa/ (20)zab mo lta brgyud/ (21)rgya chen spyod brgyud/ (22)kha ba'i ljongasaspyi snod bcudalje ltar byung tshul/ (25)spu rgyal gyi rgyal rabs/ (2rdo)bod btsan po'i rgyal rabs/ (22)chol kha gsum/ (45)bstan pa phyi dar skabasakli 'dul ba'i sdomarghan khag gsum/ (47)bod dar chos brgyad grub mtha' khag gi byung rim/ (5༷)'bri gung bka' brgyadaspyi byung tshul/ (57)sum pasgyul phran/ (64)bodatpa stong sde drug cur dbye ba/ (67)bar gyi dpa' sde nags shod stong bu chung / (74)1

nags shod 'di nyid mdo dbus gang du gtogs tshul/ (ra1)nags shod yul skyong nags lha dzam bha/ (ra7)nags lha'i lha mkhar/ (rdzo2)nags shod pa'i goms srol/ (97)nags shod kyi dpon khag (99)nags shod du chos lugs grub mtha' khag byung tshul/ (99)nags shod pa'i rig gnas dang sgyu rtsal/ (1rkya5)bod sil bu'i mjug gi nags shod/ (117)'gom nde leng drug (125)'gom gyi lte ba yul grong / (140)'gom 'om mtha' (142)'gom nyang khu gzhung / (144)'gom chu srib ma/ (146)'gom dkar gzhung / (14〈)'gom smre ti yungs dkar/ (14rdo)'gom chags rtse/ (151)skor gsum/ (151)gnas mchog ba lag shel dkar 'bum pa/ (152)'bum pa bskyar bzhengs/ (162)'bum pa rgyas bskrun/ (165)lo ltar chos phyogs mdzad sgo/ (166)sku gsung thugs rten/ (167)smyung gnas lha khang / (169)rdo rje phag mo'i lha khang / (1tre0)2

shel dkar 'bum pa'i gnas kyi phan yon dang skor tshad/ (171)nags shod 'gom dgon chos 'khor byams pa gling / (175)sku gsung thugs rten/ (220)chos spyod nyams len dang sgrub mchod khag (226)lo ltar sgrub mchod sogs las bya rim pa/ (227)yang dar bstan pa'i nyi ma slar yang shar ba/ (252)'gom dgon rten 'phyag nyi gling dur khrod/ (277)kwa mchog sgrub grwa thar pa gling / (2shrī1)'bar ba dbang gi sgrub gnas me 'bar phug (2ra5)shag wa thang dgon bka' brgyud 'phel rgyas gling / (290)shag glang del dgon theg mchog rnam grol gling / (2kya9)smre ti mar sgyed dgon/ (212)ser ris chos 'khor dgon/ (219)lha khang khag (221)bskang bshags khag (222)mchod rten khag (229)mjug gi sbyar byang / (242)'gom dgon chos 'khor byams pa gling gi chos khrims bca' yig (245)'gom dgon chos 'khor byams pa gling gi bca' yig kha gsab/ (256)dpyad gzhi'i yig cha/ (259)3

༄//mchod par brjod pa dang rtsom pa dam bca' ba/na mo ratna gu ru/gang zhig gdod nas nyes pas ma gos shing //gang zhig gdod nas spros pa'i mtha' las grol/gang dang gang gi rgyud la rab bzhugs pa'i/gang gi mgon po gdod ma'i mgon der 'dud/mkha' la sprin gyi tshul du snang ba dang /mkha' ltar khyab kyang dag pa'i spyod yul ba/mkha' yi ngang tshul snang la rang bzhin med/mkha' khyab gdod ma'i sar 'god khyod la 'dud/grangs med gong nas mngon par sangs rgyas kyang /grangs med 'gro ba 'dren pa'i mthu mnga' zhing /grangs med sems can don la bskal ba'i mthar/grangs med mdzad 'phrin ston mdzad khyod la 'dud/dka' ba'i lo zla bgrang yas sngon dus nas/dka' spyad sdug bsran 'bad pa'i mes po dang /bka' drin bla na med pa'i chos rgyal tshogs/1

bka' drin bsam bzhin bsam zhing slar yang 'dud/rab dkar kha ba'i ljongs kyi zhing khams 'dir/rab mdzes bshad sgrub shing rta bco brgyad ces/rab mang mkhas dang grub pa'i tshogs rnams la/rab dwangs gus pa chen pos phyag bgyi'o/rgyal kun dgongs pa thams cad gcig 'doms pa/rgyal dang de sras kun gyis bstod dbyangs sgrogargyal kun sku gsung thugs mchog gcig 'dus pa'i/rgyal kun dbang po rin chen dpal la 'dud/rab yangs sa chen nor 'dzin khyon 'di nyid/rab dmar ngur smrig rgyan 'chang khyu tshogs kyis/rab 'gengs dwags brgyud bstan 'dzin gser ri'i phreng / /rab brjid brgyud par bcas la gus phyag 'tshal/ljon pa'i tshal gyis sum rtsen dpal rab 'phrogaljon bzang rtsa 'bras lo mas nad kun sel/ljon shing nags kyis mdzes shing dge bcu tshang /ljon pas rab gang bkra shis nags kyi shod/ngo mtshar lha yul bkod pa kun tshang dbus/ngo mtshar gna' shul grags can mang mthong tshe/ngo mtshar mes po'i bka' drin dran pa'i phyir/ngo mtshar gnas dgon bkod sogs cung zad 'bri/cha tshang spyi yi lo rgyus rgyu skar spun/cha tshang med phyir rang rer ngag sgros tsam/2

cha tshang 'bri bar bya ba'i thabs kyis dben/cha tshang yongs phyir kun gyis 'bad par rigamang mang mdzes mdzes tshig don ya ma cha/mang po'i don phyir lhag bsam gyis bskul kyang /mang po'i rig gzhung sbyangs pa ches dben pas/mang po mgu bar dka' bas brtse bror mdzod/de yang slob dpon 'phags pas/ bstan bcos byed pos ston pa la/mchod par brjod pa 'bras med min/ ston pa dang ni bstan bcos la/ dad 'dun skyed pa bya phyir ro/ zhes gsung pa ltar mchod par brjod pa rdo rje'i tshig gi me tog phreng bas mdun bsus te/ gang gleng bar bya ba'i rim pa 'di yang / slob dpon zhi ba lhas/ sngon chad ma thos pa ni 'dir brjod med/sdeb sbyor mkhas pa'ang bdag la yod ma yin/ zhes gsungs pa ltar dang /'dir yang spyi dang bye brag gnyis las/ dang por phyi snod kyi 'jig rten dang nang bcud kyi sems can chags tshul lo/

snod bcud kyi skor/phyi snod kyi 'jig rten gyi chags tshul/de yang gcig tu ma nges te/ rje 'bri gung pas spyir sems tha dad pa'i dbang gis snang ba yang tha dad yin zhes gsungs pa de ni shin tu thugs mad de/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten 'di nyid la phyi nang gi 'dod pa dang / nang pa la yang theg pa che chung gi bzhed tshul dang / da lta'i tshan rig pa'i 'dod tshul sogs gcig tu nges dka' yang 'gal ba can du mi sems te/ gong gi rje skyob pa'i rdo rje'i gsung des grub la/ de yang 'dzam gling go la hril po sogs snod bcud 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad 'byung ba'i rten 'brel tshogs pa'i nus mthu'i byed las la brten nas grub/mdo las/ dper na bar snang la char gyi rgyun babs pa'i tshe/ bar snang mi mngon pa bzhin/ phyogs bcu'i nam mkha' mtha' med pa thams cad na/la la babs pa'i mgo tshugs/ la la bar snang nas 'bab/ la la sa gzhir thim/ la la thim nas cung zhig lon bar ma chad pa ltar zhes pas dper na/'jig rten gyi khams thams cad mthong chos su gyur pa ni mi'i skye gnas 'jig gsum lta bu las ma 'das/ de nyid la dbyibs kyi rnam par phye ba ni sna tshogs te/ phyogs rnams kun na zhing rnams rgya mtsho snang / la la zlum po la la zur gsum ste/ de dag la la phyogs na gru bzhi gnas/ zhes gsungs/ spyir na 'jig rten gyi khams 'di nyid 'og gzhi rlung gi dkyil 'khor ram rdo rje'i rgya gram ltar gnas pa'i steng du bdud rtsi chu yi zil ma las/ dbang chen gser 4

gyi sa gzhi ri rab gling bzhi gling phran lcags ri dang ri mtsho bdun bdun bcas rim bzhin sems can spyi mthun las kyis grub/ de yang slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mngon pa mdzod las/ gling bzhi gling phran nyi zla dang / ri rab dang ni 'dod lha dang / tshangs pa'i 'jig rten stong la ni/ stong ni spyi phud yin par 'dod/ zhes pa ltar ma ki rlung dkyil nas ya ki bsam gtan bzhi pa bar brtsis pa stong la stong spyi phud kyi 'jig rten zhes brjod/ de stong la stong gnyis pa bar ma'i 'jig rten gyi khams zhes bya/ de stong la stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams zhes 'bod/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di nyid/ gzhi dang snying po me tog gis rgyan pa mdzad pa bcu gnyis ston pa'i sprul sku zhig gi 'dul zhing yin/ 'jig rten gyi khams 'di lhang phug gi dbyibs can ril po zhig yin pa da lta'i mkhas dbang kun gyis mgrin gcig tu smras pa 'di gang yin zer na/ de sngon bde bar gshegs pa la 'khrul ba'i dri ma mi mnga' bas sangs rgyas zhes mtshan du gsol ba thabs dang shes rab la mnga' dbang 'byor bas yin/ de ltar gnyis su gsungs pa ma yin te/ 'jig rten khams kyi chags dbyibs tshul mi mthun pa ltar gsungs pa ni/ 'dul bya'i blo dang 'tshams par gsungs pa yin/thabs mkhas pa'i spyod pas gang la gang 'dul gyi mdzad pa 'phrin las ston pa yin te/ sangs rgyas kyis sems can gyi bsam pa dang bag la nyal dang khams dang rang bzhin bcas mkhyen nas gsungs so/ dper na rgya gar gyi gdod ma'i chos lugs phyi rol pa sogs bsam blo rnying pa'i dbang gi sa gzhi leb mo zhig 'dod pa las ril bo zhig bsam yul las 'das pas ma gsungs la/'jigarten mthun 'jug gi spyod pa de lta bu zhig mdzad pas chos lugs grub mtha' khag mang po zhig gi nang du dar rgyas 'di lta bu zhig byung ba mdzad pa ni/5

thub pa'i dbang pos gsung ba'i bka' yi gsung rab rnams la dpyad pa zhib mor mdzod dang da bzod rtogs thub/ thub pa chen po'i dgongs pa dngos sa gzhi 'di zlum po zhig tu 'dod pa ni mdo sde rnams su gsal bar gsungs so/nang bcud kyi sems can gyi gnas chul/stong gsum dang bcas pa de dag la bcud kyi 'gro ba rnams go rim nges pa yod dam zhe na/ de ni khams gsum skye gnas bzhi sa dgur 'du'o/ dang po 'dod khams la gnas ris nyi shu mchis te/ dmyal ba la tsha grang brgyad dang yi dwags dud 'gro bcas gnas ris bcu/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho 'dzam bu gling / nub ba glang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan bcas rang rang gi gling g.yog dang bcas bzhi/ rgyal chen rigs bzhi/ sum cu rtsa gsum/ 'thab bral/ dga' ldan/ 'phrul dga'/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed/ 'dod lha rigs drug bcas bcu ste/ 'dod khams gnas ris nyi shu mchis/gzugs khams la gnas ris bcu bdun mchis te/ bsam gtan dang po la tshangs ris/ tshangs pa mdun na 'don/ tshangs chen gsum/ bsam gtan gnyis pa la 'od chung / tshad med 'od/ 'od gsal gsum/ bsam gtan gsum pa la dge chung / tshad med dge/ dge rgyas dang gsum/bsam gtan bzhi pa la sprin med/ bsod nams skyes/ 'bras bu che/ mi che ba/ mi gdung ba/ gya nom snang / shin tu mtho ba/ 'og min te dang po gsum so skye'i gnas dang / phyi ma lnga 'phags pa kho na'i gnas yin pas gnas gtsang lnga zhes 'bod pa'i gzugs khams kyi gnas yin no/gzugs med kyi gnas la skye mched mu bzhi ste/ nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched/ rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched/ ci yang med pa'i skye mched/6

yod min med min skye mched bcas bzhi ni ting 'dzin gyi rang gzugs las rags gzugs ni ma grub/spyir 'dod khams zhes pa ni dbang po lnga la 'dod cing chags pas na 'dod khams/ gzugs khams zhes pa ni phyi'i gzugs la chags pa dang bral yang nang gi gzugs kyi phung po la chags srid yod pas gzugs khams/gzugs med khams ni nang gi gzugs khams la chags pa med kyang tshor ba sogs ming gzhi tsam la cung zhen pas na gzugs med khams bcas gsum du dbye ba yod/khams gsum po de dag sa dgur dbye na/ 'dod khams la zas dang grogs gnas 'dod tsam du mthun pas gcig gzugs khams la bsam gtan bzhir dga' bde'i bsam pa mi 'dra ba re res sa bzhi/ gzugs med skye mched mu bzhi la snyoms 'jug gi rim pa la khyad par mi 'dra bas sa bzhir bcas dgu yod/skye gnas bzhi ni khams gsum gyi gnas ris thams cad skye gnas bzhir ma 'dus pa med la/ mi la sogs pa kha cig mngal skyes dang / bya la sogs pa khaṭacig sgong skyes/ shig la sogs drod gsher las skyes pa/ bar do dang yi dwags sogs rdzus skyes yin yang / de ltar yang gcig tu ma nges rite/dud 'gro dang mi ni skye gnas bzhi kar yod pa sngon gyiklegleng gzhi dang / da lta'i 'dzam gling sa phyogs khag la byung dang 'byung bzhin yod pas mtshon/ skye gnas bzhir ma 'dus pa'i khams gsum sems can gcig kyang yod pa ni ma yin no/ 'o na de rnams kyi tshe tshad la nges pa yod dam zhe na/ de ni nges dang ma nges gnas ris mi 'dra ba so so ltar yod kyang spyir rnam smin las kyi rjes su 'brangs ba kho na'o/ des na bde sdug gi 'bras bu de gang gis myong snyam na/7

lus kyis myong te/ rje skyob pa rin po ches/ 'khor ba lus 'khor sems 'khor la/ gzhan gyis 'dod lugs mang na yang / 'a 'bus gang yang mi bzhed de/ rgyu rkyen las skyes rnam rtog gis/ bag chags lus su 'khor bar 'gyur/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mi sogs rags gzugs rnams lus kyis myong ba smos med khar/ bar do sogs yid lus rnams kyang bag chags kyi dbang gis sngon goms lus la myong ba ni rang re rnams kyi 'od gsal dbyings su ma dag pa'i gti mug gnyid kyi skabs su rmi lam sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba 'dis dpog nus so/'jig rten 'di las gzhan du gyur pa yod pa ni/ mi'i rig shes 'phel rgyas phyin pa'i rgyal khab khag gis 'phur bskyod la brten nas nyi zla dang rgyu skar sogs kyi gling dang / chags pa dang chags bzhin pa 'jig pa bcas kyi 'jig rten gyi khams mang po zhig rtogs la/ par ris kyang blangs yod pa des nang chos rig pa'i rgyab rten dang dpung rogs byed pa dang chos mtshungs pas/'jig rten 'di nyid du lha med smra ba dang 'jig rten byed pos bskrun par 'dod pa/ 'jig rten gyi bde sdug thams cad dkon mchog gi thugs sems mgu ma mgu la rag las pas yin par 'dod pa dang / rigs mtho dman dkon mchog gis gnang ba dang / mthar gtugs na 'dra mnyam med pa gnya' gnon gyi rang bzhin/ 'tshe ba chos su smra ba/ dge sems cung zad yod kyang phyogs re ba dang / lan la re ba/ dgos med dka' sdug gi bzod sran kho na dang / sems pa gu dog dang 'jigs snang kho na las bde ba nye tshe las ma 'das pa'i phyogs rnams la/ dngos su 'dzam gling sa gzhi chen po 'dir gsal bsgrags byed pas/ rang bzhin gyis dgag pa tshar phyin pa zhig brgyab yod/ de dang chabs cig skye ba snga phyi'i skor gyi nang chos bar do gsum 8

dang 'brel ba'i skabs/ 'dzam gling 'dir khyon mi rigs 'bor chig stong lhag tsam yod pa gsal ba dang / lhag tu mkhan chen tshul khrims blo gros mchog gis brtsams pa'i skye ba snga phyi'i skor gyi deb sogs la gzigs par 'tshal/ nang rig pa'i lta ba rten cing 'brel 'byung dang spyod pa 'tshe ba med pa'i phyogs su tshan rig pa yar thon zhig yin phyin de'i phyogs su spyod gang thub dang / da dung phra ba'i gnas mang po zhig nang rig pa las rjes su lus yod pa rtogs thub/ tshan rig pa ni nang rig pa'i zhabs 'degs zhu mkhan zhig dang 'phel rgyas gtong mkhan zhig dang gnyis su ma mchis/ nang rig pa ni yang dag pa'i tshan rtsal pa'i blo sgo 'byed pa'i lde mig lta bu dang gzhi 'dzin sa zhig kyang yin/'gro ba mi'i rigs ji ltar byung tshul/dang po 'gro ba mi'i rigs 'dī nyid ji ltar byung ba'i thad la lo rgyus deb ther khag dang chos lugs dang sa phyogs khag gi bshad srol mi 'dra ba ni/ rgya gar rig byed sogs grub mtha' khag gis dang po lha las babs par 'dod/rgya nag pa khag gcig gis lha mo nyu'e wa hris bzos par 'dod/ dbyi si lan chos lugs kyis rang gi mi rigs gcig pur lha mos ched du bzos pa sogs bshad srol shin tu mang yang / rang re kha ba can du lo ngo stong phrag mang po'i gong nas spre'u byang chub sems dpa' dang / brag srin mo gnyis las mched par bshad pa ni shin tu yar thon gyi bsam pa dang ldan pa zhig yin te/ de sngon lo ngo nyis brgya'i sngon du byon pa'i dbyin ji'i skye dngos rig pa mkhas can tar wun gyis zhib 'jug byas pa'i 'bras bur/ mi ni spra rigs las 'phel 'gyur byung bar bshad la/ da lta phyi gling pa'i sa cha khag cig la spra las mir 9

gyur pa'i rigs mang po zhig mthong rgyu 'dug pa de rnams brnyan 'phrin du gzigs kyang shes/ da lta'i bar mkhas dbang tshang mas ma gros gcig mthun chu brgya zam 'og gi dpe ltar lta ba gcig gyur tu gnas so/de dang 'dra ba 'dzam gling sa phyogs gang sar mi'i rigs rnams rim bzhin gong 'phel byung nas/ so so'i gnas sa'i sa babs mtho dma' dang /'byung bzhi'i nus pa shas che chung / mes po'i goms gshis kyi dbang gis gzugs stobs dang / kha dog kun spyod sogs so sor gyur nas/ phan tshun 'brel ba nyung bas tsho dang tsho byed pas de dang 'dra bar skad dang yi ge bcas so sor byung nas mi rigs dang rgyal khab zhes pa'i tha snyad cig rim par byung /yi ge ni skad kyi tshab dod cig yin te/ mi rnams phan tshun cung 'gyangs ba'i bar du brda sprod byed dang / dus yun cung ring bar mi brjed pa mtshon byed cig yin pas/ dang po ca dngos kyi tshab mtshon dang / de nas skad gdangs rig pa dang yul lung so so'i khyad chos bcas rim par skad kyi tshab dod cig tu 'gyur nas mi rigs shig gi srog rtsa dang mtshungs pa'i rig dngos shig tu gyur la/ skad yig 'di dar rgyas phyin na mi rigs dang rgyal khab de dar rgyas yong rgyu yin ste/ dper na/ dbyin ji dang de las chad pa a ri bcas skad yig la brten nas da lta 'dzam gling thog gi shin tu cha tshang ba'i rgyal khab cig tu chags yod la/ de'i dbang gis rig gnas dang dpal 'byor/ tshan rig bcas tshang ma de las byung bas 'dzam gling gi spyi skad zhes 'dzam gling rgyal khab tshang mas ma bskul dang blangs kyi sgo nas brtson pa cher skyed mdzad nas sbyangs dgos pa 'di yin/bod kyi skad yig 'di nyid dar rgyas ma phyin par rang mi rigs rang gis ma bsrung na/ da lta rang rer mes po khri yis ches rin thang dang ldan pa'i srog 10

dang gdos pa'i nor bu lta bu'i rig gzhung dang 'dzam gling gi rim pa gnyis par slebs pa'i skad yig cig yod kyang / da lta skyo dgos pa zhig la dgon pa khag gi grwa btsun tsam las/ dus las yol ba'i tshong zog ltar du song nas/grongakhyer khag dang grong gseb du yang rang mi rigs kyi skad yig tshul bzhin sbyangs pa phar zhog cung tsam klog pa yang ngo tsha byed pa'i srol ngan yang dar/bod mi rigs ngo ma zhig yin kyang bod yig klog shes pa ni nyin skar tsam du 'gro bzhin yod la/ tha na bod rigs yin yang bod skad mi shes pa dang /cung shes kyang gzhan skad dang 'dres pa sogs mthong dang mthong bzhin pa 'dis shes nus/ dper na rang rgyal khab gyi man ju rigs 'di nyid lo nyis brgya re brgyad tsam mes rgyal gyi bdag po byas nas srid dbang bzung myong yang /da lta mi rigs de nyid kyi srol rgyun rig gnas phal cher nyams dmas su phyin tshar bas mtshon bzhin yod pa red/ ri11

༄7//bskal bzang sangs rgyas rnams byon nas dam chos dar chul/bskal bzang stong gi zhing mchog 'dzam gling 'dir/bskal bzang mdzad pa bcu gnyis ston mdzad pa/bskal bzang zhing 'dir sangs rgyas rabs bdun sogs/bskal bzang 'dren pa stong la phyag 'tshal lo/'dzam gling las kyi sa pa 'dir bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis byon tshul ni/ spyir 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir mun pa'i bskal ba dang sgron bskal zhes pa gnyis las/ sangs rgyas byung ba sgron bskal/ sangs rgyas ma byon par mun bskal zhes 'bod/ mun bskal ni mang la sgron bskal ni ches nyung / dper na da lta'i bskal ba bzang po 'di'i sngon la mun pa'i bskal ba bzhi bcu byung ba'i rjes su da lta'i bskal ba bzang po 'di nyid byung / bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis byon tshul ni rgyas par mdo bskal bzang /snying rje pad dkar/ gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mdo bcas las byung yang 'di la gsang bsam las stong dang rtsa lnga/ gzhan las stong dang rtsa bzhi zhes gnyis su mchis kyang gzhung so sor gsal bas 'dir ma bris/ da lta'i sangs rgyas rab bdun byon tshul bsdus na/ gzungs chen gyi mdo las/sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs ni rgyal rigs gzi brjid can/ tshe lo brgyad khri'i dus su grong khyer nyer ldan du/ / ka ra bi shi'i shing drung mngon par rdzogs sangs rgyas/ / rgyal ba gtsug gtor mnga' ba rgyal rigs rdzu 'phrul can/ /12

tshe lo bdun khri'i dus na su ka'i grong khyer du/ / shing mchog spun ti'i drung du mngon par sangs rgyas so/ / rgyal ba thams cad skyob ni rgyal rigs blo gros can/ / tshe lo drug khri'i dus na grong khyer mnyam med du/ / shing mchog sā la'i drung du mngon par rdzogs sangs rgyas/ / thub pa 'khor ba 'jig ni mchog ldan bram ze'i rigs/ / tshe lo bzhi khri'i dus na grong khyer mdzes ldan du/ / shi ri sha yi drung du mngon par rdzogs sangs rgyas/ / 'dren pa gser thub gtsang ldan bram ze'i rigs/ / tshe lo sum khri'i dus na grong khyer bde ldan du/ / u dum wa ra'i shing drung mngon par rdzogs sangs rgyas/ / skyob pa 'od srung rgyal rigs bla med yon tan can/ / tshe lo nyis khri'i dus na wā ra nā si ru/ / shing mchog sā la'i drung du mngon par rdzogs sangs rgyas/ / 'gro mgon shākya thub pa rgyal rigs brtson 'grus can/ / tshe lo brgya pa'i dus na ser skya'i grong khyer du/ / a shwa ta yi shing drung mngon par sangs rgyas so/ / zhes mtshan dang /rigs/ shing mchog tshe lo gnas bcas gsal bar ston yod pa dang /sangs rgyas rnams bskal pa yar 'phel la mi 'byung bar mar 'grib kyi tshe lo brgyad khri nas brgya pa'i bar du 'byung ste/ de'i skabs mar 'grib yin pas sems can rnams bde ba nyung la sdug bsngal mang bas yid 'gyur dang nges 'byung skye bar sla bas te/ dbang po rnams la skyo shes che bas nges 'byung gyis bskul nas chos kyi snod du 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/bdag cag gi ston mchog thub pa'i dbang po 'di nyid ni mdo lugs ltar na/ bskal ba grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags/ dga' ldan du dam pa tog dkar gyi skur bstan nas/ skye dgu'i tshe lo brgya pa'i skabs su gzigs pa lnga la gzigs te/ dang po rigs la gzigs pa dang / rus dang / yul dang / cho 'brangs/ dus bcas lnga la gzigs nas/ dang po rigs ni 13

'dzam bu'i gling 'dir thog mar byung ba'i mang bkur ba'i rigs yin te/ de ni dang po mi rnams kyi sa'i zhag dang / myu gu'i tshal dang / ma rmos pa'i lo thog rnams rim par byung nas de la longs su spyad nas de dag la dbang ris gsog 'jog med cing nam dgos su len/ brngas ma thag tu skye ba dang bcud che la bdud rtsi lta bu la longs spyod pa'i skabs/ le lo can zhig gis sang gi kha zas de ring gsog 'jog byed pas/ kun gyis rim par de ltar byas nas/'bru yi 'bras bu de rnams phung sog can du gyur/ de nas ngan pa gcig gis mabyin pa blangs nas de la chad pa gcod pa'i lam bu tshugs nas/ kun gyi gros byas nas gzugs byad dang stobs rtsal ldan pa/ rang bzhin gyi shes rig bkra ba zhig mang pos gong du bkur bar gros byas nas rgyal por bskos/ de'i ming la mang bkur rgyal po zhes 'bod pas 'dzam gling gi rgyal po thog ma de yin par bshad do/ de nas sras sgra gcan 'dzin gyi bar du rgyal po dgu 'bum nyis khri chig stong dgu brgya byon par grags/gnyis pa rus la gzigs pa ni/ tshe lo nyis khri'i dus su sangs rgyas 'od srungakhyon to/ de nas yul gru 'dzin du rgyal po brgya tham pa'i tha ma rna ba can/de la bu gnyis yod pas go'u ta ma dang / bha ra dho dza gnyis las/ go'u ta ma rab tu byung / bha ra dho dza rgyal po byed nas g.yon can padma'i rtsa lag gis mig ser gyi ched du/ smad 'tshong ma 'gro ba bzang mo bsad do/ ral gri go'u ta ma'i mdun du bor nas go'u ta ma bsad do/ de 'chi khar mkhan po mdog nag dang phrad nas dris pa la/ rang la ma nyes pa'i bden pa brjod pas/mkhan po mdog nag gser mdog tu gyur/ ma nyes pa'i tshig bzhin chags pa yid la dran pas sa bon dang khrag gnyis zag pa sgo nga gnyis su gyur nas khye'u gnyis su byung ste/ bu ram shing gi tshal na yod pas bu ram shing pa dang / rjes 14

su phod pa can zhes shākya'i rgyal rigs yon tan drug bcu rtsa bzhi dang ldan pa de'o/gsum pa yul la gzigs pa ni/ mtha' khob tu mi skye ste dus gsum rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas dbus gyur 'chang dang nye ba lum bi ni'i tshal du sku bltams/bzhi pa cho 'brangs la gzigs pa ni/ rgyal po legs pa rab sad kyi sras mo sgyu 'phrul ma'o/lnga pa dus la gzigs pa ni/ rtsod ldan tshe lo brgya pa snyigs ma lnga'i dus te/ dus snyigs ma rtsod ldan/ sems can snyigs pa de'i dus kyi sems can/ tshe yi snyigs ma ni lo brgya man chad/ las kyi snyigs ma mi dge ba bcu kar spyod pa/ nyon mongs pa'i snyigs ma ni gnyen pos mi non pa'o/de ltar gzigs pa lnga la gzigs nas sum cu rtsa gsum dga' ldan lha yi yul nas babs te/ glang chen thal kar gyi rnam par yum gyi skur brten nas/sku 'khrungs pa'i dus ni gdong ngan zhes pa me pho sprel gyi lo'i dpyid zla tha chung te/ sa ga zla ba'i yar tshes brgyad kyi nyin skar ma rgyal la babs par sku 'khrungs so/ yab rgyal pos 'di skyes pas bdag gi don thams cad 'grub pas don grub zhes mtshan gsol/ de dang mnyam par yul dbus kyi rgyal po bzhi'i bu btsas te/ gnyan yod na tshangs sbyin gyi bu gsal rgyal/ rgyal po'i khab tu padma chen po la gzugs can snying po/ ko'u sham bhi na'i rgyal po dmag brgya pa la shar pa'o/ 'phags rgyal du rgyal po rtsebs kyi mu khyud mtha' yas kyi bu gtum po rab snang ngo / byang chub sems dpa' bltams nas zhag bdun na yum 'das te/ sum cu rtsa gsum du skyes so/ sa mtsho ma dang grags 'dzin ma sogs btsun mo'i 'khor gyi bskor/ dgung lo nyi shu rtsa dgu bar khab tu bzhugs nas sum cu la grong khyer gyi sgo bzhir phebs pas/ skye rga na 'chi'i 15

nges par 'byung nas mchod rten rnam dag gi drung du dbu skra bcad nas rab tu byung / chu bo na ra dza na'i 'gram du lo drug du dka' ba spyad nas byang chub shing drung du mngon par sangs rgyas te/ sa ga zla ba'i bco lngar srod la bdud btul/ nam gung la mnyam par bzhag tho rang mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te/ mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa dang lha yi dbang po brgya byin gnyis nas chos dung dang 'khor lo phul nas chos 'khor bskor bar gsol ba btab/ wa ra na sir drang srong lhung ba ri dwags kyi gnas su sngar log lta skyes kyang phyis su ma bzod pas gus par 'dud pa lnga sde bzang po sogs dang /dman pa'i 'dul bya shas che ba la bden bzhi chos kyi 'khor lo dang po de bskor/ de nas gnas bya rgod spungs ri la sogs par byang chub sems pa bye ba phrag la theg pa thun mong ma yin pa bka' bar pa mtshan nyid med pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo gnyis pa bskor/ de nas ri ma la ya dang / yangs pa can la sogs par byang chub sems pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa la/ bka' tha ma theg pa thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa don dam rnam par nges pa gsum bskor ro/chos 'khor gsum po 'di spyi'i dbang du bzhag pa las gnas dang dus rnams gcig tu ma nges te/ chos rje skyob pas chos 'khor rnam gsum 'khor gyi rtogs pa'i khyad gsungs pa ltar 'khor rnams kyi dbang po rno rtul gyis dbang du nges pa las ma yin/ de ltar mdzad pa mtha' dag yongs su rdzogs nas/ me zhes pa me pho 'brug gi lo thub pa'i dbang po nyid dgung lo brgyad cur song nas dpyid zla tha chung sa ga zla ba'i tshes brgyad kyi mtshan mo'i thun bar ma la/ zla ba nub ri'i rtse mor zhugs pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyang bsam gtan gyi ri'i rtse mo las spyod pa dang / zla ba nub par gyur cing bcom ldan 'das kyang yongs su sku mya ngan las 'das par gyur to/ 'jig rten du mun pa gnyis 16

byung bar gyur pa ni/ byis pa so so'i skye bo dag shin tu skyo ba bskyed pa'i phyir du tshes brgyad nam gung mnyam pa la zla ba ri bo nub pa'i tshe/ thub dbang yongs su mya ngan las 'das so/bdag cag gi ston pa thub pa'i dbang po de nyid 'dul bya rtag 'dzin can rnams yongs su bskul ba dang / gzugs sku'i 'gro don dngos de'i 'dul bya rnams yongs su rdzogs kyang / thugs rjes 'gro la chags pas mdzad pa 'phrin las bsam gyi mi khyab par ston pa ni gang zag dbang rab rnams kyi blo ngor gang yang mya ngan las mi 'da' ste/ rtag pa rgyun gyi 'khor lo'i tshul du sems can gyi don mdzad pa'o/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bya ba de thugs rgyud la bzhugs pa'i dgongs pa de yin la/ de 'dzin skyong spel gsum bya rgyu de lung rtogs kyi bstan pa rin po che las 'du khang dang mchod rten lha sku sogs kyis mi 'dzin par sangs rgyas bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan tsam mo/ ji skad du/ ston pa'i bstan pa rnam gnyis te/ lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid do/zhes pas/ lung rtogs bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa 'di gnyis las ni gzhan ni yod pa ma yin no/de lta bu'i bstan pa rin po che 'di khyad par ni phyag na rdor rjes srung sdud skyong ba dang / 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ thub dbang yongs su mya ngan 'da'/ dam pa'i chos ni bsrung ba'i phyir/ de tshe rtag tu ba de ni/ 'jam dpal dbyangs su 'gyur ba yin/ zhes gsungs pas/ 'jam dpal dang phyag rdor tshangs pa bcas kyis bsrung la/ de bzhin gnas brtan bcu drug gis dkon mchog gtsug lag khang gsar du byed pa der sprul pa'i skus byin rlobs shing / mthar tshe lo yar 'phel drug brgya thub pa na de dag yul dbus su 'dus te/ sku gdung rnams la mchod pa mdzad nas lhag med dbyings su mya 17

ngan las 'da' bar gsungs so/ston pa'i gtad rabs/lhag tu thub pa chen po zhal bzhugs skabs ston pas don gyi rgyal tshab tu mnga' gsol ba gtad rabs chen po 'od srung yin la/ des bstan pa lo bzhi bcu bskyangs ba'i tshe/ bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' bsdu thengs dang po de mdzad pa de'i dgos pa ni/ ston pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i snga rol du shā ri'i bu 'khor brgyad khri dang / mo'u 'gal bu 'khor bdun khri dang / de rjes ston pa dang mnyam du rang dbang thob pa 'khor khri brgyad stong mya ngan las 'das pas/ da phyin chad mya ngan las mi 'da' bar khrims bcas nas/ ston pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i phyi lo me sbrul lo rgyal po ma skyes dgras sbyin bdag byas nas n+ya gro dha'i phug tu byon nas dbyar gnas so/ de nas kun dga' bo dgra bcom pa thob nas dgra bcom lnga brgya'i dbus su kun dga' bos mdo sde/'od srung chen pos mngon pa/ nye bar 'khor gyis 'dul ba bsdus so/ 'od srung chen pos kun dga' bo la bstan pa gtad nas shā na'i gos la gtod cig lung bstan nas rten rnams la mchod pa dang bcas ri bo bya rkang gi dbus su mya ngan las 'das so/ston pa'i gtad rabs gnyis pa kun dga' bo ni/ ston pa'i khu bo bdud rtsi zas kyi bu ston pa sangs rgyas pa'i dus su bltams so/ dgung lo drug la rab tu byung nas mdo sde sogs ston pa'i 'khor gyi nang nas thos pa che bar grags la/ dgra bcom go 'phang thob nas mdo sde bka' bsdu mdzad nas 'odasrung chen pos bstan pa gtad/ mthar shā na'i gos la bstan pa gtad nas cho 'phrul sna tshogs dang bcas te mya ngan las 'das so/18

ston pa'i gtad rabs gsum pa shā na'i gos ni/ bltams pa'i tshe shā na'i gos dang lhan cig par batres pas shā na'i gos can du btags te/ rab tu byung nas kun dga' bos bstan pa gtad/ ma gha dhar bzhugs nas bstan pa skyangs/ de na gnas pa'i gnod sbyin mi srun pa yang dam la btags nas zho shas 'tsho ba sogs dgra bcom khri phrag dang / bden pa mthong ba 'bum phrag tsam byung bar grags/ bye brag tu spos tshong sbas pa'i bu nye sbas rab tu byung nas phyis de la bstan pa gtad de mya ngan las 'das so/ston pa'i gtad rabs bzhi pa 'phags pa nyer sbas ni yul bcom brlag gi byang phyogs ri spom chen du spos tshong sbas pa'i sras su 'khrungs nas shā na'i gos dang mjal nas rab tu byung / sde snod dag la mkhas par sbyangs/'gro don bskyangs nas bstan pa 'phags pa dhī ti ka la gtad nas mya ngan las 'das so/ston pa'i gtad rabs lnga pa 'phags pa dhī ti ka ni ston pa 'das nas lo brgya lhag lon pa na grong khyer 'phags rgyal du bram ze'i bur 'khrungs/ mtshan dhī ti ka gsol/ rig byed mang po'i pha rol tu song nas slob ma bram ze lnga brgya tsam dang lhan du gnas pa las/ dus nam zhig na nyer sbas bzhugs par thos/dri ba byed pas shin tu yid ches nas rab tu byung / dgra bcom rnam thar brgyad ldan du gyur nas bstan pa gtad/ tho gar rgyal po bram ze dregs med dang / karma ru pa'i bram ze sogs la gang 'dod ltar du sprul nas chos bstan nas chos rgyun btsugs pa sogs bstan pa rgyas par mdzad/ ded dpon nag po rab tu byung nas de la bstan pa btad nas mya ngan las 'das so/ston pa'i gtad rabs drug pa 'phags pa nag po ni/ ang ga'i yul na khyim bdag 'byor ba can zhig gi sras su bltams/ dhī ti ka las rab tu byung /19

rgya gar gyi yul seng gha la'i gling bcas la 'gro don mtha' yas pa dang / de nas 'phags pa legs mthong la bstan pa gtad nas byang phyogs ku sha'i tshal du mya ngan las 'das so/ston pa'i gtad rabs bdun pa 'phags pa legs mthong yin te/'phags pa 'di ni ston pa 'das nas lo nyis brgya tsam na nub phyogs bha ru katstsha na skya seng gi rigs las byung ba mthong can gyi sras su 'khrungs/ khong chung dus 'byor ba chen po dang ldan zhing / de'i srid 'byor thams cad mchil ma'i thal ba ltar bor nas dgra bcom su ya ka las rab tu byung nas zag grol gyi dgra bcom par gyur/ 'phags pa nag pos bstan pa gtad nas/ srin pos rta dang mi sogs nyin ltar za ba de'i rgyun bcad/ cho 'phrul sna tshogs yang zlog nas dam la btags/ gzhan yang 'dzam bu gling gi yul mang po dang / gling phran gzhan du rdzu 'phrul gyis byon nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa btsugs te mthar 'bar ba la sogs pa'i cho 'phrul du ma bstan nas mya ngan las 'das so/bka' bsdu rim pa/ston pa mya ngan las 'das nas bka' bsdu dang po ni 'od srung chen pos mdzad pa sngar ltar la/bka' bsdu gnyis pa ni ston pa 'das nas lo brgya dang bcu na yangs pa can du chos rgyal mya ngan med kyis yon bdag byas te/ dgra bcom grags pa sogs dgra bcom pa bdun brgyas bka' bsdu ba gnyis pa mdzad/— 'di'i dgos pa ni rung ba ma yin pa'i gzhi bcu dar ba tshar gcod pa'i phyir ro/bka' bsdu gsum pa ni ston pa 'das nas lo sum brgya na kha che'i yul du ka ni kas sbyin bdag byas/ 'di'i dgos pa ni dge slong lha chen po bya ba shes 20

rab shin tu rno ba zhig yod pa de bdud kyis byin gyis brlabs nas sangs rgyas chos lugs dang mi mthun pa'i lta ba mang po spel zhing de'i dbang gis sde pa bzhi dang bco brgyad du gyes/ de'i dus der dgra bcom pa lnga brgya/ byang chub sems dpa' lnga brgya/ so skye'i pan ṭi ta drug stong 'dus nas bka' bsdu gsum pa byas so/theg chen gyi bka' bsdu ni/ rgyal po'i khab kyi lho phyogs bi ma la su bha ba zhes pa'i ri la rgyal sras 'bum phrag bcu 'dus te/ 'jam dpal gyis mngon pa/ byams pas 'dul ba/ phyag na rdo rjes mdo sde bsdus so/de ltar gtad rabs chen po rnams nas/ rgyan drug mchog gnyis grub thob brgyad cu sogs rim par brgyud nas/ 'dzam bu gling 'dir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nam langs pa la nyi ma shar ba lta bu 'di byung ba'o/de rnams ni mtshan nyid rgyu yi theg pa'i bstan 'byung lam trem song zin to/zab mo lta brgyud/da ni theg pa chen po'i bstan pa'i rim pa dang rgyud 'dzin bcas ston pa ni/ zab mo lta brgyud 'di nyid mnyam med thub pa'i dbang pos lang kar gshegs pa'i mdo las/ lho phyogs be ta'i yul du ni/ dge slong dpal ldan cher grags pa/ de ming klu zhes 'bod pa ste/ sogs dang / 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ de bzhin gshegs pa nga 'das nas/ lo ni bzhi brgya lon pa na/ / dge slong klu zhes 'bod pa 'byung / / lo ni drug brgya dag tu 'tsho/ /zhes sogs lung gi zin pa 'phags mchog klu sgrub pa chen po 'di bee dha'i yul du sku 'khrungs/ 'jigs pa las sgrol phyir rab tu byung nas rig gnas kun la mkhas par sbyangs/ gser 'gyur gyi rtsi bslabs nas dge 'dun rnams kyi 21

'tsho ba'i sdug bsngal las sgrol/ klu yul du phebs nas chos gsungs pas klu rnams bde la bkod nas/ 'dzam bu gling 'dir chos sgra lan gsum bsgrags/'chad rtsod rtsom gsum/ bstan pa'i zhabs tog sogs yun ring mdzad nas lhag tu zab mo dbu ma'i lta ba 'bul du gtod/ rgyal bu bde spyod kyi sras kyis dbu blangs nas sku gshegs/thun min ltar na slob dpon 'di nyid 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi rjes su bzung ba yin/ de'i slob ma zla ba grags pa dang / de'i slob ma rig pa'i khu byug che/ de'i slob ma rgyal sras rig pa'i khu byug gnyis pa'i zhabs yin te jo bo rjes dbu ma'i lta ba rnyed pa'i bla ma dam pa de yin no/rgya chen spyod brgyud/rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab rgyal ba byams pa mgon pos rjes su bzung nas rgya che ba sa lam gyi rnam bzhag sogs rgyas par bstan pa byams pa'i chos sde lnga gsan nas/ sa sde lnga sogs kyi bstan bcos mdzad nas rgya chen spyod pa'i srol gtod/mdzad pa po ni slob dpon thogs med nyid yin la/ de'i dus su rgya gar na nang bstan nyams pa rnams rtsa ba nas gsos te dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/slob ma'i mchog ni gcung dbyig gnyen yin/ khong ni dang po gcen la ma dad kyang phyis su slob mar gyur nas mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob/ bka' theg pa che chungagi mdo kun bsdoms pas lnga brgya tsam thugs la mnga'/ sa phyogs gang sar chos gzhis gsar du mang po brtsigs nas byams chos khag la 'grel ba dang slob mas sa steng gang bar mdzad nas bal yul du dge slong zhig gis chos gos gyon nas zhing rmo ba gzigs pas gtsug tor rnam rgyal gyi sngags lugs ldog tu bzlas nas sku zhi bar gshegs/22

byams pa'i byin rlabs 'phags pa rnam grol sde ni/ 'phags mchog dbyig gnyen gyis rjes su bzungs nas sreg blugs 'bum phrag bcu gnyis phul bas byams mgon kyi zhal gzigs/ nyi khri'i rnam 'grel sogs mdzad nas mya ngan las 'das/ lung rtogs yon tan phun tshogs mchog gi sde/ zhes bsngags pa'i slob dpon 'di nyid 'phags pa rnam grol sde'i rjes su 'jug nas mngon rtogs rgyan las 'byung ba ltar sgrub pa la rtse gcig mdzad nas mngon du gyur/ sher phyin mdo sde rgyan dang sbyar ba yang mdzad nas 'phrin las mtha' yas so/lhag pa'i lha yis rjes bzung dul ba'i sde ni/ slob dpon mchog gi sde yongs 'dzin du bsten nas thos bsam phul du phyin/ lhag tu rgyal yum sher phyin la rang byan chud/ rje btsun mi pham gyi sku bzhengs nas gsol ba btab pas gsung byon/ yi dam arya ta rer lung bstan nas gzhan don lhun gyis grub te rgyal bstan gsal bar mdzad pas bka' drin shin tu che/rgyal yum sher phyin don mdzad rnam snang mdzad/ ces pa mkhan chen byang chub sems dpa' zhi ba 'tsho ni/ za hor rgyal po'i sras su sku 'khrungs/rgyal srid la ma chags par nā la drar rab tu byung / thos bsam phyogs med du mdzad nas slob dpon thogs med kyi lugs gsan par bzhed nas dul ba'i sde'i zhabs la gtug theg chen gyi lam zab rgyas shing rta gnyis kyi lam srol ya ma bral bar dgongs nas dbu ma rgyan dang de'i rang 'grel bcas brtsams/bod du rgyal po'i khri rabs so gcig pa chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyis spyan drangs so/lung rig smra ba'i nyi ma seng ge bzang po ni chung nas khyim la chags pa spangs nas bstan la rab tu byung / rang gzhan gyi grub mtha' kun la sbyangs 23

nas mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho la bsten nas shing rta gnyis kyi gzhung la thos bsam mdzad/ byams pa'i sgrub thabs zhus nas rje btsun gyi zhal mjal/ rgyal po dharma pa lā sbyin bdag byas nas sher phyin gyi 'grel ba don gsal brtsams/brgyad stong 'grel chen/ nyi khri bsdus pa sogs bstan bcos dpag tu med pa mdzad pas thar 'dod skyes bu rnams kyi mig gcig gorgyal ba'i man ngag kun 'dzin rin chen bzang zhes pa ni rab tu byung nas slob dpon seng ge bzang po bsten nas mdo sngags kun la mkhas par sbyangs/ mchog gi go 'phang dam par gshegs pas na ku sā li zhes grags so/bdag gzhan mnyam rjes thugs mnga' rin chen sde zhes bsngags pa 'di nyid rab tu byung nas sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi bcas nyams su blangs nasazab rgyas ring lugs gnyis kyi lam srol gcig tu dril nas chu bo'i rgyun bzhin bskyangs pas rtogs pa mngon du gyur nas rje btsun byams mgon zhal gzigs/ the tshom gyi mtha' rgya las grol nas jo bo rje'i zhabs la gtugs/mtha' 'khob bstan pa'i sgron me gser gling pa zhes bstod pa 'di nyid gser gling rgyal po'i sras su sku 'khrungs/ der bstan pa la gus pas rab tu byung nas yul dbus rdo rje gdan du byon/ mi bkres pa zas 'tshol ba ltar phyogs med du btsal bas slob dpon mahā shri ratna zhes pa slob dpon du bsten nas dam pa'i chos kun la thos bsam mdzad/ 'phags mchog byams pa'i zhal gzigs nas gsan bsam phyogs med mthar phyin te gser gling du phebs/ sde snod gsum sogs rgya cher spel bas grags pa'i snyan pa 'dzam gling kun tu ldir bas jo bo rjes lo bcu gnyis la gdams pa rdzogs par mdzad/mthar slob tshogs dang bstan pa shin tu rgyas nas sku zhi bar gshegs pa dang bcas rags rims tsam mo/24

༄khya//kha ba'i ljongs kyi snod bcud ji ltar byung chul/sa 'dzin go la'i rtse mo tog ltar mdzes/'byung khams dwangs shing chu bo kun gyi 'go/gzhung drang chos kyi 'tsho zhing snying rje che/lha gcig phyag na pad mor lan brgyar 'dud/kha ba'i sa 'dzin gyi phreng ba dkar pos yongs su bskor ba'i lha mchog phyag na padmo dngos kyis 'dul zhing 'dir/ snod kyi 'jig rten sa gzhi dang bcud kyi 'gro ba mi la sogs pa'i sems can rnams byung tshul ni/ shin tu gsal bar bod kyi mkhas dbang gong ma rim byung rnams kyis mdzad pa'i lo rgyus deb ther khag dang chos 'byung rnam thar bcas las gsal bar gsungs pa rnams la gzigs par 'os kyang / 'dir rten 'brel gyi dbang gis sa bcad ma stong tsam du smos pa ni/ches snga ba'i gangs ri'i zhing 'di chu yi bkang ba'i yol go zhig dang mtshungs pa mngon pa gong 'og nas gsungs pa ste/ rlung gi rdo rje rgya gram dang /de'i steng bdud rtsi chu yi zil ma/ de'i steng dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi 'di nyid grub pa la rim bzhin char chus gang pas yul go zhig tu chags/ dus rabs gsar ma'i 'go tshugs nas rim bzhin skam sa'i sa gzhi 'di grub/ de yang stod kyi mnga' ris skor gsum rdzing gi tshul zhes gsal ba'i chu rnams rim bzhin bri ba'i sa ris rnams gsal por mngon la mtsho dang mtshe'u bcas shin 25

tu mang bas da lta yang mthong rgyu yod/ bar du dbus gtsang ru bzhi yur ba 'dra/ zhes pas/ chus gang yol ba lta bu yod pa las/ kong gi chu brlag ces pa rgya la rba don kha bye nas chu rnams de ru thim/ smad du mdo khams sgang drug zhing lta bu zhes/ chu re dang sgang re bcas nub nas shar du babs pas de ltar bkod pa las/ sngon dus su/ stod la mnga' ris skor gsum/ bar la dbus gtsang ru bzhi/ smad la mdo khams sgang drug ces pa'i ru bzhi/ skor gsum/ sgang drug zhes pa'i ming de chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i skabs su ma byung yang da lta'i gnas de rnams su sngon dus de ltar yin zhes bkod pas dang po'i bod kyi sa gzhi'i grub stangs de ngo sprod gsal bar byas pa las dang po nas stod smad bar gsum gyi ming ni grub med/dus rabs gsar ma'i 'go tshugs nas skam sa'i sa gzhi 'di rim bzhin 'byung ba'i mthun sbyor la brten nas rtsi shing sna tshogs skyes pa lha yi dga' tshal lta bu zhig grub pa niklu chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston las/mnga' ris bskor gsum shā rkyang ri dwags gling / bar gyi ru bzhi stag gzig gcan gzan gling / smad kyi sgang drug 'dab chags bya yi gling zhes pas/ chu gnas rigs khag gcig skam sar 'tsho bas rkang pa dang ldan zhing gzugs 'gyur gyi 'go tshugs/ de skabs tsha khul dang mtshungs par de'i dus kyi bod khams kyi sa gshis gsal bar bstan yod de/ bod kyi stod khul du shin tu yid du 'ong ba sa rong 'jam zhing mu med kyi rtswa thang zhig yin pa dang / bar gyi ru bzhi ni ri brag mtho la bar bar du ne'u thang rtsi shing sogs kyis rgyan pa zhig yin pas/ de'i dus su yar klung gi khul ni da lta ltar bye ma'i thang dang brag ri bye ma can 'di 'dra ma yin par nags klung dang rtswa thang gi khengs pa'i mdzes 26

ljongs shig yin par shes nus/ smad kyi sgang drug 'di bya tshogs kyi gling zhes pas bya tshogs kyi sdod gnas zhing la ljang bu skyes pa ltar sgang gshong med pa nags kyi khengs ba'i sa gzhi zhig yin/sngon dus su mtsho gling yin pas da lta gter sgrom brag dkar dang / de bzhin bod byang gi sa cha kha shas la 'gyur rdo'i dung dkar dang rkyang sug pa gsum ldan sogs srog chags kyi rjes shul mthong rgyu shin tu mang / de'i rjes su bal bod kyi mtshams su hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud 'di 'bur du don 'go tshugs/bod yul 'dir gnam gshis 'gyur ldog byung nas nub dang byang khul gtsos pa'i sa cha khag gcig gnam gshis grang ba dang gangs ri'i rwa bas yongs su skor pa'i 'go tshugs nas da lta'i sa cha'i gnas babs 'di byung /bod yul 'dir 'gro ba mi'i rigs byung ba thog mar spre'u byang chub sems dpa' dang / brag srin las byung ba sogs lam tsam zhig gong du zhus pa dang / de nas 'phel rgyas byung rim ni/ bod kyi sa gzhi 'dir gcan gzan ri dwags kyi gling phran lta bu'i nang nas da lta rgyud stong pa'i srog chags shin tu mang ba dang gzugs 'gyur gyi srog chags kyang de bas mang / rkyang sug pa gsum ldan de rnams hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud 'bur du ma thon pa'i skabs kyi ri dwags shig yin/ de ltar gcan gzan dang ri dwags mang po mnyam du gnas pa'i khrod du cung shes rig bkra ba'i spra mi khag gcig rim bzhin mnyam gnas ri dwags dang gcan gzan mang po las rnam par rgyal nas gnas gcig tu sdod pa dang mjug ma dang lus la spu sogs med par gyur/ da lta'i mi dang phyogs mtshungs nyin re bzhin 'gyur/ gcan gzan rnams phan tshun gcig sha bza' shing gcig khrag 'thung ba'i goms gshis de rgyun mar gnas 27

nas bod srin po gdong dmar zhes 'bod/ phyis bod 'dir rigs gsum mgon po'i rnam 'phrul chos rgyal mes dbon rnams gsum gyi bka' drin las/dang po shi gson gyi dge rtsar dmigs nas log las la rang nyid kyi dpal 'byor dang stun nas srog chags mang po'i srog gcod pa'i srol bsnubs/dam pa'i chos kyi bka' drin las srog gcod kyi bya ba dngos su rtsom mkhan je nyung du song nas rim bzhin dkar zas la spyod pa'i ya rab kyi spyod pa rnams nyin bzhin 'phel ba'i 'go tshugs/ spra rigs de rnams mi lo dpag tu med pa'i nang shes rig 'phel rgyas phyin nas skad yig dang / ngo tsha'i gos dang grang skyob khang pa bcas 'tsho ba'i dgos mkho rnams rim par gsar btod byas/ gdod ma'i mi'i rigs ni spra mi yin pa tshan rig pas ra sprod byas nas ya mtshan du brtsi yang rang re bod 'dir ches snga mo nas lo rgyus khag gi nang du mtha' gcig tu 'khod yod/spu rgyal gyi rgyal rabs/pha rgan spre'ur byang sems snying rje che/ma rgan brag srin ma ni las la brtson/bu phrug rigs bzhi shes rig rnam par bkra/gdong dmar bod kyi rigs rgyud gcig par shes/pha sprel rgan dang ma brag srin gnyis nas chad pa'i mes po spra tshogs de dag ches dka' tshegs che ba'i 'byung ba'i sa gzhi chen po 'di'i klong 'dir/dus yun gang mtshams phyin nas srog chags gzhan las lhag par 'tsho thabs su rdo chas dang lcags chas/ rdzo chas rnams rim pas dar 'phel byung nas/28

stobs rtsal dang shes rig bkra ba 'ga' dang 'gas yul tsho dang lung tsho bzungs nas dgra gnyen gyi lta bas chags sdang gnyis dar/ bod 'dir dang po dbang mdzad bcu gnyis dang / rgyal phran bcu gnyis/ de rjes sil ma bzhi bcu bcas byung nas phan tshun gcig 'og gcig gis ma 'dus par dgra 'thab kho nas mi rnams bde ba'i go skabs 'ga' yang ma mchis pa'i skabs su byung ba rgyal po gnya' khri btsan po ni spyi lo'i gong gi shing bya ste 117lo spu bo'i yul na/ bya mo btsun bya ba'i sras su sku 'khrungs/ sku byad legs la nus pa che bas mi rnams 'jigs nas lha ri gyang mtho'am kong po bon ri'i nye 'dabs su sgyugs pas yar klung gi mi 'ga' dang 'phrad pas khyad mtshar nas gdan drangs/ rgyal por mnga' gsol bas bod kyi mthu nus che ba'i rgyal phran 'ga' chabs 'og tu bcug rgyal phran rnams kyi nang nas dbu rmog mtho la rus tsho'i dbar gyi 'gal zla de med pa bzo rgyu'i 'go tshugs pas/ bod kyi rgyal la snga ba gnya'akhri batren po zhes 'bod/ rje 'di'i sku ring du bon chos rnams bsgyur nas sku gshen mtshe mi smu rgyal dang / co mi phyag gar gnyis kyi byas pas rim bzhin rgyal rabs 'og ma rnams la de ltar dar ro/de'i sras rgyal rabs gnyis pa mu khri btsan po/ rje 'dis zhang zhung nas bon la mkhas pa mang po gdan drangs nas bon gyi 'du gnas bzhi bcu zhe lnga tsam bzhengs/ rgyal rabs gsum pa ding khri btsan po/ rgyal rabs bzhi pa so khri btsan po/ rgyal rabs lnga pa de khri btsan po/ rgyal rabs drug pa khri spe btsan po/ rgyal rabs bdun pa gri gum btsan po yin te/ rje 'di sku bon dang blon po'i bar chab srid kyi 'gal bas grir bkum/ 'di yan la gnam gyi khri bdun zhes 'bod/29

spu rgyal gdung rabs brgyad pa spu de gung rgyal ni/ yab gri gum btsan po dang yum bal gza' khri btsun gyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ yab dkrongs nas sras sha khyi dang nya khyi zhes ming btags nas kong po'i yul du bros/ lo ngam gyis rgyal srid bzung kyang dmangs gyen log gi 'og khyi'i spu dug gis grongs/ de'i 'og blon po phan tshun 'khrugs nas ru las skyes kyi pha tshan rnams pham nas de'i chung ma sbrum ma gcig por bros/ bu de skyes nas bus pha dang dpon dris nas rgyal po'i spur btsal nas bang so brtsigs/ sras dang 'phrad nas sha khyis dmag drongs nas lo ngam gyi rgyal sa 'phrog spu rgyal gyi gdung rabs zin/ spu de gung rgyal zhes 'bod la sras nya khyi kong por bzhugs pa des rgyal po mdzad/'di gnyis la stod kyi steng gnyis zhes 'bod/ blon ru las skyes ni 'phrul blon mdzangs mi dang po de yin pas gser dngul bzhu ba dang / zhing rmo ba'i thabs shes sogs bskrun pa dang chu la zam pa btsugs/rgyal rabs dgu pa tho legs batren/ 'di'i ring blon lha bu mgon dkar gyis zhing la dor kha dang 'brog la thul rtsis/ zhing la chu drangs nas chu ma rmo ba'i srol dar/ 'di ni 'khrul blon mdzangs ma gnyis pa zhes 'bod/rgyal rabs bcu pa sho legs btsan/ gdung rabs bcu gcig pa go ru legs btsan/ gdung rabs bcu gnyis pa 'brong zhi legs btsan/ gdung rabs bcu gsum pa thi sho legs btsan/ gdung rabs bcu bzhi pa i sho legs btsan 'di'i dus su blon rig pa can gyis rgyal rgyud tshang ma rgyal por gyur na 'gran zla mang bar shes nas de'i nang nas gcig rgyal sar bkod nas gzhan rnams blon 'bangs las dmigs su yod pa zhig byas nas 'jog pa'i srol btod/ 'di yan drug la sa yi legs drug zhes bang so g.ya' dang spang 30

la btab bo/ gdung rabs bco lnga pa za gnam zin lde/ gdung rabs bcu drug pa lde 'phrul po nam zhung batren/ gdung rabs bcu bdun pa btsan po se rnol nam lde/ gdung rabs bco brgyad pa btsan po lde gol/ gdung rabs bcu dgu pa gnam lde rnol po/ gdung rabs nyi shu pa btsan po bse lde rnol po/gdung rabs nyer gcig pa btsan po lde rgyal po/ gdung rabs nyer gnyis pa btsan po rgyal srin btsan 'di rnams ni gdung chu la btab pas bang so med pas chu la lde brgyad zhes 'bod/gdung rabs nyer gsum pa rgyal to re longs btsan/ gdung rabs nyer bzhi pa khri btsan nam/ gdungatshorabs nyer lnga pa khri sgra spungs btsan/gdung rabs nyer drug pa khri thog btsan/ gdung rabs nyer bdun pa lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan dgung lo brgyad cu'i thog la pho brang yum bu bla mkhar du/spang skong phyag rgya dang / gser gyi mchod rten/ mdo sde za ma tog snying po yi ge drug ma bcas byung nas nang pa'i chos kyi dbu brnyes/ 'di ni bod lugs ltar na gdod ma'i chos lugs de rnams gnam dang byed po la dga' bas gnam las babs zhes grags kyang / dus skabs de'i yas mas su rgya gar gyi chos rgyal rnams kyis mtha' 'khob tu chos spel khyer pho nya yang yang mngags srol 'dug pa de'i chos blon dang paṇa ṭi ta blo sems mtsho dang / lo tsā ba li thi sis rgyal po la phul bar bshad/ nyan bshad sogs ma byung yang mchod pas bkur bas rgyal po'i dbu skra yang nag por gyur/ tshems yang skyes nas dgung lo brgya dang nyis shu thub pa yin zhes grags/gdung rabs nyer brgyad pa khri gnyan zung btsan/ gdung rabs nyer dgu pa btsan po 'bro gnyen lde ru/ gdung rabs sum cu pa btsan po stag bu 31

gnyan gzigs ni yab 'bro gnyen lde ru'i sras su 'khrungs nas yum gyi sbal pa bzhes pas yab mdze nad phog nas sras kyang mig med par skyes/ yab kyi bka' ltar 'a zha'i sman pas spyan phye nas nye 'dabs kyi rgyal phran 'chims dang ban pa dwags po sogs 'ga' zhig dbang du bsdus nas dbu rmog btsan/gdung rabs so gcig pa gnam ri srong btsan ni yab stag ri gnyan gzigs kyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ tshe spang bza' 'bri ma thod dkar khab tu bzhes/ rgya nag las sman rtsis dar bar grags/ zing po rje dbang du bsdus/ khyung po spung zad kyis rtsang bod kyi rgyal po bkrongs nas btsan po'i 'bangs su phul/dwags po ngo log pa blon seng ge mi chen nas chams la phab/ 'di dus dpal 'byor/ dmag don/ rig gnas sogs 'phel rgyas gang zab yod pa mtshon thub/ btsan po rang nyid rus tsho gcig gyur bya ba'i khrod du dug gis bkrongs/mnga' 'og gi tsho pa rnams sngon kyi bag chags kyis rang 'dod ltar yong ba'i sger tsho re chags thub rgyu'i re ba bcangs nas lkog g.yo rgyun ma chad par byung ngo /bod btsan po'i rgyal rabs/nor bu dbyig gis khengs pa'i go la yi rtse mo/sha rus gcig kyang phan med rang rgyal gyi dmag 'khrugagangs ri dbang mdog gyur pa'i srol ngan de bcad nas/spun zla la rgya can gyi nub med kyi lugs bzang /shes rig ldan pa nam mkha' yi skar tshogs/dpa' mdzangs ldan pa sa gzhi yi rtsi thoganub med lo rgyus yar chab kyi gtsang po/32

btsan po'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam po de 'dud do/'dzam bu'i gling chen lnga na snyan pa'i grags pa'i ba dan dkar po lhab lhub tu g.yo ba'i btsan po'i rgyal po/ thun min dag pa'i snang bar lha gcig phyag na padmo mi yi tshul bzung ba dang / gangs can 'gro ba kun gyi bdag po ya rab bden pa rdo rje'i tshig gi bka' srol gser gyi phreng ba sa 'dzin sgeg mo'i 'gul du mdzes par byed po ni/ spur rgyal gdung rabs so gnyis pa btsan po'i rgyal rabs 'dzugs mkhan rgyal po srong btsan sgam po de nyid me mo glang gi lo spyi lo 617la dbu ru stod mal gro pho brang byams pa mi 'gyur du sku 'khrungs/sku mdog dkar la mtshan bzang gi spras pa gzhan dang mi 'dra bas bskyed stobs che/ sngon yab mes rnams kyis chab 'og tu rgyal phran 'ga' zhig bcug kyang chab srid brtan po ma byung ba dang / zhang zhung dang sum pa chab 'og tu 'jug rgyu'i tshig tsam las don la ma gnas pa'i skabs der yab sku gshegs/sras dgung lo bcu gsum la blon po rnams kyis gser khrir mnga' gsol/blon po zhang snang gtsos bka' gros nas thabs mkhas pa'i sgo du mas nang 'khrugs dang g.yo zhus mkhan re re ltar tshar bcad/ yab zas dug 'bul mkhan rnams chad pas rtsad nas bcad/ yab mes kyi chab srid la ngo log tshang ma slar yang chab 'og tu bkug dmangs la gnod pa'i dmag 'thab sogs ma dgos par sum pa yang mnga' 'og tu bcug btsan po sku dngos kyis phebs nas rgya dang 'a zha yis kyang dpya' khral phul/ rgyal sa skyid shod kyi dmar po rir spos/ khyung po spung sad kyi g.yo jus las rgyal nas khyung po rang srog bcad/ btsan po lo na gzhon yang mkhas mdzangs dang ldan zhing thugs sgam pa dang / blon stong btsan yul zung ni yi ge mi mkhyen yang shes rig bkra bas bod kyi stobs 'byor ni khong rgyal blon gnyis la brten pa dang / blon 33

tshogs rnams kyis rgyal thabs kyi bya ba sna tshogs spel nas rus rgyud tsho pa rnams rang bzhin gyi mnga' 'bangs su bkol/ de'i dus su bod kyi sa char btsan po'i rgyal rabs dang 'gran nus pa ni zhang zhung yin la sring mo sad ma dkar ra gnang yang g.yo thabs la ma tshud par/ btsan pos zhang zhung la dmag drongs nas mnga' 'bangs su bskor bas mnga' ris zhes ming chags/ bod gcig gyur gyi chab srid brtan pa'i ched du/ ru lnga/ stong sde drug cu re gcigakhod so drug mi chos gtsang ma bcu drug sogs khrims srol mang po gzhan las dpe blangs pa dang / yul babs dang bstun nas bcas pas rgyal khams bde ru bcug sngon gyi rus rgyud tsho pa'i dbar gyi yun ring dmag 'khrug gi sdug bsngal las grol nas gling 'dir ches sngon thon 'gran med kyi rgyal khab cig tu gyur thob pa byung / rje 'dis bod du dmo pa'i chos dang shes rig dar phyir rgya bal nas jo bo rnam gnyis gdan drongs nas de yis bzhugs yul tu gtsug lag khang dang / ra mo che bcas bzhengs nas/ dmar po ri steng du mkhar dgu brgya dang dgu bcu go dgu rtse mo dang bcas pas stong dang ldan pa bzhengs/bod yul du mtha' 'dul la sogs gtsug lag khang brgya rtsa dang / rgya gar mkhas pa ku sa ra dang / bram ze shang ka ra/ kha che ta nu/ bal po shī la man dzu rnams gdan drangs nas/ bod kyi lo tsā ba sam bho ṭa dang / dharma ko sha/ lha lung dpal rdor sogs nas/ mdo dkon mchog sprin dang / lang kar gshegs pa sogs dpag tu med pa bsgyur nas dam pa'i chos kyi bstan pa nyin mo ltar gsal ba sogs mtha' yas/ de ltar mdzad bzang bla na med pa la brten nas da lta'i bar du mi rnams kyis brjed du med pa'i mdzad spyod la gus bkur dang dran gso yang yang zhu gi yod/mtha' bzhi'i rgyal khab khag gi rig gnas rnams nang du 'dren phyir/34

shar phyogs thang gi sras mo 'un shing kong jo dang bal po'i sras mo khri btsun sogs btsun mo lnga khab tu bzhes nas mi rigs de rnams kyi rig gnas dang dmag don chab srid dpal 'byor bcas nang 'dren byas nas phyi yi tshong 'dus rnams nang du drangs nas shes rig gong mthor btang / rje blon 'di rnams kyi phyag rjes bla na med pa ni bod yig gsar btod gnang ba de yin te/btsan po srong batren sgam po nyid khri bzhugs mdzad sgo'i skabs mtha' skor rgyal khab dang rgyal phran rnams kyis legs skyes snyan tshig dang bcas 'byor bas rang re la yi ge med pas shin tu nongs nas/ skad yig med na yun ring brtan pa'i btsan po'i rgyal rabs zhig 'dzugs pa dang chab srid dang /dpal 'byor/ dmag don/ mi rigs zhes pa'i tha snyad med par mkhyen nas/bod blon rig pa can rnams bskul bas/ shes rab mchog tu gyur pa thon mi snyan grags kyi sras thon mi sam bho ṭas dka' ba brgya phrag spyad nas rgya gar rig pa'i khab tu phyin/ lha rig seng ge gtsos mkhas pa mang po bsten nas bod yig gsar btod mdzad/ slar bod du phebs nas btsan po sogs rim par de la sbyang brtson byed/ thon mis bod kyi skad dang mthun pa'i sgra gzhung brgyad mdzad/ spyan ras gzigs kyi skor sogs dam pa'i chos mang po bsgyur/bod la thon mi'i sngon du yi ge yod med skor la mkhas pa rnams kyis lta tshul sna tshogs shig gsungs kyang zhang zhung la shes rig de 'dra zhig yod pa'i dbang du btang na yang / de'i skabs su spu rgyal gdung rabs kyi rgyal po ni zhang zhung lta zhog dbus gtsang tsam las chab 'og tu 'dus med pas/ de'i skabs su spur rgyal gyi mnga' khongs su ga la 'grangs/ dper na klu'i spang kong gi dbur ltar na/ zhang zhung gi skad du zhes dang / sum pa'i skad du/ bod skad du zhes bris pa'ang 'gar snang bas/ gcig tu bgrangs bar mi sems snyam/ de ltar ches 35

dkon pa'i mdzad 'phrin bla na med pa bskyangs mus su/ 'phan yul zal mo sgang gi 'od zer dam pa'i pho brang du mgur cham log te/ lcags po khyi yi lo spyi lo 650la sku gshegs/sras gung srong dang mang btsan gnyis las gung srong gung btsan chung ngu nas gshegs/ btsan po'i rgyal rabs gnyis pa gung srong gung btsan ni yab srong btsan dang yum 'a zha za mang po rje khri dkar gnyis kyi sras su me rta lo spyi lo 646la 'khrungs/ dgung lo bzhi la yab 'das nas khrir phebs chab srid mgar gyis bskyangs/ gru gu'i don rgya bod bar 'khrugs pa shor/ dgung lo so dgu la gshegs/btsan po'i rgyal rabs gsum pa btsan po 'dus srong mang po rje ni yab mang srong dang yum khri ma lod gnyis kyi sras su me byi spyi lo 676btsan po grongs pa'i lo der 'khrungs/ lo gsum nas mnga' gsol/ bod du ja dang dkar yul sogs dar/ blon po mgar gyi bu rgyud dang ma mthun par 'thab pas de rnams pham par byas/ rgyal po 'di'i sku ring la rtsal po che bdun byung /mthar 'jang yul du sku gshegs de dus dgung lo nyer bdun yin/ rgyal po 'di'i dus bod lta bu dpa' ba/ rtul phod pa/ rgya'i rgyal rabs rnams la yang ma byung zhes krung go'i thang deb gsar rnying las kyang byung ngo /btsan po'i rgyal rabs bzhi pa khri lde gtsug ldan mes ag tshom ni/ yab 'dus srong dang yum mchims bza' btsan me tog gnyis kyi sras su shing 'brug spyi lo 7rkya4lor sku 'khrungs yab 'jang yul du sku gshegs/ btsan po'i phyi mo 'bro bza' khri ma lod kyi srid bskyangs/ nang 'khrugs dang gyen log las rgyal/ gong ma'i rgyal rgyud kyi sras mo gyim shing kong jo bod du btsun mor bsus/ khrang an du rta rtsed spo lo'i rgyal kha blangs/ btsan po 'di dus 36

'khrugs kyi dbang gis blon po 'bal ldong tsab dang / lang myes gzigs gnyis nas shing rta lo 754la bkrongs/btsan po'i rgyal rabs lnga pa khri srong lde'u btsan ni yab khri lde gtsug ldan dang yum sna nam bza' mang po rje'i sras su chu pho rta'i spyi lo 742lor sku 'khrungs dgung lo bcu gsum la srid bzung / 'phrin las phyogs brgyar bskyed cing bod yul du chos srid gnyis la 'gran zla dang bral ba'i phyag rjes gzhag yab dkrongs mkhan rnams dmag gis pham par byas nas slar yang mtha' mtshams rnams su dag ther dang rgya bskyed mdzad nas rgya'i gong ma'i pho brang yang nyin bco lnga tsam bzung / 'dzam gling rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan zhes don la gnas par lhor chu bo gang gā/ nub stag zig byang du gru gu'i pha mtha' bar du chab 'og tu bcug yab kyi dus su dam chos po ti mang po drangs kyang chos ma dar/ btsan po khri srong lde btsan gyis rgya gar mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho gdan drangs nas dam chos 'dul ba'i bstan pa spel/ sad mi mi bdun rab tu byung nas bod du rab byung gi dbu brnyes/ be ro tsa na gdan drangs nas rdzogs chen gyi chos bka' rnams bod du dar/ sa gsum na mthu nus 'gran zla dang bral ba'i slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas gdan drangs nas dam pa'i chos la bar du gcod pa'i lha srin ma rung ba rnams dam la btags/ bsam yas sogs lha khang brgya rtsa bzhengs/ de rnams su 'chad nyan dang / ka cog zhang gsum sogs lo tsā ba dpag tu med pas mdo sngags kyi chos mtha' yas pa bsgyur bas da lta'i bar du bka' bstan rnams mjal thob pa ni chos rgyal de'i thugs bskyed las byung ba yin no/ jo bo rjes bstan pa 'di lta bu rgya gar la yang ma dar zhes gsungs/ rje 'di'i sku ring la bod du 'chi skyob gso ba rig pa'i lha rje g.yu thog rnying ma sogs byung bas bod la 37

dka' drin che/ mthar dgung lo nga lnga me glang spyi lo 797lor zur mkhar phyig ma tshal du byon lo der sku gshegs/ bang so mu ra ri srong btsan bang so'i mdun ngos su yod/btsan po'i rgyal rabs drug pa lha sras mu ne btsan po ni yab khri srong lde btsan dang yum tshe spong bza' me tog sgron gnyis kyi sras gnyis pa chu pho stag gi lo spyi lo 762lor sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo nyer gsum la khrir 'khod/ bon dang nang chos dbar 'gal ba rno ngar can du phyin te/ yab khri srong lde btsan gshegs pa'i 'das mchod sus byed ma 'chams par gnas pas bon rnams gral 'gor ma tshugs pa dang / rgyal po'i mi ltas sogs las chos byed par bkas bcad/ de phyin ngan song sbyong ba'i kun rig dang gtsug tor dgu'i cho ga bcas las shid byed/ khro bo nyi ma la brten nas mi grir shi ba la gri 'dul sogs mdo sde gzhung dang sbyar nas mdzad/ bod du ltogs phyug snyoms pa'i dgongs pa gtad kyang / yab kyi bka' ltar btsun mo chung ba pho yong bza' thugs la bcags pas yum gyis dug phul nas grongs/btsan po'i rgyal rabs bdun pa sad na legs sam khri lde srong btsan ni yab khri srong lde btsan dang yum tshe spong bza' gnyis kyi sras su me pho 'brug gi lowī lo 776sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo nyer gsum la khrir 'khod/ nyang ban chen pos gang phan zhabs 'degs byed/ ra sa'i gtsang chu'i lho ngos rgyal sde skar chung gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ yab mes kyi gtsug khang rnams nyams gso dang zhabs tog gnang / dge 'dun gyi dbu 'phangs bstod/ mtha' yi so kha bsrung / me skyogs sogs thon bskyed gong 'phel shin tu che/ rgyal po 'dis bkas bcad nas sgra sbyor bam gnyis sogs mdzad/ mthar shing mo lug gi lo spyi lo ṭwāṃ15dgung grangs bzhi bcu par sku gshegs/38

btsan po'i rgyal rabs brgyad pa khri lde gtsug ldan ral pa can ni yab khri lde srong btsan dang yum 'bro bza' lha rgyal mang po rje'i sras su chu rta spyi lo 〈02lor sku 'khrungs/ dbu skra bsil bar mi spro bas mtshan ral pa can tu thogs/ yab mes dam pa rnams dang mtshungs par mtha' mtshams sra brtan dang / rgya bod dbar dmag 'khrugs thengs mang byas/ mthar rgya bod gnyis kyi pho brang dang sa mtshams la bka' gtsigs kyi rdo ring btsugs nas 'doms mdzad pas 'phral phug kun tu bde ba'i mdzad rjes bla na med pa bzhag snye smad bod kyi ri bo rtse lnga'am brag dmar zangs yag gi nye 'dabs su lha khang dgu thog can bzhengs nas 'on dor bkra shis dge 'phel gtsug lag khang zhes mtshan gsol/ yab kyi mchod gnas lo pan rnams sngar ltar gong du bkur nas/ sngon ma bsgyur ba'i chos mang du bsgyur/ chos byed rnams la gus bkur dang sri zhu bla na med pa zhus pas dam chos dar ba'i rtser song / btsan po srong btsan sgam po dang / btsan po khri srong lde btsan/ btsan po khri ral pa bcas la chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum zhes rigs gsum mgon po'i rnam 'phrul du 'dzin pas bskal mtha'i bar du bod mi rigs kyi mi shig snying gi ze'u 'brur gnas par nges/ mthar lcags sprel spyi lo ra40la pho brang du log smon can gyi blon ngan 'gas zhal ltag par dkyus nas sku gshegs/spu rgyal gdung rabs bzhi bcu dang btsan po rgyal rabs dgu pa khri dar ma u dum btsan ni yab khri lde srong btsan dang yum 'bro bza' khri mo legs gnyis kyi sras su shing mo lug gi spyi lo rdo15sku 'khrungs/ yab mes dang 'dra ba ya rab spyod pa ldan zhing nang chos la sbyangs/ phug mo che'i lha khang bzhengs pa dang gcen grongs pa'i mjug tu dgung lo nyer lngar gser khrir mnga' gsol/ bod yul stod smad mtha' dbus tshang ma bde bar 'khod pa'i bya ba 39

sgrub pa'i thugs bskyed yod kyang / dkar yol bsrung phyir g.yang khri chag pa'i dpe ltar/ chab 'bangs rnams spyi sems med par rang 'dod kho nas spyod ngan log pa dang / rgyal kha blon gyis bsgyur na/ blon ngan ci bshad zer ba'i dpe ltar/ bod spyi'i bsod nams nyams pas mtha'i so kha srung ba'i dpon rnams rtag chu chad pa'i rdzing bu ltar gyur nas/ so kha rnams shor/ ko ba me yi sregs pa dang mtshungs— bar mtha' bzhi rnams 'khum/ lo pan rnams rang yul du phebs/ gtsug lag khang rnams zhabs tog ni med/ rtsa che'i rten dang dpe cha srung skyob gang thub byed kyang 'ga' zhig rgyud stong / thabs shes dman pa dang blon po rnams sems la gdon zhugs pas/ 'dzam gling 'dir gcig gyur gyi bod btsan po'i rgyal rabs de nyid 'ja' ltar yal/ rgyal po rang yang gling log gi 'og tu chu phag spyi lo ṭwāṃ42lor sku gshegs/btsan po 'u dum btsan gyi sras 'od srung dang yum brtan gnyis las 'od srung ni/ yab 'u dum btsan dang yum btsun mo chun ma tshe spong bza' btsan mo mkhan gnyis kyi sras su chu khyi lo spyi lo ra42lor yab kyi khri lo gsum par pho brang yum bu bla mkhar du sku 'khrungs/ dkon mchog mi spangs ba'i rten gyi drung du skyabs 'gro blangs/ sras gnyis pa mnga' bdag yum brtan ni yab 'u dum brtan dang yum chen ma sna nam bza' gnyis kyi sras su chu mo phag gi lo spyi lo shrī42la sku 'khrungs lo der yab gshegs/ mtshan khri lde yum brtan du gsol/ dkon mchog la dad cing skyabs 'gro blangs/ mi byi lor yum brtan gyis dbu ru/ 'od srung gis g.yo ru bzung nas 'thab rtsod lo bcu gnyis tsam byasanas mthar 'od srung gi phyogs khag pham nas mnga' ris dang lho mon du bros/ dus 'khrugs 'di gtso bo yum chen gnyis dang de'i blon phyogs khag bar rgyal srid la ma mthun par rtsa rgyud then pas ri sna gog pa'i dpe ltar gyur 40 —

nas/ mang tshan dang nyung tshan byas nas sngar gyi sil ma bzhi bcu ltar du gyur ba'i 'go tshugs/ gser pa dang g.yu pa/ rtsam zan dang sha zan zhes pa'i tha snyad dar/ lhag tu rgyal sras dgung lo nyer gsum la slebs skabs 'bangs kyi gyen log dang po mdo smad nas byas pa dang / dbus su 'gro sbas 'khrugs/de nas bzung bod yul stod smad bar gsum drag po'i gyen log bar med byed/btsan po'i bang so 'dru ba'i 'go brtsams/ me bya lo shud bu stag rtse sogs bzhi gros nas bang so bgo bsha' byas/ srong btsan bang so ni sngo bzhir 'dru 'phro lus/ de min don mkhar mda' dang seng ge can sogs grengs 'phyo bcas tshang ma brus/ dus 'di nas bzung bod khams spyi la dbang ba'i btsan po ni med la rgyal rgyud rnams rim bzhin kha mthor ya mthor du gyur nas stod la gu ge spu rang ya rtse sogs dang / smad la tsong kha rgyal po/ chos blon mgar gyi rgyud las sde dge rgyal po bcas chags pas de rnams kyi rgyal rabs su gzigs par 'tshal/de'i dus su ltas dang cho 'phrul sna tshogs byung bas jo bo mched gnyis dang byams pa chos 'khor bcas khri la bkod/ chos pa yin zer rang rtags rang gis len/ shams thabs gong ba can dang skra gzhan bregs nas gtsug phud bzhag pa dbyar zla gsum dbyar gnas zer nas gtsug lag khang du gtan khrims lnga bsrung / dgag dbye zer nas grong la khyim thab byed/ ming dgra bcom gtsug phud can du 'bod nas skye bos mchod gnas byed/ mi dar ma shi na 'bum/ gzhon pa la nyi khri/ byis pa la brgyad stong 'don/ klog mkhan shes rab che ba 'gas gzhung gi 'grel ba bklag nas dmar po 'di don bsdus par 'dug nag po 'di rgyas su 'chad par 'dug yig chung 'dis de la dog pa dpyad par 'dug zer nas rtsal bshad byed pa bag re byung /41

sngags pa yin zer sgrub thabs 'chad nas sgom pa med pa bon chos ltar byed/gzhung ngag 'don byed nas grong chog 'grim/ sbyor sgrol dang bam sgrub dar bas mi la gson sgrol byed pa dang / lta sgom cha ma tshang ba ya 'thor du byung bas chos tshul tsam pas 'tsho ba don gnyer byed pa gang sar khyab ces pas/ dus zing tshabs che ba dang yun ring du song bas chos lugs tshul bzhin shes mkhan gyi rgyun chad nas/ dpe gzhung tsam la ltos nas nyams su len pas phan yon tsam dang sgra dgongs pa can la ji bzhin spyod pas/ mdo sngags gnyis kyi nyams len la gol nas lta sgom spyod gsuyoya bral kho na las ma grol pa dang /chos dpe dang lha khang nang rten bcas bsdad yod paṃs de rnams la bsrung bskyobs thob pas/ dmag 'khrug de'i kha gtad dam pa'i chos la ma yin pa de bas gsal/ dper na yun de tsam ma dgos nye char lo bcu'i nang shin tu skyo ba'i gnas tshul 'dis rtogs thub/ bod spyir dbang ba'i rgyal po zhig ma byung kyang dbus gtsang khri skor bcu gsum la dbang bsgyur ba ni dpal ldan sa skya pa yin te/ de'i bar du bod btsan po'i rgyal rabs mthor zhig du gyur nas gcig gyur gyi nus pa gang la yang med par sil bur thor nas tsho khag dbar sngon gyi rgyal phran sil ma bzhi bcu'i skabs ltar dmag 'khrugs mu mthud byung nas sdug bsngal gyi khor mo yug tu spyod par gyur/ de'i skabs chos lugs kyi lta ba yang ma dag pa mang bas mnga' ris kyi btsan po lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyis ma dag pa'i lta ba sel ba'i phyir/ nags tsho lo tsā btang nas jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha gdan drangs nas rgyal bstan la shin tu dag par mdzad pas ming bka' gdams pa zhes grub mtha'i srol dod/ sngon mdo sngags nyams len ya bral ba dang zab don ma shes pas spyod pa tho co byed pas/ rgyal ba'i bka' thams cad gcig tu go nas 'gal med nyams len gyi gdams pa go ba zhig 42

mdzad pas bka' gdams zhes grags/ de dang dus mnyam bka' brgyud pa'i srol gtod pa mar pa lo tsā la sogs lo tsā ba mang pos dka' ngal tshad med spyad nas rgya gar du phyin nas bshad sgrub gnyis kyi bstan pa bod yul 'dir dar bar mdzad/ rgyal po'i bka' bcad med pas mi re chos re dang chos re la lugs mang po dar nas phyis su bshad sgrub shing rta bco brgyad du grags par byung / sil bu'i dus 'di nas bzung chos yang sil bur 'gyur ba'i 'go tshugs/ de nas dbus gtsang khul du chos lugs rnams dar rgyas shin tu che ba byung nas sa ris grwa rgyun dang bcas bdag gir 'dzin pa'i srol dar ba dang / chos lugs la brten nas chab srid sra brtan gtong rgyu'i bya thabs sna tshogs dar nas bla chas dang dpon chas gses pas/ ston pa thub pa'i dbang po'i bstan pa 'di lta ba rten cing 'brel 'byung / spyod pa 'tshe med zhi bde yin kyang / phan tshun re dogs dbang gis dmag 'khrugs sna tshogs byung ba dang / phyis su yang phyi rabs rnams la bag chags ngan pa mang po byung /bod chu stag lo spyi lo 11ra2hor jing gir rgyal po 'khrungs/ khong gi mi rgyud ni/ rgyal po gri gum gyi sras nya khri'i rgyud pa yin zhes sog po'i chos 'byung yongs la rlung ltar grags/ yab dpon chung zhig yin pas gzhan gyi dug phul nas grongs/ khong yang nyes rdung sna tshogs myong ba las thar nas mthar rang la snying nye ba'i sde 'bangs gcig sbrel byas/ yon rgyal rabs btsugs nas mthar hor rgyal po'i gcung po tho lo no yon gyis e chen go dan gyis dmag dpon rdor tha chis dpung dang bcas bod yul du btang / lam bar du 'gog rgol mkhan la gtor bsreg dang / 'gog rgol mi byed mkhan la sa khongs dang go gnas rang 'jag gi thabs jus gnyis bed spyad nas dpung 'jug byas/43

bya yul dgon mer bsreg nas grwa pa lnga brgya tsam srog bcad/ 'bri gung du slebs pas de'i dus su bod dbus gtsang gnyis la chos srid gnyis kar dbu 'phangs mtho ba'i 'bri gung sgom pa kun rin nas 'gog rgol byas kyang ma thub/sgom pa rang yang hor dmag gi lag tu tshud/ spyan snga rin po che grags pa 'byung gnas kyis dun thang du rdo char phab pas hor dmag rnams mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob/ hor dmag rnams tshong 'grul las 'jam par byung bas bod la shin tu bka' drin che/ de nas go dan gyi bka' ltar lam ston mig 'byed kyi bla ma gdan 'dren par bka' phab pas/ spyan snga rin po che gdan 'dren par 'dod kyang thabs mkhas kyi sgo nas lung rigs la mkhas pa sa skya paṇa ṭi ta gdan 'dren pa'i jus 'god mdzad/ sa pan dgung lo 62gangs ljongs kyi don du hor yul du phyin nas bod kyi 'gro ba rnams mi 'jigs skyabs kyi sbyin pa gnang / 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pas spyi lo 1252chu byi lo kyi rdor rje'i dbang chen rim bzhin lan gsum bskur ba dang / bod khri skor bcu gsum gyi bdag por dbang bskur nas/ 1264lor rgyal sa pe cing du spos/'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa chol gsum bod kyi do dam par bsko bzhag gnang / chol gsum gyi dpon por bsko ba la mchod yon lhan rgyas nas thag gcod/ 'gro mgon 'phags pa sku gshegs nas sa skyas khri skor bcu gsum tsam las chol gsum spyi la ma dbang / 'di nas dpon rabs bdun dang mi lo 96srid kyi kha lo bsgyur nas mthar rim bzhin phag gru pa'i lag tu shor/bod btsan po'i rgyal rabs 'thor nas 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa'i bar lo ngo bzhi brgya nyi shu rtsa gcig bar sil bur lus pa dang / dbus gtsang su 'di nas bzung khri skor bcu gsum gcig sdud kyi lam lugs tshugs par byung / 'on kyang lho mon/ 'bras ljongs/ 'brug pa/ la dwags/ mdo 44

khams lho byang rnams kha thor gyis so sor sger tshugs su gnas pa las bod hril po gcig gyur gyi srid dbang gtan nas ma tshags pa'i lo rgyus 'di byung ba yin ///rdo/ ri pa chol kha gsum/bod chol ka gsum zhes pa 'di ni 'gro mgon chos rgyalu 'phags pa'i sku dus su byung ba'i bod kyi mdo dbus kyi dbye srol zhig yin par 'dod/ yul mnga' ris gung thang man nas sog la skya bo yan dam pa chos kyi chol kha/ sog la skya bo man nas rma chu khug pa yan mgo nag mi yi chol kha/ rma chu khug pa man nas rgya yi mchod rten dkar po yan dud 'gro rta yi chol kha zhes 'bod/ chol zhes pa'i tshig la da phan 'grel bshad dang go ba sna tshogs shig len zhing / kha shas kyis phyogs kha zhes bris snang / chol zhes pa ni bod skad yin na brda rnying la snod kyi ming du 'bod/ phyogs zhes pa ni bod yul tsho gsum dbye ba'i phyogs re la go dgos snyam/ 'on kyang de'i skabs khrims lugs dang / zla ba'i tshes grangs/ lo gsar/ dpon chas/ khrims lugs/ khral don dang /khri skor dud rtsis sogs mes po dam pa'i goms srol dang chas gos dor nas sog po'i las zlos gang thub ci thub byed pa'i skabs su song bas/ chol zhes pa de sog skad kyi sgra zur zhig yin las che ste/ dper na skabs der mi dpon dar sman bod la yong nas sa skya dang nang sa'i bar 'grim 'grul bde phyir sog skad du 'ja' mo zhes sa tshigs sgrig gzhi btsugs shing / skabs der rmado smad la sa rong tsub pas 'ja' mo bdun/ mdo stod la sa rong tsub pas 'ja' mo dgu/ dbus la bdun bcas btsugs zhes pas bod kyi yul srol la ma gzhig par nang sa nas sa skya'i bar srid 'dzin gyi sgrig gzhi 'am sa tshigs chen po gsum du dbye ba'i ming zhig yin par sems/ sog po'i rgyal pos 'gro mgon 45

la snga rjes su dbang yon rim pa gsum phul ba'i nang du/ dbus gtsang chos kyi chol kha dang / mdo stod mi yi chol kha/ mdo smad rta yi chol kha phul zhes pa ni/ rgya bod yig tshang chen mo deb ngos 27〈las/ mi rta chos gsum gyi 'bul ba'i lugs su phul zhes pas/ dper na da lta dar tshab zhes sgor re gnyis 'ga'i 'bul ba ltar/ 'jig rten na grags che ba mi rta chos gsum gyi dod du phul pas mdo dbus stod smad kyi spyi dpon lta bu bsko ba zhig yin pa las/ mdo stod smad gnyis la dam pa'i chos med pa dang / dbus gtsang gnyis la mi rta gang yang med pa zhig ni ma yin/ chol gsum gyi nang du bod kyi mnga' khongs yongs rdzogs tshud med de/ dbus gtsang chos kyi chol ka ni yul mnga' ris gung thang nas sog la skya bo yan zhes pas/ dung dkar tshig mdzod deb ngos 760las/ mnga' ris gung thang ni/ mnga' ris mang yul gung thang rje mi la ras pa 'khrungs yul skya rnga rtsa yod sa de yin zhes gsungs pas/dbus gtsang gnyis las stod mnga' ris skor gsum tshang ma tshud med pa dang /de min dper na 'brug pa/ 'bras ljongs/ bal yul gyi sa cha khag gcigamanga' ris kyi lho phyogs/ de min mon pa/ shar pa/ lho pa/ steng pa yod kyang da lta mi rigs gzhan du 'gyur ba'i nyen dang do dam med pas yin pa la yin pa'i 'du shes yang 'dzin mkhan med par 'gyur 'go tshugs/ 'gro mgon zhal bzhugs skabs bod chol gsum dpon chen rnams mchod yon bka' gros nas bskos la/ 'gro mgon mchog zhing du phebs rjes sa skya'i dpon chen rnams dbus gtsang gi khri skor tsam las ma dbang pa 'dra/46
