༄khya//bstan pa phyi dar skabs kyi 'dul ba'i sdom rgyun khag gsum/gangs can kha ba'i ljongs kyi zhing khams 'dir/ngur smrig rgyan 'chang tshul khrims dri bsung 'thul/bslab gsum bstan pa'i rtsa ba 'dul ba'i sdom/'dzin dang spel ba'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/bod 'dir dang po mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho las sad mi mi bdun rab tu byung ba dang / de las smad 'dul gyi rgyud pa ni bod du gling log byung nas dmar shākya mu ne dang / g.yo dge 'byung / gtsang rab gsal gsum dpal chu bo ri nas thon te mnga' ris rgyud hor yul du phebs/ de nas rim bzhin khams rma lung dan tig shel gyi yang dgon du byon/ bla chen dgung lo nga bzhi la mkhas pa mi gsum dang mjal nas rab tu byung zhing bsnyen rdzogs mdzad/mtshan dge ba gsal du btags/ mi nyag go rong seng ge grags dang mjal/'dul ba gsan nas lung sde bzhi bstan bcos dang bcas pa gnang / kwa 'od mchog grags pa khams su phebs pa la/ 'bum ṭig dang byang sems sa la sogs pa theg chen skor lo bcu gnyis gsan/ slob bu spa gor ye shes g.yung drung dang / de'i slob ma grum ye shes rgyal mtshan/ de'i mkhan bu klu mes sogs dbus gtsang gi mi bcus dbus su phebs nas lha khang khag dang gnas gzhi rnams bzung nas bstan pa gsos/ lde'u chos 'byung las/ mal gro ba lha 47

lung rab 'byor dang rong ston seng ge grags gnyis kyi yer ba nas 'dul mdo gnyis kyi dpe cha mang po khyer nas nags shod du bros/ lha lung gis zla shod tshal gyi dgon pa bzung / rong ston gyi byang tsha bye rong gi dgon pa bzung zhes dang / chos 'byung me tog sbrang rtsi'i snying po las/ zla shod tshal gyi rong du dbus pa mi drug dang ha shang gnyis te brgyad po 'tshogs nas lha lung gis mkhan po byas/ rong ston dang gatreng gis las kyi gsang sde'i slob dpon byas/gzhan rnams dad dge mdzad nas bsnyen par rdzogs par byas so zhes gsungs pas/ nags shod bye ma nang du dgon shul che ba gcig dang / zla thang gi g.yas g.yon du dgon pa yod pa rjes su dpyad par bya la/ zla shod du bsnyen rdzogs mdzad pas zhes khong rnams shod chen bco brgyad kyi stod smad du phebs bzhugs mdzad nas bstan pa gsos snyam/stod 'dul ni chos rgyal btsan po'i gdung rgyud 'od bsrungs kyi rgyud pa la/ stod kyi mgon gsum las bar pa bkra shis lde mgon gyi sras srong nges bstan pa stod nas dar phyir thugs bskyed bzang pos/ mtho ling gtsug lag khang bzhengs nas/ khye'u blo rno ba rnams rgya gar du btang / kha che pan chen dharmapa la spyan drangs nas pa la rnam gsum sogs mang du bsnyen par rdzogs/de las byung ba'i rgyud pa rnams las rim par dar/kha che pan chen shākya shri ri'i sdom rgyun ni/ 'phags yul du ta sig dmag gis nang bstan nyams dmas btang skabs su pan grub rnams sa mthar bros/dus der spyi lo 12rkya4rab byung gsum pa'i shing byi lor kha che pan chen dgung lo don lnga la 'khor pan chung dgu dang bcas bal bod sa mtshams gro mo steng du bzhugs skabs/ khro los spyan drangs nas glang mo cher 'dul ba me tog phreng 48

rgyud gsungs/ chu shul sprog ma dgon du mi bcu la bsnyen par rdzogs nas pan chen bi bhu tsan dra 'bri gung du mngag nas chos skyes me tog phreng ba phul/ de las byung ba bod du 'dul ba'i mnga' bdag tshogs pa sde bzhi byung / dpal 'bri gung pa 'phrin las bzang po'i bar chos lung tshogs pa nas gdan 'dren zhus nas bsnyen rdzogs mdzad/ bstan pa snga dar la lo tsā ba sam bho ṭa sogs mkhas grub gnyis ldan mang po byung / bstan pa phyi dar gyi skabs su bod du skad gnyis smra ba'i lo tsā ba shin tu mang zhing / lo chen rin chen bzang po nas bzung lo tsā ba brgya dang lnga bcu rtsa brgyad byon/ lo tsā ba rnams kyis rang srog dang bdos nas dka' ba brgya phrag gi ri brgya klung stong brgal nas mdo sngags kyi chos tshul zab mo rnams bod rang gi skad yig gi thog tu phabs pas bod du bstan pa dar ba lta bu 'dzam gling gang du yang ma byung ngo /49

༄//bod dar chos brgyud grub mtha' khag gi byung rim/gsang sngags rnying ma ba ni rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi skabs su dar ba gong du song zin nas de la bstan pa snga dar gsang sngags rnying ma ba zhes 'bod/ jo bo bka' gdams pa'i bstan pa ni/ sngon yul mnga' ris rgyal po dang gar log gnyis ma mthun par g.yul 'gyed pas rang phyogs pham nas rgyal po btson du bcug gar log gis khyed dkon mchog spangs nas phyi rol par zhugs na tshe thar btang / de min na sku lus dang mnyam par gser byung na srog la mi 'tshe bar bshad pas/ dbon po byang chub 'od sogs dbus gtsang gi rab byung rnams kyi lag nas gser khral bsdus kyang dbu'i tshad tsam zhig ma lon/ ye shes 'od kyis nga rgas pas ci yang mi phan/ gser des jo bo rje sogs mkhas pa rnams spyan drangs nas mtho lding dang / bsam yas sogs yab mes kyi gtsug lag khang rnams gso bar bskul nas skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya ma nyams par khrims mun du sku gshegs pas/ snyan pa'i ba dan srid rtser bsgrongs bas dkar phyogs pa rnams spobs pa skyes/ chos rgyal byang chub sems pa'i bka' ltar rgya brtson seng ge dnge nag tsho lo tsā gnyis phebs/ bod du dge 'dun gyi sde rgyas shing / mdo rgyud kyi mkhyen pa che yang lag len la ma 'khyol bas jo bo rje phebs par zhus nas/ lcags 'brug lor zhabs btegs/spyi lo 1042rab byung dang po'i chu rta lor mnga' ris gung thang du phebs nas mdo sngags kyi lta spyod ya ma bral bar byang chub lam sgron la sogs mdzad nas ma dag pa'i lta spyod thams cad tshar bcad/ bka' gdams pa ni jo bo rjes 50

srol gtod/ 'brom ston rin po ches srol phye/ sku mched gsum gyis dar zhing rgyas par mdzad zhes grags la/ de la rgyud pa gsum byung ba ni/ dge bshes po to ba nas sha ra ba la rgyud pa bka' gdams gzhung pa dang / dge bshes spyan snga ba nas bya yul ba la rgyud pa ni bka' gdams man ngag gi rgyud pa/dge bshes dgon pa ba nas dge bshes sne'u zur pa la rgyud pa bka' gdams lam rim rgyud pa bcas rim par byung bas bod kyi bka' srol chos brgyud yongs kyi rtsa bar gyur/'gro mgon bka' brgyud pa ni/ yan lag bdun ldan zung 'jug rdo rje'i sku brnyes chos sku rdo rje 'chang chen zhabs la dngos su btugs pa ni rje btsun te lo pa nyid yin zhing / spyi lo kha〈〈sa bya lor sku 'khrungs/ rdo rje 'chang gis dngos su rgyud sde'i man ngag rnams gsungs te rjes su bzung ba yin/ 'on kyang blo dman rnams the tshom sel phyir du bka' babs bzhi yi bla ma bsten zhes pa ni/ klu sgrub dang ma tang gi las pha rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa dang rdzogs rim rim lnga dmar khrid/ gdan bzhi'i rgyud man ngag dang grong 'jug rnams bka' babs dang po'o/ tsarya pa la sgyu 'phrul chen mo rdzogs rim dngasgyu ma sum gnyis/ sgyu lus kyi skor rnams gsan pa bka' babs gnyis pa'o/ la ba pa las rgyud sde mtha' dag gi dgongs pa'i don 'od gsal dang bsre ba'i skor gsan pas bka' babs gsum pa'o/ bskal ba bzang mo las dgyes pa rdo rje'i bshad rgyud dang / gtum mo gtso gyur chos drug gsan pas bka' babs bzhi pa'o/ de ltar nyams su blangs pas mchog gi go 'phang dam par gshegs so//rje na ro pa ni kha che'i yul du spyi lo 992chu 'brug lor sku 'khrungs/khab tu bzhugs tshe sgra tshad sogs gsan nas rig pa'i gnas la byang bar 51

mdzad/ nges 'byung drags pos rab tu byung nas sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi la mkhas shing na len tra'i byang sgo bsrung ba'i paṇa ṭi ta chen por gyur/bdag ni paṇa ṭi ta gyur kyang / sems ni ba 'jo ba'i tshad tsam yang mi gnas zhes sems la dbang 'byor ba'i bla ma btsal dgos dgongs nas/ lhag pa'i lha mchog 'khor lo sdom pas lung bstan nas shar phyogs su te lo pa 'tshol du phyin/ dka' chen bcu gnyis la sogs spyad nas te lo pas slob ma las kyang yang slob bzang bar lung bstan nas srid pa bar ma dor mchog gi dngos grub thob/ de'i slob rgyud ni rang las che bar grags pa bdun/ yun ring bstan pa'i bu bzhi/ bla ma brnyes pa'i bu bzhi sogs mang ngo /skad gnyis smra ba'i rgyal po mar pa lo tsā ba ni lho brag chu khyer du yab mar pa dbang phyug 'od zer dang / yum rgya sa 'od de zhes pa'i sras su rab byung gnyis pa'i chu byi spyi lo 1012lor sku 'khrungs/ rnam rig bkra la khro gtum che zhing chang rtsod la dga' ba zhig byung / dgung lo bcu gsum la 'brog mi lo tsā'i drung du chos zhus lo tsā bslab/ rgya gar du 'gro ba'i bsam pa shar nas bal po dang rgya gar du snga phyir lan gsum tsam phebs/ na ro ba dang me tri ba gnyis kyi gtsos pa'i bla ma brgya rtsa bsten nas rgyud dang rgyud 'grel gdams ngag lag len gsan pa rnams mtha' gcig tu nges par dka'/ nā ro dang me tri ba gnyis kyi byang phyogs bstan pa'i rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur/ rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag tu gyur nas/ bsil ldan ljongs 'dir sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i ring lugs 'gro mgon bka' brgyud pa zhes bstan pa'i srol gtod/ gsang sngags gsar ma'i bshad brgyud dang sgrub brgyud kun kyi bdag po'o/ spyi lo 1rkya97me glang lor sku mya ngan 'das/ slob ma'i gtso bo rngog chos rdor la bshad rgyud gtso bo gyur pa'i rgyud 'grel gyi bka' babs/52

mes ston tshon po la 'od gsal gtso gyur bde dgyes gsang gsum bka' babs/ 'tshur ston dbang nge la 'pho ba gtso bo gyur ba'i bka' babs/ gung thang gi mi la ras pa la gtum mo gtso bo gyur ba'i bka' babs bcas yin/skyes mchog mar pa lo tsā ba'i thugs sras rje btsun mi la ras pa de nyid yab mi la shes rab rgyal mtshan dang / yum myang bza' dkar rgyan gnyis kyi sras su spyi lo 1rkya40rab byung dang po lcags 'brug lor sku bltams/ ming sring gnyis yod pa las yab grongs/ a khu dang a nes sdug sna dgu btang zhing lan du mthu btang bas dgra bo rnams tshar bcad/ nges 'byung gis bskul nas lho brag mar pa'i mtshan thos pa tsam gyis mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob/rje mar pa'i zhabs la btugs nas yid chad chen po bdun dang snang chung mang pos tshar bcad kyang log lta skad cig tsam yang ma skyes/ mthar gdams ngag zab dgu yongs rdzogs thob nas rim bzhin rtogs pa'i sa lam yongs su rdzogs/ lo bzhi bcu tsam sku lus sgom thag dang ma bral bar sgom/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i sgrub gnas brag dkar rta so sogs phyi yi rdzong drug mchong lung khyung rdzong sogs nang gi rdzong drug rgya brag gnam rdzong sogs gsang ba'i rdzong drug skyid phug rdzong dang spo tho rdzong ste yang rdzong gnyis/ gnya' nang grod phug sogs yongs grags kyi phug chen bzhi/ rtsa'i rkang tshugs phug sogs ma grags pa'i rdzong bzhi bcas mang / thugs sras zla ba lta bu'i ras chung / nyi ma lta bu'i dwags po lha rje/ ras pa brgyad/ rnal 'byor pho mo bdun/ mchog gi rnal 'byor pho mo gsum/ gong gi thugs sras ni/ nye sras brgyad/ ston pa drugartogs ldan brgyad/ chos 'brel thob pa khri 'bum sogs sgrub brgyud bstan pa nyi ma shar ba ltar gsal bar mdzad/ rje btsun mi la'i mtshan thos te dad pa skyes pa la skye ba bdun du ngan 'gro las grol nas skye ba dran par zhal bzhes 53

mdzad/ tshe gcig lus gcig rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob nas spyi lo 1122rab byung gnyis pa'i chu yos lor dgung lo gya gcig thog rta zla'i tshes bcu bzhi la chu dbar sprul sku'i pho brang du sku mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul ston/sku gdung dang ring bsrel rnams lha mi rnams kyi mchod gnas su spyan drangs so/thugs sras nyi ma lta bu dwags po lha rje ni/ 'das dus byang sems me tog zla mdzes/ thub pa'i spyan sngar zla 'od gzhon nu zhes grags pa'i bla ma dam pa de nyid spyi lo 1༷79sa lug lor ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas gnyal du bod snyi ba'i gdung las sku 'khrungs/ 'phags yul mkhas pa skye med sogs las yi ge sgra sman rtsis sogs rig gnas la mkhas par sbyangs/ lhag tu yab dang bi ji la sogs gso 'dzin slob dpon sum cu tsam bsten nas yan lag brgyad pa'i gzhung lag len dang bcas pa mthar phyin/ btsun mo bzhes nas sras ming sring gnyis 'khrungs kyang snga rjes su sku gshegs/ 'khor ba la skyo shas dang bcas mar yul ba blo ldan shes rab kyi drung du bsnyen par rdzogs/de nyid las bde mchog dang phag mo sogs gsan/ dbu ru 'phan yul du dge bshes sha ra ba dang / rgya yon bdag snyug rum pa sogs nas lam rim dang sems bskyed zhus/ mdo ting 'dzin rgyal po ltar sa thob pa'i rtags dang mtshan ma shar/ dbu rur bka' gdams pa'i grwa sar bzhugs skabs sprang po'i gtam gyis bskul te rje btsun mi la dang mjal/ mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob nas rje btsun gyis bka' gdams pa la gdams ngag yod kyang man ngag med gsungs nas dpal 'khor lo bde mchog dang phag mo'i sgo nas smin par mdzad nas rje btsun gyi gdams pa rnams bum pa gang byos kyi tshul du gnang nas/ man ngag la sgro 'dogs chod/ mtshan dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa 'dzam gling grags par gsol/ lo drug 'o de gung rgyal du sgrub par bzhugs/ rgyal 54

ba'i lung gis bsngags shing bla ma'i lung bstan pa'i gnas shar dwags la sgam por byon nas zangs lung du sgrub pa bya dgos dgongs kyang / mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan la brten nas bstan pa spel/ bka' phyag chu bo gnyis 'brel gyi bstan pa'i srol btod nas slob ma rgyud 'dzin bzhi sogs sgom chen mang po bskyangs te/ rje dus gsum mkhyen pa las kam tshang bka' brgyud/ 'ba' rom pa las byang du 'ba' rom bka' brgyud/ zhang g.yu brag las tshal ba bka' brgyud/ 'gro mgon phag mo gru pa las phag gru bka' brgyud dang /grub thob bzhi/ nye ba'i sras bzhi/ bu chen bcu drug sogs las gangs ri'i ljongs su ngur smrig rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i sdes gang ba 'di byung / mthar spyi lo 1152chu bya lo ston zla bar ma'i nya la mngon dga'i zhing khams su gshegs/rje karma pa sku phreng dang po dus gsum mkhyen pa'am khams pa dbu se mchog spyi lo 1110lcags stag lor sku 'khrungs/ dpal sgam po pa'i drung nas bka' brgyud pa'i chos bka' yongs rdzogs zhus nas sras kyi thu bor gyur nas kam tshang bka' brgyud pa'i srol gtod/ 'ba' rom bka' brgyud 'gro mgon dar ma dbang phyug ni spyi lo 1127me lug lor sku 'khrungs nas mnyam med dwags po'i sku mdun nas gdams ngag rnams zhus nas grub pa thob pas 'ba' rom bka' brgyud bya ba byung / zhang 'gro ba'i mgon po g.yu brag pa ni spyi lo 112 2chu yos lor mtshan dpe'i bzhad/ rga lo dang dwags sgom tshul khrims snying po dang mjal te dam chos tshul bzhin nyams su blangs nas grub pa thob pas tshal pa bka' brgyud pa'i srol gtod/mnyam med dwags po'i thugs sras sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig gi rnam 'phrul/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus na bcom ldan mi bskyod rdo rjer 'gyur ba 'gro ba'i mgon po phag mo gru pa de nyid ni mdo khams sde dge 'bri lung me shod du yab we 55

na a thar dang yum btsun ne bya ba'i sras su rdo rje rtse dgu pa'i rnam par zhugs nas spyi lo 1110lcags stag lor sku 'khrungs/ lhan skyes kyi yon tan mnga' bas ma bslab par lha bris la mkhas zhing skye gnas dran/ rab tu byung bas mtshan rdo rje rgyal po zhes gsol/ khams sa dge ba'i bshes gnyen bca drug ri ri sa ri tsam bsten nas dgung lo bcu dgu par dbus su phebs/ stod lung rgya mar sogs dge bshes du ma'i zhabs la gtugs nas gzhung rnams gsan nas bsnyen par rdzogs/ mkhyen pa che zhing zla dang bral ba'i mkhas par gyur/ pu rang lo chung dang rga lo tsā sogs mjal nas bde mchog la sogs dbang bka' dang rgyud bshad gsan/ sa chen las lam 'bras gsan nas ngo sprod mdzad/dwags por byon nas rin po che la sangs rgyas dngos su mthong / phan tshun gsung gleng mdzad/ slar yang sgom su bcug pas blo 'das phyag rgya chen po rang ngo dngos su 'phrod/ sngon gyi bla ma de rnams ci red ang zhes gsungs shor/dpal bka' brgyud pa'i gdams pa yongs rdzogs gsan nas mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi go 'phang dam par gshegs/ gdan sa dpal gyi phag mo grur phebs nas bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa nam langs pa la nyi ma shar ba lta bu mdzad nas slob tshogs shin tu rgyas pa'i gtso bo rten 'brel mthar phyin 'bri gung pa/ mos gus mthar phyin stag lung pa/ rtogs pa mthar phyin rna phu ba/shes rab mthar phyin spar phu ba/ slob pa nye sras bzhi/ ro gcig pa bzhi/gdugs thob lnga brgya sogs grangs las 'das/ de nas 'dul bya yongs su rdzogs nas spyi lo 117rkyarab byung gsum pa'i lcags stag lor ngo mtshar ba'i ltas sna tshogs dang bcas gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos kyi dbyings su thim mo/56

༄//'bri gung bka' brgyud kyi byung chul/bka' babs bzhi sogs gdams mdzod ma lus kun/zab mo'i lam mchog rnam pa lngar bsdus nas/tshe gcig rdo rje 'chang chen sar 'khrid pa'i/'gro ba'i mgon po rad ṇa shrir zhabs 'dud/sa gsum 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig ston mchog thub pa'i dbang po gnyis pa/ 'phags mchog klu sgrub de nyid slar yang 'jig rten du lta ba ngan pa rnams bsal nas zab mo'i stong nyid kyi 'gro la chos char 'bebs phyir du/bsam bzhin srid pa'i skur bzhengs pa ni rgyal dbang ratna shri ri nyid yin te/rje nyid sku 'khrungs ba'i yul ni mdo khams phyug drug las 'bri klung dam pa chos kyi phyug pa'i zhing / ldan stod grong khyer tsung ngur yab 'jigs byed kyi grub pa thob pa rnal 'byor pa rdo rje dang / yum rang bzhin gyi rnal 'byor ma rdo rje phag mo rakshi bza' btsun ma gnyis kyi sras su gsang bdag gi ngo bo rdo rje mchu zhes po ti kha dog dkar po'i rnam par lhums su zhugs/ spyi lo 1142'das rjes chig stong drug brgya gya bdun pa khrag skyugs ces pa chu phag lor sa zlar ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas sku bltams/ bltams ma thag rdo'i steng du bzhag pas sku rjes dang / der chu mig yang brdol/ mtshan dpal ba thar nasardo rje dpal du bsgyur zhing nyid nas btsun pa skyabs su btags/ yab las 'jigs byed dang phur pa'i rgyud gsan/ slob dpon skyes bu las dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa mnos/ rwa sgrong sgom chen las bka' gdams pa'i chos 57

gsan/ rje btsun 'khor ba rlung khyer las phyag chen dang phag mo gsan/ klog yon phul ba'i ras grud nas zhabs rjes dang / yi dam rdo rje 'jig byed kyi zhal gzigs/ snying rje che bas khyi la skyugs pas gso ba dang mdze sprang la yang shin tu brtse/ klog dag pas thel klog zhes kun gyi tshad mar 'dzin/ mdo khams kyi chen po kun gyis gtsug tu bkur/ de skabs 'go zla paṇa ṭi ta las dpal phag mo gru pa'i snyan pa thos nas dbus su 'gro ba'i 'dun pa zlog med skyes/ 'gro ba'i mgon po'i zhal dkyil mjal/ mos gus tshad med skyes nas thugs yid gcig tu 'dres/ 'gro ba'i mgon pos 'khor thams cad de ring rdzogs so gsungs nas don gyi rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur/ 'gro mgon gyi bka' ltar dbu sgom bzhengs pas rten 'brel mthar phyin nas zhwa chos kyang mdzad/ gling ras kyis bstod pa nyi shus bstod/ 'gro ba'i mgon po'i zhal gyi bdud rtsi myang bas chos rnams mngon sum du rtogs nas lnga ldan gyi rtogs 'gur phul/ sku gshegs skabs thugs ka nas gser gyi rdo rje nyid kyi thugs kar thim/ sa lam bgrod pas cho 'phrul sna tshogs byung / e chung ri khrod du lo gsum sgom pas rlung dbu mar tshud/ mdze 'ur 'ded byas nas sgom med kyi rtogs pa mngon du gyur nas 'gur du bzhengs pa/ zhag gsum nyi ma dro bzhi na/ mi kho bo'i las ngan rang sar dag rgyu 'bras kyi rten 'brel tshan gcig go/ zab mo gsang sngags kyi gter kha bye/ gnyis med 'od gsal chen po la/mnyam rjes gnyis kyi 'dzin pa dag nga rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug zhig yin nam snyam/ zhes gsungs/ he ru ka'i zhal mjal nas chos thams cad kyi rten 'brel phra rags ma lus pa khong du chud/ dbu la gtsug tor sogs mtshan dpes brgyan/ rje btsun sgrol ma zhal gzigs nas skyabs bdun ma'i mgur bzhengs/ chos kun gshis babs dang / bcas rang dang sdig ltung gcig pa/58

ye bkag ye gnang sogs khyad chos dgongs pa gcig pa thugs la 'khrungs nas man ngag rnams gzhan la 'dom par mdzad/ gser 'phyang zhes pa me bya lor sgom pa sher 'od rogs su bcas te/ 'on du smad 'dul gyi rgyud pa zhang sum thog pas mkhan po dang / sde snod 'dzin pa tsi lung pa'i slob dpon dang /dmyal ba 'dul 'dzin gyis gsang ston mdzad/ dgung lo so lnga la bsnyen par rdzogs/ mtshan rin chen dpal zhes gsol/ 'dul ba mdo rtsa la shin tu mkhas par gyur/ phag grur tshogs 'khor la kha g.yar nas grwa pa chang 'thung ba mang du byung nas bka' bkyon gnang ba la bkur 'debs byung bas/ rje bla ma dngos su mjal nas 'bri gung du byon par lung bstan/ nags shod mkhan po dang pha jo rdor rgyal gyis gter sgrom gyi mdun du 'bri gung bya ba dben gnas shig yod par zhus nas phebs/ rtogs ldan mi nyag sgom rin gyi zhal chems ltar gdan sa phul ba bzhes te/ sa phag lo (spyi lo 1179) gdan sa phyag btab pas 'bri thel 'og min byang chub gling zhes mtshan gsol/ thel du sgom gra'i tshogs pa bskyangs/ dgung lo so dgu la byang nam rar phebs nas phyag zhabs rjes dad rten du bstsal/ phag gru'i gdung rten du gser gdugs phul/nags shod dang rgya mtsho bar pa sogs kyis phul ba khra khyu dang smug khyu bcas nor phud du phul/ rdo phud du spyil mo che bzhengs/ bla g.yel dang gser khang rnams rim bzhin bzhengs 'go tshugs/ 'khor shin tu mang ba la thugs skyo ba'i tshul gyis tsha 'ug tu phebs nas gnas gsum zhing skyong rnams kyis rang rang gi gnas su gdan 'dren par zhus kyang / rje nyid nas ri ba btang bar gsungs nas ri ba dang po dpal chen sgom she gtsos bco brgyad re btang /gling gseb tu chu mig brgya rtsa gter nas bton/ bsam yas nyams gso dang sde nang mi mthun par 'dum/ rgya gar du phebs par dgongs kyang dwags po 59

'dul 'dzin gyis dbus dge mdun gyis bsus nas gdan sa phul/ sgam po'i ri rtse nas tsa ri tra'i gnas dang gsang sngags kyi lha tshogs dpag tu med pa dang / g.yu mtsho'i steng gi dra ba sdom pa'i pho brang / dag pa shel ri la lha nyis stong brgyad brgya'i bkod pa mkha' 'gro mas 'ja'i dra bar gzigs lam du phabs pas/ 'gro mgon dgongs rdzogs su bkra shis sgo mang dang po de bzhengs/ dge 'dun snam sbyar can gyis bla g.yel gang zhing 'bul ba shin tu mang bas sgom pa dang po rdo rje seng ge mnga' gsol/ gnyos chen sogs gnas gsum du ri pa dgu brgya re btang / mgar chos lding pas thel zhol du 'dra sku mang po bzhengs pas da lta hor sku tshems mur zhes grags/ gnyos kyis bur 'gyed skabs tshogs pa lnga khri lnga stong lnga brgya byung / rta chag steng khar dur khrod ngan song sbyong ba'i dkyil 'khor du byin brlabs/ dgung lo don gsum pa shing phag lor dge slong gcig pur khri tsho nyis shur 'tshogs/ te ser rdor 'dzin gu ya sgang pa dang grub thob ri ba nag po/ la phyi gangs rwar rdor 'dzin g.yag ru dpal grags dang sgom pa gsal ba'i dbang phyug tsa ri trar ye shes kyi 'khor lor rdo rje 'dzin pa mgo bo che bcas 'khor ri pa lnga khri lnga stong lnga brgya nyer lnga re btang ba dang / ri khrod gzhan mang por ri pa ldab kyi mang ba brdzongs/ 'dzam gling du tshogs pa mang ba 'bri gung pa las mang ba ma byung /mtha' bzhi'i che dgu kun gyis zhabs la btugs pa dang bsngags pa/ dad pas 'bul ba sogs mang / lhag par ngo mtshar ba'i gtam so bdun dang /rnam thar brgyad sogs brjod pa'i yul las 'das/ rje nyid kyi zab chos dang /khyad chos dang / sum chos/ bcu chos/ ri chos sogs shin tu mang bar gsungs pa las/ yi ger 'khod pa'ang pod brgya phrag yod par gsungs/thugs sras bu slob gtso bo spyan snga brgyad/ thugs sras brgyad/ dpal 60

chen brgyad/ ras pa brgyad/ gangs pa gsum/ lo tsā ba brgyad/ 'dul 'dzin bcu/ sgom chen bcu/ zhig po lnga sogs byung la/ de rnams la brten nas stod smad du rang dgon sum stong lhag tsam bcas byung zhing ri thams cad 'bri gung ri pa/ thang thams cad 'bri gung thang pa zhes bstan pa shin tu rgyas pa ni/ bka' brgyud pa'i chos bka' spyi dang lhag par phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan dang zab lam nā ro'i chos drug la gnad du bsnun nas sgrub pa la rtse gcig tu gzhol bas yin/ rje mi las nga'i chos ni kha nang du lta ba'i chos yin gsungs pa ltar las/ 'dre 'dul dang grong chog phyogs re ba dang / ma dag pa'i tshogs gsog nad pa'i bsrung ba dang gshin po'i lam 'dren sogs spangs nas chu bo rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin la gzhol ba las byung ngo / de ltar sangs rgyas kyi mdzad 'phrin gcig tu bsdus pa'i bla ma de nyid kyis chos kyi 'khor lo bar med bskor zhing / sku dngos kyi 'dul bya yongs su rdzogs nas spyi lo 1217rab byung bzhi pa me glang lor sa zla'i tshes nyer lnga'i srod du zhi ba chos kyi dbyings su thim pa'i tshul ston/ pur zhus pas thugs gsum dang / dbu thod bde mchog rang byon/ ring bsrel bre lnga 'dzam gling rgyan du bzhugs/thugs gcig dang ring bsrel bre gsum bcas thub chen gyi nang du bzhugs/thugs gcig gser khang chos rje'i thugs kar bzhugs so/rje 'gro ba'i mgon po phag mo gru pa'i thugs sras stag lung thang pa rin po che spyi lo 1142rab byung bzhi pa chu khyi lor 'khrungs/ byang stag lung du phebs nas grub mtha'i srol gtod pas stag lung bka' brgyud zhes pa byung /'gro mgon slob ma grub chen gling ras padma rdo rje spyi lo 112ṭwāṃrab byung gsum pa sa sprel lor sku 'khrungs/ khong gi slob rgyud la stod 'brug dang smad 'brug bar 'brug sogs byung /6/

'gro mgon slob ma zwa ra skal ldan ye shes ni rab byung gnyis pa'i mjug tu sku 'khrungs/ g.ya' bzang du phebs pas g.ya' bzang bka' brgyud zhes pa byung /'gro mgon slob ma rgyal tsha kun dga' shes rab ni spyi lo 111rdorab byung gnyis pa'i sa khyi lor 'khrungs shing khro phu bka' brgyud zhes gsar gtod mdzad/'gro mgon slob ma gyer sgom chen po spyi lo 1144rab byung gnyis pa'i shing byi lor sku 'khrungs/ shug gseb du phebs nas shug gseb bka' brgyud zhes byung yang / da lta rnying ma'i mo dgon du gyur/'gro mgon slob ma smar tshang sangs rgyas ye shes ni spyi lo 1125rab byung gnyis pa shing yos lor sku 'khrungs/ smar ba bka' brgyud byung yang da lta med/'gro mgon slob ma sangs rgyas yel ba spyi lo 1124rab byung gnyis pa'i shing stag lor sku 'khrungs nas yel ba bka' brgyud zhes pa dar 'phel byung yang da lta med/shangs pa bka' brgyud ni khyung po rnal 'byor pas srol btod ba yin zhing / khong ni spyi lo 990rab byung gnyis pa lcags stag lo 'khrungs/ rgya gar du byon nas ne gu ma sogs las brgyud pa'i chos srog tu bzung bas shangs pa bka' brgyud pa'i chos srol de byung /zhi byed pa ni 'phags yul gyi grub thob dam pa sangs rgyas bod du phebs nas zhi byed pa'i grub mtha'i srol tshugs/ chos brgyud 'di la snga dar phyi dar bar dar sogs byung yang rkang 'phel ba ni de tsam byung med/jo nang bka' brgyud pa ni yu mo mi bskyod rdo rje las byung zhing dol po 62

shes rab rgyal mtshan gyi skabs dar 'phel byung / khong ni spyi lo 1292rab byung lnga pa'i chu 'brug lo sku 'khrungs/ ngam ring jo mo nang gi dgon par bzhugs pas jo nang pa zhes grags/ dus 'khor la gtso bo mdzad/ dbu ma gzhan stong pa'i lta grub 'dzin/ zha lu'i lugs yang dge bshes mu tra ba las brgyud nas gtso bo dus 'khor la mdzad cing bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal gyis grub mtha' zur du btod pa da lta bzhugs/ dpal sa skya pa kun dga' snying po mchog spyi lo 1024rab byung dang po'i shing khyi lor sku 'khrungs/ 'brog mi lo tsā ba la gtugs nas rnying chos dor ba dang gsang sngags gsar ma zhus nas dgon pa btab/ rje sa skya gong ma rnam lnga sogs mkhas pa mang du byon nas chos srid gnyis kar dar ba'i rtser son/ de rjes bla brang khag dbar ma mthun nas nyams gud cung zad phyin kyang 'phrin las da lta'ang rgyas/ ri bo dge ldan pa ni rje bla ma blo bzang grags pas srol gtod/ khong ni spyi lo 1257rab byung drug pa'i me bya lo mdo smad tsong kha'i yul du sku 'khrungs/ karma rol ba'i rdor rje las rab tu byung / dbus gtsang du phebs nas 'bri gung spyan snga rin po che'i zhabs drung du yun ring tsam bzhugs pa dang / bod kyi mkhas grub rnams kyi zhabs la btugs nas bka' gdams gsar ma zhes pa'i rang lugs dri ma med pa gsar du gtod nas/ bstan pa rin po che 'di stod smad kun tu 'phrin las shin tu che bar byung bas/ zhib cha logs su shes par bya'o/63

༄khya//sum pa rgyal phran/gangs can nor 'dzin sa yi dkyil 'khor du/mi 'jigs stobs kyis phyug pa'i rgyal phran khrod/lhun po'i tog ltar mtho ba'i sum pa zhes/'dzin ma'i khyon du snyan pa'i dbyar rnga ldir/sum pa zhes pa ni bod btsan po'i sngon du byung ba'i stobs ldan gyi rgyal phran zhig yin zhing / 〈tun hong bod kyi lo rgyus yig cha 〉yi nang bod du rgyal phran bcu gnyis dang sil ma bzhi bcu zhes byung ba las/ yul sum yul gyi ya sum na rje 'bal lji mang ru ti/ blon po rlangs dang kam gnyis zhes bris snang zhing / rgya'i thang deb las nub phyogs 'jang rigs zhes pa de sum pa 'di nyid yin par deng gi mkhas dbang phal che bas smra/ thang deb las bud med kyis rgyal phran de'i dbang cha 'dzin cing / rgyal mo'i rus la sum pa dang /ming la ma'o cad zer/ rgyal mo dang rgyal mo chung ba gnyis kyis mnyam du srid dbang skyong / nyin lnga'i nang srid don thengs re gnang ba dang / rgyal mo chung bas rogs 'degs mdzad/ rgyal mo che ba grongs tshe chung bas srid bskyangs/rgyal mo'i khyo gas srid don mi shes shing / rgyal mo'i smad la sham thab nag po dang / stod thung sngo nag phu dung sa la ma reg tsam gyon zhes bris pa dang /tun hong yig cha las/ sum pa ni bod kyi byang shar su gnas zhes dang / nye dus kyi lo rgyus mkhas dbang sku zhabs rin ni chang gis dpyad pa gnang bas 'jang rigs kyi sum pa'i rgyal sa ni chab mdo'i sa khul 'dir yin par 'dod/64

de dang mtshungs par kong sprul rin po che dang dung dkar rin po che sogs kyis khams khul gyi sa cha mang che ba sum pa'i mnga' khongs yin par gsungs/ kha cig gis sum pa ni zhang zhung sgo phug bar gsum gyi nang du bgrangs kyang / blo gzu bos brtag na batren po'i gong nas rgyal phran bcu gnyis dang sil ma bzhi bcu zhes zhang zhung dang sum pa'i rgyal blon gyi mtshan so sor 'byung bar te/zhang zhung ngar ba rje bo lig snya shur/ blonarshapo khyung po ra sangs rje dang stong lom ma rtse gnyis zhes dang / yul sum yul gyi ya gsum na/ rje 'ba' lji mang ru ti/blon po rlangs dang kam gnyis zhes so sor dbye ba dang / zhang zhung dang sum pa gnyis bod btsan po'i mnga' khongs su 'du skabs sum pa dang zhang zhung re re ltar dbang du bsdus pa sogs la brten/ zhang zhung dang sum pa gnyis bod gdod ma'i chos lugs thog bod yul spyi dang 'dra bar bon chos spyod pa dang /chab srid thog sa 'brel tsam las zhang zhung sgo phug bar gsum zhes pa de chos lugs kyi bshad srol zhig min nam snyam pas dpyad pa 'tshal/ phyis su sum pa'i rgyal rabs de nyid mu mthud rgyun gnas ma thub pas sa cha'i dbye mtshams dang / rgyal rabs dang blon rabs sogs zhib phra med par gyur nas rgyal phran gyi ming tsam las ma thob/ btsan po'i gong du sum pa'i rgyal phran de stobs 'byor ldan zhing lag rtsal ni sngon thon gyi gral du slebs kyi yod pa dang / shar phyogs thang dang / lho phyogs bod/ nub phyogs zhang zhung / byang phyogs sog po gtsos pa'i rgyal phran sa khul khag dbar/ pho nya gtong res dang skyes bzang 'bul res yod pas mtha'i rgyal khab rnams dang 'dra mnyam gyi stobs shugs ldan par shes/ lag rtsal thog shin tu mkhas shing dar gos sogs dar bas/sum pa'i rgyal mo rnams dar gyi stod gos phu dung ring zhing smad sham sngo nag gyon zhes lkerus cha dang tshong las la spyod pa dang / pho brang dgu thog dang bdun 65

thog bcas yod pa dang / rgyal po gri gum btsan po'i skabs su sum pa'i sa nas go khrab kyi thog ma blangs par grags shing / rgya'i thang deb las go khrab ni mig gnyis ma gtogs mi mthong zhing / shin tu sra bas gris mi chod par bshad/ sum pa lcags rgyal zhes lcags rigs las snon la shin tu mkhas shing lag rtsal mthon por slebs pas da lta yang bar khams khul du bzhugs pa'i dbu chen rnams kyis bod gangs can gtsos pa'i 'dzam gling yul gru khag tu gser zangs las grub pa'i sku gsung thugs rten mchod chas sogs bzhengs ba glog 'phrul la ma brten pas grags pa che/sum pa zhes pa'i yig 'bru gnyis po 'di la cung dpyad khul byed na/tun hong gter yig las/ yul sum yul gyi ya sum na zhes gsungs pa/sum yul zhes pa ni yul tsho gsum la go dgos pa dang / ya gsum zhes de la nan bshad kyis yul tsho gsum de rang yin par rtogs dgos snyam ste/ rgya'i thang yig gsar rnying shog grangs 1 nub kyi 'jang gi rus su gtogs pa der yang rigs brgya dang lnga bcu mchis/ rma chu dang / gtsang chu/ 'bri chu/ rgyal mo rngul chu bcas 'babs yul du bkrams te gnas zhes pas/ chu chen bzhi'i bar gsum du gnas pa'i yul tsho gsum la sum pa zhes 'bod pa'i tha snyad de byung ba yin nam snyam pas dpyad/ de nas sum pa'i mtha' khul shar du thang dang / lhor bod/ nub tu zhang zhung dang ge sar bcas kyi bar du rgya bskyed/rgya skad du 'jang zhes 'bod dgos don ni ra lug 'tsho skyong mkhan gyi mi zer ba yin pas/ da lta 'brog pa zhes pa dang gcig mtshungs yin/

༄//bod kyi stong sde drug cur dbye ba/spyir 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir snod bcud thams cad rtag pa dang brtan pa'i rang bzhin zhig min phyin/ 'pho 'gyur 'gro srid pa zhig yin te/thu bhod rgyal phran nang nas grags che shos sum pa'i rgyal phran de yang nyams gud du phyin nas mi ring bar spur rgyal btsan po'i mnga' 'og tu gyur/ spur rgyal btsan po'i rgyal rabs dang po srong btsan sgam po'i skabs su/ spur rgyal bod kyi chab srid dang rig gnas/ dpal 'byor sogs nyin bzhin yar rgyas 'gro ba'i 'go tshugs/ dpa' mdzangs ldan pa'i chab srid mkhas can de nyid kyis/rang gi rigs rgyud gcig pur gtsigs su ma bzung bar spyi dmangs yongs la phan pa'i bya ba gang bzang bsgrubs pas/ mi lo khri khrag 'ga'i bar du phan med bdag 'dzin gyis khrag gi rba klong 'khrugs pa de nyid rgyun bcad pas/ mi rnams blo kha de ru phyogs nas gcig 'jug gnyis mthud kyis spur rgyal btsan po'i mnga' khongs su 'dus/ skabs der/ sum pa yang dngos su 'dus te/tun hong nas thon pa'i bod kyi lo rgyus yig cha deb ngos 66 'ung gi log tu myang mang rje zhang snang gis sum pa mtha' dag dmag gis gdab mi dgos par/lug rtug gis sgyu phab ste/ lce'i thor tho la brjod nas/ khyim grangs ma shor bar yongs kyis 'bangs rnal mar bkug go zhes byung ba dang / g.yu phreng deb ngos ṭwāṃ5las go bder brjod pa ni/ de'i rjes su btsan po'i blon chen mang rje zhang snang gis dmag rgyag ma dgos par sum pa'i yul khams yongs 67

rdzogs thabs mkhas kyi bya ba la brten nas/ tsho pa'i 'go gtso dag la snyan pa'i gtam dang zhi ba'i gros btab ste/ yul tshan so sor them dud gcig kyang phyir bros dang thor gyar med pa bod btsan po'i chab 'bangs khongs dngos su bcug zhes pas/ bod kyi btsan po srong btsan gyi sku tshe'i stod la sa cha'i rgya khyon la ma gzhig par dmag gi sgrig gzhi'i dbang gis dbu ru/ g.yon ru/g.yas ru/ ru lag sum pa ru bcas lngar dbye zhing / sum pa'i ru ni spur rgyal btsan pos mtha' bzhir rgya bskyed pa'i skabs su dmag dpung dang dpal 'byor gyi rten sa gtso bo zhig yin te/ thang deb gsar ma sum pa'i lo rgyus su/ sum pa ni thu bhod rgyal phran khrod ha cang che shos yin zhes dang /stobs ldan thu bhod kyi dmag rgyag par rta rgyab khal gsum gyi phyed ka ni sum pa nas 'kho sgrub byed kyi yod ces dang / sum par dud tshang khri phrag dang / rdzong gzhis brgyad cu lhag yod ces pa sogs gsal/ de ni yin te/ bod btsan po'i mtha' bzhi rgya bskyed la sum pa med na 'gro lam dang dmag sgar rgyag sa yang mi dbang / sum pa'i stobs shugs dang sa cha stod smad la gzhi bcol nas/ nub kyi zhang zhung / byang gi gru gu/ shar gyi 'a zha dang ljang yul bcas rim bzhin yar klung btsan po'i mnga' khongs su bsdus pa dang / de bzhin shar gyi rgya nag lhor rgya gar/ nub tu ta zig byang du tu ru ka sogs la 'gran pa'i stobs shugs de byung ba yin/ dper na bon gyi lo rgyus khag las/srong btsan gyis zhang zhung 'dul phyir nyid kyi sring mo sad ma dkar zhang rgyal la gnang nas/ zhi ba'i sgo nas chab 'bangs su 'gug pa'i thabs btang / bod btsan po'i g.yo jus de'i 'og tu zhang rgyal ma tshud par sras mos bod la nyen kha yod pa'i brda 'byor/ bod rgyal pos zhang rgyal sum pa la 'dun mar phebs 68

skabs dwangs ra dung phug nas bkug nas dkrongs zhes gsungs pa'i tshig ris de rnams la brtag na/ bod btsan pos zhang rgyal la thad kar rgol ba'i 'deng tshod med pas/ sum pa'i stobs shugs la brten nas byung bar mngon/zhang zhung gi sa cha tshang ma bod btsan po'i 'og tu tshud rjes/ zhang zhung de nyid ru gcig la brtsis pas ru drug byung / de nas ru drug cu re gcig gi sgrig gzhi btsugs/ ru chen drug gi nang nas sum pa ru la nags shod stong bu chung dang bcas pa'i stong sde bcu gcig zhes rgya che shos dang / dpa' rtags mang zhing bod rgyal la lhag bsam gyi sri zhu sgrub mkhan zhig yin/ sum pa de nyid sngar las rgya khyon chung du cung zad phyin te/ ru mtshams dbye skabs/ dbus rgya shod stag pa tshal/ lho smri ti chu nag nub yil zhabs sding po che/ byang nags shod gzi 'phrang / shar snye yul bre nag ces dbye bas/dbus tshad rgya shod stag pa tshal ni da lta stod nags shod na bur sen gsum/ smad rgya stong lding dgu zhes dpal 'bar khongs su 'du ba'i lung der yin zhing / phyis yi ge 'gyur nas rgyal shod zhes 'bri srol dar/ sngon rgya shod bon lung skya mo zhes 'bod pa'i yul lung 'di yin te/ yul 'dir shing gro ga'am stag pa'i tshal gyis gang bas stag pa tshal dang shar nub kyi dbus tshad du bzhag pas dbus tshad rgya shod stag pa tshal zhes pa de byung ba yin/lho smre ti chu nag ni/ mdo dbus sa yi mtshams 'dzin smre ti bye rag pa (zis rag pa'i ) lho phyogs/ smre ti chu nag gam yul mi rnams kyis rna'u chu nag zhes 'bod/ btsan po'i dus rabs nas bzung ming don rgyun gnas 'byung ba/ sngon bod kyi sa khra'i thog tu mdo dbus kyi sa mtshams yin zhes bkod yod pa dang / sngon gyi yul mi rgan rabs rnams kyis gnas der/ sa 69

mtshams gyi shing byang gtsugs pa mthong ba'i bshad srol yang yod/ gnas 'di nyid ni mtho sgang gi sa cha grags che shos shig yin pas/ lha sa'i skyid chu sngon mo'i chu 'go dang / dngul chu'i chu lag che shos 'ga'i 'go ma dang phyogs bzhir chu bo 'bab pas/ sngon sde dge chos rgyal bstan pa tshe ring gis sde dge'i bka' 'gyur bzhengs nas par phud de 'dzam gling sa yi gtsug tu 'bul ba'i thugs bskyed 'og bka' yi blon po gnyis btang bas/ smre ti lha yi lung mo cher slebs pas/ chu bo rnams kyi 'go ma nyi zla dang mtshan mo skar ma yang lag gi len thub snyam pa 'di 'dra bas 'dzam gling sa yi gtsug tor lta bu yin par shes nas/ sde dge sa skyong la snyan gsan pas sa thag ring zhing bgrod lam la 'phrang chu gsum mang bas dpar phud dkar chag de 'byor ba las bka' 'gyur cha tshang dngos su gdan drangs ma thub/ bka' 'gyur bzhugs sa la g.yu gong mkhan chen gdan drangs nas lha khang ka ba bcu drug zhig yungs dkar gyi sa thog tu bzhengs shing / nye char 'bri gung sgo cog sprul skus bzhengs pa da lta zhol dpar khang bka' 'gyur bya ba 'di'i phud gsum pa de gnas 'dir gdan drangs nas thel klog dang ldan pa'i a mchod nyer lngas dag 'don dang rab gnas rgyas ston mdzad pas kun gyi khyad du 'phags pa'i gnas mchog zhig la brtsi yi yod/ lo rgyus pa khag gcig gis smre ti chu nag ni stag pa tshal gyi lho ru yod par smra ba de ni mi 'thad de/ kong po'i stod khul du yin pa'i phyir/ de ni nags shod stod kyi lho phyogs su nags shod tsho sde'i sa cha ru yin/nub yil zhabs sding po che'am kha cig gis yel rab sde bzhi zhes bris snang bas yil rab ces pa de dag par snang ste/ rgyal phran zing po rje stag skya 70

po'i mnga' khongs su yel rabs sde bzhi zhes pa'i sa zhig yod pa de yin snyam/blon po bka' yi thang yig las/ bod kyi stong sde bshad pa las/ yil rab zom steng 'gos kyi stong ste yin zhes/ yil rab sde bzhi ni sum pa'i lho nub/zhang zhung gi shar khul/ zing po rje'i nub byang su gnas pa zhig yin nam snyam pas dpyad par 'tshal/ btsan po'i skabs su bod du ru drug la khod bca' skabs/ sum pa'i khod ni byang nam ra zha don gram pa tshal du bcas/ khod dpon ni hor bya yu ring po yin zhes pa las khod ga 'dra zhig byed pa'i don ma gsal kyang / khod yul nam ra yin pas gtan khel sum pa'i sa cha las stabs bde ba'i sa zhig tu bcas pa las gzhan gyi sar khod bca' mi srid pas/yil rab ni da lta byang gnyan chen thang lha'i stod khul dpal mgon rdzong dang nyi ma rdzong gnyis kyi sa khul der min nam snyam/ kha cig gis zhang rgyal bkrongs ba'i sa cha dwangs ra dung phug zhes pa de zhang zhung dang sum pa'i sa 'tshams yin pa'ang 'dod/byang nags shod gzi 'phrang ni/ bod btsan po'i skabs su nags shod pas dpa' rtags bzhag pas sbas sde bcu gnyis la dbang bsgyur ba yin la/deb ther 'gar rgyal sde bcu gnyis zhes bris pa'ang snang / blon po sbas kyi sde gzhung ma ni skyid chu'i rgyud der yin pas sbas sde zhes nags shod pas dpon byas pa min nam snyam la/ yang de skabs nags shod kyis dpon byas pa'i yul tsho mang po yod na'ang stong sde gcig ma longs tsam yod pas da lta'i yus shul khul bar dbang bsgyur bas mtshams der nags shod gzi 'phrang zhes pa zhig yod pa yin nam snyam/ gzi 'phrang zhes pa ni/ nags shod kyi gtsos pa'i mdo khams khul gyi skad la ba ya btags la za zhes klog srol yod pas/ bye 71

ma'am ze ma'i 'phrang zhes pa'i don min nam snyam pas kun gyis dpyad par zhu/de min shar du rma chen spom ra/ lhor 'dzam bu'i klu ri/ nub tu gnyan chen thang lha/ byang lha btsan mu ni zhes skabs shig sum pa'i sa'i rgya khyon yin pa'ang grags/shar gnye yul bre nag dang bum nag zhes bris snang pas/ da lta nyag bre'i sa cha yin nam snyam pa'ang byung / lhag tu dbus tshad rgya shod stag pa tshal du bzhag pas nub tu ji ltar nar ba bzhin du shar du yod pa smos ma dgos/yang gal po che la nan tan/ dam pa'i chos la brgya tshar zhes pa'i dpe ltar/bod btsan po'i ru drug las sum pa ru la stong khyab rgya ldan gyi stong sde zhes pa'i ming thogs tshul la dpyad pa zhig byas na/ da lta rgya shod du rgya stong lding dgu zhes pa'i lung 'dir sa ming zhig chags yod pa der bod btsan po'i gong dang de'i skabs chab srid kyi lte ba zhig byed pa yin las che ste/ sum pa stong khyab rgyu ldan gyi tsūng sde zhes pa tshig bsdus pa rgya stong du grags pa yin/ dper na/gnas 'di nas thon pa'i rje mar pa'i slob ma rgya stong zhig po/ 'bri gung pa'i chos sras rgya stong chos rje/ karma pa'i slob ma rgya stong chos bzang / rje rin po che'i slob ma rgya stong blo bzang grags pa dang bcas yul 'di nas phebs pa sha stag yin pas/ rgya shod 'di sum pa stong khyab rgya ldan gyi stong sde'i chab dpal rig gsum gyi lte gnas gtso bo zhig yin te/ grub thob nag po dgung 'khur gyi 'khrungs yul rgya stong du sum pa sum phyug bya ba bcas yod/ da lta lo ngo nyi stong sngon gyi bod kyi gna' bo'i 'dzugs skrun gyi dpang rtags pho brang yum bu bla mkhar dang / de min rje mi la'i sras mkhar dgu thog sogs dang bzo dbyibs mtshungs pa'i mkhar rdzong / nags shod ka rong ske khang mdo'i mkhar rnying dang /72

g.yang shod mkhar 'dung / sngo kho'i mkhar skya rdzong / bu rdzum dkar mdo bum pa sogs sum pa'i rgyal phran skabs kyi btsan rdzong rnying gral yin nges pas rjes su zhib 'jug bya yul gtso bo zhig yin/ tun hong yig cha las sum pa'i rgyal mo'i pho brang dgu thog zhes gsungs/ bzo dbyibs ni pho brang yum bu bla mkhar sogs mjal bas shes nus/sum pa'i mnga' khongs rtse mthon dang / pho mthong gnyis/ rgod tshang stod smad gnyis/ 'jongs stod 'jongs smad gnyis/ dre stod dre smad gnyis/nags shod stong bu chung bcas (lde bu'i chos 'byung shog grangs 259las 'dzom stod 'dzom smad gnyis/ tre stod tre smad gnyis zhes yang gsungs )stong sde bcu gcig las da lta nags shod stong bu chung gcig pu sa ming ma 'gyur bar gnas pa las/ gzhan bcu da lta 'di yin bya ba ma mthong bas/phyis su mdo khams khul gyi sa rgyus yod mkhan dang mkhas dbang rnams kyis thugs la 'dzin par zhu/ 73

༄//bar gyi dpa' sde nags shod stong bu chung /stobs kyi 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i dpung tshogs ltar/khros pa'i nyams dang dpa' ba'i ki sgra yis/pha rol dgra snying lkog mar 'byin pa byed/dpung btsan bar gyi dpa' sde stong bu chung /zhes mdo khams shod chen bco brgyad kyi dbu rtse/ chu bo rgyal mo dngul chu'i 'go bo/ nags shod sman ljongs phyug mo 'di nyid ni/ shar gyi jo bo dpal 'dzoms/ g.yu 'brug tshangs nas langs 'dra/ lho yi 'dzam bu'i klu ri/dung seng g.yu ral bseg 'dra/ nub gyi ri chen nags lha/ mkha' lding nam 'phangs gcod 'dra/ byang gi me mo rag khrom/ rgya stag tshang nas langs 'dra/de min gangs ri dang rdza ri nags ri sogs mi chen gral la tshogs 'dra'i dbus su mtsho dang mtshe'u sman ljongs rnam par bkra zhing / gter gyis gang ba'i gzhong pa zhig dang mtshungs pas gnas 'dir 'gro ba mi'i rigs ni bod spyi mtshungs ltar yin la lhag tu ri bo hin ma la ya 'bur du ma dod pa'i gong gi skabs su byung ba'i rkyang sug pa gsum ldan gyi 'gyur rdo'i rjes shul da lta shag sbang ngu zam so la yod pas de bas ches snga mo nas srog chags kyi rigs byung ba dpang rtags shig yin/ 〈zakṣiṃ.oṃma'isnulkolko41〉nag chu sa khongs lo rgyus deb las gsal/ gnas 'dir bar gyi dpa' sde nags shod stong bu chung yin par ni bod kyi chos 'byung chen mo khag tu yul lung 'di'i ming du nags shod ces rgyun gnas dang / mtha' skor gyi sa cha khag bcas kyis shes rtogs thub la/74

lhag tu nags lha'i lha bsang 〈'dod 'byung nor bu'i bang mdzod 〉las/ yul ni nags shod stong bu chung / phu gsum dpag bsam rgyas pa 'dra/ mda' gsum yol ba brel ba 'dra/ ri brag mtshon cha gzeng ba 'dra zhes gsungs pa dang / gzhan yang rlangs kyi po ti se ru las/ rlangs kyi gdungs rgyud de nyid 'od gsal lha nas chad pa'i gnam lha mched brgyad sogs rim par byung zhing /khyad par rlangs kyi yab mes sam mang ldom stag btsan gyi skabs su/ rlangs kyi po ti se ru deb ngos 10 lha'i gsungs nas/ rang re lha sras mched brgyad kyi/ khyed ni mi yi sras su sprul/ bu dang sras med thugs chad na/ zla ba bcu gsum sgrub pa mdzod/ yi dam sgom la gsang sngags sgrongs/ lo gsar zla ba bcu gsum la/ lha ri gnyan po'i can du byon/ bsang dang mchod pa gsol ba thob/ lha yi sras mo grub ste yong / lha tshangs sras mo grub pa na/ lha yi sras la mi yi rgyud/ rigs rgyud khyad du 'phags par yong / mi rabs bdun cu rtsa gsum bar/ bla ma mi dpon rgyun mi chad/ sems can kun gyi 'dren pa dang /dpa' bo rgyal khams 'dul ba dang / grags pas sa steng khengs pa yong /rgyud pa gang gis thob pa dang / rgyud kyi sgrub pa gang byed rnams/ 'di nas 'phos nas lha ru 'khrungs/ zhes dang / lo gsar zla ba bcu gsum la/ yul ni myang dgu lha yul na/ rdza ri smug po g.yag 'gying pa 'dra ba zhig gi rtsar byon/sku la dar dkar na bza' gsol/ dbu la sher gyi la thod bcings/ zhes sogs mang po gsungs pas/ lha yi lung ltar mang ldom stag btsan lha ri'i mgul du phyin nas lha tshangs pa'i sras mo dang sbyor bas/ phyi lor gnas der bu len pa gsungs kyang / mang ldom gyis dus las yol bas tshangs pa'i sras mos sras de lha ri'i khongs gseng du bzhag pas/ yab mang ldom stag btsan gyis dran sos nas phebs pas/ sras ma shi bar seng ge dang rgod kyis 75

bsrung nas rlangs pa phyur re 'dug pas/ yab kyis rlangs so rlangs so zhes thugs dgyes pas rlangs thog da lta mkhas dbang rnams kyis rlangs kyi 'khrungs yul phyogs 'dir yin par 'dod/ lha ri gnyan po'am rdza ri rmug po g.yag 'gying ba 'dra ba zhes pa de ni nags shod kyi lha ri rmug po nags lha dzam bha'i khongs gseng du yin par snyam/ 〈tung hong yig tshang las 〉yul sum yul gyi ya gsum na/ rje 'bal rje mar ru ti dang / blon po rlangs dang kam gnyis zhes pas/ rlangs kyi gdungs rgyud kyis sum pa'i bka' blon yin pa dang / nags sog shag gsum gyi spyi dpon yin te de rjes rlangs kyi grub thob byang chub 'dre 'khor mchog spyi lo 969sa sbrul lor 'khrungs shing / rlangs kyi po ti se ru deb ngos 52nags sog shag gi bcas pa/ rnal 'byor nga yi pha yul yin/ sha nye rus thog de na yod/ sngar yang pha yul ngo bo 'dug da 'ang pha yul byed pa yin zhes nags shod dang sog shod/ shag chu gsum la nags sog shag gsum zhes 'bod pa dang / gzhan yang nags sog sum mdor lo gsum sgrub pa bzhugs/ zhes dang mgur las/ nags sog gnyis kyi kha bar na/ nga bzhin grub pa thob pa de zhes pas gtso bo sgrub gnas chags ri'am khams kyi dur ba ri 'di yin pa dang / bod sil bu'i dus bstan pa phyi dar gyi skabs su gnas 'dir gsang sngags rnying ma'i grub pa thob pa yin zhing / 'khrungs yul yang 'dir yin par nges/ mthar spyi—lo 1༷76me 'brug lor sku mya ngan las 'das/ rlangs kyi po ti se ru lcags par ldeb 21las/ stong tshang jo bo spun bu des/ nags sog shag gsum gyi spyi dpon byas pas/ yul 'dzin snga bar bshad pas yul 'di dang po rlangs gi gdung rgyud nas 'dzin par shes/ lde'u chos 'byung deb ngos 274bar gyi dpa' sde ni/ ri spen ma lung gi yar bcad/ chags sgo dang 76

pas mar pa'i (cha skor dar bas mar bcad pa'i ) yul de na rgyal sde bcu gnyis la (rbas sde bcu gnyis )/ nags shod stong bu chung gis dpon byas te/ljang mo thag mdung can glang po che'i mdung khur te/ dmag dang bcas nas 'ongs pa la/ 'thab pa'i dpa' rtags ral gri la ri mo bris/ dur rgyags ltor zos/ tsha leb rgyab tu gon/ slar mi ldog pa'i bsam pa dang bcas te/dpa' bo'i ral kha byas pa na dpa' ba'o zhes dang / rlangs kyi po ti se ru deb ngos 22 rlangs do zhes lha ru g.yu dgung po de mchod nas/ ljang la dmag byas/ ljang gi thog mda' nag po de btegs/ ljang mi dug can gyi mig de phyung / de'i dpa' rtags su ljang gi ral gri ngo de dang / 'od 'bar ma de thob pas de bas nag po ljang gi 'dul dpon yang lha rigs rlangs yin gsungs pa bzhin bod btsan po'i dmag dpung sum pa'i shar lho gnas pa'i ljang yul la dmag drangs skabs/ shin tu dpa' rtsal che ba'i ljang mo thag mdung can dmag bseb tu rgyugs pa la/ nags shod pas ral gri'i shubs bcag pa'am ri mo bris nas slar mi bkol bar thag bcad/ dur rgyag ltor zas zhes zas kyi tha ma yin par nges chod/ tshe slog rgyab tu gon zhes pa gos kyi tha ma yin rgyu nges chod ces pas/ slar mi ldog pa'i sems thag bcad nas dmag la rgyug pas ljang mo thag mdung can tshar bcad nas ljang yul dbang du bsdus pas bar gyi dpa' sde zhes mtshan snyan srid mthar mi nyams pa'i phyir du bod btsan pos bstod pa gsum gyis bstod/ bod btsan po'i khrims srol las/ dpa' bo stag gis ma bstod na/ dpa' bar byed pa'i ru ma med/ mdzangs ma yig tshang gis ma bstod na/ phyin chad mdzangs ngan shan mi phyed/ legs pa bya dgas ma bstod na/ slan chad legs pa su yis byed/ ces dang / dgra lha'i bsang gsol khag las/ dpa' bo stag gi cha ga can/ ngar ma gzigs kyi 77

thig les rgyan zhes pas/ dmigs bsal can dpa' ngar che ba stag gzig dang mtshungs par bstod pa yin/ bar gyi dpa' ste nags shod stong bu chung ni cung zhig stong kha ma longs kyang / ljang yul btul skabs dpa' rtags dgung la bzhag pas dpa' ba'i rtags su stag slog ngar ba'i rtags su gzig slog sogs gnang / de nas rim par stag gzig gi pags pas gos mthar cha ga sprod srol byung bas gling sgrung las kyang / dmag stag sham can la brgya tsho gcigadamag gzig sham can la brgya tsho gcig ces dang / rim bzhin sde tsho'i dpon dang / dgon pa'i sde pa la yang stag gdan sogs rim par dar/ btsan pos mi sdar ma la/ smad pa gsum las/ sdar ma wa zhus ma dmad na/ dpa' dang sdar ma shan mi phyed ces/ sdar ma wa bros rgyag mkhan la wa zhu bskon nas mi rnams kyis mtshang 'bru byed pa yin pas/ btsan po'i rgyal rabs sngar nas nyams na'ang dpa' rtags dang dmad rtags gnyis kar da lta'i bar du dus ston gyi zab 'phyor du song / mdo stod smad bar gsum sa khul rnams btsan po'i drag po dmag gi rten gzhi yin pas de'i dbang gi da lta'ang stag gzig gi pags pa dang wa zhwa/ mtshon cha 'dogs pa la dga' zhing mtshon cha dang mi 'bral ba ni sngon gyi goms gshis yin pa smos ma dgos/lo rgyus mkhas dbang khag gcig gis/ dpal sde gsum gyi mtha' yi so kha srung zhes pa'i tshig ris la ltas nas/ dpa' sde gsum de bod kyi mtha' khul gyi sa cha zhig la ngos 'dzin mkhan yang byung te/ dper na/ mkhas dbang don grub rgyal gyis gsungs 'bum bod gsum pa'i shog ngos 214las/bar gyi dpa' sde es 'bod/ de'i sa cha ni da lta zi khron zhing chen gyi dkar mdzes dang / yun nan zhing chen bde chen rdzong / bod rang skyong ljongs kyi chab mdo sa khul bcas yin nam snyam zhes bris pas/ de ltar ma yin te/78

bod kyi stong ste re gcig las bar gyi dpa' sde de nyid dpa' rtags dgung la bzhag pas/ mtha' yi so kha bsrung ba'i dmag dpung dmigs gsal can zhig yin pas de ltar btags pa dang / btsan pos ljang la dmag drangs skabs ljang btul ba las/ ljang dang sa mtshams yin pa mi khyab ste/ dper na smad kyi dpa' sde phyug mtshams ni dbu ru stod kyi stong sde'i nang tshan yin pas so/ bar gyi dpa' sde nags shod stong bu chung zhes pa ni sa cha'i dmag dpung gi ming las dmag gi dpon gyi mtshan ma yin te/ de'i skabs su dmag dpon ni/ rlangs po ti se ru deb ngos 22 rlangs do zhes lha ru g.yu dgungs pa de mchod nas/ ljang la dmag byas/ ljang gi thog mda' nag po de btegs/ ljang mi dug can gyi mig de phyung zhes pas/ dpon gyi mtshan la rlangs do zhes 'bod pa de yin par nges/nags shod ces pa ni shing nags kyis ri klung med par gang zhing rtsi shing me tog dang sman rigs kyi dri bsung dang ldan pa'i shod du gnas pa'i yul sde la nags shod ces 'bod la/ yul skyong nags lha dzam bha'i bsang gsol rgyas pa las/ yul ni nags shod stong bu chung / phu gsum dpag bsam rgyas pa 'dra/ mda' gsum yol ba 'brel ba 'dra zhes gsungs pa ltar/ phu gsum thams cad la yangs pas gtsang po'i g.yas g.yon nas lung lag dpag bsam shing gi lo ma rgyas pa ltar 'brog sa bzang zhing rta nor lug gis rtsa thang gang / mda' rnams yol ba 'brel 'dra zhes rong gzhi dog pa chu brag 'thab cing nags tshal stug pas/ sngon bka' gdams dgon chen rin chen sgang dang / bya yul lha khang bcas bzhengs skabs shing rnams nags shod nas drangs pa dang / dbu ru byang stag lung lha khang dmar 'gyed bzhengs skabs shing cha rnams nags shod ka rong stod nas drangs tshul gsungs pa dang / da 79

lta'i rdzong khul 'dir sngar nags ra lpags thang zhes shing nags kyis gang bar bshad/ rgyal po bka' chems deb ngos 197las/ blon po mgar khams stod nags shod stod snye bo nags su slebs pa dang / nags shod du o cong (kong jo ) 'khor bcas 'dug pa thugs dgyes so/ zhes gsungs pa las sngon dus su ka rong phu dang / nags shod stod rnams su da lta las shing nags stug par shes pas yul 'di la nags shod ces 'bod/ nye rabs su rig gsar g.yas g.yon du tshod 'dzin med par lo ngo stong phrag gi sngon nas bsrung skyob byas pa'i gdod ma'i nags tshal rnams la gtor skyon tshabs chen btang nas shing nags kyi shul tsam med pa/ smug ltems mer gang ba'i sa cha de nyid da lta thal mdog can gyi ri klung du bsgyur/ ri la sa shas che bas sngon gyi gcan gzan ri dwags kyang chags sa med par gyar yod/ gzhan yang kha cig gis nags shod ces pa ni a mdo mtsho nag gi chu/ nag chu grong khyer nas babs te shar phyogs nags shod du babs pa la nag shod ces 'dod mkhan yang byung /de rjes su lde'u jo sras kyis mdzad pa'i chos 'byung deb ngos 267 las/rgyal srid chos la song dogs nas rje yis chos spangs zhes btsan po'i rgyal rabs dgu pa khri dar ma u dum btsan rgyal srid bzung bas bod yul stod smad bar gsum gling log byung nas slar yang sil bur gyur/ dmag don dang /shes rig dpal 'byor bcas kyi stobs shugs yā gling na snyan grags che ba'i btsan po'i rgyal rabs de nyid ko ba skam po me la bsreg pa bzhin mtha' bzhi yongs su 'khum pa'i dus de nas bzung sum pa yang spur rgyal batren po'i gdung rgyud sras khri lde mgon gnyen gyis cung zad bdag kyang rim par do dam de trem med par yul tsho rang rang gi dpon gyis mnga' 'og rnams bdag gir bzung nas da lta bar gnas pa'i nags shod ces pa'i sa ming ma 'gyur ba 'di 80

ni bla na med pa'i dpa' sde'i mtshan snyan las byung ba zhig yin/nags shod 'di nyid mdo dbus gang du gtogs tshul/bar gyi dpa' sde 'di nyid mdo khams smad gsum gyi khongs su gtogs te bar la dbus gtsang ru bzhi bya ba ni/ bod btsan po srong btsan gyi skabs su dbye ba dang / stod la mnga' ris bskor gsum zhes pa ni/ bod sil bu'i skabs su btsan po'i gdung rgyud stod la chad pa'i dus der spu rangs gangs kyis bskor/ gu ge g.ya' yis bskor/ zangs dkar mtsho yis bskor zhes dus de nas thog smad la mdo khams sgang drug zhes pa ni dus gang du byung ba ma shes na'ang 'di skor gyi sa dpyad la brtag nas byung ba min nam snyam/btsan po'i skabs su gzhung las tshan bcu dang sde bcu las/ lde'u chos 'byung deb ngos 256 khams gsum ni/ stod khams gsum dang smad khams gsum/ dbus khams gsum yang na mdo khams/ bde khams/ tsong khams zhes btsugs pas mdo khams gsum dang / mdo khams smad gsum zhes 'bod/ de min sa khul so sor dus rabs kyi 'phel phyogs/ chos lugs kyi dar nub/ dpal 'byor gyi dgos mkho/ bgrod lam gyi 'khor phyogs/ chu bo'i 'bab phyogs bcas kyi dbang gis/ smad la sgang gsum dang / mdo khams gsum/ mdo sna gsum/ mdo khams chu drug sgang lnga/ chu bzhi sgang drugamado khams 'dud gsum/ mdo khams phyug drug mdo khams rong dgu/mdo khams shod chen bco brgyad/ rong dgu shod bcu zhes mang du dbye ba'ang yod pas skabs thob tu go ba len dgos/ mi bu 'dra chags las/ sa bcad yul bgos srid pas byas/ yul mtshams thams cad chu yis phye/ yul rer chu re ming du btags zhes pa dang / smad mdo khams sgang drug zhing dang 'dra 81

zhes/ rgya zhing chu ma dang 'dra bar hin ma la ya'i ri bo 'bur du thon nas sgang re dang chu re rgyug pas zhing dang 'dra zhes/ sgang drug gi sa cha mang che ba sngar sum pa'i rgyal phran gyi mnga' ris yin zhing / gling sgrung las sog g.yag la man chad smar khams gling khri gong 'og las gong ma'i sa cha yin zhes gsungs/smad khams gsum la chu bzhi dang sgang drug ste/ dang po chu bzhi nub nas shar du 'bab pa'i g.yas kyi dang po ni dngul chu kham pa yin zhing / chu bo 'di'i ming la 'bod srol 'ga' yang mchis te/ rgya bza' kong jo bod du phebs skabs sa rong tsub pas ngu shor bas rgya mo ngu chu'am rngul chu zhes pa'i shod srol yang yod/ chu bo mdog kham pa yin pas dngul chu kham pa zhes 'bod/ gang ltar chu bo 'di'i chu mgo stod a mdo skya nag mtsho nas byang nag chur rgyud khams shod chen bco brgyad kyi dbu rtse nags shod sman ljongs phyug mo'i dkyil nas babs te/ nags sog 'dus mtshams nas sog chu dang 'dres nas dngul chu zhes 'bod nas chab mdo dpal 'bar rdzong gi byang /steng chen rdzong gi lho/ lho rong rdzong rgyud/ dpa' shod/ mdzo sgang bcas kyi lhor 'bab/ rdza yul shar nas mthar yun nan zhing chen du slebs nas sar wun gtsang po rgyud/ hin dhu rgya mtsho chen por 'bab pa yin/ chu sgang lo rgyus bya ba las dngul chu ni sog la skya bo'i mdun nas 'bab zhes bris pa ni rgyus med kyi gtam ma dag rgyun 'byams shig yin/ de min bod ljongs yul skor sne shan zhes pa las dngul chu 'di hor sbra chen nas rgyud ces rgyus med kyi skad cha ru zad/chu chen gnyis pa rdza chu'am zla chu ni/ stod dge rgyas rdza dkar po nas 'bab pas rdza chu dang / rdza dmar mkhar sgang nas babs pa la rdza chu/ rdza yi rgyal po go bo khyung phug gi ri rgyud kyi chu yin pas na rdza chu zhes 'bod/ hor sbra 82

chen wa mo la nas babs pa'i ngom chu dang 'dres nas chab mdor 'bab/ rim bzhin rgya nag the lan ṭi/ lo'o si/ kam pu tri/ wa ti na bcas rgyud nas phyi'i rgya mtshor 'bab/chu chen gsum pa 'bri chu se bo ni/ gdang la'i byang shar 'bri'i thur mgo la zhes pa ri bo 'bri 'dra ba de'i sna khung g.yas g.yon nas chu rer 'bab pas 'bri chu zhes 'bod/ stod a mdo'i dkar dmar gram gsum chu dang 'dres te sa tham rgyud lho nas shar du 'bab cing yang tsi gatreng po rgyud mthar phyi'i rgya mtshor babs/chu chen bzhi pa rma chu ni/ yag lha stag rtse'i chu dang / yug chu/ ba ri chu gsum/ rma stod mtsho sngo rings kyi chu 'dabs mtsho skya ring la 'dus te/ rma khog nas 'bab pas rma chur grags/ rma stod rma rgyal spom ra'i ri rgyud dang /mdo la'i ri rgyud kyi chu rnams 'dus te/ rgyal nang gi lan kro'u rgyud hong ha gtsang po zhes mthar rgya nag hrang tung phyogs nas phyi'i rgya mtshor 'bab/ nyag chu ni chu chen zhig yin kyang rang tshugs kyis rgya mtshor ma babs zhing 'bri chu dang 'dres pas chu chen du ma bgrangs so/sgang drug ni lho nas rim par brtsi ba'i sgang dang po spo bo sgang ngam spo 'bor sgang ni/ rgya mo dngul chu dang kong yul bre sna'i ri rgyud gnyis kyi bar 'di yin/sgang gnyis pa rngul rdza sgang ni dngul chu dang rdza chu gnyis kyi bar der gnas pa de la dngul rdza zil mo sgang zhes 'bod/sgang gsum pa rdza chu dang 'bri chu gnyis kyi bar la 'bri rdza sgang zhes 'bod/sgang bzhi pa/ rma chu dang 'bri chu gnyis la rma zla sgang ngam rma rdza sgang zhes 'bod/83

sgang lnga pa me nyag rab sgang ni lho byang du ldog pa'i rma chu'i khug so chen mo nas rgya bod sa mtshams bar/sgang drug pa rma chu phan chad a mdo'i sa cha phal che ba shar zla sgang du ngos 'dzin/sgang drug po 'di de sngon gyi lo rgyus rnams su dbye mtshams gsal bar bstan pa zhig med pas mtha' gcig tu kha tshon bcad par ma 'os kyang rags rim trem zhig bris pa yin pas da dung rjes su smad khams gsum dang sgang drug gi nang du sa yul gang zhig 'du min skor la zhib 'jug bya dgos/mdo stod nags shod stong bu chung 'di nyid sgang drug las dngul rdza zil mo sgang gi char gtogs te/ de ni mdo dbus sa yi mtshams 'dzin smre ti bye rag pas gtsos/ ri tshogs mang che ba rtse mo gangs dkar gyis brjid cing ri zhol rnams su rdza brag dang shing spang gis rgyan la na bun gyis bklubs pa/'bri zil dkar dang 'dra bas zil mo 'am zal mo zhes dngul rdza zal mo sgang gi stod du gnas/ kha cig gis nags sog rgyal gsum ni byang thang gi lung tshan zhig yin par smra ba ni sa rgyus med pa'i rang rtags yin/ slob dpon padma'i bka' thang shel brag las/ ma 'ongs sgrub gnas lung bstan pa las/lung lnga gling gcig ljongs gsum gangs nyis shu zhes pa'i nang nas/ byang shar mtshams na sbas yul lung gsum ljongs zhes gsungs/ skyabs rje rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pas mdzad pa'i nags lha'i lha bsang rgyas pa las chos 'khor lha sa'i shar phyogs na/ dkar dmar gram gsum lho phyogs na/ tsha ba sgang gi nub phyogs na/ dwags pa shel ri'i byang phyogs na/ sbas lung nags kyi skyed tshal na zhes dang / bshad mdzod chen mo las/ de dang mthun par sgang drug stod smad phye ba gnyis gnyis te/ dngul rdza sgang stod yin pa dang /84

smad tsha ba sgang / zhes dbye bas nags shod kyi lung 'di'i gnas phyogs stod dngul rdza sgang yin pa dang / dbus lha sa'i shar phyogs sam shar stod du gnas par gsungs/ bod yul srin mo gan rkyal du log pa lta bu'i dpung 'go g.yas pa dang / mdo stod shod chen bco brgyad dbus kyi rtse/ dge mtshan ldan pa bkra shis nags kyi shod ces pa dang / stag phu padma badzra yis/ mdo stod shod chen bco brgyad/ yang rtse o rgyan chen po/ sbas yul sman ljongs lung gsum zhes mdo stod shod chen bco brgyad kyi rtse mo yin zhing / sum pa ye shes dpal 'byor gyis chos 'byung las/ rgyas shod/ sa shod/ rta shod/spags shod/ sngo shod/ nags shod/ kre shod/ rme shod/ rgyang shod/ ngom shod/ de shod bcas bcu gcig bgrang ba tsam las/ de sngon shod bco brgyad ces kha las ma ṇi bgrang bgrang ltar bshad kyang mtha' gcig tu grangs sgrig pa zhig da phan ma mthong / bod kyi sa char shod ming ldan pa mang po yod pa de thams cad mdo stod shod chen du bgrang ba ni nya nyung bsres pa las dge mtshan gang yang med nges te/ de thams cad mdo stod kyi sa cha ma yin pa'i phyir/bdagagis dpyad pa zhig btang ba'i khul byas na/ mdo stod shod chen bco brgyad pa de tshang ma/ chu bo rgyal mo dngul chu'i g.yas g.yon gyi lung tshan che ba shod ming thob pa rnams yin te/ sngon rnal 'byor pa byang chub 'dre bkol de nyid gling rje ge sar rgyal pos gdan drangs nas gling gi gtso bo sum cu/ thul ba sum cu/ stag shar sum cu/ bla mchod sum cu/ mo btsun sum cu rnams kyis mi res 'bul ba re dang zhu ba re byas skabs/ grub thob chen po'i zhal nas mgur gsungs pa/ rlangs kyi po ti se'u ru'i deb ngos 54lho stod lung chen bco brgyad kyang / rnal 'byor nga yi pha yul yin/ zhes dang / lar gyis yul la khyed rang gang gsungs du 'dug ste/ lho lung chen bco brgyad 'di chos 85

la'ang dkar/ sa cha bzang / chos byed khrims skyong ci byed kyang na'ang /sa'i mthil/ yul gyi bcud yin pas zhes dang / deb ngos 54las/ rnal 'byor byang chub 'dre bkol/ sangs rgyas rgyud 'dzin spel ba la/ lho yi bstod du spel bar bya zhes gsungs pas/ gong ltar sa'i mthel dang sa bcud phun sum tshogs pa'i lung chen bco brgyad po 'di'i ming de dus na yod pas rang bstod tsam ma yin par mdo dbus gang du phyin kyang bgrod bde ba dang / sa babs shin tu bzang bas than skyon dang chu log gi 'jig pa med par sa'i bcud phun sum tshogs pas phu la 'brog sa bzang zhing / mda' rnams 'bru rigs sna lnga sogs skyes 'bras rnams bcud che la/ snod bcud kyi bkod pa phun sum tshogs te/ rtse mo thams cad gangs ri dang rdza ri/ sked par spangs ljongs dang shing rigs sna tshogs dang gcan gzan dang ri dwags bya rigs sogs mang ba dang / bod kyi nags tshal gyi 'byung khungs dang mdzes ljongs gtso bo zhig yin/ de min khong gi phebs shul sogs rlangs kyi po ti se'u ru las dpyad pa bya yul mang por snang bas kun gyi thugs la 'dzin par zhu/da lta sa cha dang dngos su ra 'phrod byung ba ni/ 1 nags shod/ 'bri ru rdzong khongs kyi sa cha phal che ba/ 2 sog shod/ sog g.yag la'i khul/ 2dkar shod/ sog rdzong khongs/ 4 re shod/ sog rdzong khongs/ 5 rgya shod/ stod 'bri ru dang smad dpal 'bar/ 6 sa shod/ dpal 'bar rdzong khongs/ 7 dpa' shod/ dpal 'bar rdzong khongs/ rdo rgyang shod/ steng chen rdzong khongs/ 9gyim shod/ steng chen rdzong khongs/ 10 rta shod/ steng chen rdzong khongs/ 11 g.yi shod dam g.yang shod ni ri bo che rdzong khongs/12 dngul shod/ lho rong rdzong khongs/ 12 rngod shod/ mdzo sgang rdzong khongs/ 14 zla shod/ chab mdo rdzong khongs/ 15 ngoms shod/ chab 86

mdo rdzong khongs/ 16 me shod/ sde dge rdzong khongs/ 17 smar shod/go 'jo rdzong khongs/ 1rdo kre shod/ dkar mdzes rdzong khongs zhes/ de ltar khams mdo stod nags shod nas smad dkar mdzes bar du skabs shig gcig 'gyur gyi sa babs dang chu rgyud rig gnas gcig gi sgrig gzhi'i khongs su gtogs pa zhig yin/ nags shod sman ljongs phyug mo 'di nyid mdo stod sa yi rtse mo yin par bka' chems bka' khol ma dang / rlangs kyi a mi byang chub 'dre 'khor dang / skyabs mgon rig 'dzin chos grags/ sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ gong sa lnga pa chen po/ sum pa ye shes dpal 'byor/ stag phu padma badzra/ zhang zhung chos dbang grags pa/ shing bza' bskal bzang chos rgyan/brag dgon bstan pa rab rgyas sogs kyis mgrin gcig tu smra/nags shod yul skyong nags lha dzam bha/lcang lo can gyi pho brang dam pa nas/mthu stobs bdag po'i 'od dkar las sprul pa/snod bcud dpal dang yon tan ma lus bdagaganyan rje nags lha'i byung ba brjod la spro/bsil ldan gangs ri'i phreng bas skor ba'i zhing 'dir grags che ba'i lha chen nags lha dzam bha 'di nyid/ byang phyogs lcang lo can gyi pho brang dam pa nas gsang bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa de nyid kyis sde brgyad ma rung ba rnams kyi gnyan po dang / 'gro rnams dbul phongs kyi sdug bsngal las sel phyir gnod sbyin nor lha'i rigs su sku sprul pa'i sa thob kyi sems pa chen po zhig yin par gsungs te/ sngon gyi bskal ba dang po la/ phan pa'i lha dang / gnod pa'i 'dre gnyis srid pa'i dus der/ yab 'o de gung rgyal dang / yum bdud rtsi 87

sman mo gnyis kyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ yum gyi spyi bo las ger mdzod/ dpral ba las nags lha/ phyag g.yas nas byi ro/ g.yon nas tsa ri'i btsan rgyal dmar po/ mgrin pa nas klu mi mgon dkar po bcas byon/ mdo khams shod chen bco brgyad kyi gnas 'dir 'dre srin gdug pa can gyi pho brang bco brgyad yod pa de 'dul ba la/ dkar phyogs sde brgyad kyis bka' gros shing / mo ma stag rdzong gi nags lhas 'dul bar mo la shar/ sde brgyad ma rung ba de rnams 'dul phyir/ byang gi phyogs dang dbus khams bcas kyi sa mtshams yar chab gtsang po lho nas nub tu 'bab pa'i 'go/ 'bri chu sngon mo nub nas shar du 'bab pa'i g.yas phyogs/ rgyal mo dngul chu nub nas shar du 'bab pa'i 'go ma/ mdo khams shod chen bco brgyad kyi dbu rtse/ bod khams srin mo gan rkyal du log pa'i dpung mgo g.yas pa ru phebs pa la/ yum gyis 'jig rten longs spyod spel bar smon lam btab/ yab kyis bdud rtsi spar bu de byin/ pha babs su phyir nas sbos rdzongs mer nag du sbas pas lung 'dir sa bcud dang 'byor ba che ba de las byung / gnas 'dir sku mkhar mdzad nas bse rmog dbu 'a/ gsol bas bza' mig rmog la rshar bas bza' rnams bran du 'khor/ dung khrabs dbu la gsol bas sgyu skar 'dul/ sde brgyad dmag dpung mdzad cing gnas bcas pas/ sde brgyad kun gyi rgol bar brtsams kyang / lha chen nags lha nam mkhar byon nas mdung rtse steng du btad pas steng gi lha dmag 'dul/ mdung sked bar du btad pas gnyan dmag 'dul/mdung steng sa la gtad pas klu dmag 'dul/ khyung ri'i 'gul du khyung dmag tshogs/ nags seng ge brag la seng dmag tshogs/ ne khyim 'gul du sman mo tshogs/ bon po ri la stag dmag tshogs/ shag o rgyan thang la sde brgyad tshogs/ de rnams nags lha'i dmag dpung dang stobs 'gran pas sde brgyad 88

dmag rnams pham par byas/ sde brgyad thams cad kyi rang rang gi bran g.yog bya bar zhus te/ ne khyim mched bdun btsun mo bya bar zhus/ shar du rma rgyal spom ra/ lho'i 'dzam bu'i klu ri/ nub nas gnyen chen thang lha/ byang lha btsan mu ne bzhis dmag dpon bya bar zhus/ jo bo rong lha rgyal mtshan/ klu rgyal ger mdzod gnyen po/ klu yi mi mgon dkar po gsum gyis gnyen po bya bar zhus/ shar sdong lha rdo rje brag rtsal/ dwags lha sgam po/ yar lha sham po/gangs dkar ti se bzhis bya ra bya bar zhus/ g.yag la se bo/ jo bo dpal 'dzoms dkar po/ chu grong smug po/ 'bum rje se bo/ a se thod nag khug btsan btsan po/ chu thal khams pa/ kang ri mthon po bcas brgyad blon po bya bar zhus/ rkyang ri rngog nag jo bo gram rdzong brag dmar/ jo bo man rdzong brag nag jo bo yo ba brag nag bcas bzhi las mdzad bya bar zhus/ jo bo dpal gyi bla ma/ jo bo g.yung drung smug po/ jo bo g.yung drung dar po/ dmod pa'i sras rgod btsan po bcas bzhi mdung 'dzin bya bar zhus/ g.yas na rgya tsha brag dkar/ g.yon nas glas dmar brag kyog mdun du bla ma'i thag gdong /rgyab tu me mo rag khrom bcas bzhi ru 'dren bya bar zhus/ bra rtsal lo nag g.yag tshe/ btsun po dpa' ba'i khyung tshe/ dpa' bo a sbang stag rtse/ lo yi sgo sdi tse ni bcas bzhis lha rje bya bar zhus/ spos rdzong mer nag shel lung snying ri/ do chung ser ru/ grib btsan dmar po bzhis gter srung bya bar zhus/lo phu zhal dkar/ brag dmar gnam rdzong / seb bkra rdza rgan/ sra rba ri rdzong bcas bzhis pho nya bya bar zhus/ dge bsnyen ag tshoms/ sngags pa yog nag rnga brdung / sngags pa sngas mo skad rdzong bcas gsum sngags pa bya bar zhus/shar na mo ma stag rdzong / lho yi g.yug rje gangs dkar/ nub tu dpal kyi nag ze/ byang na kong rtsa brag dmar bcas bzhis sgo srung bya bar zhus/ jor sgom 89

lha ri/ bar ri zlum po/ shan pa tsong ke dmar po bcas gsum gnyer pa dang shan pa 'go 'dzin bya bar zhus/ sde brgyad kyi dmag tshogs khri 'bum dang /ru 'dren sum brgya drug cu la sogs 'khor gyis bskor ba'o/yul skyong lha chen nag lha 'di sa thob kyi sems dpa' chen po slob dpon padma'i bka' bsrung chen po zhig yin te/ rje rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pas/o rgyan padma'i bka' sdod mchog lha chen nags lha dzam bha dang / de 'khor lha srin sde brgyad bsang zhes gsungs/ gnas kyi srung ma mdzad tshul ni/ sring rdzong bde bshegs sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi gnas/ me mo rag khrom mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i gnas/ o rgyan thang gu ru mtshan brgyad kyi gnas/ zi ro chos lung rdo rje phag mo'i gnas/ rkyang ri rngog nag tshe yi gnas/ sog rgyal ba rigs lnga sangs rgyas rigs lnga'i gnas/ chags ri phug dkar ser dmar sngo nag phag mo rigs lnga'i gnas/ khu ru 'phrang thub pa rigs drug gi gnas/ me 'bar phug ri ma ti mched lnga'i gnas/ de ltar nags lha 'di nyid bod khams spyi dang shod chen bco brgyad kyi gtso'i yul khams 'di'i gnas srung chen po zhig yin/ 〈slob dpon padma mdzad pa'i jo bo'i nags lha'i gsol mchod 'dod 'byung nor bu'i bang mdzod zhes bya ba las khol du phyung ba yin 〉snyigs dus 'dir rang rgyal gyi dbang gi byung rgyal du smra ba 'gas/ bod yig brda dag tsam phar zhog sbyor klog gtsang ma zhig mi shes bzhin du/ blun rmongs 'ga'i ngag sgros la ltas nas/ nags lha zhes pa de nag phyogs pa'i lha zhig red/des rkyen pas nags lha dang / de'i lung der gnas pa bdud sde red zhes 'ud sgrog chen po byas pa yang byung / de ni rang nyid bod kyi brda sprod rig pa la sbyangs pa med pa'i rang 'tshong ngoms pa las 'bras bu gang yang med de/nags shod pa'i yul skyong la nags lha dzam bha zhes pas/ khams shod chen bco 90

brgyad kyi dbu rtse/ chu bo rgyal mo dngul chu'i 'go ma/ sman shing nags klung gang ba'i shod du gnas pa'i sde la nags shod dang / yul skyong ba'i lha la nags lha zhes 'bod pa dang / mtshan dngos nor bu skug 'dzin/ dzam bha la/de min yab yum dang lha klu sde brgyad sogs gsol ba'i mtshan mang bar yod kyang de tsam gyis chog par bya ste/ dper na yul yar klung gi lha la yar lha dang /mtshan dngos sham po zhes pa dang gnyis su ma mchis pa zhig yin/ dpe tshan 'gar gzhi bdag rnams kyis nags lha ni nag phyogs pa dngos yin zhes zhus pa'i lo rgyus 'gar snang bas/ dam pa'i skyes bu zhig yin par khas 'che yang /gtam phug lha 'dre la bcol ba dgos pa gang yang med de/ sa thob sems dpa' zhig gi thugs rgyud/ gzhi bdag dman pa rnams kyis dpog par mi nus la/ ston pas gang zag gi rgyun gang zag gi mi lon pa yin gsungs pas/gzhi bdag la yid ches de tsam mdzad pa ni ches ngo mtshar/ yang kha gcig gis/ bsang gzhung du/ o rgyan pad ma'i bka' bsrung che/ lha chen nags lha dzam bha bsang zhes pa tshig ris de yang dor bar byed/ de ni lkugs rtags che ba dang thos pa med pa'i skyon yin te/ nyes pa rnams sel las/ gnyan chen thang lha la sogs pa/ dbus ru nyin srib sa bdag bsang / dwags po dpal ri la sogs pa/ dwags po nyin srib sa bdag bsang / kong btsun de mo la sogs pa/ kong po nyin srib sa bdag bsang / bzhag khra phyug mo la sogs pa/ mdo khams lha klu gzhi bdag bsang / ri bo dan tig la sogs pa/mdo smad lha klu gzhi bdag bsang / zhes mang bar gsungs pa dang / bsang gzhung 'gar/ 'dzam gling lha srin sde brgyad bsang zhes gsungs pas/'dzam gling dang bod khams stod smad la ma tshud pa'i thabs shig tshol dang /lhag tu srid zhi thams cad mgron bzhi'i khongs su ma 'dus pa ni gang yang med/91

kha gcig gis nags lha ni rgan gso zhag tshar ba red da lta dbang cha yod ma red zer/ dngos med lha 'dre ma dgos/ dngos yod rang gi 'go dpon su yin dang / shang las khungs brje 'then tsam yang mi shes bzhin du/ lha 'dre'i yo lang tshang ma mkhyen pa'i rtogs ldan de gdug can lha 'dres rgyud rlams pa zhig dang / thabs nus kyis rmongs pa'i rgyu nor spor ba'i mkhas mchog gnyis gang yin cha med/lha chen nags lha dzam bha 'di nyid kyi skyes rabs dang rtogs pa 'di yin bya bar spyan snga mngon shes lnga ldan dang sa thob skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi spyod yul las/ bdag cag rnams lta bu so skye phal ba zhig gis 'di dang 'di yin bya bar thag gcod ga la thob/ 'on kyang rgyal ba'i lung gi zin zhing rtsod med kyi mkhas grub rnams kyi gsungs la dpang por bya ste/ 'bri gung skyabs mgon rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pas/ o rgyan pad ma'i bka' srung che/ lha chen nags lha dzam bha bsang zhes dang gzhan yang nags lha'i bsang mchod las zhi rgyas dbang drag gi bsang gsol dang bstod pa yang mdzad yod/ skyabs mgon 'phrin las bzang pos/ hoḥdam can chos kun ye nas dmigs med kyang / sna tshogs du ma 'char ba rig pa'i sgo/ 'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das sgro btags tsam/ sangs rgyas bstan srung lha chen nags lhar bstod zhes/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan srung bya ba bshad sgrub las gsum skyong dang 'dzin dang spel ba la mgon skyob bya mkhan rnam pa chos skyong gyi skur bstan pa las don du sa thob byang sems sha stag yin/ de min dregs tshogs rnams chags sdang gis don phran la phrag dog dang yo lang sogs byed pa'i srung ma tsam las sangs rgyas bstan srung bya ba ga la thob/ khyab bdag stag phu padma badzra mchog gis/ khyed ni bla ma ltar bsten na/ byin rlabs rgya mtsho bdag la bstsol/92

khyed ni yi dam ltar bsten na/ dngos grub rgya mtsho bdag la bstsol/ khyed ni nor lha ltar bsten na/ 'dod rgu rgya mtsho bdag la bstsol/ khyed ni yul lha ltar bsten na/ sdong grogs kha 'dzin 'tsho skyong mdzod/ zhes gsungs pas gang la gang 'dul de la der ston pa/ 'jig rten 'das kyang srid pa'i skur bzhengs nas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa/ rtsa gsum kun 'dus kyi ngo bo yin pa dag sa gsum du gnas pa'i sems dpa' yin pa las/ nag phyogs pa'am dug gsum gyi kun nas dkris pa zhig bla ma yi dam nor lha bka' srung 'os pa zhig bka' bstan du 'dug pa ston dgos pa thal/ de ltar gsungs mkhan de ma nges zer na/ stag phu sku phreng brgyad pa rje btsun ngag dbang blo bzang 'jam dpal bstan pa'i dngos grub bam/ gter chen padma badzra zhes gzhung bka' pod lnga la mkhas shing / 'khrul med kyi gter ston chen po bod khams kun la grags pa'i mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi skyes bu min pa su yi smra/de dang mtshungs par stag phu sku phreng gnyis pa ngag dbang chos grags bzang pos/ ye shes 'od kyi pho brang dam pa nas/ lha gnyan nags lha dzam bha 'khor dang bcas zhes dang / zhabs drung mkhas grub bstan 'dzin 'jigs bral chos kyi rgyal pos/ dkar phyogs skyong mdzad lha yi dge bsnyen che/ yul skyong nags lha 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs zhes gsungs pa las nag phyogs pa zhig yin par ma gsungs pas de rnams gang zhig 'grel/ mi shes bzhin du smra ba ni rang 'tshang rdol ba las dgos pa dbeen to/nags lha'i lha mkhar/nags lha'i lha mkhar ram rten mkhar ni nags shod spyi yi nags lha'i bskang gso rgyun 'dzugs bya yul zhig yin pa dang / nam bzhengs skor de tsam 93

mi gsal kyang / lo rgyus yun ring ldan pa smos ma dgos te/ pa hrong thang gi dgon shul dang / chu ma mkhar/ ri ma mkhar/ seng thang la dgon shul dang /seng ge brag rtse la mtshams khang dang / o ke brag la mtshams khang gi shul yod pas de rnams gna' rabs kyi mkhar shul red/ mi rnams kyi bshad srol la gling bla brang lta smon dgon du phebs skabs/ lha mkhar du tsho shog nas 'bul ba g.yag khams pa bco brgyad tshe thar ram nags lhar spyan gzigs su phul bas de rnams dgra jag gcan gzan gyi 'tshe ba med par gzhi bdag gis 'tsho skyong bya ba dang / lha mkhar 'di gnas mchog lcang lo can dang dbyer med pas phyis su skyes bu 'gro don can zhig gis bzhengs par lung bstan par bshad/ gling sprul lung rtogs bstan 'dzin 'phrin las mchog spyi lo 1ṭwāṃ5rkyalor 'khrungs spyi lo 1900g.yas g.yon du gnas 'dir phebs par sems/ de'i sngon du 'bri gung gdan rabs nyer dgu pa skyabs mgon chos kyi nyi ma mchog spyi lo 1771lcags yos lo 'gom dgon du phebs nas zla lnga pa'i tshes nyer bdun la nags lha'i sbos rdzongs mer nag (spangs ljongs mer nag )la phebs nas bsang gsol dang / nags lha'i rten rdzas la lha rta gro zhur gcig dang lha g.yag rog po/ lha lug dkar po dang gter bum/ mtsho la ral gri klu bum bcas phul nas zhag gcig bzhugs/ de rjes 'bri gung gdan rabs sum cu pa skyabs mgon padma'i rgyal mtshan mchog 'gom dgon du phebs nas/ yar lam nags lha'i lha mkhar du zhag gsum bzhugs shing /bsangagasol rgyas pa/ lha rta dang lha g.yag sogs spyan gzigs su btsan pa gnang / khrom la bka' dbang bstsal bas de skabs lha mkhar zhes bris 'dug pas sngon dus su yod par nges/ 〈skyabs rje rnam gnyis kyi rnam thar bris ma las/〉 94

khyab bdag stag phu gter chen padma badzra mchog spyi lo 1916smin zla'i dus bzang la 'gom lding dpon nas gdan drangs nas lha rta rag pa rin chen rgyan dang bcas phul ba dang / de min rta nor dar zab/ gzi byur sogs 'bul ba mtha' yas phul/ rje nyid kyis sbos rdzongs nas nor bdag gsang ba'i bsgrub skor rnams gter nas bzhes/ lha mkhar du srog khang rten gtor bcas 'chug med lag tu bstar/ zhabs drung mkhas grub bstan 'dzin mchog spyi lo 1956lor gnas 'dir phebs nas bsang gsol mkha' lding dbang po bya ba skyi ru dpon tshang du mdzad/ de min nags shod bstan pa'i sgron me rnams gsum gtsos ris med mkhas grub rnams kyis bsang gsol dang bstod pa mdzad pa mang bar yod nges kyang / da lta de tsam las mjal ba'i skal ba ma byung bas rjes su 'god rgyu yin/lha mkhar du sngon dus su mgon khang ka ba bzhi dang steng thog ka ba bzhi/thab tshang ka ba gnyis lcags ri dang bcas yod pa dang / ka ba bzhi ni bstan pa'i sgron me rnam gsum dang tsho sde bcas kyi ka ba red zer srol yod pas dgos pa gang yin ma shes/ rten gtso slob dpon rin po che/ rigs gsum mgon po/ nags lha dang ge sar/ sgrol ljang / gsung rten du bka' 'gyur/sprin a tho nas byang chub mchod rten bcas bzhugs/ nyin ltar bskang gso chad med/ gnas 'dir bzhugs mkhan ni yul mi rgan rabs rnams kyi ngag rgyun du/ 'gom dgon dang / rab brtan dgon/ lta smon dgon gsum gyis lo gsum rer grwa pa gnyis re bzhugs srol res mos dang chos rgyun gtong rtsa yang mnyam du bzhag par gsungs/ bar skabs shig la 'gom a stag dge slong bya ba de spyod pa cung zhan pas stod dgon gnyis nas blo la ma babs pas bar skabs shig 'gom gyi mtshams pa bzhugs mkhan med par gyur kyang stong 95

rtsa rnams sngar bzhin rgyun gnas dang / lo gsum re'i rtsis sprod skabs su 'gom lding dpon dang / thang stod yab tshang / rgya sog dpon bcas kyis rtsis sprod byed kyi yod/ rig gsar gong du rab brtan dgon gyi grwa ye shes zla ba bzhugs/ de rjes lta smon grwa bstan 'dzin 'jam dpal bzhugs skabs rig gsar tshes nas tsha la brko ru song bas/ 'gom dgon pa'i grwa dkon mchog zhi ba bzhugs yod/lha mkhar gyi sgrig srol ni/ mtshams pa mtshams tho'i phyi la mi 'gro rgyu dang bskang gso chad med/ lha mkhar nas mig rgyang gang bar ri dwags mi bshol ba/sbos rdzongs mer nag nas bla ma'i mdo bar rta bzhon pa dang zhwa mo mi byon/ nye skor gnas tshul byung rigs mtshams pa nas thag gcod chog pa'i hor rgyal po'i sdig tham bcas yod/ lo rer sde spyi nas bka' 'gyur dag sgrog bla sprul gang rung nas dbang gzhi len pa/ rab gnas/ klu bum bcas 'bul/ tsho sde nas rta rgyug dang 'gros bsdur/ 'og 'gyur dang zhar 'phen sogs rtsed rigs sna tshogs bcas byed kyi yod/ spyi lo 1966spyi dang 'dra bar nyams gud du phyin/ spyi lo 19ra4lor 'gan khur bzang po dang / sgro ba khams gsum dbang 'dus/ rgya mi dpal 'byor dang / sbyin bdag dar khyung dang /mkhan po rkyang ri bsod nams bcas kyi gtso bo mdzad/ dad ldan mang tshogs yongs kyi rgyab skyor 'og mgon khang ka ba bzhi/ steng khang thab tshang ka ba gnyis/ rten gtso gu ru rin po che/ lha chen nags lha/ rigs gsum mgon po/ gsung rten bka' 'gyur cha tshang / thugs rten byang chub mchod rten bzhengs pa dang / mtshams bstan 'dzin 'jam dpal dang / ngag dbang lam bzang gnyis gdan drangs nas khong rnams gnyis kyis ge sar dang /sgrol ljang / mchod rten cha brgyad bcas bzhengs/ stag phu'i phyag gnang gu ru 96

gtso 'khor gsum/ 'od dpag med bcas dang / rab brtan dgon bka' bcu shes rab 'jam dpal nas nags lha zhi ba dang / skor lam du mchod rten cha brgyad/ smyung gnas lha khang ka ba gsum/ nang du spyan ras gzigs dang rnam sras/ stag phu padma badzra/ nyi grags gter chen bcas kyi sku dang /gser zangs kyi mchod rten bcas bzhengs grub/ steng thog la bla sprul rnams pa'i gzim chung / de yi nang du rje yab sras gsum dang de'i gsungs 'bum/rwa lo tsā'i phyag tsha 'jig byed sku byin can/ zhal thang ltung bshags so lnga/thang rnying rje yab sras gsum/ zhabs drung rin po che'i 'dra sku/ khyung sprul rin po che'i 'dra sku/ gnam lcags kyi me long bcas bzhugs pas 'dzam gling spyi dang nags shod pa'i lha chen nags lha'i rten mkhar khyad 'phags yin pas bsod nams dpal kyi gzhi ru dar zhing rgyas pa'o/nags shod pa'i goms srol/mdo stod nags shod pa'i yul ljongs 'di nyid/ ya thog gi dus su mi rigs dang yul lung rang nyid kyi goms srol thog bod spyi dang 'dra ba bod 'dod ma'i rang gshis dang de rjes bon gyi chos lugs spyod pa dang / cung lung phyogs yin zhing bon chos dang bod rnying pa'i goms srol yod pa smos ma dgos/ de rjes bod chos rgyal mes dbon rnams gsum gyi lugs bzang gis/shes rig can rnams gong du bkur ba dang / pha ma dang slob dpon la rang gi srog ltar brtse zhing / rang bstod pa dang gzhan smod la mi dgyes par/ phan tshun gleng mol byed skabs brda rnying dang bod snga ma'i skad brda mang zhing brda sprod rig pa dang mthun pa/ skad gdangs sbom la lhing zhing dal bar smra ba/ngo bstod kyi skad ris nyung zhing smras pa'i tshig las mi 'da' ba/ shes rig 97
