rnam dag zhig yin phyin brgyud pa nas brgyud par 'dzin zhing khung lung man ngag dang ldan/ dkon mchog la sri zhu che zhing ma nus pa la lhag par brtse ba/chos lugs grub mtha' mang zhing dgon gnas nyer lnga tsam yod kyang phan tshun ris med kyi rang tshugs thub pas thub bstan sgo kun nas skyong ba/ dam pa'i skyes bu mkhas grub mang po byung yang bya bral khengs skyung gis rang bstod dang rdzun bris nyung ba/ skyid dus ku co dang thob rtsod med la/ sdug dus phan tshun sems khur che zhing sdug theg pa/ ri klung med par nags tshal gyis gang zhing ri skyes srog chags dang rig dngos la gtor skyon nyung zhing bde bar gnas pa/rtsa chu bzang zhing phyugs lug dkar nag khra gsum gyis khengs pa/ zhing sa bzang bas 'bru rigs lo 'bras legs/ de skabs su phyogs gzhan nas sha mar 'bru gsum sgrub par nags shod du yong bar bshad/ dpon rnams dmangs la byams shing / dmangs kyis dpon la bkur ba/ phyi yi btsan 'dzul med pa dus bde ba rgan mo gser 'khur gyi lung zhes 'bod/ skyes pa rnams bod gdod ma'i srol ltar mgo la dar dkar gyi la thod dang / dbu skra lan gnyis bcas ni bod kyi sngon srol ltar gnas te/ po ta la'i chos rgyal sgrub phug gi rgyal blon rnams mjal ba tsam gyis shes par nus/ tshar lo dmar po ni bod dmag gyi mtshon byed yin snyam ste/ mdung gi tshar lo dmar po/rmog 'phru dmar po/ dbu gur gyi phub sogs kyis shes/ phyu pa'i phu dung sa la ma thug tsam dang / phyogs la thon skabs ral gri sogs mtshon cha dang mi 'bral/ bud med rnams gos sna ring zhing / rin chen sna lnga'i rgyan gyis stod smad kun tu mdzes pa/ lhag par du dung dkar gyi mdzes cha mdun du snol ba/ya rab mdzangs ma'i so tshis dang ldan zhing khyim bral gyi bya ba kun nas spangs/mi rnams rang gi rus la lhag par brtsi zhing rus dang ming mnyam du 'bod/98

nags shod stod smad bar gsum tshang mar lo ltar dge ba'i chos phyogs gang grub dang / nyin mtshan med par snying po yig drug la 'bad/ dgong ltar re bzhin dgong 'don zhes sgrol ma la sogs chag med gsung / de ltar ya rabs kyi spyod bzang shin tu mang yang bri bar ma longs pas/ mdor na bod du yul skor ba zhig yin phyin nags shod lung pa 'dir phebs na bod kyi yul skor gyi khyad chos cha tshang zhig khyed kyis mkhyen thub/nags shod kyi dpon khagasngon dus su lung 'dir dpon tshang mang po byung bar smos ma dgos pa 'og nas rim par gsal yang / spyir lung pa 'di nyid du gtso bo tsho dpon khag drug yod pa dang / de'i nang nas thob thang che zhing chen hu'i mtshan gnas thob pa stag drug dpon tshang yin/ hor rgyal rabs dgu pa lha rgyal dar gyis nags shod dbang sgyur skabs su/ rgya shod stod kyi na bur sen gsum nags shod du zla sbrel ba nas bzung nags shod tsho dgu bya ba byung / de ni stag drug 'bri ru/ 'gom/ bo phan/ rakṣi/ khra ring / na rog bu rdzum/ sen tsha bcas yin/ bod sil bu'i gong dang mjug nas da bar dpon gnas dang dpon rgyud ma nyams par gnas pas mi thog nyi shu lhag tsam son pa sha stag yin zhes gsungs/ dpon khag rnams kyi byung rim dang mi rgyud bcas kyi byung rim rnams skyabs rje ri dbang rin po ches brtsams pa'i deb ther du gzigs las zlos par mi bya'o/nags shod du chos lugs grub mtha' khag byung tshul/galuja drungacan/ yul 'dir sngar bod gdod ma'i rjes srol ltar chos 99

lugs kyi grub mtha' bon chos kho na yin pas/ da lta yang rgya shod du bon gnas dang dgon pa ma nyams par gnas/ yul 'dir nang bstan dar ba'i dus rabs ni/ rgyal po bka' chems deb ngos 1rdo5 shā ba gzungs nas rmos byas/ blang gru dus thang du rang thag chu bskor bcos/ nags shod du lam nor du bcug pa la sogs snyad byas nas 'gor ro/ zhes dang / de min blon po 'gar khams stod nags shod snye bo nags su slebs pa dang / nags shod na ong cong (kong jo )'khor dang bcas pa 'dug pas thugs dgyes so/zhes rgya mo bza' dang jo bo shākya mu rna bcas gnas 'di nas phebs/ de nas nags shod stod kyi dgon nyin srib phyag btab/ kong jos phyag gis rdo pha wang thog yi ge drug ma bris gnang shing / dbyangs su drangs pas da lta dbyangs mo khug zhes ming thog rang byung lta bu'i phyag bris da lta bzhugs yod kyang /tsan dan sol ba byas pa'i dpe ltar rdo de gsar du brkos nas lo rgyus kyi gna' rdzas de med par bzo ba'i nyen che/ de min zla thang nas yar phyin pas kha ze mdor rgya mo bza'i chibs drel gyi stod phur yin zer ba rdo phur nyag can gnyis bcas da lta dngos su bsdad yod pa dang / gru la cog nas jo bo bzhugs pa'i shing rta 'khor lo'i lam dgon pa srib bar ma nyams gsal bar gnas yod/ de ni yul 'dir nang bstan chos kyi thog ma de yin par snyam/gsaja sngags rnying ma ba/ slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas mchog gis/ byang shar mtshams na sbas yul lung gsum ljongs/ zhes sgrub gnas khyad par can du lung bstan/de rjes rlangs gyi grub thob byang chub 'dre 'khor mchog spyi lo 969sa sbrul lor 'khrungs shing / bod sil bu'i dus bstan pa phyi dar gyi skabs su gnas 'dir gsang sngags rnying ma'i grub pa thob zhing / sgrub gnas chags ri 100

'am khams kyi dur ba ri 'di yin pa dang mthar spyi lo 1076me 'brug lor sku mya ngan las 'das/ de rjes gter ston brgya rtsa'i rnam thar las/ o rgyan rdo rje gling pa nyid rgod lung du phebs pa dang bying mda' o dkar brag nas gter chos mang po spyan drangs pa dang / mu tig sher gyi rba ma gong du phebs par gsungs pa dang / chos skor khag gcig nang gnas 'dir min par bshad kyang dpyad pa bya dgos/ de'i rjes su 'bri gung 'pho lung sprul sku'i sku skye khams nang chen du sku 'khrungs pa/ gter ston chen po khams nyi ma grags pas shar gter pod nyer gcig bcas gter nas spyan drangs nas/ spyi lo 17rkya2chu lug lor chags ri dgon srin rdzong 'od gsal sgrub sde phyag btab/srin rdzong gi gnas sgo phye/ rang lugs grub mtha' zur du btod nas bshad grwa dang sgrub grwa tshugs/ dad ldan rnams kyis sa skor yul ris phul ba la gzhi byas nas bstan pa dar bas/ da lta nyi grags yab sras gtsos pa'i bla sprul rim par byung nas 'gro don rgyas bzhin mchis/ de min nags shod gter ston mahā badzra bya ba 'khrungs shing 'gro don cung byung bar mngon/bka' gdams la/ jo bo bka' gdams pa'i chos srol ni sne'u zur pa ye shes 'bar gyis ba lag dgon phyag btab nas rim par dar bas dgon gnas che shos yin pa dang / de min nags shod ko sna grong 'di sngon gyi bka' gdams pa'i dgon chen zhig chags pas/ dgon pa'i sa ming ma 'gyur bar da lta yang bed spyod byed kyi yod/bka'aldartsad la/ sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i mnga' bdag mar pa bka' brgyud pa'i bstan pa dang po ni/ spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu gnyis pa'i nang du phag mo gru pa rdo rje rgyal po mchog gis nags shod shug lding dgon phyag btab pa nas bzung rim par dar ba dang / de rjes 'bri gung skyob pa rin po che dang /101

spyan snga rin po che sogs rim par phebs/ gzhan yang karma pa dus gsum mkhyen pas phyag btab pa 'brong sna dgon 'du khang ka brgya ma bcas bzhengs pa nas bzung / karma pa zhwa dmar nag sku phreng rim byon gnas 'dir 'gro don rgyas/ dus mkhyen gyi thugs sras gya pa gangs pas sog tsan dan dgon dang wa thang dgon bcas btab nas nags sog tu 'gro don rgya chen mdzad/de rjes zhwa dmar mkha' spyod dbang po'i slob ma nags shod chos bzang gis stag rtse dang ba yo'i gdan sa mdzad/ nags shod pa bla ma rin bzang dkar pos nags shod du grib gdon dgon phyag btab/ de ni da lta sbyin chen dang sbyin chung gi bar na dgon chen zhig nyams pa'i shul dang / dgon de'i gsung rten bka' 'gyur gser bris 'bru re la gser zho re yod pa de nags shug lding dgon dang / rwa khyim dgon gnyis la bzhugs/ ces pas de min nam snyam pas phyis su dpyad/ (kha gcig gis 'brong sna dgon yin par 'dod )gzhan yang karma pa sku phreng bdun pa rta lo gsar bzhad nas nags shod du byon/ nags shod blo zam dang bkra shis steng du bla ma rin po che ban sgar bas thog mar mjal/ rdo rje 'chang dang sgrol ma sogs zhal gzigs/ sog tsan dan dgon du chos 'chad pa dang sgrub mchod btsugs/ dgon sde'i bca' khrims dang / yul sder ri rgya sogs dge bskul che/ dkar po rin bzang gis karma pa mthong ba don ldan khams la phebs skabs nags shod du gdan drangs nas grib gdong dang / sbrul mdor chos mang du gsungs zhes/de skabs sbrul mdo rnam chen dgon dang rnam chung dgon gnyis/ gcig 'bri gung bka' brgyud dang / gcig karma bka' brgyud yin zhes gsungs/ de min dwags po lcags lung dgon dang / skyi ru stag lung dgon/ kwa mchog 'brug dgon thar pa gling sogs bka' brgyud pa'i chos srol mang du dar/ nya102

phyis su rig gsar skabs su ldebs bris nyis rtsegs byung ba yang 'ga' byung /saskyali/ dpal ldan sa skya ba ni mngon tshan che ba ma dar kyang / shug lding dgon 'di nyid skabs zhig sa skya'i grub mtha' 'am chos srol 'ga' nyams len yod par bshad/dgeldan pa/ ri bo dge ldan pa zhes ring lugs dri ma med pa 'od stong can 'di nyid gnas 'dir shin tu dar rgyas che zhing / rje tsong kha pa'i dngos slob khri steng mdzes pa'i bla ma bzhi'i ya gyal/ gu she chen po dpal ldan don grub mchog gnas 'dir phebs nas dus rabs bco lnga pa'i nang tshan du stag gdong ri bo dpal 'bar dgon phyag btab nas gdan sa nags shod du mdzad nas nags shod stag phu zhes sku phreng rim byon rnams mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi grags pa'i snyan pa bzang / stag phu sku phreng brgyad pa padma badzra mchog gis stag phu'i tsa ri'i gnas sgo phye ba dang / stag phu'i gter gsar rnams gter nas bzhes nas nyams su bstar/rje yi slob ma grags pa bzhi'i ya gyal nags shod bstan pa'i sgron me rmams gsum las zhang zhung chos dbang grags pa mchog ni mnga' ris zhang zhung du 'khrungs/ 1440lcags sprel lor nags shod du phebs nas bka' dgon rnam chen dgon dang / rnam chung dgon gnyis nyams gud du phyin pa zla sbrel du btang nas khams stod nags shod sbrul mdo rnam rgyal dpal 'bar gling dgon rgyas bskrun gnang / mdo dbus khams gsum du dgon gnas mang po bzhengs yang gdan sa ni dgon 'di ru mdzad/ rje nyid sku phreng rim par byung ba rnams gzhung bka' pod lnga la mkhas pa dang / lhag tu zhabs drung mkhas grub bstan 'dzin mchog gis nags shod du smon lam chen mo'i ser tshogs dang / bka' pod lnga'i 'grel ba brtsams nas gzhung gi slob 103

gnyer bya yul chos gling dgon rgyas bskrun gnang nas chos dang gang spyir phyag rjes bla na med pa bzhag pas rje rin po che dang gnyis su med pa'i gus bkur byed kyi yod/ gzhan yang rje yi thugs sras bdun gyi ya gyal 'dul 'dzin grags pa rgyal mtshan mchog phebs nas 'dul bya lhag par che ba bshad srol tsam las dngos su phebs min dpyad pa zhu/rje yi slob ma grags pa bzhi'i ya gyal rgya ston blo bzang grags pas shug lding dgon phyag btab/ 'brong sna dgon drung blo bkra shis/ rwa khyim dgon lha rtse bla mas phyag btab/ ban dkar dgon ni sngon karma bka' brgyud kyi dgon khag lngar zla sbrel nas bye'u gnas brtan blo bzang gis phyag btab pa bcas da lta nags shod 'bri ru rdzong khongs su ri bo dge ldan pa'i dgon gnas mang /nags shod pa'i 'bri ru rdzong khongs su dgon gnas rnams kyi mtshan tsam brjod pa ni/ gsa' mda' dgon/ sen tsha dgon/ dga' ri dgon/klu mkhar dgon/ dngul kho dgon/ rdo rteng dgon bcas bon dgon/chags ri dgon/ rgod lung dgon/ se bkra dgon bcas rnying ma ba dang /'gom dgon/ wa thang dgon/ mar sgyed dgon/ glang del dgon bcas bka' brgyud/shug lding dgon/ g.yag 'khrab dgon/ chos sde dgon/ 'bri ru dgon/ chos gling dgon/ sgrub sde dgon/ 'brong sna dgon/ rwa khyim dgon/rab brtan dgon/ lta smon dgon/ ban sgar dgon/ bya sna dgon/ bya mda' dgon bcas ri bo dge ldan pa'i lugs 'dzin pa bcas zhib par 7skyabs rje ri dbang rin po ches brtsams pa'i 〈nags shod 'bri ru'i lo rgyus 〉su gzigs par 'tshal/104

nags shod pa'i rig gnas dang sgyu rtsal/sngon dus su gnas 'dir lo rgyus thog gnas lnga rig pa'i mkhas pa'i khyu tshogs grangs med byon nges kyang dus rim sna tshogs kyi dbang gis brtsams chos dang rtsom pa po'i mtshan rnams da lta ma bzhugs/ rjes su bod sil bu'i 'jug 'dir de dang mtshungs par chos lugs grub mtha' khag dang mkhas grub mi dpon grags pa che ba mang du byon nges kyang dpyad gzhi'i yig rigs lag son ma byung bas rjes su kun gyis dpyad par bya dgos pas yul chu btung pas yul khrims srung zhes pa'i dpe ltar 'gan rang babs su yod pa bshad ma dgos/ da lta bod kyi lo rgyus dang lo na rgan pa'i zhal rgyun dang dngos su bzhugs pa bcas nas byung ba'i mkhas dbang rnams kyi brtsams chos gang yod thor tsam 'bri bar bya ste/ rje rin po che'i dngos slob khri steng mdzes pa'i bla ma bzhi'i ya gyal stag phu gu shri dpal ldan don grub mchog dus rabs bco lnga'i nang nags shod du phebs nas stag gdong ri bo dpal 'bar phyag btab/khong ni mkhas pa'i snyan pa 'dzin ma'i khyon du khyab pa dang / gsung rtsom la/〈cho ga'i rnams bshad 〉dang 〈bar do'i ngo sprod dris lan po ti gcig 〉sngon 'gro'i skor dang / 〈rang rnam pod gcig 〉bcas mdzad/ de rjes stag sprul sku phreng gsum pa ngag dbang chos grags bzang po mchog rgyud smad dang dga' ldan byang rtser phebs nas slob sbyong mdzad/ se ra'i khri thog bcu bzhi pa mdzad/dgung lo drug cu chu byi lo 1552lor dga' ldan khri pa'i gser khrir lo bdun bzhugs pas 'gro don mtha' yas dang / brtsams chos 〈nags lha'i lha bsang dgos 'dod nor bu'i bang mdzod 〉dang de min mang po yod par nges kyang da lta 'di yin bya ba ma rnyed/stag phu sku phreng bzhi pa blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan mchog 'bras blo 105

gsal gling du chos zhugs dang / lha ldan smon lam chen mo la grwa bskor mdzad/dkar nag rtsis la sbyangs pa mthar phyin/ gsung rtsom la 〈rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma na ro mkha' spyod ma 〉dang / 〈'od zer can ma'i gsol mchod/〉'dzam gling du skad grags yod pa'i bod kyi mtho rim slob grwa yongs kyi sbyang gzhi 〈bya mgrin sngon zla ba'i rtogs brjod 〉dang / 〈dpal ye shes mgon po legs ldan beng 'dzin la brten nas nyams len bya tshul 〉sogs chos tshan drug cu bcas mdzad/stag sprul sku phreng lnga pa gar gyi dbang phyug ni 'bras spungs blo gsal gling du chos bzhugs mdzad/ bod gzhung gi bka' ltar gnam mtshor phebs nas mtsho'i zhal kha phye bas/ byams dang rta mgo gser tog dang / gdan sa pho brang dge 'phel byang chub gling zhes mtshan snyan gsol/ tsa ri mkha' 'gro snying rdzong gi gsang gsum gyi yon tan shar zhing 〈gnas yig rtsa ba me tog chun po 〉mdzad/ ri bo gru 'dzin/ g.yu lo bkod pa/ o rgyan gsang mdzod sogs la phebs nas 〈gsang ba bcu gsum 〉gyi gsang gter bzhes/ gsung rtsom la 〈gnas mchog bho dhi di pa'i gnas kyi yon tan/〉 〈dga' ldan phyag rgya chen mo'i dris lan/〉 〈 rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgo nas gshin po'i rjes 'dzin/〉〈kun rig cho ga bsdus pa/〉 〈dpal sa skya'i gser chos bcu gsum rjes gnang phyogs bsgrigs/〉 〈stag phu'i 'khrungs rabs/〉 〈rta mgrin sgrub thabs/〉 de min rig gzhung spyi dang bstan srung chos skyong yul lha gzhi bdag gnas bstod bcas pod brgyad tsam bzhugs/ stag phu gar dbang gis nags shod du dmigs bsal du steng dkar ras pa dang sbyin chen ras pa/ mo ba ras pa bcas btsugs pas da lta steng dkar ras pa gcig pur bsdad yod pas/ ri dbang rin po che'i thugs 106

bskyed 'og ras pa rgan gras rnams kyis nyams gso zhus pas da lta bod ljongs sgyu rtsal srung skyob khang du tshud yod/ ras pa ni rnal 'byor dbang phyug mi la ras pa las byung ba'i skor bshad srol yod pas nags shod steng dkar ras pa dang ar gzhas gnyis kyis bod kyi gna' rabs sgyu rtsal dang / bod kyi rig gnas bcu'i tshab mtshon dang don snying ldan pa'i dmangs khrod rig gnas chen po zhig yin/ 'di la 'khrab tshan sum cu so lnga tsam yod/ da lta bod du mtshan snyan 'dzam gling la skad grags yod pa'i gtam brjod zlos gar dgod bro'i gtam gleng zhes pa 'di lo rabs nyi shu'i smad du bod la dar ba yin zhes mig dmar lags dang thub bstan lags gnyis kyis gtsos phyag las gnang gi yod/ 'o na nags shod du steng dkar ras pa'i nang gi bod kyi lha mo'i 'khrab gzhung chos rgyal nor bzang dang / rgya bza' kong jo bcas kyi thogabram ze/ rkang mgyogs/ klu rgyal/ srid pa'i pha ma rgan khog drang srong lha mo/nya pa'i ri bshad/ rku ma rna bcad dang brag g.yab tshong pa bcas 'khrab tshan rig gzhung thog la gtam brjod zlos gar gyis bzang po la bstod pa/ ngan pa la zur za dang dus babs kyi bslab bya/ gzhon nu rnams la phug bsam gyi bslab bya sogs spyi mtshungs ltar dgod bro la rna bar snyan pa'i mtshar gtam 'di bod kyi lo rgyus thog dgod bro'i gtam gleng dang po de yin kyang / rang gis 'di yin zhes dril bsgrags byed ma thub pas gzhan gyi ma shes pas bod kyi dgod bro'i gtam gleng nye rabs su dar bar bshad pa yin/ de min chogs lugs dang 'brel ba'i 'khrab tshan rje btsun mi la ras pa dang khyi ra ras pa/gzhan yang pi wang kha gzhas bya ba 'di snyan 'jebs ldan pa'i zhabs bro sogs gna' bo'i sgyu rtsal ji ma ji bzhin gnas yod/ stag phu gar dbang kyis mdzad pa'i gar 'di ni spyir glu gar dang rol mo dkrol gtong bya ba'i rig rtsal gyi 107

rnam grangs shig yin pas bod yul stod smad bar gsum la cung mi 'dra/ gar ni bod kyi btsan po de sho legs kyi skabs su dar bas lo ngo nyis stong lnga brgya tsam gyi lo rgyus ldan/ phyis su mdzad sgo che khag rnams la 'khrab srol yod/nags shod pa'i gar dang stag phu'i ar gzhas gtsos pa'i dmangs khrod kyi zhabs gzhas khag gcig dang rwa khyim grong gi bod shog bzo skrun lag rtsal bcas gzhan dang mtshungs par bod kyi sgyu rtsal srung skyob khang du tshud par bya dgos/stag phu sku phreng bdun pa padma badzra mchog 'bras spungs su chos zhugs mdzad/ dbu ru bar skor phebs nas myang gu ru phug nas mkha' 'gro'i brda yig lan gsum babs/ rje 'bangs nyer lnga'i zhal gzigs/ sgrub sde dgon phyag btab/ stag phu'i ar gzhas le'u sum cu lhag yod pa ljags rtsom gnang ba 'di ni/ khyab bdag stag phu pa chen po'i ar gzhas ni bod kyi ar gzhas kyi nang nas rtsom rtsal thog khyad du 'phags pa'i sa gzhi'i chags rab/ dam chos dar ba chos kyi snying po nyams len bya tshul/ dus babs kyi bslab bya sogs ha cang gi gson nyams ldan pa zhig yin te/ rang lung pa'i sgor gzhas/gzhas shags/ glu gar sogs rmang gzhi'i thog la gsar gtod gnang bas/gnas 'dir glu gar gyi pha sa zhig yin/ bod mi rigs spyi dang lhag par rang lung pa'i gna' bo'i sgyu rtsal zhig yin pas da lta nag chu'i sgor bro sogs dang /de min smad phyogs su dar nas 'od sder du yang mthong rgyu yod/ dbus khul su yang spyod bzhin yod pas/ dmangs khrod kyi sgyu rtsal de rnams rang lung pas 'od sder dang brnyan 'phrin sogs su ngo sprod ma thub pas nags shod lung pa nas byung ba'i dmangs khrod kyi sgyu rtsal zhig yin pa shes kyi med pas/ gzhan gyi 'od sder du lung pa so so'i dmangs gzhas zhes 'bri gi yod kyang / da lta 108

nags shod pa'i dmangs gzhas zhes bris pa gcig kyang med pa 'di/ dper na rgyu rgyab la mi dgos zhes pa ltar bdag skyong ma thub pa'i lan pa ni/ rang lung pa'i rig gnas sgyu rtsal la 'dengs rtsis de tsam med pa'i rang rtags shig red/ de dag la phyogs sgrig dang 'od sder sogs bzos nas 'od sder gyi lam du 'grims thub pa bya rgyu de gal che bar mthon/ de dang mtshungs par rje nyid kyi ras pa yang bskyar gso mdzad par grags/ de min tsa ri mkha' 'gro snying rdzong gi gsang gsum gyi yon tan sogs gzigs nas gnas kyi sgo mo phye/〈gar gyi dbang phyug gi 'khrul ba 'byam gsang ma'i lo rgyus rgyab can/〉〈gsang chos rgya can bcu gsum dbang chos phyogs sgrig〉 〈gter gsar/〉 〈bde gshegs so lnga'i mdo chog〉 〈dzam lha'i chu sbyin/〉 〈 thugs rje chen po'i sgrub thabs 〉sogs chos tshan drug cu yod par gsungs/rje yi slob ma grags pa bzhi ya gyal zhang zhung chos dbang grags pa mchog rje yi slob ma'i nang nas rnam dpyod shin tu che bar grags la/ nang rig spyi dang / sgra tshad snyan ngag sdeb sbyor tshig rgyan mngon brjod sogs la dge ldan bstan 'dzin kun gyi nang nas rje 'di las mkhas pa ma byung / nags shod sbrul mdo'i gdan sa mdzad/ chab mdo dgon pa'i khri thog gnyis pa gnang /gsung rtsom la 〈rnam nges la thad ldan gyi 'grel pa/〉 〈dus 'khor bskyed rdzogs/〉〈mkhas grub rje'i dus 'khor ṭig chen 'phro lus mjug rdzogs/ 〉〈dpal mi la bzhad pa rdo rje la bstod pa tshigs bcad ma/〉sogs mdzad/〈snyan ngag ra ma ṇi'i gtam rgyud las brtsams pa'i snyan ngag gi bstan bcos dri za'i bu mo'i rgyud mang gi sgra 〉spyi lo 1429lor brtsams pa'i bod kyi ra ma ṇi'i gtam rgyud bod rang gi skad du phab pa dang po de yin/ zhabs drung sku phreng dgu pa ngag dbang dge legs mchog gzhung bka' pod lnga la sbyangs/109

rang dgon du chos spyod khag la dag ther gnang / rgyang rtse'i mchod rten dang mtshungs par bzhengs/ gsungs rtsom la 〈dpal lha mo'i zlog mdos/〉 〈myur mdzad ye shes mgon po'i bstod bskul/〉 〈 me long gdong dang bkra shis lha rtse'i bsang mchod/〉bcas mdzad/zhabs drung sku phreng bcu gcig mkhas grub bstan 'dzin mchog se rwa theg chen gling du grwa saracazhugs lha rams dge bshes pa'i mtshan rtags bzhes nas dgung lo nyi shu la rang dgon du phyag phebs/ dgon pa rnams zhabs brtan dgon pa tsam gyis thugs ma tshems par mtshan nyid bshad grwa 'dzugs par thugs bskyed nas 〈gzhung pod lnga'i rtsa 'grel 〉brtsams/ chos gling dgon rim bzhin nyams gso gnang / rig 'dzin 'ja' tshon snying po'i sku gong ma/ gter ston chen po ma hā badzra mchog nags shod smad du sku 'khrungs/khams sring mo rdzong gi gnas yig dang gnam lcags kyi rdo rje bcas gter bzhes mdzad/ nags shod se tsha grub thob ni grub pa thob pas nam mkhar bya ltar lding zhing / sprul sgyur nus pas sogs shod du sogs tsan dan dgon gyi nyer 'tshe thams cad tshar bcad nas 'gro mgon bka' brgyud pa'i bstan pa'i srol rnam gsos pa sogs mdzad 'phrin mtha' yas/rdzogs chen gdan rabs gnyis pa slob dpon rin po che ni/ se tsha grub thob kyi gdung rgyud du sku 'khrungs/ chung nas dam pa'i rang rtags ngoms shing grub thob pa'i spyod pa kho nar mdzad/ bka' brgyud pa'i chos sgor zhugs nas phyag chen dang chos drug ro snyoms skor drug ras chung snyan brgyud la sogs nyams len byas nas rtogs pa mngon du gyur/ nges med kyi rtul bzhugs phebs pas rdzogs chen grub dbang rin po che dang mjal nas gdams ngag rnam bum pa gang byos kyi tshul du gnang bas rgyal tshab du mnga' gsol bas 110

gdan rabs gnyis pa mdzad pas zhal gdams sogs brtsams chos yod nges kyang ma mjal/ slob tshogs ni gsang sngags rnying ma ba'i che dgu rnams kyis gtsos ris med mkhas grub mtha' yas byon pa yin no/ 'gro ba'i mgon po khams nyi ma grags ni rab byung bcu gcig nang me phag lor sku 'khrungs/rdzogs chen padma rig 'dzin gyi drung du lo brgyad tsam bzhugs nas bka' chos mang bar gsan/ mdo dbus stod smad bar gsum dang 'phags yul sogs phebs/ khams kyi sring mo rdzong gsum sogs nas gter chos 〈shar gter 'bras bu lta bu'i chos skor po ti nyer gcig 〉gdan drangs/ nyi grags gter chen rin po che sku phreng gnyis pa padma theg mchog bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan mchog nags shod snol ma grong du gter chen mahā badzra gyi rgyud du sku 'khrungs/ 'bri gung lho sprul skus 'gom dgon du lung bstan pa ltar/ nyi grags rin po che'i yangs srid du khrir bkod/ skyes sbyangs kyi dpal yon du mas phyug pas/mkhas btsan bzang gsum gyi yon tan bod gangs can gyi zhing du grags pa dang / nyer mkho'i bstan bcos pod gnyis mdzad/gter ston chen po klong chen rol ba rtsal lam rig pa'i rdo rje ni/ nags shod smad yar thang du sa byi lor sku 'khrungs/ skyes ma thag o rgyan rin po che mkhyen zhes lan gsum gsungs/ dgung lo bdun la phyag rjes bstsal/ sring rdzong sgrub sder phebs pas mkhas grub kyi go 'phang mthon por phebs pas sprel lor bka' shag gzhung nas sman sgrub tshugs pa'i zhabs 'degs bla na med pa gnang / mi lpags rong nas zab gter gdan drangs/ mkha' 'gro bzhis rdo zhig bteg nas byung ba bcag pas nang nas bka' 'dus chen mo sogs zab chos gter rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab par byung / sku tshe smad du dbus gtsang su phebs nas gzhung sa'i rgyal tshab de me rin po che sogs mkhas grub mi sde kun 111

gyis gtsug tu bkur/ gzhan yang rgya gar gnas chen khag sogs nas gter bzhes mang / mthar mdzad pa 'phrin las thams cad yongs su mthar phyin nas zangs rir sku gshegs/ slob tshogs ni mdo dbus stod smad kun tu gang ngo / de min sku phreng rim byon la gsung chos brtsams pa yod nges kyang ma mjal/'brong ngur chos rje sku phreng dang po gya pa chos rje mchog mkhas grub gnyis ldan du gyur nas/ mtshur phu'i gdan rabs bzhi pa dang / karma pakṣi'i yongs 'dzin gnang / nags sog la 'gro don che/ brtsams chos yod par grags kyang ma mjal/ chos rje sku phreng dgu pa dge ba'i dbang po mchog ni mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyur nas snyan pa'i grags pa phyogs rgyar khyab/ bcu phrag rig pa'iganas la shin tu mkhas pas/ gong sa lnga pas mdo ba chos rje dge ba'i dbang po mkhas btsun bzang gsum gang nas kyang gral 'gor 'god rgyur 'dug gsungs/ gong sa mchog la zhabs brtan phul ba'i snyun las grol bas rta mgo gser tog sogs dang / rtse pho brang gi rta lam gong mar chibs bskyod thog phebs chog pa'i go gnas bstsal/ de ltar gong sa lnga pas kyang mthon bzos che bas byang phyogs paṇḍi ta dge ba'i dbang po zhes pas brtsams chos yod par nges kyang / da lta 〈me mo'i gnas bshad 'gro ba 'dren pa'i shing rta 〉ma gtogs ma mjal/nags shod grub dbang yon tshang chos ldan ni rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i nang du nags shod du 'khrungs/ 'bri gung du phebs nas sgrub grwa'i khri thog nyer gsum pa gnang bas brtsams chos la 〈chos drug man ngag padma'i zhal lung bya ba rgyas bsdus gnyis/ bla sgrub dmigs rim zhib rgyas/ phyag chen khrid kyi lung sbyor 〉sogs mdzad/ 112

'bri gung grub dbang chos skyabs rin po che ni chung dus nas shag wa thang dgon gyi grwa pa mdzad nas 'bri gung du chos zhugs su phebs/ 'bri gung sgrub grwa'i khrid dpon no no rin po che dang skyabs mchog rnam gnyis kyi zhabs nas bka' brgyud pa'i chos srol yongs su rdzogs pa zhus/ thos bsam sgom gsum mthar phyin nas 'bri gung sgrub grwa'i slob dpon khri thog so gcig pa mdzad nas lo nyer brgyad bskyangs/ brtsams chos la 5bka' phyag chu bo gsum sgril gyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor/〉 〈mar lugs phag mo gsang chen rgya mtsho/〉 〈 rnam rgyal tshe sgrub 〉sogs chos tshan nyer gnyis da lta'ang bzhugs/ ri dbang dkon mchog dam chos bstan pa'i nyi ma mchog ni gnas lnga rig pa'i mkhas mchog cig yin pa dang / lhag par 'tsho byed sman la mkhas pa'i tshad du 'dzin pa dang /brtsams chos sman gyi phyag len sogs 'ga' yod par gsungs kyang da lta ni ma bzhugs/nags shod u thang phyug mor char rgyud tshang zhes sman rtsis gnyis dang /lhag par dkar nag rtsis dang dbyangs 'char bcas kyi phyag len la mkhas pa/bod khams spyi dang rang lung pa'i sa babs dang yul dus dang bstun nas rje gong ma rim byon gyis mi rabs mang po'i myong ba'i thog nas lo ltar lo tho bzos nas rgya che'i mang tshogs la phan pa bskrun pa dang / nag rtsis 'debs nas rkyen sel bar chad sel rogs dang / dbyangs 'char gyi gzhung las tshe 'di'i skag rigs rnams sel ba'i thabs shes dang gto bcos phyag len la shin tu mkhas shing / khong tshang gi mi rabs mang pos shes rig rtsis kyi rgyun 'dzin phun sum tshogs pa dang / lo rgyus yun ring ldan pa'i khyim rgyud cig yin/ sman rtsis sogs rig gzhung gi dpe cha khang chung zhig gang bar yod pa dang / de'i nang du gzhan gyi go thos yod pa 〈sangs rgyas bstan rtsis 〉bya ba/113

lo tho'i bstan rtsis phyogs bsgrigs pod gcig yod par gsungs pas mi rabs nas mi rabs bar bod khams spyi dang yul lung 'di'i dgon gnas dang mi sna grags can sogs lo tshig bstar la brgyus pa'i rtsa che'i nor bu gcig yin kyang rig gsar skabs su gtor brlag phyin/ de min dpe tshan gang yod 'di dang 'di zhes ma shes/ dus rabs nyi shu pa'i nang du char rgyud rtsis pa 'bas dga' zhu ba bzhugs pas dgon khag rnams gtsos pas dkar nag rtsis la mkhas pa'i slob tshogs mang / da lta khyim rgyud dang rtsis rgyud ma chad par bzhugs yod/gnyags mdo sog ru lha rje tshang ni mi rabs nas mi rabs bar sman sngags rtsis gsum gyi rgyud pa ma chad pa lo rgyus yun ring ldan pas grags can gyi sman rgyud shig yin/ sog ru'i ril dmar zhes pa sogs rang lugs sman sbyor khag gi phyag len dang / sog ru tshang gi lha khang du sman gyi dpe cha sogs ha cang mang shing rig gsar skabs me brgyab pas nyin gnyis tsam me thag ma chad/de'i nang du rin chen sna lngas bris pa'i dpe tshogs mang ba dang / mi rabs mang pos nyams myong phyogs bsdoms dang / gnas 'di'i sa babs gshis dang / sman sna khag gi grangs dang tsha grang gi khyad chos bcas gsal bar gsungs pa'i dpe tshogs rtsa chen mang po dang / de min khyim rgyud dang spyi'i lo rgyus zung du 'brel ba bcas yod par gsungs kyang da cha med par gyur/ da lta khyim rgyud ma nyams par gnas yod kyang / sman rgyud ni ma stongs tsam las med/de rnams dpe mtshon tsam las gzhan yang mkhas dang grub pa'i rnam thar dang brtsams chos mang bar yod nges kyang thos 'dzin gyi bu gar nges pa can ma lhung / dper na nags shod bstan pa'i sgron me rnam gsum gtso'i bla 114

sprul sku phreng rim byon khag dang / de mtshungs gdan sa khag la phebs pa'i dge bshes dang bka' bcu ba mang po byung myong bas gsung rtsom grangs can yod par nges/ de min rnying ma dang / bka' brgyud pa'i mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyis brtsams pa'i gsungs rtsom kyang yod nges pas/ da lta bzhugs pa dang ma bzhugs pa'i mtshan tsam dang / grags can gyi mi sna sogs gang spyi nas phyogs bsgrig gnang ba'am/ yang na dgon sde rang rang so sos phyogs bsgrig dang 'grem ston ma byas na/ rje gong ma rnams byon pa'i byon go mi chod pa dang / khong rnam pas brtsams pa'i dgos pa dang nying dgos rnams stong bsam ring lugs su 'gyur rgyu yin/ grags can mi sna dang gna' dgon brtsams chos rnams 'grem spel thub na rje gong ma rnams kyi mdzad pa'i dmigs yul dang don go chod nas/ dad ldan phyi rabs pa'i rgyud la dngos shugs brgyud gsum la phan thogs nas rje bla ma de 'dra shig byon pa'i byon go chod pa yin/ de min gsung rtsa chen po yin zhes ma dpe gcig pu nyar nas gzhan la mi ston par dad pa chen pos rten gyi grangs su bzhugs kyang / kun gyi mjal mi thub pa dang gcig pu brlag na rin thang ldan pa'i nor bu de phyogs gang du btsal kyang rnyed par mi 'gyur/ gsungs rtsom yar rgyas dang 'grem spel dar khyab bcas btang na/ rje bla ma de nyid sku yis 'gro don yol kyang / gsung gis 'gro ba rnams la 'gro don rgya chen po mdzad pa dang mdzad bzhin pa zhig yod thub/ de ltar ma byas na lung pa gang zhig yin kyang rnam dpyod dang dpa' rtsal spyang grung ldan pa'i mi med par brtsi ba dang / chos tshan rnams sogs rig gnas rnams dar rgyas ma btang na gzhan gyi mi shes/shes kyang dpe tshan rnyed pa shin tu dka' bas rig gnas sgyu rtsal gang zab pa dang / gang la rogs skyor dang nus pa 'don pa'i kha phyogs med la shes med 115

kyi lung pa zhig yin par chags 'gro/ lung tshan gang zhig yin kyang gna' bo'i lo rgyus dang mi sna grags can sogs mtshan rnams bskyar du gsos nas gong ma'i shul bzhag rig dngos dang lo rgyus la nga tsho lo chung rnams la ma bskos kyang 'gan rang babs yod pa dang / phyi rabs pa'i 'byung rtsa yin pa shes dgos/ dper na snga rabs kyi lo rgyus kha gsal med pa'i thog mi sna rgan rabs khag gcig la bka' 'dri zhu ba'i gnas med pa dang / khag gcig sku gshegs pas khong rnams la yang 'gan yod pa yin/ da lta dbus gtsang khul sogs la mtshan snyan phyogs bzhir khyab pa'i gnas dgon 'di rnams lo rgyus dang mi sna grags can gyi mtshan snyan dang phyag rjes bskyar gso byas ba las byung ba zhig yin pa dang / brtsams chos kyi rtsom rtsal/ nang bzhugs lha sku'i rgyu cha dang / phyi lha khang gi bkod pa gzhan las mtshar bas byung ba zhig de bas ma yin/ da lta dus rabs nyer gcig pa'i nang du 'dzam gling 'dir dbyin yig dang glog klad la sbyangs pa med na yig rmongs sel ba'i ming med pas/ rang re rnams bod yig sbyor klog tsam dang grong chog tsam gyis chog mi shes par rig gnas thams cad la 'bad pa bya dgos/ rgyal ba'i lung rtogs kyi bstan pa ni 'dzam gling la kha phyogs pa dang / yun ring gnas pa la rang re bod mi rigs spyi dang lhag par dgon pa khag gi grwa btsun rnams yin/ rang re rnams kyis snga srol rig gnas rnams rgyud 'dzin dang da lta'i dus rabs la kha phyogs nas 'dzam gling chos lugs khag gi nang nas tshad ma dang tshan rig pa'i gzhi 'dzin sa dang / 'dzam gling zhi bde bskrun pa'i gnyen po ni nang chos kho na yin par ra sprod bya dgos/ nye char rang re rnams la rmongs dad pa dang / sems gtso pa/ stong bsam ring lugs zhes pa'i ming de rnams ston pas gsungs pa'i dam chos bslu med kyis ma lan par/ rang re rgyud 'dzin rnams thos bsam 116

sgom gsum ya bral spyod pas lan pa yin/ grwa btsun rnams kyis nang rig dang rgya bod dbyin gsum la sbyangs pa byas nas dus rabs la kha phyogs pa'i dgon rer ma thar slob grwa re rgyun ma chad pa nges parachu'adzugs thub par bya dgos pa las gzhan du ltag chu chad pa'i rdzing bu lta bu las yun ring brtan po mi yong bas dam 'dzin bya dgos/ de dang mtshungs pa rgya che'i dad ldan rnams kyis grwa btsun gcig pur chos lugs mi sna zhes ma bos par/ phyag bskor dang ma ṇi bcas gcig pus chog shes ma byed par/ 'go skyabs 'gro nas dngos gzhi phyag rdzogs dbu gsum bar tshig 'bru re re ltar go ba len nas rang rgyud la bde ba bskrun dgos pa las/ rang nyid chos la blo sems mi gtad par 'don gla dang chos lugs mi sna gdan 'dren zhus pa gcig pus ga la 'grig bka' dbang gcig gi dbang gral du tshud pa'i mi zhig yin phyin rdo rje spun yin pas don chung phran tsam 'ga' la don chen ri tsam bzo ba de rnams gzhan don lta zhog rang nyid kyi lta ba mtho ba dang rang gi rang la dad che ba las byung bas bzod pa sgom gang thub bya dgos pa las/ chos zhes bskor ba dang kha ton dge sbyor byed rgyu las/ de min lus ngag yid gsum la g.yo 'gul ma btang na/ sems 'dul sangs rgyas bstan pa yin bya ba'i gnas med pas kun gyi don la 'jug par 'tshal/ dud tshang zhig gam tshogs pa che chung gang 'dra zhig zhugs kyang sngon rjes la sems 'phral dang mno bsam med par 'di yin bya ba mi sgrub pa de rnams yang na re dog bral ba'i bya bral gyi 'khrul zhig chen po zhig dang / yang na snga bsam phyi blo med pa'i blun rmongs mdo med cig dang gnyis las ma 'das/bod sil bu'i mjug gi nags shod/bod btsan po'i rgyal rabs dgu pa mjug rdzogs nas bod yul stod 117

smad bar gsum sil bur gyur rjes/ sde shog re la dpon phran re/ lung chung re la tsho rgan re/ ri 'bur re la rdzong chung re/ sde la dpon med/ dpon la khrims med/ tsho chen gyis tsho chung za/ shed yod kyis shed med brdung / rdzi bos kha chems 'jog chu len yin kyang drag chas sprod dgos pa'i dus shig shar bas slar yang bod yul thams cad tshong las kyi 'grim 'grul nyung la/shes rig phan tshun ma dar ba dang / bod ljongs spyi la dbang ba'i bdag po med par sog ma'i phung po lta bur gyur/ yul tsho'i dpon gyis rang 'og la bdag skyong mdzad pa las spyi dpon lta bu ma byung / dus rabs bcu pa'i g.yas g.yon du/ rlangs kyi po ti se ru deb ngos 56las/ rlangs kyi rnal 'byor byang chub 'dre 'khol la/ dpal bzang gis chos kyi bka' 'gyur dang /nags shod kyi sa bcad phul zhes/ de'i sngon la yul 'di'i dpon dpal bzang yin la khong gis rnal 'byor pa byang chub 'dre 'khol la phul ba yin pa dang / gzhan yang / rlangs kyi po ti se ru deb ngos 52las/ dpal bzang rag shis lha sron gsum/ nags sog shag gsum sa bcad phul zhes/ de skabs su mdo khams stod khul 'di a mi byang chub 'dre 'khol gyi mchod gzhis yin par gsungs/ gling gi lha sde rnams la mgur bzhes skabs/ nags sog shag gis bcas pa/ thel chu gling yul bcas pa/ rnal 'byor nga yi pha yul yin/ sha nye ru shog de na yod/ sngar yang pha yul ngo bor 'dug da'ang pha yul byed pa yin/ rnal 'byor byang chub 'dre 'khol nga / sangs rgyas rgyud 'dzin spel ba la/ lho yi stod du spel bar bya/ zhes dang / sa bya lo tshes brgyad la bslab bya bstsal ba las/ sog nags sog dkar shod nag dang /yul 'dzin shes na btsan po'i rgyud yong gsungs/ de nas nags sog sum mdo la lo gsum bsgrubs/ ra sa bran thog tu lo gnyis sgrub/ mi lo brgya dang 118

rtsa brgyad bar/ nags sog gnyis kyi kha bar na/ nga bzhin grub pa thob pa de/nga 'dra zhabs tog mus kyi gyis gsungs/ rnal 'byor pa byang chub 'dre 'khol lam/ rlangs kyi grub thob chen po lha gzigs byang chub rdo rje de nyid nags sog shag gsum gtso bor gyur ba'i lho lung chen bco brgyad 'dir phebs bzhugs mdzad pa dang / gling rje ge sar gyis spyan drangs nas bla mar brten nas mthar mdzad pa rnams yongs su rdzogs te spyi lo 1rkya76me 'brug lo zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu la zhi bar gshegs/ zhes 'khrungs lo mi gsal kyang dgung lo brgya dang rtsa brgyad thob pa zhig yin pas spyi lo 969sa sbrul lor 'khrungs par mngon no/ de rjes phag gru bka' brgyud pa'i skabs su phag mo gru pa'i chos brgyud dar tshul bcas 'brel ba zab pa dang / 'bri gung skyob pa rin po che'i skabs su yon bdag gi 'brel ba zab pa dang nor phud du khra khyu dang smug khyu gnyis phul ba dang / sa phud nags shod kyi sa cha smre ti lha yi lung mo che bcas phag gru'i gdan sar phul/ lhag tu tā si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan gyi bka' chems las shog grangs 225 rab byung lnga pa'i nang / 'bri phag gnyis srid phyogs nas ma mthun te dmag rgyab nas 'bri gung pa'i byang bod dmag rnams shor/ bzung ba'i btson rnams gtong bar zhu/ yang 'dun ma zhu zer nas zhu ba byas/ 'dun ma zhu na/ nags shod pa'i dpon/ dpon rin chen 'od sgom pa'i snying mi yin pas/ khong yong dgos byas pas/ rin chen 'od byung / khong rnams kyi lag tu/ gnas brtan shes rab dpal dang /thod log rdor ra ba tshul rgyal rnams kyis 'go byas/ rtsed kha nas zin pa rnams dang / 'dir yod gzhon nu rin chen dang / dza ma ba/ sna med/ rin chen rgyal po'i mgo byas btson gces pa thams cad la rta gos bskon nas btang / yi ge 'ba' 'ga' dang bcas pa bcug pa'i steng la/ sgom pa kun 119

rin 'das/ zhes bkod pas/ 'bri gung byang bod ces pa nags shod kyi dmag dang dpon rin chen 'od bcas 'bri gung pa'i dmag dang mnyam du phebs pa 'dis/ 'bri gung khri skor mnga' thang rgyas pa'i skabs su nags shod kyi sa khul 'di rnams 'bri gung khri skor gyi mnga' khongs su yod par bsam la/rab byung bdun pa'i nang du 'bri gung pa'i sgom pa nags shod pa rdzong ji bsod nams rin chen pas mdzad pa dang / 'bri gung gdan rabs bcu gnyis pa bshes gnyen don grub rgyal po nags shod du phebs skabs/ sngon yab mes bzang po rnams kyi mnga' ris la dbang bsgyur phyir dang srog chags bye ba khrag khrig mang po'i don phyir zhes gsungs pas 'di'i g.yas g.yon du 'bri gung khri skor gyi cha shas shig yin pa dang / mtshams bcad pa rin po ches nags sog gi ngo log pa tshar bcad nas bde bar 'god pa bcas kyis shes so/de'i rjes su khyung po 'bum rje grags pa'i skabs su khyung po'i dbang bsgyur 'og tu tshud pa yin zhing / khyung po ni dang po zhang zhungargyal rabs sku bon gyi mi rgyud yin pa dang / zhang zhung rgyal rabs 'thor rjes/ smad a mdo khul sogs bod kyi sa khongs rnams su rim par yul byol du song / khyung po mu lang sku mched ni dbus gtsang sogs la brtan med bya bral gyi tshul du byon nas steng chen dang 'dan khog sogs la gzhis chags/ khyung po'i bla rabs rim par byon pa'i khyung dbus rin po che shes rab rgyal mtshan gong mas rjes su bzung nas zhu yi bon gnas rnams su phebs/ steng chen rma mda' kha nas gser ri'i gzhung du phebs pa dang / gnas de'i yul skyong rgya gtsug gtor nyi ma 'brug grags kyis 'khor 'bangs bka' brtan dang bcas pa phul/ bon a bla dang khyung po nang chen pa rgyal mtshan sogs gdan drangs nas srid bskyangs/ 'khor 'bangs zhig gis sog po'i gser yig brkus pas ngan 120

khag khyung po la phog nas kha 'thor du song / khyung dbus rin po che shag rong du sku gshegs/ zhal chems ltar chibs pa 'bri gung gcung rin po che dang chos 'brel zab pas der phul/ khong gi zhal chems ltar gcung a bla gdan drangs nas/ spun khyung po nang chen grags pa la gong ma se chen han nas 'ja' sa dang tham ka sogs dpag tu med pa gnang / de rjes mi rabs 'ga' song nas khyung po dpon tshang rgyal ba grub kyi dus su sku mched rnams sde bgos pas cung gud/ spun 'bring ba'i rgyud khyung po ser tsha nas mi rabs 'ga' song mtshams su khyung po 'bum rje grags pa'i dus su ma yig g.yu mgo'i nang gsal ltar/ stod smad kun tu dmag drangs nas dbang du bsdus pas de'i dus su nags shod kyis gtsos pa'i nye skor rnams khyung po'i mnga' khongs su 'go btags zhus/ 〈khyung rabs g.yu mgo las/〉 shag gi sbang ngu zam so na/'bum rje'i shel mkhar smug chung brdungs/ zhes gsal bas shag rdzong dkar chags par mngon/ dpon tshang 'di phud gzhan rnams kyi skabs su khyung po steng chen gyi sa khul rang las med pa 'dra/ yun de tsam ma song bar khyung pos nags shod la do dam ma thub/ nags shod tsho dgu 'di nyid spyi lo chig stong drug brgya'i nang du hor rgyal rabs dgu pa lha rgyal dar gyi skabs su hor tsho ba so dgu bya ba de byung bas hor tsho'i khongs su bsdus/bod yul du hor zhes pa 'brog sa'i nor lug skyong mkhan la hor zhes 'bod pa dang / bod byang phyogs la hor sde zhes dang / dper na hor dpon g.yul rgyal zhes pa lta bu yod/ nag chu'i hor smad dang / a mdo la hor kha bzhi zhes sde tsho 'ga' dang / gong sa lnga pa'i yab hor bdud 'dul rab brtan zhes mes po'i rus la hor zhes 'bod/ de min rus rgyud ming la hor zhes pa mang po snang / sog po la hor zhes 'bod pa ni/ sngon mi rigs gzhan 121

gyis hi mi zer bas/ bod pa rnams kyis hor mi zhes tha snyad de byung ba yin/so sor skabs thob kyi go ba len pa las mtha' gcig tu mi 'dzin/ hor tsho so dgu'i hor rgyal gyi mi rgyud ni/ sog po tsho chen zhe dgu'i se chen han gyi mi rabs dang po ni/ bod spur rgyal btsan po'i rgyal rabs brgyad pa gri gum btsan po'i sras nya khri sog yul du phebs nas tsho chung zhig gi dpon byas pa ni/hor se chen han gyi mi rabs dang po de yin te/ dzñosum pa chos 'byung 〉deb ngos kha60gnam gyi khri bdun byung ba'i rjes su bar gyi steng gnyis las rgyal po gri gum btsan po zhes pa blon ngan zhes pas bkrongs tshe/ sras bya khri sha khri nya khri ba gsum yod pa spo bo/ kong po/ nyang po gsum du bros nas phyis su sras gsum gyi bya khri ba'am spu ti gung rgyal zhes pas bod kyi rgyal po mdzad la/ sras tha chung sog skad du bor ta ze zhes pa kong po nas btsun mo gā ma ral zhes pa blangs shing khrid nas sog yul du byon te bi gā la zhes pa'i chu 'gram gyi ri bur hanagal tun zhes par 'byor nas/ rang gi rigs rus kyi khungs dang gang nas 'ong ba'i yul dang 'ong ba'i rkyen sogs gsal bar bshad pas pe ta zhes pa'i mi sde thams cad kyis dpon du bkur nas bsti stangs chen po byas shing bor ta che no zhes grags la/ da lta'i sog yul gyi deb ther la lar de'i yab gser khri ba yin zhes grags pa ni gnam gyi khri bdun gyi tha ma sreb khri ba zhes pa la nor ram snyam zhes gsungs pa dang / de min gu shri dka' bcu su dhi a yu wartas mdzad pa'i hor gyi chos 'byung dang / se then sa snang tha'i cis mdzad pa'i hor rgyal rgyud/ dge bshes dam chos rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i hor chos 'byung sogs gcig mtshungs ltar gsal ba dang / mkhas dbang shing bza' rin po che'i bod sog chos 'byung las kyang de ltar gsungs yod/ se chen han rgyal rabs dgu pa thog thig mur gyi sku mched chung ba/ gu ron o lon tha'i ji 122

'am ir ti cog la zer/ sog po nas gtsang sa skyar 'gro phyir ngo 'khor rta pa bdun bcas hor sbra chen gyi sar/ sog na ra khug tu 'byor nas khyi ra ba 'ga' dang 'phrad/ sog gas dmar du slebs nas tsho sde dang 'phrad/ khong rnams mda' dang rta rtsal la 'gran zla bral bas yul de'i dpon byed nas bsdad/rgyal rabs gnyis pa ir ti cog la sras med pas sku mched thog this mur gyi sras 'bring ba u yug rgyal rang skal sde dud bzhi bcu dang bcas 'dir 'byor/ rgya stong sde pa'i sras mo khab tu bzhes pa sras rgyal po dkar nag dmar gsum byung / rgyal po dkar po 'bri gung rgya ma khri khang hor khang gi sras mi rabs thog ma yin zhes dang / rgyal po nag po 'jang yul du song nas 'jang gi sa sgo gong ma blangs/rgyal rabs gsum pa rgyal po dmar pos yab kyi gdan sa bzung nas dgung lo brgya dang bco lnga zhugs/ de skabs karma bka' brgyud pa'i chos lugs hor yul du dar/ karma pakṣis hor yul du 'gro don mtha' yas pa mdzad pa dang dus mnyam/rgyal rabs bzhi pa sras ya ga dang / rgyal rabs lnga pa phag mo/ rgyal rabs drug pa bsod nam rgyal/rgyal rabs bdun pa hor stag las yab kyi khrir bzung nas/ nang chen la dmag drangs nas dbang du bsdus/ sras bdun las bkra shis kyis srid skyong bas rgyal rabs brgyad pa yin/ hor rgyal rabs dgu pa lha rgyal dar gyis/ sngon nang chen yab mes dus su hor 'og btsud pa cha ma gnas pas slar yang hor dmag drangs nas dbang du bsdus/ nang chen bu mo rdor shul la song ba 'phrog nang chen la nas khal 123

brgya dang brgyad kyi khral bkal/ 〈hor rgyal rabs nyi zer don bsdus 〉 las/de rjes tshang gsar sde la dmag rgyab nas dbang 'og tu btsud/ de rjes rag shul la rgyab nas rta brang gsum phabs/ rta phral hor la 'jal rgyu byas/ de rjes ri che la brgyab nas ri ches rta brgya phul/ de rjes rgya ston la dmag brgyab nas rgya stong drung pas rta brgya phul/ nags blon gnyis nas mdzo brgya phul/bya rta sga kha la dmag sgar rgyab/ rgyal lcags gnyis la 'dun ma byas/ skya mda' chos rjes 'then pa byas/ nas khal brgyad cu phrag gnyis phul/ de rjes nags shod sa la rgyugs/ sde spu drag gnyis kyis 'then pa byas/ rkang khyim gzhung la dmag sgar brgyab/ 'gom sen tsha gnyis kyis dar brgya 'then/stag phu'i khra mo sde bcod blangs/ 'bes sngo leb kyis nas khal brgyad cu phul/'bi ru'i khra mo 'jig 'jig blangs/ shug thum sgang la bde che bzhag wa phyi thang la gnang bgos byas/ nags shod tsho drug mgo btags zhus/ de rjes lha ri ar rtsar rgyug smri ti gzhung la dmag sgar brgyab/ rtsag ne ga ma la la lug jag rgyug rtsag ne ri dmar lan gsum bzos/ rtsag gru 'bo gsum sbris thag bcad/ smad ma khag gsum mgo btags zhus/ de ru dkar nag ser gsum brgyab/ khyung gnyis la dmag sgar brgyab/ nas khal stong dang nyis brgya'i khral bkal/ sgang dkar nag gnyis kyis mgo btags zhus/ nas khal brgya dang lnga bcu'i khral bkal/ cha 'phong kha la rdzong gzhis chags/ yang 'brug yul la dmag rgyab skabs/ 'brug pa'i gser 'khru mda' yis gtor/'brug pa'i go khrab tsha ga zhu rgan gris bcad zhes de'i skabs su hor lha rgyal dar gyis stod smad g.yas g.yon tshang mar dmag drangs nas dbang du bsdus skabs/ nags shod tsho drug dang na bur ser gsum bcas tshang mar hor tsho'i mnga' 'og du gyur/ gu shri han gyis bod la dmag drangs skabs hor lha rgyal 124

dar nas bsu ba zhus pa dang / lha rgyal gyi dar nu bo dkon mchog rgyal la 7gong sa lnga pa chen pos mgon po'i rjes gnang bcas bstsal ba lnga pa'i rnam thar lcags par shog grangs 247 du bkod 'dug pas/ de nas nags shod tsho dgu zhes pa'i tha snyad de byung zhing / spyi lo 16rkyarkyagayas g.yon dga' ldan srid gzhung ma tshugs tsam du nags shod 'di hor tsho'i mnga' khongs su gyur yod/ de skabs hor rgyal po'i lha rgyal dar skabs dmag drangs nas phyogs khag nas khral bsdu mdzad pa yun ring ma song bar/ sog po gu shris bod du dpung 'jug byed nas hor tsho ba so dgu zhes pa'i sa khyon 'di las ma dbang /hor rgyal rabs bcu pa lha rgyal dar gyi nu bo dkon mchog rgyal gyis chab srid lte ba sbra chen du spos nas/ mnga' thang sgrig gzhi gsar du bskyar sgrig byas/ srung kha'i bon po drug cu/ yang chen sum cu/ yang chung sum cu/ sog po o rod rgyal khag gi bka' shog dang / yig tshangs blangs ba dang / gong sa lnga pa las she bam dang bka' dbang zhus/ hor tsho so dgu dang dem chi (don chus ) (hpha༄snu)nyer lnga sogs sdom tsho sde bdun bcu don dgu mtsho sngon sog po rgyal po'i mnga' 'og du 'dus/ hor tsho so dgu ni/ 'gom/ rakṣi/ khra ring / bon phan/ stag drug 'bri ru/ na rog bu rdzom/ sen tsha/ rdor stod/ dkar smad/ sgar khongs/ rdor smad/ nag ru/ dkar stod/ nyin tha/ bya ze/ nyin mo/ dmar ru/ dmar rong / srib tha/ 'dre dag ral gsum/ khri ru/ khrom tshang / nim tsha/ yang pa/ ye tha/ drug cu/ sdom pa/sgang ru/ bon tha/ 'brog shog sog sde/ ar smad/ ge mo/ rdza dmar/ar stod/ bra bo bcas hor tsho ba sum cu so dgu zhes 'bod/ mi ser nas hor rgyal la 'bul ba'i khral phud/ lo gsum re la dud brgyas rta re mtsho sngon 125

du 'bul dgos/ de ma 'byor na rta tshab dngul 'bul dgos pa las rta zam dang 'u lag gang yang mi dgos par gtso bo tsho ba rang rang gi mnga' khongs bdag skyong bya rgyu de yin/hor rgyal rabs bcu gcig pa jo bo rgyal gyi skabs su/ yul shul nas sog po'i gser yig pa nags shod dang sog shod kyi bar du bcom dus/ pho lha mi dbang bsod nams stobs rgyal gyis khas len drag pos tshar gcod bya rgyu thag bcad nas/ hor tsho'i sa khul du slebs nas dang po nags shod pas 'gog rgol cung zad byas kyang ma thub par sog shod du phyin nas dbang du bsdus/ mi dbang pho lha'i rtogs brjod shog grangs 456las/ de tshe hor rigs kong rgyal bya bas rgol bar brtsams kyang zhogs gcig gis gtor nas/zas nor thams cad dpung gis phyer/ rjes lus yul mi nus med rnams la 'jam po'i tshig gi dal bar byas/ phyogs der yul phran/ nags shod/ yu shul/ hor kha bzhi/ 'brong pa stod smad/ rdo shul/ khyung po dkar nag ser gsum sogs mi khyim khri khrag gnyis brgal ba gong ma mchod yon gyi chabs 'og tu bcug sog sde bsam sbyor ngan pa rnams rta zog rgyu nor dngos po rnams gzhung bzhes btang zhes bris yod pa dang / de skabs rgyu dngos rta nor mdzo 'bri/ gser dngul me mda'/ mar sogs zas rigs dpag tu med pa bka' shag srid gzhung la phul bar gsungs pas/ hor rgyal po dkon mchog rgyal yab sras gnyis nas rgol ba'i nus pa ma byung bar mgo sgur zhus/hor rgyal rabs bcu gnyis khri dpon rnam rgyal skabs su/ ching rgyal rabs srid dbang btsugs pas/ mol gol han rgyal rabs nas hor tshor bdag skyong bya ba'i thabs zad/ hor stag la'i spun dbang lu la tha'i ji'i go gnasayod pas hor ser po'i dus kyi tha'i ji bcu gsum zhes 'bod/ sngar 126

mi'i shod srol la hor tsho 'di sog dus rgya dus bod dus zhes dbye bas 'di yan sog dus yin/hor rgyal rabs bcu gsum pa khri rgyal rje yab kyi gdan sa bzung nas/spyi lo 1721rab byung bcu gnyis pa lcags phag lor zi khrong bca' sdod dang bod sdod bca' sdod/ mtsho sngon bca' sdod bcas kyis bka' bgros nas de ltar tsho ba bdun bcu don dgu de gcig gyur byed na gyen log yong ba'i nyen kha che bas dog zon byas nas/ ching rgyal rabs skabs tsho ba don dgu dbye mtshams bzos nas/ dim chi sogs tsho pa bzhi bcu mtsho sngon du sbyar ba dang /hor tsho so dgu 'di zi khron du sbyar/ rgya lugs ltar dpon ming 'bod srol dar nas tsung be hu/ (‘ṣṭha0ṭha༄) che hu/(༈ṭha༄) be hu/ (thokhano) be cang / (11ṣṭha) zhes pa'i dpon ming rim par byung bas 'di nas bzung rgya dus zhes 'bod/ de skabs sger sde dang bla brang ma the ba'i gzhung khral dngos 'jal mkhan them dud 240rkyatsam zhig yod pas/ lo gsum rer dud brgya res rta re 'bul bas a ban nas g.yu re sprad srol mchis/ hor rgyal po khri rgyal rje lha skyong khri bzhugs bcu gcig pa'i skabs/ tsho ba so dgu dang dem chi (don chus ) (༅snu)nyer lnga bcas kyi spyi khyab dā bī hu (rkispu()zhes gong ma chen pos dbu phe'u ho khri bstsal/rgyal rabs bcu bzhi pa lha mkhar bstan rgyal la hor tsho'i tsung bī hu la bskos/rgyal rabs bco lnga pa tshe ring rab gtan dang/hor rgyal rabs bcu drug pa tshe ring dbang rgyal la spyi lo 1ra22lor tsung bī hu'i go gnas sngar ltar rgyud 'dzin gyi bka' brtan sogs thob/hor rgyal rabs bcu bdun pa khri dbang rab brtan sngar ltar mdzad/127

hor rgyal rabs bcu brgyad pa nor bu dbang rgyal spyi lo 1rdo55gor dmag 'gog phyir hor dmag chig stong btang bas dpa' bo dpa' rtags su/hor spyi khyab la byi ru'i tog chu mig bcu gsum rma bya'i ldem sgro dang / stong dpon rdo dga' la shel gyi tog dang o rog gi sgro bstsal/hor rgyal rabs bcu dgu pa rnam rgyal dbang 'dus ni dpon rgyud stong pas rab byung gi sdom pa babs/ gong mas sngar ltar thob thang bstsal/ spun dbang 'dus kyis mgo log tshur rgol sgar pa mi lnga brgya tsam tshar bcad/ de min jag tshogs du ma bcom nas spyi tshogs bde ru bcugahor rgyal rabs nyi shu pa tshe dbang lha rgyal skabs spyi lo 1rar9lo la sngar ltar thob thang rnams byung yang nang khul 'gal bas/ chu kha dpon tshang rnam rgyal lha dar nas rgyal srid la rngams phyir/ rgyal po yab yum sras gsum lkog gsod btang / bod sdod a ban gyi bka' blon nas lag dmar the le gra pa srog thog btang / khri rgyal rje nas tshe dbang lha rgyal bar la rgya nag po'i skabs kyi che hu brgyad zer/ lo phyed ring dkar ru dpon hor rgyal gyi dpon tshab byed/ hor rgyal rabs nyer gcig pa hor ye tha nor bu dbang rgyal rus rgyud gcig pas rgyal sar bkod/ spyi lo 1910lcags khyi lo hor rgyal rabs nyer gnyis pa tshe dbang bstan 'dzin rgyal sar 'khod pas/ rgyal nang du lcags phag gsar brje langs nas bod sdod a ban nas hor tsho la kha lo bsgyur ba'i nus pa shor nas mar log lu'u cun 'thor dmag lnga bcu tsam zhig hor tsho nas rgyud bros pas/ bod dmag gis ra mda' ra ga shag dang / mda' dpon gnang byung ba/ mda' dpon bying pa bcas snga rting du slebs nas/bod sde re dkar sog gsum dang / rgya stong lding dgu bcas bod sdod dmag 128

dang bcas rjes 'ded btang bas/ lu'u cun dmag bros lam nags shod dang / ser tshwa/ steng chen bcas nas mtha' skrod btang / spyi lo 1914rab byung bco lnga pa shing stag lor bka' shag srid gzhung nas bod sdod a ban gyi bskyongs ba'i sa khul rnams se rwa dgon par phul bas/ se rwa mkhan po ngo 'khor bcu sde rtsis dang khral bsdu'i grabs shom byed par phebs/de nas bzung bod bka' shag srid gzhung gi do dam 'og dngos su tshud pas bod dus zhes 'bod/ se rwa mkhan po sku 'khor rnams steng chen du phebs pas/gcig ni hor tsho'i khul 'dir sgrig srol dang / rta zam gyi lam lugs/ them dud zhib bsher gyi khral sogs byung ba'i dbang dang / khong rnams kyis thabs shes zhan pas ga re 'gag tu yul mi dang thug nas dmar gsod btang / spyi lo 1916me 'brug lo mda' dpon bkras mthong dang / mda' dpon khyung ram bcas 'byor/ hor spyi dang po mkhan chung grags pa rnam rgyal btang nas chu glang g.yul 'khrug lu'u cun rgya dmag la rgyab skyor dang 'brel ba byed mkhan la 'dri rtsad zhib tu byas nas nyes can pa rnams shag seb bkra gur dkar tsha kha la khrims gcod sna tshogs btang / kha shas srog thog dang kha shas kha dbang gzhung bzhes/ kha shas dpon gnas las gnas dbyung dang slar skyar gso mi chog pa'i khrims thag bcad/ yul mi'i lag nas me mda' yongs rdzogs bsdus pas chig khri tsam byung pa de slar 'bri la bsgyur nas lo ltar she mar 'bul rgyu dang / de dang mnyam du ya rabs kyi khrims srol rku khram pa rnams tshar bcad pas dus bde bar mdzad/ me 'brug zhib gzhung bya ba'i dud rtsis byas nas sa tshugs skyel 'dren dang mi nor sa zhing la zhib rtsis kyi khral 'gel ba'i lam lugs gsar du gtod/ de ltar don gnas yongs phyir gan rgya bzhag dpon gnas rnams bcos sgrig mdzad nas/ hor rgyal po dang /129

dkar ru/ stag drug bcas chen hu rnams bī hu'i gral du bzhag bī hu'i 'og bī cang rnams lding dpon zhes bsgyur/ sbra chen hor rgyal bzhugs yul yin pa dang / nags shod 'bri ru dang / steng chen gnyis la chen hu gnyis kyi bzhugs yul yin pas rdzong re rgyab nas/ hor dang zi ling gi sa mtshams 'dam chu phar tshur du byed/ da lta lha ri rdzong khong rtsa za ru bzhi pa sde khog dang /thang sdod/ sangs pa/ tsheng pa bcas dang po nags shod tsho dgu nas chad pas skad gshis dang gos rgyan bcas 'dra che la da lta'i pan chen rin po che dang / rwa sgreng rin po che sogs bla chen mang po zhig gi 'khrungs yul yang yin/nye char du nags shod tsho dgu'i khongs kyi sde dud sum brgya lhag yod pas nags shod kyi tsho dpon so so nas bdag po byed pa de/ me 'brug zhib gzhung nas 'dra drug gan rgya zer ba/ de'i nang chu glang nas/ lha ri'i rtsa za rnams bka' shag mgo snga bzhes gnang bas nags tsho dang kha bral zhes spyi lo 1912lor lha ri rdzong khongs su brgyab/ da lta yang phan tshun gnyen tshan mang / de nas rig gsar nas bzung smre ti yungs dkar la sogs lha ri rdzong du rgyab pas rdzong de'i byang phyogs tshang ma snga phyi'i phar bsgyur ba la nags shod pa'i sde gzhung ma yin pas skad dang goms gshis la cung tsam brtags na shes par nges la/ lho phyogs rnams dbus skad dang mtshungs so/ de min hor smad du nags shod pa'i khral dud mang / hor spyi grags rnam rang nyid khrims lugs me ltar 'bar bas mthar steng chen du 'das/horasbyi khyab gnyis pa rim bzhi sman spel nas mus mthud kyang de tsam gnas ma thub/horaspya gsum pa mkhan chung g.yu thog pa'i skabs ga rgya bstan dar nas phyag mdzod mdzad/130

hor spyi beezhi pa rim bzhi ka shod pa'i skabs su de trem dzus bde ma byung /hor sbyi lnga pa mkhan chung grags rgyam sngar ltar mdzad/hor spyi bdun pa mkhan chung thub bstan padma nags shod rakṣi'i sa gnas su 'das/ hor spyi brgyad pa khyung ram pa yin zhing / khong gis sngar las lhag pa'i bya thabs btsal nas spyi lo 1rdzo2rdos stag lo sa zhing dang khang pa 'doms la 'jal nas sa stag zhib gzhung zhes pa/ zhib cing phra ba'i khral bsdu'i thabs shes spel/ yungs dkar brgya dpon la rta lcag zhus pa sogs dmangs sems 'khrug pa'i bya ba 'ga' thon pa dang / spyi khyab mchog lo na mtho bas de tsam ma thub/ rwa sgreng bla ma dang khyung ram gnyis 'gal ba byung nas mthar stod du rgyang 'bud btang / hor spyi rnams kyi spyod pa cung tsub pa dang dmangs sems la bstun ma shes pas hor spyi'i lam lugs med par byas/ lo der rgyal khab rim pa'i dbu khrid rag sdis mchog 'gom nyang gzhung du sku 'khrungs pas lo rgyus rgyas par 'og tu 'gom sde leng drug zhes pa las gsal/ spyi lo 1942chu rta lo hor tsho'i sa khul de sngar chen hu gnyis kyi sa gnas rdzong gnyis bsdom pasardzong khag drug la bgos nas bod zhing dang mtshungs par rtse slob grwa nas thon pa rdzong sdod ser skya zung re btang / chu rta zhib gzhung bya ba lag bstar byas/ rdzong khag drug ni/ steng chen rdzong / 'bri ru rdzong / ser tsha rdzong / khri rdo rdzong / snyan rong rdzong / sbra chen rdzong yin/ da lta nags shod 'bri ru rdzong ni 'bri ru tsho shog gi zhing sa nags shod sbrul mdo/ sngon nags ra pags thang zhes shing nags stug pos khengs pa'i tshal der yin/ nags shod tsho dgu'i chab dpal rig gsum gyi lte ba ru gyur/ spyi lo 1946me khyi lor stag brag bla brangagi zhabs gras 'ga' phebs nas nags shod tsho dgu stag brag gi sger sde 131

byas na 'go pa mi ser la gzigs mthong dang khral chag yong bar gsungs pa dang / lhag tu stag brag lde 'chang dang a hor bstan pa gnyis grogs po gtam/ spyi lo 1947me phag lo stag brag nas 'go 'dren lha ri'i rta khal mi gsum rtsa chag yong bar khas len dang bcas/ nags shod pa'i dpon khag 'ga' lha sar bos nas sger sde'i khungs su gyur/ stag brag nas bod srid gzhung gi bstsal ba'i rtags tham leng gnyis gtsos thob thang lag khyer rnams bsdus/ lo der zhing chen rim pa'i dbu khrid bstan 'dzin mchog 'gom yul grong du sku 'khrungs/ lo rgyus rgyas par 'og tu 'gom sde leng drug zhes pa las gsal/ spyi lo 194ṭwāṃs khyi lor mgo mtho sar btags na ske dma' sa nas chad pa'i dpe ltar/ khral babs lji po khur rgyu las ma byung / de skabs phan tshun lab gleng mang zhing 'khrug gzhi che tsam longs ba'i skabs der stag brag srid 'dzin las babs pas/ sngar ltar nags shod pas gzhung khral tsam las gzhan byed mi dgos/ spyi lo 1952chu 'brug lo bod bka' shag srid gzhung gis sngar yod thob thang rtags tham sogs slar gso gnang / spyi lo 1951lo hor tsho yongs dang 'dra ba mdo smad mnga' khungs su gtogs nas tshogs 'du yang steng chen du phebs dgos/ spyi lo 1951lcags yos lo'i zla ba bcu gcig pa'i nang du 'bri ru rdzong bcings 'grol u yon lhan khang tshugs/ spyi lo 195rdos khyi lo zla ba 12pa'i nang du mdo khams chu bzhi sgang drug gi spyi khyab li thang a 'brug mgon po bkra shis kyi sku tshab 'ba' ba skal bzang 'byor nas/'bri ru zhabs drung mkhas grub bstan 'dzin dang dpon bsod nams rdo rje/khra ring dpon gzhon nu rdo rje bcas nas nags shod tsho dgu gcig gyur thog tsho shog re nas dmag mi sum bcu re bsdus nas rang sa rang bsrung gi gan rgya'i rtags thel bzhag des rkyen pas 'bri ru rdzong u yon lhan khang 'thor/ bla 132

dpon gnyis kyis dmag spyi rgan gzhon gyi las 'gan khur bas dngos su dmag brgyab kyang pham/ snga 'gyod phyis bsdom lam nor ldog shes zhus pas 'bri ru dpon bsod nam rdo rje rdzong srid gros su las gnas thob nas tang dang mi dmangs la zhabs 'degs bla na med par zhus nas de nyid du sku gshegs/spyi lo 1959lo'i zla ba brgyad pa'i nang du zing 'khrug zhod 'jag btang nas 'bri ru rdzong dbu brnyes/ zla bcu pa'i nang du rdzong srid gzhung dbu brnyes nas dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur tshugs/ rdzong yongs la slob grwa khag bdun dang slob ma yang 12kyarkyalhag yod/ spyi lo 1966lo rig gnas gsar brje chen po las 'gul rgyal yongs khyon la spel bas lin cang gsar rje'i ngo rgol ba rnamasago skabs thob/ las byed pa rgan gras la ma rtsa ring lugs kyi lam la 'gro mkhan dbang 'dzin pa gtor zhes pa dang / shes yon can la dri ngan kha ba'i spun dgu pa dang tshojadapag gnyis zhes pa'i rigs dang / 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi las byed par gral rim 'go 'dogs pa zhes zhwa mo g.yogs/'thab phyogs gcig bsgyur gyi rtsa 'dzugs yin pa'i chab gros rtsa bshig dang /mi rigs bar gyi 'gal ba de mthar gtugs nas bshad na gral rim 'thab rtsod kyi don yin zhes sogs bsgrogs pa dang / lhag tu rnying pa bzhi ste/bsam blo rnying pa/ rig gnas rnying pa/ yul srol rnying pa/ goms gshis rnying pa bcas gtor bya'i rigs la rnying gtor gsar 'dzugs zhes pa mi rnams dbang shes med pa ltar byas nas/ bshad kyang yid ches mi byed pa/dgra gnyen dbye ba med pa/ nyes med nyes 'gel dang mi rabs mang po'i rig dngos dang lo rgyus rgyu cha bcas dang / dgon pa grwa tshang bcas pa bsreg gtor bshigs gsum gyis gang yin med par skad cig tu med par bzos/ting zha'o phing gis de ni krung go'i lo rgyus kyi bslab bya zhig yin gsungs yod/133

de'i rkyen pas spyi lo 1969lo nags shod 'bri ru'i sa khul du slar yang drag po'i zing 'khrug gzhi rgya che ba mi grangs sum stong brgyad brgya tsam gyis langs kyang tang gi yang dag bka' drin chen po'i mdzad phyogs 'og tu skad cig gis zhod 'jag btang / lo der mi dmangs kung hri can du bsgyur/ spyi lo 1966nas spyi lo 1976lo bar la lo bcu'i zang zing ngam god chag ring zhes 'bod/ spyi lo 197rdolo skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa tshogs nas/ rig gnas gsar brje chen po'i lo bcu'i god chag gi skabs kyi nyes can rnams rbad de rtsis med du btang / spyi lo 19ra0khyon yongs su 'gan 'khri'i lam lugs lag bstar gnang nas 'byor phyug gi phyogs su bskyod do/134

༄//'gom sde leng drugammug po ldong gi rus rgyud 'gom sgro ba dpon tshang ni/ rus rgyud phun sum tshogs pa byang chub sems pa spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam 'phrul sprel bu byang chub sems pa dang / rje btsun sgrol ma'i rnam 'phrul brag srin mo gnyis sbyor ba las gdong dbyibs mi 'dra ba las mi'u rigs bzhi byung ste/ se dang spru gnyis/ldong dang stong bcas bzhi las/ dma' kha shu g.yag zhur gyi gong kha bya ba'i sa cha der ldong gi rus rgyud las srid pa'i rgyal bu theng gi zhes pa zhig byung ba de ni skabs der dbang mdzad sku dbang che shos shig tu gyur pa yin la khong la bu gsum byung / de la'ang bu gsum byung bas bod mi khri do chen po zhes yab gzhis bskyangs/ bod mi khri do chen po las/ phu bo ldong / a lcags 'bru/ se khyung dbra/ smu tsha lha/ phu bo dbas dang / tha chung brda ste drug byung ba cher bskyed rjes dma' kha shul ras 'debs stag pa zhes pa nas sa cha mi 'dra ba khag drug tu bgos te/ tsho ba'i gtso bo bzung nas gzhis chags/ bod mi'u gdung drug gam bod mi'u rigs drug zer/ rgya bod yig tshang chen mo lcags dpar shog grangs 12 mthu che dam tshig ma nyams pa/ se khyung dbra yi bu rgyud yin/ zhes dang / se khyung dbra'i che drug ni/ stod na zhang zhung khyung po gnyis/ bar na mar pa spu rang gnyis/ smad na re khe nyag le gnyis/ che drug mtshan gyi btsun drug de/ kri la me sha dang me tshan gnyis/ brag tu la gu gu dang rdor nye gnyis/ nyag le la kho po dang pho dbra gnyis/ de che btsun spel ma bcu 135

gnyis yin/ zhes se khyung dbra yi rgyud las grol ba yin zhing rjes su sgra 'gyur nas dbra la sgro zhes sgro ba smug po 'gur ring de rdo mkhar du mkhar rdzong chags/de rjes 'gom stong tsho yul dgu'i spyi dpon dang bka' gtan dang gong ma'i yig tshang sogs pha rgyud bu 'dzin chog pa'i thob thang ldan pas mi rabs mang por dmangs kyis gus bkur bla na med pa zhu zhing / dper na dpon gyi na bza' dum bu cung zad tsam yang g.yang khug du 'jug gi yod pas/ dpon dang tsho sde bar 'cham mthun gang zab yod pa mtshon pas/ dpon tshang la 'gyur ba cher ma song bar dpon radzas nyis shu lhag phyin pas da lta'ang khyim rgyud ma chad par bsdad yod/ gong gi dpon rnams kyi lo rgyus dang mtshan gyi rnam grangs trem ma 'chis kyang rjes su dpyad rgyu/ 'gom dpon bsod nams lha rgyal mchog gis dpon mdzad skabs/ hor ga rgya dkon rgyal lha sar 'gro skabs nyang gzhung nas rta gnyis sku shor bas dpon la zhus kyang stabs ma bde bas gnas tshul thag gcod ma thub/ ga rgya lha sa nas mar yong skabs/dpon gyi a khu a bu mar 'dzong gi sras nor bu bzhugs pa'i sbra chen la btad nas yong bas/ sras nor bu ma bros par me mda'i ru phab/ ga rgya nas rta khri la ru phab pas/ dpon gyi lcam nag chu byang ma'i brgya dpon a gong gi sras mo rin chen sgrol mas tshab 'tshub ngang bar du rgyug pas/ dpon the tshom cung zad shor/ ga rgya nas the tshom med par rgyab pas lcam gyi nu ma gshag nas/ sras nor bu'i brang du thebs pas bkrongs/ 'gom dpon khri thog pa bsod nams lha rgyal gyis/ 'gom stong tsho yul dgu'i dmag grwa sgrig nas ya lan sprod rtsis mdzad/ ga 'gom gnyis 'bri ru rdzong stag brag phyag mdzod sgu ru'i skabs gyod sgrig pas/ hor spyi'i bcad rgya la ga rgyas mi 'dod pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan/136

'gom dgon pa'i grwa dmag dang tsho sde dmag chen bcas kyis sa btsan bzung nas tshar gcod bya rgyu dang / skyen pa bu dkon mchog gdong len du dpa' khas len dang bcas phebs pas/ hor spyi'i las rogs grwa bzhi'i ru dpon skal bzang dang / de min phan tshun dpon khag dang / ga rgya'i phyogs su dga' ba'i dpon khag 'ga' bcas 'gom gyi dmag zil ma bzod pa dang /spyi tshogs bde 'jags mi yong bar dgongs nas/ slar yang gzhi mthun gros bsdur gnang / ga rgya rang nyid yang spyang grung ldan pas mi stong la rgyu nor phon chen sprod rgyu'i gan rgya bzhag nas hor sbra chen du log thub trem byung / rjes su ga rgyas nan ma theg par kha bshad don la ma gnas pas gzhung btug byed pa'i cha rkyen du gyur/rong po dgon nas zis ru dkar spos la nor lug mang po'i rku khag btsugs kyang zis rus khas len ma byed/ rong pos zis ru gtor pham gtong la nye skabs/ skyen pa dkon mchog dang pad dar gnyis kyis bar 'dum byas kyang rong po'i phyag mdzod kyis ma nyan par dkon mchog gi snying khar me mda' rgyab kyang mtshon ma blangs/ pad dar gyis phyag mdzod bsad pas/ dkon mchog gi mtshon ma blangs pas grags pa gang sar khyab/ de nas gnas 'dir sdod ma bde bar gnas skabs bros byol du phebs/ dim chi nyer lnga dang bod 'bang 'khar lnga shog drug tu/ dpa' rtsal che bas kun gyi bkur zhing dpon gnas yang thob nas lo drug bsdad/ gzhan gyi byad khas dpon bsod nams lha rgyal sku tshe ma brtan par grongs/de rjes lho yungs dkar brgya dpon lha nam dpon tshab lo bcu trem mdzad/ dpon tshang nyams gud du phyin pa dang / tsho sde kha 'thor du 'gro bas/137

brgya dpon lha nam dang lding dpon dpal bzang rab brtan gnyis kyis gros bzang 'og nags shod tsho dgu gcig gyur thog 'gom skyen pa spun gnyis gdan 'dren ma thub na nags shod tsho dgu gnas thabs med pa'i gzhung btugs gnang bas/ de don mngon gyur byung nas nags shod nas 'bri thul ma brgya dem chi la sprad nas rang yul du phebs/ de rjes dpon lha rgyal gyis sras 'gom dpon rnam rgyal dbang phyug ni spyi lo 192kharab byung bcu drug sa yos lor yab dpon bsod nams lha rgyal dang / yum sog dar ma lding dpon gyisras mo bkra shis g.yang 'dzoms gnyis kyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ chung dus nasayab grongs pa dang phyi dgra rkun dang nang 'khor g.yog gi rgyu nor rnams khyer bas khyim gzhis stong la nye skabs/ brgya dpon lha nam gyis 'khor g.yog la rta lcag zhus pa dang / lding dpon bzang rab brtan lo lnga bzhugs nas/sngon rta pho brgya mo brgya yod pa tshang ma med pas rtsad dpyad/ chibs 'brong nag dang sprug gdong gnyis a mdo'i jag pas ded pa tshur blangs nas rku mjal du 'bri dgu bcu go dgu dang nor ma khra bo gcig bcas brgya tham pa dpon tshang du phul/ 'gom dud nas rtsid pa gru gu re khral phab nas sbra len gsum ka drug a tshag sgal du phab/ 'gom dpon rnam rgyal dbang phyug dgung lo bcu gsum la khri 'don mdzad pas 'gom tsho'i che dgu yongs dang phyogs khagadapon tshang rnams khri gsol mdzad sgo la tshang kha shig shig tu phebs nas bkra shis brjod/ spyi lo 1951la chab mdo steng chen du mthus mi tshogs chen du phebs/ nags shod tsho dgu bcas pa chab mdo'i mnga' khungs su yin pas khral don rnams chab mdor skyel dgos pa'i gros mthun bzhag skabs/'gom dpon nas nga pha yul nas yong dus sa thag ring po mthong byung bas de 138

don gnas mi thub par gsungs pas/ sku na chung yang grags pa chen po byung zhing dmangs kyi bde sdug la bsam mkhan zhig red ces kun gyis bsngags/stag drug dpon gyi sras mo bsus nas khab tu bzhes/ dgung lo bcu bdun thog mnga' 'og mi ser 'thor ba rnams bsdu phyir phebs pas lha ri a tsa'i dmag gis bo ngan g.yang lha bsad/ dpon gyis 'gom leng drug gi dmag rnams lha rir drangs pas dpon ya nge skal rgyal dang 'dum byas pas/ rang sde rnams tshur blangs/ bo ngan g.yang lha'i mi stong rnams chad lus med par khyim du sprad/ phar dgra tshur gshed mi byed par zhi bde'i gan rgya bzhag de rjes sde dge jag rgod kyis smri ti yungs dkar sde nas khyim dud bdun gyi rta zog jag la bcad pas/ bde sdug snyan zhu dpon tshang du 'byor bas/ dpon rnam rgyal dbang phyug gis nyang gzhung nas dmag bsdus te/ jag dmag kang la phar nang nas rjes zin pas jag dmag gcig bsad/ rta zog rnams tshur blangs/ de skabs zis ru dang che 'brom gnyis 'khrug chen shor nas skya mi bcu bdun zis ru'i sgor bab nas gyod gzhi chen po thug 'gom dpon nas phan tshun 'dum sgrig byas nas zhi ba'i ngang du bzod bde bar mdzad/ khong ni mtho po'i gnya' nas gnon zhing / snyoms chung ma nus pa rnams mtha' nas skyong mkhan/ zhi bde dang 'dra mnyam la dga' ba'i mi dpon bzang po zhig red 'dug ces kun gyi bshad srol du mchis/ de rjes 'bri ru rdzong u yon dang /nag chu sa gnas kyi u yon bcas mdzad nas spyi lo 19rar sa 'brug lor sku gshegs/ khong la sras gnyis yod pa da lta bzhugs/ 'gom dpon gyi mnga' 'og tu/ stod smad gnyis la dgon chen gnyis dang / sngags dgon ri khrod mang bar bzhugs/ 'gom sde leng drug la/ stong tsho yul dgu mchis shing sde — 139

dud mang / lding dpon gcig 'gom lho byang la brgya dpon gsum dang /rgan chen bzhi ni shag gi skyen pa rgan po/ nag gi spu thi rgan po/ yungs dkar khro thung rgan po/ chu sreb thag gdong rgan po/ rgan chung nyer gsum bcas yod/'gom gyi lte ba yul grong /nags shod tsho dgu las 'gom tsho pa'i lte ba'i yul grong ni chags snga shos yin zhing / nags shod bkra shis nags klung phyug mo'i sked pa tsam na gnas zhing / sngon bod mi a yan jag pa spun bdun zhes pa nags shod du slebs nas yul bzung bas grong rnams chags pa yin zhes/ sngon skyi ru'i lha khang gi ldebs bris su yod 'dug gtso bo rus rgyud de rnams las sgro ba smug po 'gul ring zhes pa de rdo mkhar du mkhar rdzong chags/ sprel gyi dung 'khru 'gul ring zhes pa de ba lag la mkhar rdzong chags/ sog ru karma khrab chen zhes pa gnyags mar grong la mkhar rdzong chags/ skyi ru bla ma rta nag de skye ru gong ma la mkhar rdzong chags/ skyen pa bu yi thog sdug zhes pa sa dmar la mkhar rdzong chags/ spu thi bu yi char 'bebs zhes pa wag ta la mkhar rdzong chags/ zhes sngon lung 'dir mkhar rdzong chags nas grong sa 'dzin snga shos 'gom rus bdun zhes brjod/ de'i rjes su yungs dkar nor bu'i 'gul ring zhes pa rdo mkhar la mkhar chags/ spu tsha bu yi grags nor de rag sne la mkhar rdzong chags/ byi ru'i g.yu rdor de ba lag kha steng la mkhar rdzong chags/ de ltar rtsa ba'i 'gom tsho'i rus rgyud de rnams las chad pa dang / de nas 'phel rgyas phyin te dud mang che ba bu rnams khyim gcig tu sdod pa las/ dud khag bgos 140

pa nyung bas/ yul grong du sa zhing dang mkhar rdzong / 'brog sa la nor lug sogs bdag gnyer bya phyir sbra gur byed nas chu sreb dang nyang khu gzhung du skyas spos nas sdod srol yod pas/ mi rnams kyis pha gzhis dang / pha mkhar/ pha sa zhes gtso bo rgyud 'dzin srol shugs che bas rig gsar bar ma nyams par gnas yod/ de nas dud chung 'ga' dang bcas rim par yul 'brog gnyis su bye ba mang du phyin nas/ 'gom leng drug ces nags shod du sde tsho mang shos dang / dgon sde mang shos kyi gral du song na yang 'gom rus bdun las sgro ba dpon tshang dang / skyi ru lding dpon gnyis kyi spyi khyab byed pa'i 'og 'gom leng drug gi sgrig gzhi dang khrims srol do dam 'og tu mi lo stong phrag bar 'gyur ba cher ma song bar gnas zhes shod srol mchis/ nags shod spyi'i lung pa 'dir rus ming gnyis mnyam du 'bod cing / srol shugs che bas sngon gyi rus rgyud gtso bo bcu gnyis dang / de min rus rgyud rnams gsal por gnas pa dang / ya rab spyod bzang gi ngo tsha sogs ma nub par gnas/ phan tshun sha nye rus thog rnams ma 'dres par gnas thub pa 'di bod snga rabs pa'i spyod srol ma nyams pa'i rang rtags yin/ sha rus gcig na phan tshun ngo shes dang rgyus med yin kyang spun mched du brtsi zhing gnyen sgrig sogs rtsa ba nas spangs/rig gsar gong du 'gom yul grong la brgya dpon gnyis dang rgan po bzhis do dam byed de sprel dpon tshang zhes yul grong brgya dpon gtso bo dang / yungs dkar tshe 'grub dang / sog ru lha g.yang bcas yin/ skyen pa rgan po rig 'dzin rdo rje/ sde rgan po pid pid/ sprel rgan po skyug mer/ sis sa rgan po tshe ring bcas rgan po bzhi yod kyang skabs thob tsam las pha rgyud bu 'dzin ni ma yin/141

lhag tu zhing chen rim pa'i dbu khrid pa bstan 'dzin mchog ni spyi lo 1kha46lo'i zla ba 12kyi nang du bod ljongs nags shod 'bri ru rdzong rlan chu shang 'gom yul grong wag ta grong tshor sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo 12la slob grwar phebs/ spyi lo 1965lor zla 11par tang nang zhugs/ spyi lo 1966lo'i zla 10pa'i nang las kar zhugs shing / hrang he hu'i tan slob chen gsar 'gyur tshan khag gi gsar 'gyur ched las nas slob mthar phyin/ spyi lo 196rkyalo zla 7nas spyi lo 1966lo'i zla ba drug pa bar bod ljongs mi rigs slob chen dge 'os tshan khag la slob sbyong byas/ spyi lo 1966lo zla ba drug pa nas bcu pa bar krung dbyang mi rigs slob gling du gsar 'gyur sbyong brdar 'dzin grwar slob sbyong byas/ de nas spyi lo 1972lo'i zla ba 7bar 〈bod ljongs nyin re'i tshags par 〉las khungs kyi gsar 'god pa dang / gsar 'gyur 'tshol sgrig gi tsu'u krang gzhon pa yin/ de nas spyi lo 1976lo'i zla ba rabar du hrang ho hu'i tan slob chen gyi gsar 'gyur tshan khag tu slob sbyong byas/de nas spyi lo 1979lo'i zla ba 2pa bar du 〈bod ljongs nyin re'i tshags par khang 〉lho kha bca' sdod gsar 'god pa'i dbu 'dzin gnang / de nas spyi lo 1rdzordo0lo'i zla ba 9bar 〈bod ljongs nyin re'i tshags par 〉khang gi spyi'i rtsom sgrig pa'i gzhung las khang gi kru'u ren gzhon pa mdzad/ de nas spyi lo 19ra2lo'i zla lnga pa'i bar du 〈bod ljongs nyin re'i tshags par khang 〉gi rtsom sgrig pa gzhon pa dang / rang ljongs skyong rtsom rig sgyu rtsal las rigs mnyam 'brel lhan tshogs kyi kru'u zhi gzhon pa mdzad/ de nas spyi lo 19ra2lo'i zla 5pa nas 19ra5lo'i zla 11bar bod rang skyong ljongs tang ud rgyun las u yon dang / bod rang skyong ljongs rig gnas cud kyi cud krang gnang / de 142

nasasbyi lo 19rdo5lo'i zla ba 11nas spyi lo 2001lo'i zla ba rapa bar bod rang skyong ljongs tang ud kyi hru'u ci gzhon pa mdzad/ de nas spyi lo 2rkyarkya1lo'i zla ba rdopa nas spyi lo 2001lo'i zla ba 1rkyabar krung go'i rtsom pa po'i mthun tshogs kyi tang tsu'u hru'u ci gzhon pa dang krung go'i rtsom pa po mthun tshogs kyi skabs drug pa'i kru'u zhi gzhon pa gnang / de nasaspyi lo 2rkya01lo'i zla ba 1rkyapa nas krung go'i rtsom pa po'i mthun tshogs kyi tang tsu'u hru'u ci gzhon pa dang hru'u ci khru'u yi hru'u ci yin/ spyi lo 2rkyarkya2lo krung gung yun nan zhing chen hru'i ci gzhon pa/ spyi lo 20rkya6lo'i zla ba 11nang skabs bdun pa'i nang rgyal yongs rtsom pa po'i mthun tshogs kyi tshogs 'du'i thog rgyal yongs rtsom pa po mthun tshogs kyi kru'u zhi gzhon pa gsar du gdams thon byung ba red/khong gi brtsams chos gtso bo che ba ni sgrung rtsom 〈lha'i bka' drin 〉dang 'bol rtsom 〈dga' 'os pa'i pha yul 〉〈byis pa'i dus kyi rmi lam 〉ched rtsom 〈rig gnas thon las 'phel rgyas kyi skor gleng ba 〉〈rig gnas kyi skar khung da thun nan la lta ba 〉glog brnyan rtsom rig brtsams gzhung 〈sis sgang lis bu mo 〉bcas sogs mdzad yod/'gom 'om mtha'/rang byung brag dkar lhun po dang / sman shing 'om bu la sogs dri bsung 'thul zhing sman rigs mang pos gang ba'i ri 'di la 'om yag dang / de'i gzhung la 'om gzhung zhes thog 'om yag ri rgan gyi mtha' skor du gnas pa'i grong sde la 'om mtha' zhes 'gom yul grong rus tsho rnams kyi 'brog sa gtso bo yin/ 'gom gyi 'brog sa chags snga shos yin pas/ 'om tsho las rim bzhin 143

'gom tsho zhes sgra zur chags/ bu rgod cing rta mgyogs pa'i yul zhes sngon shag zad zad se mo rong sgo dang / be zad zad be khu dmar 'bas bar bdag skyong byed/ sde 'di'i dpon ni skyen pa brgya dpon mi rabs rim byung nas bdag skyong gnang bas phyis su skyen pa brgya dpon 'gro 'dul/ skyen pa brgya dpon pad dar bcas rim par byung / skyen pa dkon mchog ni 'gom dpon gyi blon chen mdzad/ 'om mtha' la rgan po bzhi yod kyang skyen pa rgan po sprel sga po zer tsam las ma shes/ da lta sde dud nyis brgya tsam yod/'gom nyang khu gzhung /'gom leng drug las shag nyang khu gzhung zhes 'gom dpon tshang dang /shag wa thang dgon gnyis kyi gnas yul yin zhing 'gom sde'i nang nas rgya che shos shig yin/ stod seb bkra dang nyang gzhung stod smad bar gsum tshang ma bcas yin/ da lta dud grangs bdun brgya tsam mchis zhing / nye skor du gnas chen rnams wa thang dgon gyi gnas yig las gsal bas skyar zlos mi dgos phyir du ma bkod/lhag tu rgyal khab rim pa'i dbu 'dzin pa rag sdis mchog ni 192ṭwāṃlo'i zla ṭwāṃnang du bod ljongs nag chu sa gnas nags shod 'bri ru rdzong khongs shag chu grong rdal 'gom nyang khu gzhung du sku 'khrungs/ spyi lo 1961lo'i zla ba 1༷nang du krung go gung khran tang nang du zhugs shing / spyi lo 1959lo'i zla ba 7par las kar zhugs/ de nas 1962lo'i zla ba 2par krung dbyangs srid khrims las byed slob grwar slob sbyong byas/ de nas spyi lo 1966lo'i zla ba rapa bar nag chu sa khul srid 'dzin kung hru'i spyi bde las 144

khungs su las ka byas/ de nas spyi lo 196rdolo'i zla ba 11bar bod ljongs nag chu sa khul spyi bde zhib dpyod khrims khang dmag don do dam khang la phyag las gnang / de nas spyi lo 1972lo'i zla ba 6bar bod ljongs nag chu sa khul gsar brje u yon lhan khang du phyag las gnang / de nas spyi lo 1975lo'i zla ba rabar krung gung bod ljongs nag chu sa ud kyi hru'u ci byas/spyi lo 1977lo'i zla ba 1rkyanas spyi lo 19ṭwāṃ5lo'i zla ba 11bar krung gung bod rang skyong ljongs hru'u ci byas (skabs der hru'u ci ang dang po de yin )spyi lo 1977lo nas spyi lo 1979lo'i zla ba rapa nas bar bod rang skyong ljongs gsar brje u yon lhan khang gi krun ren gzhon pa dang / de nas spyi lo 1979lo nas spyi lo 19ṭwāṃ5lo bar bod rang skyong ljongs sgrig khrims zhib bsher u yon lhan khang gi hru'u ci gnang / de nas spyi lo 19ra2lo'i zla ba 4bar du skabs gsum pa'i bod rang skyong ljongs mi dmangs tshogs chen gyi rgyun las kru'u ren gzhon pa yin/ de nas spyi lo 19ra2lo'i zla ba 9pa nas spyi lo 19rdo5lo'i zla ba 7bar krung dbyangs tang gi slob grwar zab sbyong pu'u ru las byed rig gnas 'dzin grwar slob sbyong gnang / spyi lo 1khaṭwāṃ5lo'i zla ba 11nas spyi lo 1995lo'i zla ba ṭwāṃbar krung gung bod rang skyong ljongs ud kyi hru'u ci gzhon pa gnang / spyi lo 19rdo6lo'i zla ba 5nas spyi lo 19ṭwāṃṭwāṃlo'i zla ṭwāṃpa bar skabs bzhi pa'i srid gros hru'u ci yin/ de nas spyi lo 19kha2lo'i zla ba 1bar skabs lnga pa'i bod rang skyong ljongs srid gros kru'u zhi byas/ spyi lo 19rdzo2lo'i zla ba 1po'i nang skabs drug pa'i bod rang skyong ljongs mi dmangs mthun tshogs kyi rgyun ud u yon lhan khang kru'u ren bdams thon byung / spyi lo 19rdzo5lo'i zla ṭwāṃpar skabs lnga pa'i krung gung bod rang skyong 145

ljongs kyi ljongs ud hru'u ci gzhon pa bdams thon byung / spyi lo 19khaṭwāṃlo'i zla ba 5nang skabs bdun pa'i bod rang skyong ljongs mi dmangs mthun mi tshogs chen gyi rgyun las u yon lhan khang gi kru'u ren bdams thon byung ba red/spyi lo 2002lo'i zla 1bod rang skyong ljongs skabs brgyad pa'i mi dmangs mthun tshogs kyi tshogs chen dang po'i skabs su mi dmangs mthun tshogs kyi rgyun ud kyi kru'u ren bdams thon byung ba dang / spyi lo 20rkya2lo'i zla ba 2par skabs bcu pa'i rgyal yongs mi dmangs mthun tshogs kyi tshogs 'du theng dang po'i thog tu rgyal yongs mthun mi'i rgyun ud kyi u yon krang gzhon pa bdams thon byung / krung gung skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung dbyangs rjes snon u yon dang / skabs bcu gnyis nas bcu drug bar krung dbyangs u yon yin/'gom chu grib ma/'gom leng drug las grags che ba chu srib ma ni/ nags stod bkra shis lha yi do rwa/ yul skyong nags lha gnyan po'i bya 'dabs su gnas zhing / shar du rtar rdzong / lhor rngas phu/ nub tu a sbong / byang zla thang bcas kyi bar du sde dud rnams rim par gnas zhing / sde tsho 'di nyid 'gom yul grong las 'brog sa byas nas rim par chags pas spyi dang 'dra/ gtso bo bdag skyong ni 'gom skyi ru sgye cang ngam lding dpon gyi khur len cing / dpon gyi bzhugs gnas dpal gyi bla ri sras mo'i ri sham mar rwa lung 'du nag steng du bzhugs/dpon rabs gong ma'i gong ma rnams mi gsal kyang / phyis su skyi ru rwa bzo zhes pa dpa' rtsal che zhing spyang grung ldan pa/ lhag par sgrub pa la rang dbang thob pa'i grags can de yin/ de'isras a phyi/ de'i sras bha yo/ khong ni sman 146

rtsis la mkhas pa'i gzhan phan la brtson/ de'i sras a chung / de'i sras bsam 'phel/ de la sras gsum las rgyal mtshan ni sman dpyad la mkhas shing sgrub pa la brtson/ sras dkon mchog rin chen ni rang dgon du bzhugs/sras dpal bzang rab brtan gyis lding dpon gyi las gnas bzung bas spyi tshogs thog grags pa che zhing chab srid la mkhas pas de skabs su 'gom dpon lding zhes mtshan snyan che/ spyi lo 1916me 'brug lor stag phu padma badzra mchog ja 'dren zhus nas/ rta rag dkar rin chen rgyan cha dang bcas phul ba dang /de min rta nor dar zab/ gzi byur sogs 'bul ba mtha' yas phul/ stag phu padma badzra mchog sbos rdzong du phebs skabs mer bdag klus nor sgrub gsang ba'i sgrub skor phul/ rten mkhar du rten 'dzugs mdzad/ dpon gyi sku ring la lo ltar bka' 'gyur dag sgrog ris med bla ma mang po gdan 'dren zhus/'gom dpon rnam rgyal dbang phyug sku na gzhon pas nyang gzhung du lo bzhi lhag bzhugs nas dpon ming dang khyim tshang bskyar gso gnang nas tshugs thub par zhus/ spyi lo 1954'bri ru rdzong gi u yon dang / spyi lo 196rkyalo nas nag chu sa gnas u yon/ mi dmangs kung hre tshugs pa sogs skabs la bsgyur bkod dang / khyim tshang gzhung bzhes 'thab rtsod sogs dka' sdug sna tshogs myang / spyi lo 1975lo sras tshe ring dgra 'dul ni nad pa mang po'i g.yog tu btang kyang 'thab rtsod dang sdug gcod sna tshogs btang bas tsha chu shang gi sman khang du sku gshegs/ spyi lo 19rdo6lor lding dpon gyi tsha bo tshe ring don grub 'bri ru srid gros u yon du las gnas bskyar gso gnang /147
