'gom dkar gzhung /'gom leng drug las dkar gzhung tsho pa ni/ mkhar khung del dkar ma zhes pa sa 'di'i gzhung la chags pas dkar gzhung zhes ming chags/ mi rabs kha shas gong la rgan po sbrug rdo zhes 'gom 'om mthar sdod pas/ 'om mtha'i brgya dpon dang cung ma mthun par sde dud kha shas dang bcas/ be mo dang / a hong / 'khor mang bcas kyi sa mdud du bsdad nas rim par chags/ dkar gzhung 'di rgan po gcig gi mnga' 'og yin pas/ dang po rgan po sbug rdo dang / de'i rjes rgan po 'bog tsha tshang nas mi rabs kha shas khur blangs/ 'bog tsha cung zad gud pas/ rgan po skyen pa rab gsal yin/de'i rjes su dkar gzhung 'dan ma tshang zhes pa'i mi rgyu chos gsum 'dzoms pa/'gom dgon pa'i grub dbang dkon mchog bzod pa dang / dbu 'od srung bcas kyi yab tshang / mdan ma rgyal mtshan bcas kyis tsho sde'i khur blangs/grwa khral 'gom dgon du yin pas phyogs gzhan la sgrub srol med pas rig gsar gong du 'dus grwa bco lnga tsam rang dgon du bzhugs/ sde khral spyi dang mtshungs pa 'gom dpon nas lta rtogs byed/ nye rabs su 'gom dpon lding nas sde 'gug byed nas shag stod du bsdad/ dud kha shas tsam las rim par dkar gzhung du spos nas da lta bar gnas/ da lta dud grangs lnga bcu tsam yod pas kun gyis chos lugs byed sgo dang chos srung khag sngar rgyun ltar 'dzin/'gom smre ti yungs dkan/'dzam gling sa yi rtse mo/ mdo dbus gnyis kyi sa mtshams/ smre ti ze rag pa'i lho phyogs/ yar chab gtsang po'i 'go ma/ gser gzhong sa la bzhag 'dra'i steng du mtsho dang mtshe'u g.yu yi khra tshom bkod pa dang 'dra ba'i smre ti'i 148

smad khul/ dbus su yul lha jo bo dpal dkar zhes rtsa ri chags grab byas zer smyug ma dang / rtse gangs dkar steng du mtsho dang gnas yig rdo la bkod pa/ sked pa jo bo'i bla mtsho dang spyan gzigs seng ge bcas rang byung bkod pas khengs pa'i gnas ri dang / shar du brag nag lhor or gyi go khrab/nub tu mer gyi ri dmar/ byang du rlung ri rtse gcig bcas bka' yi blon po bzhis yongs su bskor ba'i dbus su sde tsho chen po 'di nyid/ nags shod 'gom sde leng drug las smre ti yungs dkar tsho ba yin te/ yungs dkar dpon 'di ni sngon a mdo 'go log nas yin par bshad pa'i mi rgyud/ 'gom yul grong yungs dkar las chad pa yungs dkar rgyal mtshan zhes pa dgra 'thab la mkhas zhing blo gros dang ldan pa de nyid/ g.yog 'khor sde dud 'ga' dang bcas smre ti 'jon sna khug tu gzhis chags/ nags shod 'gom dang 'bri gung gnyis gang ci'i thad 'brel ba zab pas/ khong rnams rtswa rin dang chu rin lta bu 'bri gung bla brang la mar khal brgya dang / dngul srang brgya bcas 'bul dgos kyang / dpon sa la khral mi dgos/ grwa khral 'gom dgon gsar dang /sde khral 'gom dpon la 'bul ba dang / do dam bcas 'gom gzhan dang spyi mtshungs yin/ sog dus dang rgya dus bcas la lho smre ti'i dgra sgo 'gog mi zhes/ dpa' rtsal che zhing / gong ma'i bka' shog dang / tham ga rag gdan dang dung tog sog zhwa dang / khrab rmog mda' gzhu bcas yod pa dang / rim bzhin sde 'go blangs pa dang / 'go btags zhus pa sogs sde dud mang bar gyur nas 'gom dpon lding nas brgya dpon du bskos/ dpon rabs gnyis pa yungs dkar chos mdzad/ dpon rabs gsum pa yungs dkar dbang rgyal yin zhing / hor spyi rim bzhi ka shod pas brgya dpon gyi dbang cha sprad/ de'i skabs khyung rgyud dud gnyis dang kha mchu thug nas khyung 149

ram pas rta lcag zhus/ rma shul thum por sgril nas gzhung gtugs phyin pas/bden pa ra 'phrod byung bas spyi tshogs la grags pa che/ dpon rabs bzhi pa yungs dkar lha nam ni mi chos dang yon tan che ba dang / blo rig bkra zhing brtul phod pa zhig byung / 'gom dpon bsod nams lha rgyal grongs pas dpon tshab mi lo bcu tsam mdzad pa dang / 'bri gung sbra ga 'am 'od rna dang sa gyod thug nas yungs dkar rgyal/ 'gom skyen pa dang rong po dgon pa'i bar 'khrug pa yungs dkar rgya dpon gyis jus bkod byed nas/ nags shod spyi nas skyen pa spun rnams 'bri brgya sprad nas rang yul du log chog pa byung nas phan tshun bde bar bkod/ skabs zhig rang 'og sde dud 'ga'i rta rnams jag pas ded pas ra 'dar yungs dkar spun gsum phebs nas dmangs don du rang srog shor/ phyi rabs rnams dpon zhes pa'i ming don mtshungs pa'i bslab bya len yul zhig tu gyur/ dpon rabs lnga pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan ni da lta bzhugs/ 'gom yungs dkar la brgya mgo'i a ma rkyang ri dkon mchog dang / tshag gsum rgyal mtshan/ skyi ru bcas yin/ rig gsar gong la yungs dkar sde dud nyis brgya ma zin tsam dang / bla brang sger sde sdom pas nyis brgya lhag tsam yod pas/ da lta dud grangs ldab gcig tsam 'phar yod/gzhan yang rdel rug gzhung der dgon shul dang / mtshams khang bcas yod/lo ltar 'gom bla grwa rnams phebs nas gang dgos sgrub rim dang / nyin mar nyin phyur bya ba 'bul/ chos srung khag ni 'gom dgon spyi dang mtshungs/yungs dkar dpon gyi nang rten du gru shag bla mas btsugs pa'i grib btsan rten mdung dang / grub dbang a mgon gyi phyag bu/ de min bka' brgyud bla rabs 'ga'i byin rten gang mang yod ces thos/ 150

'gom chags rtse/hor spyi gsum pa mkhan chung g.yu thog dbang 'dus nor bus shing byi 1924lor zhib gzhung las/ khral med dang dbul dud ma tshud pa'i nang du chags rtse 'go btags la rgan po gcig dud grangs bcu drugami’zhes 'khod pas 'gom dpon tshang nas bdag skyong dang / gtso bo spu thi rgan chen yin/skor gsum/nags shod rakṣi tsho pa'i smad kyi sde shog la rag nag zhes/ shing nags stug pos gang zhing sa rgyu gshin pas grong sde gnas zhing / sde khungs dang khral khungs rakṣi dpon tshang du yin/ chos khungs 'gom dgon gsar du byed srol byung / sngon gnas shod dwags po lcags lung dgon gyi chos srol ni bka' brgyud dang / ri phug dgon yang bka' brgyud yin par sems la/ lcags lung dgon nyams gud du phyin nas/ ba ro dang gnas shod ri phug gsum sngon nas chos srol dwags po bka' brgyud pa'i lugs dang / 'bri gung bka' brgyud pa dang 'brel che bas bka' brgyud nang tshan la brten nas/ 'gom dgon gyi chos gzhis su byed rgyu'i mdun pa che bas/ 'gom dang rakṣi gnyis gyod thug pas 'gom gnyan sde nas thabs jus btang nas 'gom dgon pa'i srid kyi dbang cha phyed ka grong khag gsum la sprod par khas len zhus/ de nas bzung 'gom rakṣi ban dpon zhes thon sgo yod pa tsam gyis mi babs la ma ltos par ban dpon byas pa'i srol byung nas chos gzhis brtan 'jags thob pa yin no/151

༄7//gnas mchog ba lag shel dkar 'bum pa/oṃ su sti/zab mo ting 'dzin brtan zhing g.yo ba med/yi dam bstan pas snang srid dbang du 'dus/gangs can lam rim mnga' bdag sne'u zur par/bdag sogs 'gro rnams byang chub bar du 'dud/'phags yul zhing du grub chen wir wa pa/zhing 'dir skyu ra'i gdung sras chos kyi rgyal/bdag sogs gdul bya'i don du gnas 'dir byon/bshes gnyen don grub rgyal por gus phyag 'tshal/phan bde phun tshogs 'byung ba'i yid bzhin nor/sngon las 'phral rkyen gegs rnams ba mo'i tshul/skad cig dran pa'i mod la 'joms mdzad pa/gnas mchog shel dkar 'bum par phyag 'tshal lo/zhes 'dzam gling sa yi rtse mo bsil ldan zla ba'i mdzes rgyan 'phrog pa'i lhun sdug gangs ri'i phreng bas yongs su bskor ba'i gnas mchog grags pa'i ba dan dkar po srid pa'i rtse mor lhab lhub tu g.yo zhing gtsang chab kun 152

gyi 'go ma/ sprin dkar la stod kyis mdzes pa'i ri bo dang / smug sprin rab tu dkrig pa'i rdza ri dang spang ri/ shel dkar mdangs la 'khu ba'i gangs dkar dang / rab rno a sngon 'big snyam byed pa'i ri tshogs rnams blta bas mi ngom zhing tshar du dngar ba'i mu 'brel gyi ri tshogs rnams kyis btams/ mu dang mtha' mi mngon pa'i mtsho chen dang mtshe'u bcas kyis skor ba'i zhing / lhag tu mdo stod shod chen bco brgyad kyi dbu rtse/ nags shod sman ljongs phyug mo'i mthil 'dir/ sum rtsen lha yi dga' tshal ltar shug pa dang / rkang 'thung la sogs ljon mdog g.yu lo gyon pa'i nags tshal rnams phan tshun gar stabs la 'gran zhing / snyan pa'i dbyangs bdun rdzogs shing drug 'gyur glu sgra sgrog pa'i dpyid kyi pho nya lha bya khu byug sngon mo/ dal bar dal ba gshog zur ldeb cing mgrin dbyangs zab mo mtho ru sgreng ba'i lha bya gong mo la sogs bya tshogs rnams/brag dkar dang g.yu lo'i rtse mo nas phan tshun mgrin dbyangs la 'gran zhing /tshangs dbyangs drug bcus bde gshegs rten la mchod pa dang nyon mongs du khas mnar ba'i 'gro rnams skyid kyi dpal yon ster/ rwa yig gnyis pas mtshan pa'i sbra ma ra rnams me tog gi tshal rnams rol zhing / dper na na chung gzhon nu'i tshogs rnams skyed mos tshal du rol ba ltar rgyu zhing / snyan pa'i gdangs dang 'jibs pa'i dbyangs la drangs ba'i tshangs sras bu mo'i dgyes glu lta bu gcig gi rjes su gcig gis zlos ltar sgrog dug gsum nad kyi gnyen po rang byung 'byung bzhi'i bcud las 'khrungs pa'i sman gyis ljon pas 'gro ba'i nyer 'tshe shugs las grol zhing nad rims nyung ba/ rab zhim 'bras bzangag bur dri bsung ltar yal med du mnga' ba'i me tog rnams 'go lcog ldem bzhin gar gyi tshul du g.yo/ yan lag brgyad ldan dal babs lha chu sngon 153

mo'i tshogs rnams spu dkar mu tig 'dzum phreng gi zur mig g.yo zhing gya gyu'i 'gros kyi ldem ldem 'khyug 'khyug lhung lhung gi sgra rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs la rol bzhin bde bar rgyu bas 'dzam gling na grags pa'i rgya mo dngul chu zhes pa'i a ma yin/ in ḍa ni la'i gos bzang rin chen sna lnga'i 'phra bkod dang mtshungs ba'i dbyar dus/ 'bru sna mang po'i lo tog rnams sdug gur bkra shing 'dzam bu'i chu gser dang mtshungs zhing dam chos snying po las 'bras dang mi rtag pa dngos su ston pa'i slob dpon ston gyi dus/ nor 'dzin bu mo ka shi'i gos kyi klubs zhing lha mchog phyag na pad mo'i zhing der dngos su slebs pa'i snang ba ster zhing / rim gnyis lam la 'bad pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams gtum mo'i lang tsho ngoms pa'i dgun dus/ sil sil rnga yab dkar po g.yob dang mtshungs zhing yar skyes rtsa phran la sogs le lo'i gnyid las slong / brjid chags sa 'dzin phreng ba lang long du chu 'dzin gsar pa'i yol bas khebs shing dbyar skyes kun gyi rtsa ba yin pa la nyin ltar bskul ba ltar gyi dpyid ka sogs dpal yon du mas phyug pa'i sman ljongs/ bkra shis nags klung phyug mo'i sa yi lte ba gnas mchog ba lag shel dkar 'bum pa zhes stod smad kun du grags pa bod kyi 'bum chen bcu gsum gyi ya gyal/ byin rlabs kyi tshan kha 'bar zhing / sgom chen nyams rtogs skye zhing las ngan sdig sgrib byang ba/ nad gdon sa bdag klu gnyan la sogs gnod pa kun la dper na dug sbrul la rtsi ma ghi ta dang / 'chi ba gso ba'i bdud rtsi lta bu ni 'bum chen 'di nyid las gzhan min te/ ba lag shel dkar 'bum pa zhes snyan pa'i ba dan phyogs brgyar g.yo ba 'di nyid spyi lo 1071bod rab byung dang po lcags phag lor bka' gdams pa'i dge bshes sne'u zur pa rin chen 'bar zhes byang chub 154

sems pa 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam 'phrul/ lha mchog mi g.yo ba'i dngos grub brnyes pa dge bshes dgon pa ba dang spyan snga ba'i thugs sras/bka' gdams lam rim rgyud pa'i mnga' bdag pa des phyag btab/ khong ni rab byung dang po'i chu rta lo spyi lo 1042jo bo rje mnga' ris su phebs pa'i lo der spras sne'u zur gyi sa skor thang pa zhes bya bar/ yab zhang stag po zhes pa'i sras su mtshan dpe'i bzhad/ sngon sbyangs sad pas ting 'dzin brtan po mnga'/ brag rgyab tu byon nas rab tu byung ba'i mtshan ye shes 'bar zhes gsol/ der lo 'ga' bzhugs nas ston pa shākya tshul gyis zhus te/ rwa sgreng du dge bshes dgon pa ba'i thugs la 'dogs par zhus/ dgon pa ba'i mtshan thos pa tsam gyis tshe 'di'i snang ba 'gag jo bo yab sras gnyis kyi thugs sras de 'dra ba mjal snyam nas/ jo bo chen po'i man ngag rnams rdzogs par zhus nas mthil phyin pa zhig byung na ci ma rung snyam/ rwa sgreng du phyin nas dgon pa ba dang mjal bas dang po 'di gnang gsungs/ bstan pa'i 'jug sgo skyabs 'gro'i khrid dang / tshogs gnyis rdzogs byed gtor ma gnyis gnang nas zla phyed tsam bskyangs/ de nas tshig nyung don bsdus jo bo rjes 'di ltar gsungs zhes skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim rnams legs par sbyangs/ bla ma la bcos min gyi mos gus brtan pas dgon pa ba'i thugs dgyes nas mgo la phyag byug mdzad pa dang / thun min gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i dbang dang man ngag gnang zhing / yi dam mi g.yo ba'i zhal gzigs/ las tshogs kun la nus pa thon pas kun la grags/ dge bshes dgon pa ba mjal nas sku mya ngan las ma 'das kyi bar du mnyes pa gsum gyis mchod/ dgon pa ba sku mya ngan las 'das nas lam rim snying po bya phyir grwa sa la ma chags par sne'u zur 155

sgrub khang du thugs dam mdzad/ po to ba'i grwa sar grwa pa bcu skor la klu nad byung bas yi dam mi g.yo ba'i nus pas dmigs pa gcig gis grol/ rwa sgrong du pha bong la zhabs gtad de zhabs sgrog bcings pas sbrul dkar po gcig pha bong las thon pas der mdze pho zhig yod pa nad las grol/ dge bshes po to ba'i sngas bsrung dang lam rim zhus pa dang / sku mched gsum las lam rim man ngag 'ga' zhus/ dge bshes kyi zhal nas/ bod kyi srung ba'i skor thams cad phyogs gcig tu bzhugs pa bas/ nga'i dmigs pa skor gsum gyis mdze pho sos pa mang ba yin gsungs/ mi ma yin rnams kyang dge bshes sne'u zur ba'i rdo rje'i rwa ba las mi thar bar gleng / thub pa'i dbang po sogs sangs rgyas byang sems mang po'i zhal gzigs/ sngon gnas rjes dran dang gzhan sems shes pa sogs mngon shes lnga dang ldan/ drung du 'khod pa yang las dang nyon mongs kyi 'go non/ blo gtad pa'i bu slob la yang lo rer dbyar dgun gnyis la lam rim tshar re re chag med/ bka' khrid skabs su slob ma rnams kyi lam rim zin bris kyang mang / skabs zhig la brgyad stong 'grel chen skabs dang po la zla ba gsum khrid/ 'di'i lugs kyi lam rim shin tu dar ba byung /bstan pa la bya ba rgya chen mdzad pas slob tshogs mtha' yas/ slob ma'i gtso bo dge bshes rin chen sgang dang 'dul 'dzin thag ma ba/ lha 'bri sgang pa/de min gtan du tshogs pa nyis stong tsam re 'dus/ mthar sku dngos kyi 'dul bya rnams rdzogs nas dgung lo bdun cu don bdun sa khyi lor mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan nas dga' ldan chos kyi pho brang du gshegs so/bu slob rnams kyis gdung bzhus pas dbu thod dgon pa ba'i phyag rjes yod pa de dngul gdung du bzhengs nas/ phyis 'bri sgang nas gdan drangs te 156

don steng gi gdung rten chen mo'i nang du bzhugs/ phyag gcig mnyal smad gser phye 'bum pa'i nang du bzhugs/ zhal ko rin chen sgang gi mchod rten nang du bzhugs/ gzhan yang ring bsrel dpag tu med pa byon te ring bsrel kyang gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i kha gting med par sngo seng nge ba mjal ba tsam gyi dwangs ba 'dren pa'i yungs 'bru lta bu'i ring bsrel mang /rje nyid kyi slob ma dgyer sgom chen mo ni/ bram ze dgyer snang gi rigs su snon gyi mdor/ yab dgyer shes rab skyabs dang / yum g.yang mo klu lcam bya ba'i sras su sku 'khrungs/ glang thang pa'i zhabs la btugs/ phyis sne'u zur ba'i zhabs la mjal nas lo dgu bsdad/ sgom pa la gtso bo mdzad pas dgyer sgom chen po zhes grags/ bu slob brgyad brgya tsam tshogs pa'i nang nas slob ma'i gtso bo sangs rgyas dbon rin po che yin zhing / bskal ba bzang po'i byang sems skal ldan shing rta yin/ seng ga la'i gling dgra bcom pas kha che pan chen shākya shri ri'i gcung po la me tog bzhi bkur ba gcig skyob pa rin po che dang / gcig di bha gi de'i lha chen po bzhengs pa de'i thugs kar bzhugs/gcig rin chen sgang gtsug lag khang byang sems skal ldan shing rta'i skye ba yod pa de la sprod gsungs pa bzhin phul/ 'gro don dang slob tshogs mtha' yas/g.yor po'i rgyal khams bskor bas po ti rang la nyis stong lhag byon/ zang zing gi dngos po zad pa med pa byung ste/ der bsten nas gtsug lag khang bzhengs ba'i skabs/ dge bshes dpon dar ma rdo rje nags shod du shing 'dren par btang nas nags shod du phebs/ shing rnams gegs med par rin chen sgang du drangs/ dbu rtse ka chen bcu gnyis dang / khyams chen ka ba drug bcu rtsa bzhi/ mgon khang ka ba gnyis bcas grub/ spyan snga'i slob ma bya yul ba chen 157

mo bya yul dgon pa 'debs skabs shing rnams nags shod stod nas drangs bar bshad/ de skabs su nags shod 'gom ba lag dgon dang 'brel ba che ba byung yang / shin tu rgyas pa'i rnam thar lag song ma byung bas rjes su dpyad par bya/'bum pa zhes pa ni rtsa che shos dang grangs mang shos shig la go dgos te/dper na bka' 'bum dang / gsung 'bum/ sku 'bum zhes nang bzhugs byin can dang kha grangs mang shos kyi mchod rten zhig la go dgos pa las/mchod rten las logs su gyur ba'i 'bum pa zhig yod par mi sems/ sngon jo bo rjes glang thang du dge sbyor mdzad nas sa tstsha grangs mang btab nas bzhugs su gsol ba'i mchod rten zhig bzhengs par nang bzhugs gzungs rdzas mang bas 'bum pa zhes bod gangs can ljongs su 'bum pa dang po de bzhengs pas 'bum dang zhes mtshan chags/ de'i slob rgyud gtso bo rnams kyis phyag len gnang ba'i bod kyi grags can 'bum chen bcu gsum zhes pa'i nang / dge bshes sne'u zur bas phyag btab pa ni ba lag shel dkar 'bum pa 'di nyid yin/ 'bum pa'i mchod rten ni rgya gar du bzo dbyibs mi 'dra bar mchod rten sna tshogs mchis pa las/ rmang dge las seng khri bya ba'i srol med/ bod kyi snga srol mchod rten khag gcig de dang mtshungs par rmang dge las seng khri med pa dang / bum pa yang 'dum po par gzugs sha stag yin/ de'i rjes su bod kyi mkhas pa khag gtsig gis bod lugs su sangs rgyas kyi chos la gus bkur mtshon byed du/ seng khri bya ba gsar gtod mdzad/ bod snga rabs pa'i mchod rten gyi bzo dbyibs kyi nang du 'bum pa'i bzo dbyibs ni de'i khongs su 'dus/ da lta bod kyi dgon pa ches rnying shos bka' gdams pa'i gdan sa 158

rwa sgreng dgon dang / brag yer pa/ snye thang sgrol ma lha khang / 'bri gung thel gyi gdung 'bum sogs mchod rten khag mjal ba trem gyis shes par nus/ de rjes su bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas chu zhing las ma brgal bar mchod rten gyi thig rtsa cung bde bar bzhengs nas sa khyab rdo khyab du gyur/ de rjes 'phreng kha ba dang / brag nag dpal ldan yab sras/ dngul chu lugs/ g.ya' sel lugs sogs cung mi 'dra ba cha chung drug cu re bzhi las mi 'gal bar sna tshogs byung ba 'di rnams so/de nas dge bshes sne'u zur pas gnas 'dir dgon gnas shin tu rgya che bar bzhengs pa dang / dgon gyi g.yas phyogs su mchod rten nam 'bum pa bzhengs nas rab gnas skabs/ gnas mchog sum cu rtsa gsum dga' ldan lha yi pho brang nas bka' gdams gong ma rnams kyis dri med shel gyi rab gnas gnang bas bol nub tsam babs/ shel gyi rab gnas dang po wag ta'i phu nas mar rdong rdzong gog ldil ri gdong nas 'bum pa'i bar babs pas da lta yang che ba mchod rten gyi dbyibs can/ chung ba shel phreng tsam dngos su rnyed rgyu yod pa ni kun gyi mthong chos su gyur/ lha yi dbang po brgya byin gyis phyag bzo dam pa'i chos kyi lte ba 'phags yul rdo rje gdan gyi mchod sdong dbyibs can bcas mnyam du byung bas shel dkar 'bum pa zhes mtshan chags/ kha cig gis shel char bab pas sher rtse 'bum pa zhes gsungs/ shel dkar mchod rten ni da lta 'gro ba lha mi kun gyi mchod gnas su bzhugs/ kha cig gis bram ze'i phyag gcig bzhugs pas bram lag 'bum pa zhes zhu/ de'i rjes su bod rab byung bcu gcig dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i nang du grwa sgom chos kyi rdor rjes mtshan ldan dge ba'i bshes gnyen kun dga' dri med blo gros bya ba'i sku gdung 159

phyag gnyis ma gtogs ril bor bzhugs zhes gsungs/ rin chen gter mdzod dpe gzugs shog grangs 1rdo o rgyan dri med kun dga' sogs cher mang zhes/ bsnubs sangs rgyas ye shes kyi rnam 'phrul du gsungs pa de min nam snyam/ 'bum chen g.yas kyi rgya gar mchod rten zhu ba 'di/ ston pa 'das nas lo sum brgya tsam na chos rgyal mya ngan med kyis 'dzam bu'i gling du mchod rten bye ba bzhengs ba'i smon lam 'grub pa'i gras shig yin zhes/phyogs bzhi nas lcags thag gis ma skor na slar rgya gar du 'phur 'gro zhes gsungs/ rig gsar skabs su rtsig rdo rnams lung pa rang gi rdo dang mi 'dra ba ngo mtshar zhes der yod kun gyis smra/ mdun du mchod rten gcig yod pa de'i nang rig gsar skabs rje mi la'i rdza'i khog ma zhes kha yig can zwa sngo sgor re yod pa sogs rtsa che'i rig dngos 'ga' byung yang med par gyur/ rgyab tu mchod rten gcig dang / 'bum pa'i g.yas su ri dbang sku thog gnyis kyi gdung rten khang bu brtsegs pa gnyis/ de'i g.yas su dri med mchod rten ni skyi ru dge slong dkon mchog phan bde nas tshes bcu lha khang gsum dang mchod rten gsum bzhengs pa'i nang tshan yin/ sngon 'di'i skor du mchod rten cha brgyad yod par bshad/ 'bum pa'i yar ri 'gul der mchod rten cha brgyad kyi rjes shul bum pa'i zhabs ra yang da lta bsdad yod pas kun gyis srung skyob bya dgos pa'i rig dngos shig yin/ de'i mar gsham der mchod rten gnyis dang / de'i g.yon phyogs der mchod rten chen po gcig gi rjes shul bcas mjal rgyu yod pa de rnams dgon gnas dang mnyam du nyams gud du phyin/'bum pa'i g.yon du dge slong gral skyob kyis bzhengs pa tshes bcu lha khang ngam gu ru lha khang zhes rten gtso gu ru padma 'byung gnas yab yum dang 160

ldebs bris su 'bum pa'i dus chen khag tu gnas chen khag 'phrod pa'i lo rgyus bcas bris yod/g.yas kyi don grub chos rje'i lha khang ni/ spyi lo 1417me bya lor rje nyid gnas 'dir phebs nas 'dul bya'i re ba bskang ba'i rjes dran su bzhengs pa yin la/ rten gtso chos rje don grub rgyal po'i 'dra sku dang / g.yas su rje nyid kyi dad rten du bstsal ba'i zhabs rjes shin tu gsal ba/ zhabs rjes de nyid rig gsar skabs srung skyob bya phyir sku gdung dang mnyam du me 'bar du dbor bas da lta me 'bar sgrub phug du bzhugs yod/ g.yon du rje'i chibs rjes rdo la bzhag pa dang / de min nye rabs su sgrol ma bla ma zhes pa zhig gis sgrol lha nyer gcig bzhengs nas/ 'di skad du/ phyag 'tshal gser mdog grub pa'i sgrol ma/ rin chen dus la babs pa'i lha mo/ tshe yi bar chad sel ba'i nyer gcig bsam pa'i don chen 'grub par mdzod cig ces pa'i tshig bcad yang brtsams pas rjes su sgrol ma lha khang zhes 'bod/ dkyil du thab tshang bcas yod/ lo ngo stong phrag gong gi bod mi'i snying stobs mtshon pa'i rgyal ba'i sku dang gsung snying po yig 'bru bcas rdo la brkos pa 'di/ 'dzam gling thog rdo brkos ches snga shos dang mang shos shig yin/ sgyu rtsal dang lo rgyus mtshon byed dang mi rigs kyi snying stobs dang yab mes rnams kyi mdzad bzang mtshon byed cig yin/ rig gsar skabs su rdo 'bum phyed tsam las ma lhag par gtor skyon du song /lo ltar bsnyen gnas smyung gnas/ zla rim ltar tshes bcu nyer lnga btang ba'i gtong co yod pas/ zhing 'bum dkar zhes da lta rgan gso khang gi rgyud gyi zhing kha rnams yin/ 161

ba lag 'bum par zla ba dang po'i tshes bco lnga la dar chen slong ba'i thebs rtsa dang / nyin mtshan khor yug 'bar ba'i sdong kong / rang dgon nas 'bum pa'i lha gnyer rgyun bzhugs bcas yod/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i nang du ri dbang dkon mchog dam chos bstan pa'i nyi ma mchog gis 'bum chen chos 'khor bcu gsum gser 'bul skabs/ rje drung rin po che rnam gnyis ba lag zhing mo che ru dbu gur phub nas/ sgro ba tshang gi nang 'gar thab bcas/ ka mdo mgar ba dbu chen btsan rgyal pha bu gnyis nas gser rgyab nas 'bum par nyams gso dang rab gnas gang zab gnang / mthar rig gsar skabs te spyi lo 1966me rta lo rten dang brten pa bcas pa bshig pa'i 'go tshugs/ mchod rten gyi bum pa dang seng khri nas i khung phug nas rgyu nor thob re bcang / 'jig rten gyi rgyu dang dam pa'i lha chos sogs rtsa chen gang yang ma thon pas/ 'go khrid kyis lha 'dre gdon bgegs kyis mi tshogs la 'go skor 'di ltar byed kyi red/ stod smad kun tu grags pa'i gnas chen zhes kyang / don snying 'di red zer bka' slob gnang / de rjes drag char chen po zhig babs nas bsgyur bkod pa rnams char g.yol byed skabs/ 'ur sgra dang bcas sa spungs 'ga' yang nyil bas/ sa dmar dge 'phel gyis bltas pas dar tshon sna lnga'i dkyil du shel dkar mchod rten 'di dang / slob dpon rin po che'i sku gcig bcas byung ba rnyed nas rjes su spyi lo 19rdoṭwāṃlor dgon du phul/ de ltar rten dang brten pa bcas pa gtsang bshig byas pa dang / ma ṇi'i rdo phung kyang phyogs gzhan du khang pa'i rmang rdo dang zam rgyag byed la dbor/sdong rdzong zam pa ma ṇi yin pas rjes su chu log gis khyer skabs rdo rnams la yi ge 'bru gcig kyang med pa ngo mtshar zhes rgan rabs rnams kyis gleng / 'bum 162

pa'i nang bzhugs kyi gzungs rnams ma nyams par gnas shing / gnas bdag rnams kyis srung skyob byas pa'i rtags dang / dus 'tshubs skabs su byis pa 'gas 'bum pa'i mchod rten la rtsed mo rtses nas don brus pas/ mi dmar po ral pa can zhig gis mngon sum du ded pa sogs ngo mtshar che/ spyi lo 1966lo nas bgrang bya bco brgyad tsam gyi ring la dam pa'i chos tshul rnams cung zad ngal gso'i gnas su gyar/ 'bum pa bskyar bzhengs/las 'bras bslu ba med pas slar yang skal bzang shar ri'i phrag pa nas bsu ba'i 'thor rlung gang sar khyab pas/ spyi lo 1rdzor4lo bod rab byung bcu drug shing pho byi ba'i lo hor zla bdun pa'i tshes bco lnga nyin skyabs rje ri dbang rin po che mchog gi bka' lung ltar/ rnal 'byor pa ngag dbang rdo rje dang /bstan 'dzin rgyal mtshan/ de min dgon par skar 'dzin skabs su phebs pa mang che ba bcas phebs nas/ dar lcog rgyag rgyu dang / sa rdo la 'gul tsam zhig gnang nas/ nye skor dad ldan rnams dang lhan du ma ṇi'i rdo 'bum chen mo brtsigs/spyi lo 19ṭwāṃ5shing glang lo'i zla ba gsum pa'i tshes dgu nyin gyi dus tshes dge bar/ skyabs rje ri dbang rin po che nag chu nas mar phebs pa dang /mkhan po dge slong ye shes 'byung gnas dang / dbu tshul khrims rnam gnyis mnyam du phebs/ tshes bcu'i snga dro nyi shar la sa chog dang grwa brtson 'grus nas gar 'chams sa 'dul sogs mdzad/ yang dar bstan pa'i skabs su skyabs rje mchog gi bka' dbang thog ma tshe rta zung 'brel 'chi med dpal ster gyi dbang gis chos kyi sgo mo phye/ ma ṇi jo dar sgron nas dngos su las grwa'i dbu 163

tshugs/ 'bum chen bum pa'i rmang nas sku gdung sgrog rus mtho gang dang /tshems dkar 'dangs ldan pa/ rkang pa'i lhu dum bcas byung ba rnams ri dbang rin po ches bum pa'i nang du bcug nasatshogazungs zhugs su phul/ sngon gyi gzungs rdzas mang po bzhugs pa shes nas mchod rten gyi rmang de ma slog par sngar ltar bzhag sngon gyi mchod rten las cha gcig rten 'brel du spar nas de skabs 'bum pa rang gi thig rtsa med pas 'phreng kha lugs kyi thig rtsa ltar bzhengs bas seng khri'i bar slebs nas lan 'ga' zhig pas/ dgon gzhung nas bstan 'dzin rgyal mtshan phebs nas 7skyabs mgon chos kyi snang ba la thugs rtags zhus pas lo gcig tsam phar 'then na legs par lung bstan/bka' srung rnams la 'phrin bcol dang thugs smon bcas gnang pas nyer 'tshe med par rim bzhin grub/ gzungs zhugs rnams grub dbang dkon mchog chos bzang mchog gis rdo rje phag mo'i lha khang du sku mtshams dang bcas bdun gcig ring sgrub/ gtso bo'i gzungs zhugs ni yang dar bstan pa'i skabs su bka' 'gyur dang po de sgo cog rin po che la dbang bas zhal nas ngas bka' 'gyur gyi phud dang po de nags shod dgon la phul yod gsungs pa de dang / de min gu ru stong sku/ rdor sems stong sku/ rgya bod mkhas grub yongs kyi byin rten sogs ches mang / sngon gyi gzungs zhugs rnam rgyal ma'i gzungs dang / ye dhar rten bzhugs/ sku 'dra sna tshogs bcas mang po bzhugs/ dus tshes dge bar rang dgon 'dus tshogs rin po ches rab gnas legs par grub/ dkyil du dkor khang ka gnyis gcig bcas bzhengs/ dbu dkon mchog tshul khrims kyi zhal bkod ltar tshes bcu lha khang bzhengs nas/ rnam rgyal nyi ma nas gu ru mtsho skyes rdo rje'i sman sku mi tshad ma 164

dang / stong sku bcas bzhengs/spyi lo 19rdoras 'brug lor bstan 'dzin rgyal mtshan nas thugs 'gan bzhes nas sngon gyi dkon mchog phan bdes bzhengs pa'i dri med mchod rten de/ rang dgon pa'i dbu bla rang grol nges gsang bstan pa'i nyi ma rin po che'i gdung rten du bzhengs/ thig mkhan dge slong ye shes 'byung gnas dang /blo bzang 'jam dbyangs rnam gnyis nas mdzad/ nang bzhugs rten gtso/rang grol rin po che'i na bza' cha tshang / tshems bcas bzhugs pa dang /7skyabs mgon chos kyi snang ba'i phyag gnang thub pa gdan 'dzugs gtsos byin rten khag rnams bzhugs/ de min lho ru mchod rten gnyis dang don grub chos rgyal gyi lha khang du gser gdung bcas bzhengs/ nang du gzungs zhugs du rang grol sku thog rim byung gi byin rten sku tshab bye ma a krong dang / stag phu padma badzra gyi dbu thod a rang byung bcas bzhugs/ sbyin bdag bstan 'dzin rgyal mtshan nas khur blangs te rab gnas legs par grub/ lo der ser khog nas sbyin bdag 'jam dpal gyis gtsos pas ri dbang sku thog gnyis kyi gdung rten khang bu rtseg pa bzhengs/ gzungs zhugs su skyabs rje ri dbang rin po che'i sku bal gyi ring bsrel khag bcas bzhugs/ g.yas su bshes gnyen don grub rgyal po'i lha khang nyams gso zhus nas rten gtso rje nyid kyi sku bcas bzhugs/'bum pa rgyas bskrun/ba lag shel dkar 'bum pa rgyas bskrun dgos don ni phyi ltar mchod rten ser kha gas pa dang / nang ltar sngar gyi 'bum pa'i thig tu 'gyur ba/gsang ba ltar na skyabs rje ri dbang rin po che nyid gter sgrom ri skor du 165

phebs nas a phyi chos kyi sgrol ma'i bla mtsho nas/ da lta'i 'bum pa'i bzo dbyibs dang mtha' skor du khang pa bcas gsal bar gzigs/ lhag tu 19rardolo sa 'brug lo'i zla ba gsum pa'i tshes brgyad kyi dgong mo dgon par zhabs bskor du phebs nas ke ru'i grwa shag 'og gi rdo leb la sku ngal gso skabs/ nyi ma nub rir rgas la nye ba'i nyi zer dang 'dres zhing thugs 'ur ba'i rnams pa zang thal chen po'i ngang la da lta'i 'bum pa'i bzo dbyibs 'di lam mer mjal/ tshes dgu la cha chung re bzhi las ma brgal ba theg chen brgyad dang ldan pa ngo mtshar ba mdzad/ 7skyabs mgon chos kyi snang bar spyan gzigs phul pas legs so dang bcas lha gos srid na ring ba bstsal/ spyi lo 1992chu sprel lo zla ba dgu pa'i tshes nyi shu gnyis la las grwa legs grub yong phyir mgon khang gsar du btsugs/ spyi lo 1992chu bya lor dbu bstan pa dar rgyas dang / spu thi dkon mchog rgyal mtshan rnam gnyis kyis las ka'i 'gan 'khur bya rgyu'i bka' gnang nas lo gcig ring mchod rten gyi phyi'i bzo dbyibs rnams yongs su grub/ de'i phyi lo la bcu gsum 'khor lo sogs gser 'bul ba dang / de'i phyi lo nang bzhugs lha rten rnams kyang bzhengs grub/ sngar gyi bskor khang mal der smyung gnas lha thang ka ba bzhi dang sgo 'phyor ka ba gnyis bcas bzhengs/lo ltar chos phyogs mdzad sgo/spyi lo 1992rab byung bcu bdun chu sprel lo zla ba dgu pa'i tshes nyi shu gnyis kyi ston pa lha las babs pa'i dus chen nyin/ mgon khang dngos su btsugs pas/ mgon khang bla ma dang po dbu dkon mchog mthar phyin dang dbu bstan 'dzin tshul khrims rnam gnyis bzhugs/ zla re'i tshes bco lnga la zla 166

bsang / tshes bcu la padma'i ljon shing dbu 'dzugs skabs/ dbu rgan dkon mchog tshul khrims nas phyag len bka' khrid dang sbrags gsungs/ bod zla dang po'i tshes bco lnga nyin rang dgon gyi 'dus tshogs lhan rgyas 'bum par phebs nas cho ga res mos sam gang 'dod kyi tshogs brgya dang / stong tshogs/'bum tshogs dang / mkhan sprul mchog nas sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i dbu nas rim par bka' dbang gnang / shel rtse 'bum par mjal kha zhus/ shel rtse 'bum pa gdan 'dren dang 'bum par khrus gsol dang rab gnas gnang /shing phag lo nas bzung zla dgu pa'i tshes bco lnga dang / zla ba drug pa'i tshes bco lnga gnyis la lo ltar tshogs bla rim byon nas smyung gnas bla ma mdzad nas tshogs/sku gsung thugs rten/ba lag shel dkar 'bum chen gyi rten ni chos lugs ris su ma 'chis pa'i bod gangs can kyi yul 'dir bka' drin bla na med pa gzhal bar dka' ba sha stag yin zhing / de mtshangs ris med ser skya pho mo rnams kyis phyag ༄bskor mchod 'bul bya yul gtso bo zhig yin/ mchod rten gong thog tu phyogs bzhi dbus dang bcas shar du rdor sems/ lhor rin 'byung / nub tu snang ba mtha' yas/ byang du don yod grub pa/ dbus su rnam par snang mdzad bcas bzhugs pas sangs rgyas rnams kyis mdzad pa 'phrin las thams cad ye shes lngar ma 'dus pa med/ de'i shod kyi bang rim la 'das pa'i sangs rgyas mar me mdzad/ ma 'ongs sangs rgyas byams pa mgon po/ da lta'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa/ slob dpon padma 'byung gnas/ mkhan chen bo dhi satwa/rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan/ chos sku rdo rje 'chang chen/ telle shes rab 1༵ṭwāṃng

po/ nā ro ye shes dngos grub/ mar pa chos kyi blo gros/ mi la bzhad pa rdo rje/dwags po zla 'od gzhon nu/ phag gru rdo rje rgyal po/ skyob pa 'jig rten gsum mgon/ rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa/ skyabs mgon 'phrin las bzang po/spyan ras gzigs/ 'jam dpal dbyangs/ phyag na rdo rje/ bod rgyal gnya' khri btsan po/ lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po/btsun mo 'un shing kong jo/ bal mo bza' khri btsun/ jo bo rje/ 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/ rngog legs pa'i shes rab/ mgon po tshe dpag med/gtsug gtor rnam rgyal/ rje btsun sgrol ma dkar mo/ rje tsong kha pa/ mkhas grub rje/ rgyal tshab rje/ dge bshes sne'u zur pa/ snubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes bcas rim par g.yas bskor du bzhugs/de 'og gong rim 'og ma la/ bsil ba'i tshal chen mo/ so sor 'brangs ma/ rma bya chen mo/ stong chen mo/ gsang sngags rjes su 'dzin ma bcas grwa lnga'i lha tshogs bzhugs pas rgyal khams spyi dang yul phyogs 'dir/ dus mtha'i rims nad 'joms pa'i gnyen po ru bzhugs/ de nas yi dam 'khor lo bde mchog rta phag yab yum/ bstan srung ye shes mgon po/ a phyi chos kyi sgrol ma/ dgra lha dpe har chen po/ chos skyong rtse'u dmar/ dpal ldan lha mo/ dgra lha ge sar rgyal po/ yul skyong nags lha dzam bha/ gnas srung grib batren chen po bcas bzhugs/don grub chos rgyal lha khang du/ rten gtso bshes gnyen don grub rgyal po'i sman sku lo brgyad tsam dang / ston pa thub pa'i dbang po'i sku byis tshad ma/skyob pa'i li sku/ de min rdo rje 'chang / sgrol ma sngon po/ phyag rdor/ rje tsong kha pa bcas bzhugs/ gsung rten du rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur chen mo/ thugs 168

rten du gser gdung chen mo bcas bzhugs/smyung gnas lha khang /rten gtso grub dbang rin po che'i thugs dam gyi rten spyan ras gzigs dpal mo lugs bcu gcig zhal sman sku thog tshad ma 'di ni/ grub dbang dkon mchog chos bzang rin po ches ma yum gyi dgongs rdzogs dang de min bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i zhabs brtan du spyi lo 1995shing mo phag gi lor bzhengs nas/ zla ba dgu pa'i tshes bcu la rab gnas rgyas par rje nyid kyis 'bum pa dang mnyam du mdzad/ tshes bcu gsum la bsnyen gnas smyung gnas gral 'dzin dang bka' khrid bka' lung gnang / de nas bzung lo brgyad ring grub dbang rin po che nas smyung gnas bla ma mdzad pas byin rlabs che/ g.yon du spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa de yang mnyam du bzhengs/ de'i g.yon du nā ro mkha' spyod/ rten gtso'i g.yas kyi skyob pa rin po che'i sku 'di grub dbang rin po che'i sku mched kyi dgongs rdzogs su bzhengs shing / gzungs zhugs la sngon gyi skyob pa'i gzungs dbyibs khyad par can de bzhugs/de'i g.yas su skyabs rje ri dbang rin po ches gser zangs kyi gu ru snang srid zil gnon dang rtogs ldan rnam rgyal nyi ma nas gu ru gtso 'khor gsum gser zangs las grub pa gru tshad ma dang / sangs rgyas ye shes nas khur blangs te/ zhi khro dam pa rigs brgya'i sku cha tshang / skyabs mgon rin po che'i bzhugs khri/ smyung gnas nyer 'kho cha tshang bcas bzhugs/tshes bcu lha khang ngam gu ru lha khang zhes dang de min srung ma khang ni/rtenagatso gu ru snang srid zil gnon gser zangs las grub pa 'di nyi grags rin po ches gu ru stong sku bzhengs ba de'i gras yin zhing / rnal 'byor pa ngag 169

dbangardo rje nas dang po 'bum pa bzhengs skabs su phul/ rtogs ldan rnam rgyal nyi ma nas slob dpon rin po che'i sman sku mi tshad ma/ de min gu ru stong sku/sgrol ma'i sku gnyis/ 'jam dpal dbyangs/ tshe dpag med/ rin chen 'byung ldan/ sgrol ma pad 'khor ma/ rtse dgon pa'i mkhan po don grub bde chen gyis gser zangs rgyal chen sde bzhi/ de min sku 'dra gsar pa thang stong rgyal po/ thub pa'i sku che chung bzhi/ gu ru che chung gnyis/ gu ru drag po/sgrol ljang / gsung rten du bka' 'gyur/ cho ga sna tshogs/ mgon khang bla ma'i nyer spyod cha tshang bcas bzhugs/rdo rje phag mo'i lha khang /lha khang 'di 'gom ba lag dgon gyi skabs su yod pa zhig yin la/ phag mo'i mgon khang yin zhes gsungs/ rten gtso rdo rje phag mo de sngon sog dmag slebs skabs gsungs byon pa'i gras yin zhes bshad srol dang / dgon rnying dgon gsar du spo skabs gsungs byon nas nga mi 'gro 'gro don gnas 'dir yod gsungs pas gzhag pa zhig yin/ de rjes nags shod du 'brum nag gi rims nad mched skabs/ phag mos bzhes nas sku la 'brum nag thor ba byung bas rims nad chad ces dang / de min rje phag gru'i bzhugs khri sa khri dmar po bcas byin rlabs che ba bzhugs/de rjes rig gsar skabs spyi dang mtshungs/ spyi lo 19ṭwāṃ7lo 'gom yul pa'i sngags 'chang mthu chen ye shes zhes 'jim bzo la mkhas shing / lha mo ku ru ku ler la grub pa thob pa/ sman rtsis kun la mkhas shing nus ldan de'i slob ma sngags 'chang dri med 'od zer nas nyams gso zhus nas rten gtso phag mo dang / spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal bcas bzhengs ba sogs mdzad 170

yod/ shel dkar 'bum pa'i gnas kyi phan yon dang skor tshad/gnas kyi phan yon sogs rgyas par ni/ 'gom dgon chos 'khor byams pa gling dgon par bzhugs/ stod gangs rin po che dang smad kha ba dkar po/ bar ba lag 'bum pa gsum la gnas yig rgyas bsdus gsum las 'bring ba de gnas 'dir yod pa de yin ces bshad/ smad tshong ja pa zhig gis de shes nas 'bum pa'i lha gnyer la mjal kha zhu bar zhus pas/ dgon par yod ces gsungs/ khong gis dgon par song nas zhag gcig g.yar bar zhus pas phyi nyin gar song med par gyur nas brlag de rjes gos chen ser po'i rgyab sha can/ tshes bcu lha khang gi ldebs bris nas bshus pa dus chen khag la gnas chen gang zhig 'phrod min skor gsal bar bshad pa de dus 'gyur skabs 'bum pa'i lha gnyer sog po 'gur skyab kyis ma ṇi rdo phung bar bseng na sbas kyang rjes su ma rnyed/gnas mchog 'di nyid gnas chen stong gi gong nga / gnas phran stong gi a ma yin zhes/ rta lo la gangs rin po che/ lug lo la gnam mtsho/ sprel lo la tsā ri dang zho stod gter sgrom sogs 'phrod pa dang / de dang mtshungs par dus tshes dge bar gnas mgron phebs pas gnas chen khag dang 'ja' 'od gyis sbrel zhing / mtshan ltas bzang bas ngo mtshar che/ gnas mchog 'di nyid skor tshad la bskor ba nyis stong lnga brgya/ phyag bskor nyer lnga/ sgrig phyag gcig bcas 'tshal zhing / lus dad pas phyag dang bskor ba/ ngag dad pas 171

snying po dang bstod tshig sems dad pas mi phyed pa'i dad pa dang bcas bskor na/ gnas skabs nyer 'tshe mtha' dag zhi nas/ mthar thug rnam mkhyen rgyal ba'i go 'phang dam par bgrod par gsungs/ lhag par du dge bshes sne'u zur pa chen pos byin gyis rlabs pas mdze nad dang sa bdag klu yi gnod pa sogs 'gos nad kun dang / 'jigs pa brgyad dang bcu drug gis mi tshugs shing / gnas 'brel tsam gyis ngan song gi skye gnas las grol ba dang / gnas 'di'i byin rlabs kyis 'gom bar yang zhes bar do yang zhing mdze nad kyi mi tshugs pa sogs phan yon brjod las 'das/sngon dus su rdo la brkos pa'i lo rgyus sam dag snang rgyas bsdus gnyis bzhugs/ de ni gnas 'dir gnas 'brel du phebs pa'i skyes chen rnams kyis dag pa'i snang bar snang srid dag pa rab 'byams du shar ba'i ngang nas gsungs pa zhig las lo rgyus dngos su 'dren pa ni cung mi bde ba zhig yin te/rdo brkos cung che ba de ni rab byung bcu gcig pa'i nang du byung ba'i gter ston pa grwa sgom zhig po badzra zhes pa gnas 'dir phebs pa dang / nyag gdong dge bsnyen dam la btags nas gsol kha brtsams/ khong gi dag snang byung ba'i gnas tshul rdo la bkod pa zhig yin te/ padma bka' thang lcags par shog grangs 566re drug dang / gter ston brgya rtsa'i rnam thar dpe gzugs shog grangs 55dang de min gu bkra'i chos 'byung sogs rnying ma'i chos 'byung khag las/ o rgyan rin po che'i gter lung las/ dus ni lo re lo res ngan du 'groḥ mkhan po byas nas grong du tshogs dbang bskuraḥ lkog tu bu med khyi phag tsam pa 'byungaḥ sde 'khrug nang dme rgyab rten dug la reḥ dbu tshal gser khang sbas pa'i gter kha 'diḥ mi bzhag 'don pa'i rtags de bstan 172

na byungaḥ grwa sgom chos kyi rdo rje zhes bya 'byungaḥ zhes gsang sngags kyi sgrub pa khag dang bka' dbang rnams sngon dus su shin tu gsang ba mdzad kyang / bod kyi chen po 'gas khrom du dbang bskur rgyud bshad kyi srol gtod nas dam med dang dam tshig gang yang mi shes pa'i slob ma shin tu mang zhing gsang sngags 'chol ba'i dus rtags thams cad yongs su tshang ba'i skabs der/ rgyal sras lha rje'i skye mtha' lnga pa phyung nag shākya dar gyi yang srid drug pa lho kha grwa nang du sku 'khrungs pas grwa dang / rten sngags 'chang yin pas sgom pa/ mtshan chos kyi rdo rje zhu bas grwa sgom chos kyi rdo rje zhes zhu/ khong gis gter nas 'gur drag ki la ya dang / 'jig rten mchod bstod dang dpe har las rgyud bcas gter nas spyan drangs ba dang / gnas 'dir phebs pa yin/ chos rdor bya ba'i gter ston gcig nang chen sgom sder sku 'khrungs shingade ni ches snga mo nas yin par gter ston brgya rtsa'i rnam thar du gsal/ 'o na lho kha nas yin pa de gang gi shes zhe na/ 'gom dgon pa'i nyag sdong bsang gsol rje 'phrin las bzang pos mdzad pa'i shing par las/ rig 'dzin grwa sgom chos kyi rdo rjes mdzad pa'i gsol kha nyid la gzhi bzhag nas cung zad mang du btang ba yang / slar rig 'dzin nyid la gzigs su phul zhing zhal gyi sku bgad gtong te legs 'dug gsungs nas/ 'di yang chos 'khor byams pa gling gi bya 'dabs su bris pa dge bar gyur cig ces gsungs pas 'gom dgon khyung ri'i klad du spos pa'i 'jug tu yin zhing / rig 'dzin nyid la gzigs su phul zhes gter ston de nyid 'bum par bzhugs pa'i dus yin pa dngos su rtogs thub/ gnas rdo de'i steng du/ tshe lo sum bcu'i kha ral dus/ glang lo'i ston zla bar ma la/snubs la gdams pa phog pa yin/ 'brel thog yon tan mtha' las 'das/173

padma 'byung dang ḍā ki'i rigs/ grwa sgom zhig po badzra dang / ḍā kki dbyings phyug dkar mo yi/ gsang ba'i gnas bshad smon lam gyis/ zhes pas/gter ston nyid snubs chen gyi rnam 'khrul dang / rig ma de nyid mkha' 'gro ma yin par gsungs/ gnas 'di'i nye skor du bka' babs gter chen 'ga'i las 'phro yod pa dang / glang lo ston zla ra ba zhes spyi lo 16ṭwāṃ5rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing glang lo'i hor zla bdun pa'i nang du snubs la gdams pa phog zhes de nas bzung byin rlabs dang nus pa mtho ru btang ba'i skad yin/gnas rdo chung ngu de ni/ gu bkra'i chos 'byung lcags par shog grangs rdo64las/ gdan rabs gnyis pa gter chen chos kyi rgyal po mtshungs med rig 'dzin chen po de nyid kyi sku gsung thugs kyi sras mchog khams gsum chos kyi sgron me/ rgyal sras sems pa chen po o rgyan bstan 'dzin grags pa'am gu ru bsod nam bstan 'dzin zhes dang / shog grangs ṭwāṃ6ṭwāṃlas/ sku mtshams dang bcad rgya kho na la chig sgril mdzad/ sgrub gnas kyang / me 'bar phug dang / phug nag rdo rje snying rdzong rnams su gnas 'brel re tsam las/ gtso cher ser bkra shis steng du bzhugs/ zhes pas/ rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i nang du me 'bar sgrub phug tu gnas 'brel du phebs skabs/ ba lag 'bum par gnas 'brel du bzhugs pa'i nyams snang rdo la bkod pa yin te/ gu ru bsod nams bstan 'dzin chen po zhes pa rgyal sras sku phreng dang po'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs so/ 174

ro༅//nags shod 'gom dgon chos 'khor byams pa gling /na mo gu ru badzra dha ra ya/mi brjed zhing gi 'dren pa zas gtsang sras/zhing 'dir bsam bzhin 'gro ba'i skur bstan nas/gang la gang 'dul theg pa sna tshogs mtha'/bstan nas byung ba rgya chen spyod rgyud dang /zab mo lta rgyud so thar sdom rgyud dang /bka' babs byin rgyud rtogs pa don gyi rgyud/nyams len byin rlabs brgyud pa drug ldan kun/gcig rgyud 'gro mgon rgyal ba'i dbang por 'dud/sgrub brgyud ki la sha ri'i phrag pa nas/'jig med smra ba'i dbang phyug seng ge yis/nag phyogs gcan gzan tshogs rnams 'dar zhing g.yo/skyu ra chos kyi grags pa'i zhabs la 'dud/rin chen dpal gyi gdan sa byang gling du/sgrub pa'i gtsug nor nags shod sman ljongs su/don brgyud bstan pa ches cher gsal ba'i mgon/grub pa'i dbang po shākya rin chen 'dud/rig pa bslabs dang mdo rgyud bstan bcos dang /175

bslab gsum dbang bskur man ngag lam ston pa/byin rlabs kun bstsol rtsa ba'i bla ma la/mnyes pa gsum gyis mchod do gus pas mchod/ces tshigs su bcad pa rigs lnga'i grangs ldan gyis mdun bsus te/de yang 'gro ba'i 'dren pa 'gro mgon bka' brgyud pa'i bstan pa nyin mo ltar gsal ba/ rgyal ba 'bri gung pa'i chos sde chen mo nags shod 'gom dgon chos 'khor byams pa gling dgon pa 'di nyid/ 'gom ba lag dgon zhes 'gro mgon bka' gdams pa'i dge bshes chen mo sne'u zur pa ye shes 'bar gyis spyi lo 1071bod rab byung dang po'i lcags phag lor phyag btab/ sngon dus su dge bshes sne'u zur pa'i rnam thar mang bar bzhugs pa dang phyag btab pa'i lo rgyus rgyas par bzhugs nges kyang / phyis su rnam thar la dbye bsdu sna tshogs kyi dbang gis zhib par ma mjal kyang / rab byung bcu gcig pa'i nang du sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos brtsams pa'i be rūr ser po lcags par shog grangs 222nang gi dgon tho las/ rba lug dgon ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen sne'u zur pas phyag btab/ snga sor bka' gdams gsar rnying gi ring lugs 'dzin pa deng sang 'bri gung par 'gyur nas bla rabs sogs ma smos/zhes sde srid nas lo rgyus gsal por mjal bar snang zhing / gong sa lnga pa'i bka' yis bskul nas las chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis brtsams pa'i bka' gdams chos 'byung gsal ba'i sgron me zhes pa der brtsams pa'i dpyad gzhi sogs sne'u zur pa'i rnam thar mang po mjal ba gol ma chag de'i rjes su lam rim bla rgyud sogs rgyas bsdus tsam las khog phob gcig par snang bas rgyas par ma mjal/ de nas bzung bka' gdams pa'i bstan pa ches cher gsal bas rin chen sgang phyag 'debs skabs dge bshes dpon dar ma 176

rdo rje nags shod la phebs nas shing drangs pa dang / bya yul ba chen pos bya yul dgon phyag 'debs skabs nags shod stod nas shing rnams drangs pa sogs kyis bka' gdams pa'i dge bshes rnams dang 'brel ba zab par mngon/ de skabs nags shod 'gom ba lag dgon zhes 'di nyid shin tu rgya khyon che bas/ bshad srol la dbus se rwa theg chen gling dgon de nyid/ ma nyams gra rgyas skabs kyi rgya khyon tsam zhig yod par gsungs/ dgon pa'i shar 'dabs ba lag thang slob chung gi rgyal sgo'i thad tsam/ rig gsar gong du ma ṇi pad ring zhes rdo phreng gcig yod pa de dgon gyi lcags ri'i rmang steng du ma ṇi bkod pa yin zhing / lho phyogs da lta rlangs 'khor gyi gzhung lam bar yin par bshad kyang / mi dmangs kung hre'i skabs ngal rtsol bsgyur bkod sa zhing khod snyom byed skabs/ ba lag thang nas khang pa'i rtsig rmang dang mi bsdad shul thal ba dang sol ba sogs thon pa dngos su mthong pas/ dus skabs gang zhig gi dus su 'gro ba mi'i rigs 'phel rgyas dang nyams gud phyin min brjod dka' bar gyur pas/ phyis su dngos rdzas rigs byung na tshan rig dang mthun par brtag dpyad byas nas lo rgyus gsal kha gtod dgos/ nub ngos su 'bum pa'i sku mdun rdo rje phag mo'i skor dang / byang ngos ri ma 'gul bar yin zhing / shing nags stug pos yongs su khengs/ rgya phibs dang gser 'khru'i nyi 'od 'phro zhing / dpal gyi rwa sgreng dgon dang chags dbyibs mtshungs/ phyis su dgon pa'i 'du khang gtso bo ni/ rdo rje phag mo'i lha khang gi thog der yin zhing / spyi lo 1127rab byung gnyis pa'i me lug lor nags smad shugs lding dgon 'di nyid phag gru rdo rje rgyal pos phyag btab/ 'gom ba lag dgon du phyag phebs nas bzhugs/ rdo rje phag mo lha khang du bzhugs khri dmar po'am sa khri dmar po zhes nye char su bzhugs pas byin rlabs che/ de 177

skabs su gdan sa thel du rje phag gru'i slob ma nags shod pa mang zhing / de'i nang nas gtso bo nags shod pa'i mkhan po yar bcad dang / nags shod rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas nyid phag gru'i zhabs la gtug nas dmigs pa sum brgya drug bcu'i gdams pa thob/ gegs sel dang bog 'don mdzad nas mthar yon tan ji lta ba rgyud la skyes nas grub pa thob/ de min nags shod gnas brtan sogs mang /de rjes nags shod shug lding dgon rnam rgyal lha rtse ru skyob pa 'jig rten gsum mgon gyis gtsang dgon du bsgyur ba dang / gnas ri 'di nyid slob dpon klu sgrub yab sras kyis byin gyis rlabs pa'i gnas/ 'phags yul dpal gyi ri dang dbyer ma mchis pa dbyibs dang sa bcad yongs su tshang zhing /lung dkar lcog gu mdun brag sgo chung dbyibs can de rgyal bu bde spyod bzang po'i ro sgrung nang gi brag khung de yin pa dang / ngo mtshar ba'i gnas yig dang dgon de'i lo rgyus dang bskor tshad phan yon bcas/ rje phag mo gru pas mdzad pa jo bo dkar chag zhes pa pod chung zhig yod pa rgan thub bstan bstan 'dzin nas mjal bar gsungs kyang rig gsar skabs mi dmigs par gyur pas gsal bar brjod ma nus/ sngon dgon 'dir rje phag mo gru pa'i las zogagazhan khyad yod pa'i snying nor zhes gtsos rten gsum mang / rje skyob pa rin po che gnas 'dir phebs skabs 'bri ru 'phal ma nang / 'byung pos rgyud brlam pa'i mas bu spyang kir bsgyur ba des/ chos rje skyob pa yid la 'phreng bzhin glu 'di ltar len skad/ rje skyob pas skyob zer rdzun du gda'/ spyang a thang nga yi skyo ba la/ zhes smre ngag dang bcas spyang ki de shar rer dbur stod 'bri gung du phyin/ skyob pa rin po che mjal nas ljags mchil btab pas mi gzugs su 'gyur nas rje skyob pas tshung bstan ltar mjal nas grub pa thob pa 178

sogs/ rje skyob pa nags shod du phebs pa'i lo rgyus pha gtam bu la 'jags pa'igatam rgyud khyad mtshar ba dang / dgon 'di'i rten gtso skyob pa'i zhal thang dbu'i g.yas g.yon du chos rje'i phyag rjes dang / khri'i g.yas g.yon du zhabs rjes yod pa/ dar gos lnga rtseg gi zhal khebs can bcas bzhugs pa dang / de skabs chos rje skyob pa mchog ba lag shel dkar 'bum par phebs yod min sna tshogs bshad kyang / rlangs kyi po ti bse ru'i lcags par shog grangs 107yig phreng bcu gnyis las/ byang nam ra dang nags shod rgya mtsho bar pa zhang drung gi sa cha rnams yon bdag tu chod pas/ 'dul bya chen por gyur nas snyan pa'i grags pa phyogs bcur khyab/ smug khyu dang / khra khyu gnyis phyag tu byung ba la/ gdan sar nor phud la smug khyu dang / khra khyu 'di phul/zhes dang / yul phud du smi ti lha yi lung mo che phul/ zhes gsungs pas skyob pa rin po che nags shod du phebs pa dang / nags shod pas nor lug tsam ma zad/ sa cha yang phul bas rje skyob pa nyid gnas 'dir phebs par sems/rlangs kyi po ti bse ru rgyas pa shog grangs 106yig phreng bcu gcig nags shod mkhan chen yar bcad nas/ dpal phag mo gru pa la slebs pa'i bu slob/mdo khams smad na'ang mang / rang re'i 'di pa'i slob rgyud du ma gyur pa cher med ces nags shod pa'i mkhan chen yar bcad phag gru'i zhabs la btugs nas mkhan po'i mtshan gnas thob/ mkhan chen spyan snga 'bar nas lam sna byas te rje skyob pa 'bri gung du gdan drangs/ thel dgon pa'i bla g.yel sogs rim par bzhengs pa'i khur blangs nas mkhan po'i bya ba mdzad/ rje nyid kyi sku yi bkod pa du mar ston pa yang mjal/ de nas bzung dam tshig gtsang zhing thugs nang dag pas 'brel ba zab/ bka' 'bum du ti se sgyu lus nags shod ma sogs phyi rabs la bka' drin che/179

spyi lo 125༷skor/ phag gru khri skor dang / 'bri gung khri skor gnyis chos phyogs la gdan sa gcig par 'dzin kyang / srid phyogs la cung ma mthun bas dmag drangs/ 'bri gung khri skor pham nas gnyer pa tshul rin sogs 'go byed mang po bzung nas bar 'dum byed skabs/ rlangs kyi po ti bse ru lcags par shog grangs 225las/ ta sis 'dun ma byed na nags shod pa'i mi dpon rin chen 'od sgom pa'i snying mi yin pas kho yong dgos gsungs pa ltar phebs pas 'bri gung khri skor bzung dmag rnams slog zhes pas/ nags shod pa'i mi dpon nyid nus pa che shos yin pa dang / bar 'dum bya ba bcas la phebs pas 'dum pa byung bas de skabs 'bri gung khri skor gyi stobs shugs gtso bo zhig ni nags shod pa yin/'bri gung skyu ra'i gdan rabs bcu gnyis pa chos rje bshes gnyen don grub rgyal po ni/ chos rje nyer gnyis pa rin po che'i gcung rdo rje rgyal po'i sras su spyi lo 1269rab byung drug pa'i sa mo bya lo cho 'phrul zla ba'i yar tshes brgyad la mtshan dpe'i bzhad/ brda sprod gtsug lag rig gnas kun la mkhyen rab phul du byung / lha babs skyu ra'i gdung rabs dri ma med pa chad par dog ste/ mtshan ldan rig ma khab tu bzhes pas bdag po wang 'khrungs/mi ring bar pan chen gyi sdom rgyun tshogs pa bzhi'i ya gyal chos lung tshogs pa spyan drangs nas bsnyen par rdzogs/ mtshan don grub rgyal po zhes gsol/dgung grangs nyer bdun pa spyi lo 1292rab byung bdun pa'i chu bya lor gdan sa chen mor chos rje skyob pa'i rgyal tshab tu seng khrir bkod/ bgrang bya bcu dgu'i ring la dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bar med du bskor nas skal ldan gyi slob ma rnams la phyag chen chos drug dang zab chos khag gis tshim par gnang / 'on kyang log smon 'gas rje nyid kyi 'phrin las kyi 'od stong ma 180

bzod nas cung zad 'grib pas/ dgung lo zhe bzhi la bkwan ting zhes pa'i cho lo dang / zhe lnga la khri zur nas spyi lo 1414shing rta dgung lo zhe drug lor yab mes bzang po'i mnga' ris la dbang bsgyur phyir dang / rje nyid kyi 'phrin las dang phyogs 'di'i bsod nams kyis/ nags shod pa'i dgon sde spyis zhabs kyi padmo phyogs 'dir bsgyur bar gsol ba btab pas/ srog chags bye phrag khrig mang po la thugs brtse ba'i slad du dang / sku gsung thugs kyi 'phrin las la brten nas thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i sar 'khrid cing don chen por 'gyur bar gzigs nas/ chos rje'i zhabs kyi padmo dri ma med pa mdo khams shod chen bco brgyad kyi dbu rtse nags shod sman ljongs phyug mo'i mthil/sngon rgyal ba dam pa mang pos zhabs kyi bcags shing / yul la dge bcu tshang zhing / las bzhi'i 'phrin las sgrub pa'i sa bcad phun sum tshogs pa nags shod 'gom ba lag dgon gyi gnas gzhi ru phebs/ 'dir gnas skye rgu yongs la dam pa'i chos char bla na med pa phabs/ nags shod lha sde kun nas bsngags pa du ma dang bcas dad cing gus pa'i lha phyag yang yang 'tshal zhing /zab mo phyag chen chos drug sogs zab chos rnams kyi rtogs pa 'bul zhing /zang zing rdzas mchog kun gyi mchod pa phan tshun 'gran pa dang mtshungs par chos rje'i drung du phul ba'i tshe/ nyi ma nub rir rgas la nye bas na/ nags shod pa'i skye bo kun gyis rang rang gi bsam pa ma rdzogs par grub chen wir ba pa'i rnam 'phrul chos rje don grub rgyal po la zhu ba 'di skad ces phul lo/kye ma/ chos rje don grub rgyal po khyod/grub thob kun gyi rgyal po yin no zhes/gleng bar bden na de ring nyi ma ni/cung zad then nas 'bul ba bzhes par zhu/181

zhes zhus ma thag cung zad thugs 'ur ba'i rnam pas spyan nam mkhar sdang mig du gzigs shing sdig 'dzubs dang bcas pa'i phyag gis nyi ma g.yo 'gul med par mdzad pas/ thams cad so so'i re 'dod ltar bya ba rnams yongs su zin nas/ da ni thun tshod las yol bas thams cad so so'i bya ba rnams gyis shig gsungs bzhin du phyag sor bsdus pas nyi ma yang btsan thabs su bros pa ltar gyur te/ cung tsam nas nam mkha'i rgyal po langs/gnas 'dir 'khod pa'i skye bo thams cad thar ba'i lam sna zin pa sha stag byung / sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pas ri khrod gang zhing / de nas bzung gnas 'dir 'khod pa'i skye bo rnams rim par phyag chen dang chos drug la 'bad nas dngos su 'bri gung bka' brgyud pa'i srol 'dzin rnal ma zhig tu gyur bar mngon/rje nyid lam bar du nags shod lung par rang dgon khag dang lhag par shug lding dgon du phebs/ dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nas dad rten du rje nyid kyi dbu zhwa zhig bstsal bas da lta bzhugs yod/ rje 'di'i sku dus su 'bri gung sgom pa'i khur 'dzin nags shod pa rdzong ji bsod nam rin chen gyis bgyis te/ rang srid mi nyams par skyong zhing / byang khyung po'i ru sde dang /rong po'i sde dag bcom pa dang / rgya ma dang mnyam 'brel gyis sne gdong la dmag brtsam pa'ang byung / stag lung lha khang dmar 'gyed kyi shing cha nags shod ka rong stod nas dbor ba'i bka' gnang / chos rje bshes gnyen don grub rgyal po nyid grub chen wer ba ba'i rnam 'phrul yin pas kong smad lta ba rgyal 'dzin du chu bo gyen du zlog pa dang / ra sa'i sgrol ma lha khang gi sgo ldebs su phyag rjes dang zhabs rjes/ bar skor rdo bcal steng du phyag 'khar gyi shul bcas snang sems gcig tu 'dres pa'i rnam thar bzang po la brten nas/182

bka' gdams pa'i dgon chen gyi ri khrod bsam gtan pa bzhugs gnas khag cung nyams kyang / 'di nas bzung slar yang ri khrod khag la phyag chen chos drug gi srol 'dzin ri ba khag mang po 'phel bas/ da lta sa dmar rgya phug dang / me 'bar sgrub phug ka mchog gtsos pa'i ka rong lung dang / ri phug dgon gyi g.yas g.yon/ gnas shod brag shar gtsos pas dben gnas rnams su zab mo rim gnyis la gzhol ba'i sgrub khang gi rjes shul khag da lta yang mthong chos su gyur pas sgrub brgyud pa'i bstan pa shin tu gsal ba'i mtshon rtags su zhugs/ de dang mnyam du bka' brgyud zung bzhi ya brgyad kyi nang gsal/ karma bka' brgyud/ dwags po bka' brgyud/ stag lung bka' brgyud/ 'brug pa bka' brgyud bcas kyi chos srol 'dzin pa yang rim par byung / spyi lo 1417me bya lor chos rje don grub rgyal po'i sras/ 'bri gung gdan rabs bcu gsum pa bdag po wang ni wang gi las ka byung / chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston smad cha lcags par shog grangs 125rkyayig phreng bco brgyad las/ dbang rin po ches yab las chos mtha' dag gsan te dbang gi las ka byung / sgom pa'i khur mdzad tshe nags sog gi ngo log pas lo rta dpon bsad ru ba mang du ded pa la khri dmag mdzad nas btul/ phyir phebs tshe phyi ltas mdzad pas g.yul sar skye bo mang po'i phung po dang grod pa/dud 'gro'i rtso phung la nyi 'od phog nas sa gzhir 'od kyis gang bar gzigs nas/ bka' blon rgyal bzang la dris pas dud 'gro'i rtso phung dang nag po 'di mgo lag yin par go nas bcos min gyi nges 'byung drag po skyes/ blon rgyal bzang mtshams g.yog mdzad nas de nub tu them pa las ma 'das par lo bcu gcig 'dag sbyar mdzad/spyi lo 1477me bya lor 'bri gung gdan rabs bcu bdun pa skyob pa 183

'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i rnam 'phrul rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen dpal bzang po mchog hor yul du phebs skabs/ khams stod dang khyung po sog pa sogs phebs pas rje nyid kyi rnam thar tshig bcad ma las/ de ga'i mod la nags shod lung pa ru/ spyan 'dren zhus shing 'gro mang smin par mdzad/zang zing longs spyod sprin char 'bab pa'i tshul/ yi ge'i 'du byed bsgyur ba gang gi nus/ de nas slar yang 'bri gung thel du phebs ces pas/ rje nyid nags shod du phebs nas dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo dpag tu med pa bskor/rang re nags shod pa rnams kyis zang zing gi 'bul ba ni/ sprin char 'babs pa ltar phul nas 'bri gung gdan sar chibs bsgyur gnang / nags shod pa'i 'bul ba sogs kyis bkra shis sgo mang rten dang brten pa bcas bzhengs grub/de rjes rim par dgon 'di nyid mtha' khul lcags ri dang grwa shag sogs nyams pa dang / mtha' skor nags tshal rnams med par gyur bas shā 'od kyis dgon gnas rnams grog rong du gyur/ lhag tu 'du khang gi gtso bo rdo rje phag mo'i lha khang thog gi gnas mal de chu log gis khag gnyis su dbye bas da lta chu mgo'i 'gag zhes grong pa'i khang sa dbor yul 'di yin/ dgon gnas stong la nye skabs/ nags shod bla ma shākya rin chen mchog gis khyung ri'i klad du dgon gnas sa dpyad phun sum tshogs pa gzigs te gnas 'dir spos pa yin te/ khong ni nags shod du sku 'khrungs/ chos bzhugs grwa sa 'bri gung thel du phebs nas/ 'bri gung skyu ra'i gdung rabs nyer gnyis pa mtshungs med chos rgyal phun tshogs bkra shis dpal bzang po mchog gi zhabs la btugs nas rab tu byung / 'bri gung bka' brgyud pa'i chos srol yongs rdzogs gsan nas mkhas grub kyi go 'phang mtho por phebs/ dgun chos su chos drug gi ras phud mdzad pas grub pa'i rang rtags ngoms/ skyabs mgon 184

rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa'i chos drug gi dmigs khrid dang 'khrul 'khor gyi zurakhrid dge rgan mdzad/ 〈'bri gung chos mdzod chen mo/〉 dpe gzugs sgrub grwa'i rtogs brjod nor bu'i ljon shing shog grangs dgu pa'i yig phreng gnyis pa las/ rtogs ldan blo gsal/ rtogs ldan shākya rin chen/ nyi khri byang btang zhes pa la sogs pa/ rje chos kyi grags pa'i sku tshe'i sgang tsam gyi bar du grub pa'i skyes bu kho na byon par grags kyang de dag gi lo rgyus rnam thar nges pa can ma rnyed/ ces pas nags shod pas rong 'do khri chen zhu bas/'bri gung sgrub grwa'i slob dpon khri thog bdun pa rtogs ldan shākya rin chen 'di nyid yin par nges/ rnam thar rgyas pa grub dbang nges don rgya mtshos kyang ma mjal/ gang ltar chos kyi grags pa'i skabs su 'bri gung du sgrub brgyud bstan pa ma nyams pa'i skabs su/ zur khrid dge rgan byed pa sogs gong gis rje nyid yin par sems/ rje nyid ni 'bri gung bka' brgyud pa'i chos kyis mdzod 'dzin dang / nags shod lung 'dir bka' brgyud spyi dang bye brag tu dpal 'bri gung bka' brgyud pa'i srol 'dzin bla na med pa zhig yin/ skyabs mgon chos kyi grags pas gdan rabs shis brjod las 'khor lo gnyis kyis phyug pa bla ma shākya rin chen zhes bsngags pa che/ 'gom ba lag dgon de nyid gnas yul spo ba'i thugs bzhes mdzad/'bri gung skyu ra'i gdung rabs nyer gsum 7skyabs mgon rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa mchog ni yab chos rgyal phun tshogs dang / yum g.yang khug mganyis kyi sras su spyi lo 1595rab byung bcu pa'i shing lug lo'i rgyal zla'i dmar phyogs la sra brtan rdo rje'i spor du sku 'khrungs/ sngon sbyangs bag chags sad pa'i mthu las spobs pa'i gter brgyad grol bas rig gnas kun la chags thog med par mkhyen pa dang / nges pa don gyi mkhas grub gnyis ldan 185

gyi ma hā paṇḍi ta chen por gyur/ rje nyid dgung lo bco brgyad bzhes pa rab byung bcu pa'i chu byi lo spyi lo 1612lor yang ri sgar pa'i bla ma mdzad nas byang gnam mtsho de nas rngod dang ri bo che bcas su phebs skabs/ chos grags rang rnam gsong po'i dga' ston glog par shog grangs 74rgyab shog yig phreng 4par/ de yang nged yang ri'i bla ma byas nas phyin dus bla ma shākya rin chen pa ri bo che bar bdag gi zlar byon/ nags shod ba lag dgon da lta'i dgon gsar gyi mal bkag po sgang zer ba zhig yod par spos na rung ngam mi rung gsungs par/ shin tu legs par 'ong / gnas de'i ming bkag po sgang zer ba mi legs pas chos 'khor byams pa gling thogs zer ba byas pa de yin/zhes pas skyabs mgon mchog nas ma 'ongs par gnas 'dir bka' brgyud pa'i bstan pa dri ma med pa dar ba'i rten 'brel dang bcas dgon ming yang bstsal/ rong 'do bla ma shākya rin chen mchog khams ri bo che nas yar khams stod nags shod du phebs/ spyi lo 1612rab byung bcu pa'i chu glang lor dngos su nags shod 'gom ba lag dgon de da lta'i khyung ri'i klad du spo ba'i 'go tshugs/ nags shod stod u thang phyug mo na char rgyud tshang zhes rang re lung pa'i rtsis rig la mkhas pa'i khyim rgyud ni lo ngo stong phrag lhag song bas/sangs rgyas bstan rtsis chen po zhes pod chen gyi nang du/ 'gom dgon bkag po sgang du spos nas lo zhes sogs 'khod yod 'dug pas/ bod khams spyi dang nags shod kyi lo rgyus rgyas par yod kyang mthar rig gsar zhes dgos med bya mang gi skabs su med par gyur bas shin du phangs/ dgon gnas 'di nyid du 'du khang chung chung gsum yod pa gnyis grwa shagaci gi nang dang / gcig 'du khang gi mal 'dir yin par shod srol mchis/ de dang mnyam du sa dmar ri klung dgon zhes pa dgon shul dang mchod rten shul/ sgrub grwa'i shul bcas da 186

lta shul bsdad yod/ dgon stod dgon ni sa dmar grong gi thog der gnas pas da lta 'du khang gi shul dang dur khrod grwa shag dang mkhan po'i bzhugs sa dang bcas kyi shul bsdad yod/ sngon gyi skyi ru stag lung dgon 'du khang gtso bo de nyid ldebs bris dang bcas bsdad yod pas gnas shul de 'dra bsrung skyobs bya dgos pa'i rig dngos shig yin/ de min dgon chung nyams pa 'ga' dang bcas zla sgril btang / de rnams kyi rtsig rmang shul yang da lta yod/ba lag dgon gnas spos shul du ri phug a ne dgon zhes a ne dgon pa zhig chags par gsungs/ bla ma shākya rin chen mchog gis khur blangs pa dang 'gom sde yongs nas rgyab skyor 'og 'du khang ka ba so drug sbug g.yas g.yon thog brtsegs gsum gsum la ka ba bzhi bzhi dang bcas/ gsol thab khang nas 'og bar bzhi thog ka ba bzhi bzhi dang / rten dang brten pa rim par bcas pa grub/ gnas mchog 'di nyid sa dpyad phun sum tshogs te/ gnam la 'khor lo rtsebs brgyad/ sa la padma 'dab brgyad/ logs la bkra shis rtags brgyad dang / 'og tu 'byung bzhi rim brtsegs/ de steng gling bzhi gling phran/ rtse ru rnam rgyal pho brang lta bu dang / shar nas bltas na glang chen gyi mchu steng du chags 'dra/ lho nas bltas na dung dkar mo'i rang sgra sgrog 'dra/nub nas bltas na bya khyung chen gyi klad du chags 'dra/ byang nas bltas na nor bdag gi ne'u le'i kha nas nor bu skyug 'dra/ sa la dge bcu tshang zhing /phyogs bzhi'i ri la rgyal ba rigs lnga'i rnam pa/ dus bzhir mi 'gyur rtsi shing lo tog rgyas/ lhag par mdo sngags kyi sgrub gnas sa dpyad thams cad yongs su tshang ste/ rje skyob pa rin po ches/ ri chos 'di bka' brgyud gong ma rnams kyi gces par 'dzin pa yin la/ gnad zab mo nye tshe la myang ba'i gsang gdams rnams/ dper na ba las 'o ma 'byung / 'o ma las zho 'byung / zho 187

las mar 'byung ba bzhin du/ rgyud sde 'o ma'i rgya mtsho las/ zab chos mar gyi snying po gser zhun ma lta bu bcud du dril nas gnad du bsdus pa yin pas gzhan dang bag mi mthun no/ dper na/ lus la chang 'thung na sems la ra ro nas 'gro ba ltar/ da lta rab bsgom da lta nyid du 'bras bu 'byung ba ste/rten 'brel lus la sgrig na rtogs pa sems la 'char zhes dang / tshe 'di sangs rgya ba la ri chos 'di yin zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rjes 'jug gsar bu rnams bzhugs spro zhing spro ba ster phyir cung zad brjod na/ chag med ri chos las/ sa yi ka ba bzhi dang / sa yi srung bzhi/ sgrub gnas zhi rgyas dbang drag bcas yongs su tshang te/ rgyab ri mtho zhing mdun ri gus/ g.yas g.yon chus mdun du 'dus/ mdun du chu shing na ba rgyas zhes dang / srung bzhi ni shar phye lho spungs nub gdan pa/ byang nas yol ba bres 'dra bzang / shar lam lho lam grog dang g.yang / srung bzhi ni/ shar gyi lam ni stag skya bo/ lho chu g.yu 'brug sngon mo ste/ nub gyi sa dmar brag dmar ni/ nub srung bya ni dmar po ste/ byang gi rdza shur wa wong brag byang srung rus sbal rgya bo ste/ zhes dang /las bzhi ni/ sa mdog dkar zhing sur dkar skyes/ nam mkha' 'dum zhing sa gzhi 'jam/ de ru zhi ba'i las rnams 'grub/ nags tshal me tog gling chen rgyas/ ri brag rdza rnams nor bu'i dbyibs/ de ru rgyas pa'i las rnams 'grub/ brag mdog sa mdog dmar shas che/ shug pa 'om bu se ba skyes/phug pa thang chung zla gam dbyibs/ nub kyi phyogs nas chu chen 'bab/ de ru dbang gi las rnams 'grub/ lung gsum mdo dang chu gsum 'dus/ sa gzhi gru gsum tsher ma skyes/ brag nag brag dmar khros pa'i gzugs/ de ru drag po'i las rnams 'grub/ ces pas de ltar zhi rgyas dbang drag gi sa dpyad thams cad yongs su tshang ba ngo sprod ma dgos par mjal ba tsam gyis shes par 188

nus/ chos rje skyob pa rin po che'i ri chos phyi nang gsang gsum las/ rje rin po ches rang gi myang bas grub pa ni/ dben pa'i gnas la yon tan khyad par gsum dang ldan te/ yid kyi rjes su mthun pa/ bkra shis pa/ 'du 'dzis dben pa'o zhes dang / mi rgod sho gam rgyu srang med/ tshangs par spyod pa'i grogs dang ldan/ brag ri pad ma spungs pa'am padma 'dra na bkra shis/ brag ri skyo shas che na thabs lam gtum mo/ sgyu lus spyod pa la bogs che/ spangs ri dang nags khrod la gnas pa che/ sgom gsar pa la dga' bar 'dug g.ya' ri dang / gangs ri la rig pa dwangs/ gsal shes che/ rten 'brel sgom pa dang / 'od gsal sbyong ba la khyad par bogs che zhes zab mo phyag chen drug gi gnas khyad par ba dang / lhag du rje skyob pas sngags kyi dgongs don ltar dbang phyug gi rten dang / dus mtshan ma'i rten gnyis ka yod na gnas chen du 'gro gsungs pas/ chu gsum 'dus pa'i mdor brag phur dang / byang shar du dus mtshan ma'i bha ga rang byon dang de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'bab pas yi dam 'khor lo bde mchog dang bden gnyis ma sgrub pa'i sa bcad gzhung dang mthun zhing gnas chen phun sum tshogs pa yin/ rje skyob pa'i ri chos nang dang gsang ba ni gzhung rang la gzigs na shes sla/ de ltar sa dpyad rags pa tsam zhig las rgyas pa ni bri bar mi long pas de tsam mo/'gom dgon chos 'khor byams pa gling gi bskor tshad phan yon ni/ rta rong ha'i steng gi rdo brkos las/ chos 'khor byams gling sku gsung thugs rten mthong grol sde bcas bskor tshad rgyas pa ni bzhi stong lnga brgya/ 'bring po sum stong dang lnga brgya/ bsdus pa nyis stong lnga brgya bcas 'bad pa don ldan rang gzhan byang chen gyi go 'phang bla med myur thob shog ces pas kun gyis 'bad par rig go/189

skyabs mgon chos kyi grags pa mdo khams nas gdan sar phebs nas slarayang zla dgon du phebs chad yong tshul gyis dgongs pa zhus te rdzong nas btegs/ rngod stod smad/ ye spom dgon/ rnam rgyal dgon sogs phebs nas shar kong la rgyud zla dgon du phebs nas thugs bskyed chen mo sogs chos kyi bdud rtsis tshims par mdzad/ spyi lo 1619bod rab byung bcu pa'i sa lug lor khams stod nags shod pa'i gdan zhu ltar gnyan sde mi sde che dgu kun gyis bsu ba'i bkod pa rgya chen po dang bcas phebs 'byor byung nas rang dgon du sgar phab/ nags shod stod smad bar gsum nas 'dus pa gzhis byes mang bas 'du khang du ma shong bar/ dgon gyi gling dkyil du rdor phreng rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor nyer brgyad rdzogs pa'i dbang chen bstsal/ 'du khang du 'dus tshogs la dpal kun rig rnam par snang mdzad dang / khyad par du bka' brgyud spyi dang / mgon po 'bri gung bka' brgyud pa'i chos srol bla na med pa rnams kyi dbang khrid lung gsum cha tshang gnang / de nas nags stod me mo rag khrom du gnas gzigs su phebs nas/ lha dang bla ma'i zhal mjal/yi dam chos skyong gis lung bstan/ skye ba snga phyi'i dran snang dang / phyag zhabs rjes sogs kyang bzhag lha sku sogs 'bum phrag gzigs kyang gnas kyi bka' rgya cung ma grol bar lhug par smra ba snga bas ma bris/ shag zam chen phar kha'i steng du sgrub phug dang sgrub khang gi shul bcas yod pa dang / rgya tsha'i mtshams khang du phebs par yang smra/ gnas dang khad nye bar khor tsha smad tha'i rgyal po dpon lu'i ru bar gdan drangs nas zhag shas ngal gso dang sbrags bzhugs/ gang 'dod chos kyi 'brel ba gnang / de nas nags shod 'gom dgon gsar dgon chos 'khor byams pa gling du chibs bsgyur gnang /'gom dang 'bri ru'i sde khag dbar 'gal ba byung bas rje nyid dar yug thang du 190

phebs nas/ 'bri 'gom gnyis kyi gnyen sde dang 'go ba rnams bsdus nas dam pa'i chos dang zang zing rdzas kyis tshim par byas nas 'khrug pa 'dum/zab mo chos kyi bdud rtsis ngoms par byas/ de nas ka rong rgyud zla dgon du phebs nas sman sgrub dang / dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bar med du bskor nas rim bzhin 'bri gung gi gdan sar phebs/ rje nyid kyi gsung chos skyabs rje mchog rang dgon du bzhugs pa'i rnam thar pod gcig yod pa de'i nang du gnas 'dir bzhugs pa'i skor zhib phra yod ces sngon gyi rgan rabs rnams dang / lhag tu 'bri gung grub dbang dpa' chung rin po ches gsungs zhes skyabs rje ri dbang rin po ches gsungs/ de min yul skyong nags lha zhi rgyas dbang drag gi bstod pa dang bsang gsol/ rje nyid kyi mdzad pa chos srung rnams kyi bsang gsol bsdus pa dang / 'gom chos mdzad tshul khrims rin chen gyis bskul ngor sa gsum ma zhes sku phreng dus gsum dang bcas pas zhe bzhi pa 'di rtse gzim chung tu mdzad/ rong 'do bla ma shākya rin chen nas bskul bas gdan rabs shis brjod dang / rje chos kyi grags pas mdzad pa dpal kun rigs rnam par snang mdzad kyi cho ga mdzad nas rang dgon du bka' dbang yang bstsal/ rig gsar skabs mthor gyar song ba dang / de min phan tshun dpe bshu byed pa sogs gang ltar mjug byang ma mchis pas the tshom za ba byung yang yin par nges/ sngar mi'i kha rgyun du chos kyi grags pa'i mdzad pa'i kun rig yin zhes smra/ lhag par 'bri gung grub dbang rin po che bstan 'dzin nyi ma nas/ chos grags kyis kun rig rgyas bsdus gnyis mdzad pas khyed tsho'i dgon pa'i kun rig de bsdus pa de yin par 'dug gsungs/rje nyid kyis rang rnam du nags shod dgon gsar du gnyan sde nas lan gnyis gdan 'dren zhus kyang phyi ma lan gcig phebs nas cung bzhugs pa las mi 191

gsal kyang / rang dgon pa'i bla ma rgan gras rnams kyi zhal rgyun du gsung srol la/ rje rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa mchog rang dgon du phebs nas gdan sa'i khri 'dzin dang po yin zhing / 'bri gung bka' brgyud pa'i chos srol phyag chen chos drug gi khrid rim dang / 'don chos cho ga'i rigs rnams kyi 'don rta dbyangs dang thig rdul tshon sogs yang ri sgar dang mtshungs par btsugs pa dang / dbu khri pa'i lag deb dpe ko leb bya ba brtsams nas phyis su dar ba'i cho ga khag de la bstun nas 'don sgrig gi srol byung / lhag tu 'jam dpal gshin rje'i sgrub pa bzhugs nas/ gshin rje zhal gzigs pas dgon pa'i sa rdo ri brag kun kyang a ra pa tsa'i yig 'brus gang zhing da lta yang dngos su mthong chos su gyur/ lhag tu rje nyid kyi gzim chung gsang sngags theg mchog nyi 'od rtse la mun mtshams sgrub khang / de'i cha lag ja rgyug dril brda dang / gnam sgo sogs cha tshang / 'gon khang du gtor bsngos gsungs bar phebs par sgo 'brel dang / gzim chung du na gza' nyer spyod gzim chas bcas yod pa dang / gdan rabs gsol 'debs las gnas gsang sngags theg mchog rdo rje'i spor/ rig 'dzin chos kyi grags par gsol ba 'debs ces gsungs/ da lta yang chos kyi grags pa'i sku stod dang / dom ra/ zhal chas bcas bzhugs yod/ skyabs rje nyid gnas 'dir bzhugs pas dad ldan rnams la bag chags che bas mi rabs re la sprul pa res gdan sa skyong bar gsungs/ de'i skabs su rang dgon 'di nyid mnga' thang rgyas pas rgyal ba 'bri gung bka' brgyud pa'i rtsa ba'i gdan sa drug gi nang gsal zhig yin/dpe rnying gi gras gshin rje'i skor dang khro rol skor khag gcig rig gsar gong du ko btum byed pa 'ga' chos grags skabs su dgon par bstsal ba'i dpe cha'i gras su yin zhes dngos su mthong / lhag par gong sa lnga pa dang thugs 192

'dris che bas rang dgon du rtse gzims chung la rgya phebs/ 'og tu rta lam bkod chog pa'i gnang ba dang she bam bcas bstsal kyang / don thog ma song bas rgya phibs shing cha yang glang sna bzos yod pa red/ sngon dus su dpe rnying dang rtsa che'i rig dngos rnams dam sbyar zhus nas mjal bar dka' bas rig gsar skabs rtsa 'thor du song / snyan brgyud kyi lo rgyus 'di ni mi lo sum brgya brgyad cu tsam las ma song bas bden pa yin pa'ang nges/ rjes su dpyad gzhi'i yig cha sogs byung na blo gros dang ldan pa rnams kyis thugs la 'dzin pa las/ bdag lta bus kha tshon gcod par ma spobs/ skyabs rje rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa mchog zhal bzhugs kyi skabs su/ thel sgar gnyis su sgrub pa dang sgrub chen/ bshad sgrub las gsum gang yod rnams dgon 'dir dar zhing rgyas pa dang / gra rgyun mang po zhig thel sgar gnyis su bzhugs yod pas gsal/de'i skabs su 'gom phun tshogs ni/ nags shod du sku 'khrungs nas 'bri gung du phebs/ rje chos kyi grags pa'i gsol dpon dang / rig gnas la 'jug skabs sbyangs ba'i grogs mchog yin pas mkhas grub gnyis ldan du gyur/ 'bri gung gdan rabs nyer bzhi pa rje btsun dkon mchog rin chen mchog rig pa'i gnas la mkhas shing / lhag tu bka' brgyud pa'i zab chos yongs kyi mnga' bdag tu gyur/ dgung lo so bdun me stag lor gcung chos kyi grags pa gdan sa'i khrir bkod nas/ spyi lo 162rkyarab byung bcu gcig pa lcags rta lo'i g.yas g.yon du 'gom sde dgon spyi nas gdan drangs pas/thog mar hor sde'i khrod dang / rngod gtsang dang / zla dgon bcas rang lugs kyi dgon pa khag la dge 'dun brgya phrag lnga lhag tsam la rgyud sde rgya 193

mtsho'i dkyil 'khor zhal phye nas 'phrin las dbang gis smin par mdzad/ de nas nang chen du phebs nas rta rna rgyud nags shod du phebs te/ 'gom dgon chos 'khor byams pa gling gi 'dus spyi la mar lugs rngog gi dkyil 'khor bdun gyi bka' dbang dang / lnga ldan dang zab lam nā ro'i chos drug sogs rgyal ba bka' brgyud pa'i zab chos yongs kyis dad ldan kun gyi yid tshims par gnang / rje nyid nas rten gtso skyob pa'i dar sku bzhengs ba de dang rtsa ba'i cha nas rang dgon du bzhengs grub pa'i rten rnams dang lhan gcig rab gnas phyogasdu gcig tu mdzad/ 'gom sde dgon nas 'bul tshan gnod sbyin bu la yang skyeng ba ster ba yang byung / de nas chos rje'i zhabs kyi padmo gdan sa'i phyogs su bsgyur/ gser phreng nang du 'bis 'gom 'khrug pa bsdoms zhes gsungs kyang / chos kyi grags pa dang 'dzol bar nges te/ rang rnam srong po'i dga' ston du yod pa las rje 'di dus min par shes dgos/'bri gung gdan rabs nyer drug pa skyabs mgon 'phrin las bzang po mchog spyi lo 1656me sprel lor sku 'khrungs/ rje nyid 'gom dgon du phebs pa'i lo rgyus gsal bar ma mjal/ rje nyid kyi gsung 'bum pod bzhi'i nang rnam thar gnyis tsam yod par gsungs kyang / da lta pod gnyis las ma bzhugs pa dang / lhag tu rnam thar khag gnyis mjal ba'i go skabs skal ba ma byung bas gsal bar brjod ma nus kyang / rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i gsung 'bum las rang dgon du phebs pa gsal ba yin te/ rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i nags lha'i bstod pa nyung ngu las/ 'bri gung pa dkon mchog 'phrin las bzang pos skabs su babs pa'i legs spel du sug bris byas ces dang / lha chen nags lha dgyes pa'i rnam pa la legs spel du skabs su babs pa yin pa dang / rang dgon pa'i yul lha dmar btsan dang / nyag gdong / bla brag194

sman khang zil mo bcas kyi bsang gsol mdzad pa dang / chos mdzod chen mo las sman sgang gi gsol mchod mjug byang du/ yul lha sman gyi gsol mchod 'di/ dgon gsar chos 'khor byams gling gi/ spyi bla rin chen tshul khrims kyis/ ji ltar bskul bzhin 'bri gung pa'i/ dkon mchog 'phrin las bzang po yis ces pa sman khang gi sa dpyad rnams ji ma ji bzhin gsal bar gsungs pa dang / nyag gdong gsol mchod mjug byang las chos 'khor byams pa gling gi bya 'dabs su bris pa dge bar gyur cig ces pas skyabs mgon 'phrin las bzang po dgung lo sum bcu so gcig yan mad du rang dgon du phyag phebs pas de ni spyi lo 16ra6me stag lor yin zhing / rang dgon nas skyabs mgon mchog gi 'dra sku bzhengs nas slar yang gdan 'dren zhus kyang phebs ma grub/ khong gis khyed tsho'i sku de nga 'dra po yod pe gsungs nas bzhad pas/'dir sku de yang bzhad/ bod zla gsum pa'i tshes gsum la rab gnas gnang bar gsungs nas/ dus der steng shod bar gsum du rab gnas 'thor/'ja' 'od la sogs mtshan ltas bzang / rje 'di'i sku ring la rang dgon du gsar ma'i gar 'cham rnams rim par dar/ de skabs su dgon bla rin chen phun tshogs mchog bzhugs/spyi lo 1715rab byung bcu gnyis pa shing lug lor lho sprul dkon mchog chos kyi rgya mtsho mchog 'gom dgon du phebs nas 'dus pa rnams la bka' brgyud pa'i pha chos phyag chen chos drug gtsos pa'i chos kyi char chen 'bebs skabs/ nyi sprul sku phreng gnyis pa padma theg mchog bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan nam rig 'dzin bstan skyong rgya mtsho mchog gi gtsug phud bzhes nas mtshan dkon mchog blo bzang dpal 'bar du gsol/ grib dang mi gtsang ba la 'dzems pa'i lung bstan dbugs dbyung mdzad/ bla brang du tshe dbang dang 195

bka' dbang kha shas gnang / spyir chags ri dang 'gom dgon gnyis sngon nas 'brel ba bzang /de skabs su mdo chen dpa' bo bcu gsum gyi ya gyal/ sprin dpa' bo zhes mthu stobs nus pa'i mnga' bdag myur mgyogs glog gi zhabs dang mtshungs pa/ sa brgyad byang sems chen po/ snang mtha'i sgyu 'phrul rdo rje dgra bcom gyi skur brten pa/ sprin dpa' bo sku thog dang po dpa' bo spu ris zhes pa de nyid spyi lo 1644rab byung bcu gcig shing sprel lor/ yab sprin rdo rje dang / yum klu mo mtsho gnyis kyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ chung byis pa'i dus nas mgo la spu ldem re zung las ma skyes pas dpa' bo spu ris zhes mtshan thogs/byis pa gzhan dang mi 'dra bar spyod pa bzang / spyan snga mngon shes lnga dang ldan pas lha 'dre'i gzugs dang / lha dang bla ma'i lung bstan pa yang mang po thob/ dpa' bo mchog nags shod stod smad bar gsum du phebs skabs glang bu tshe skyabs zhes pa la chibs nas phebs/ dgung lo nyer lnga sa sprel lor tre ri rong bskor chen mor phebs nas/ sprel zla'i tshes bcu la dag pa shel ri'i dbu rtser gser zhu phog pa dang mnyam du pho brang g.yu mtsho nas tsa ri'i thod pa smug chung gter nas spyan drangs nas mar phebs skabs/ khams nyi ma grags pa dang mjal bas/ dpa' bos bla ma lags khyed gang du phebs zhus pas/ nga tsa ri'i thod pa smug chung gter nas spyan 'dren du 'gro gsungs pas/ de ngas zhogs pa snga mor gdan drangs tshar zhus pas/ nyi grags rin po ches/ gter 'don rtsal khyod la yod kyang / 'chus pa'i skal ba khyod la med gsungs nas/rten tshab du phyag gis rdo zhig bcangs bas dzam lha rang byung dang / me tog padma'i ri mo yod pa zhig byung ba dag gnang / sprin smyon gyis thod pa khams nyi grags la phul bas 'chi med tshe chang gis bkang nas rjes su chags ri phug nag 196

tu bzhugs/ dpa' bo mchog 'gom yul rong du phebs pas kha cig gis dpa' bo 'khrungs sa yin pa'ang bshad pas dpa' bo'i khar shul da lta sa dmar mar grong gi mchod rten thog der yod/ dpa' bo der bzhugs skabs/ka nag 'dud mdo bdud mo zis ru dmar mig 'dug pas/ dpa' bo gis gre sang res mdzad pas kyang 'dre de zhum zhum re byed/ de rjes dpa' bos 'dul bar grags la/ sa dmar chu lam steng du zhabs rjes bzhag skyi ru gong ma'i lha khang gi zur du sprin smyon gyis glang tshe skyabs btags pas rdo phur nyag can dang / bla brag tu dpa' bo'i la se'i rjes dang / snga dror dpa' bo'i zhabs rjes bzhag phyi dror 'dre mos khyi rjes bzhag ces lung gsum 'dre mo'i khyi rjes bzhag shul der dpa' bos mgo mjug bsgyur te bzhag pas/ rdzong sna'i 'dre mo 'dul bar phebs pas de nas phyi dro slebs pa dang 'grul pa 'gro mi phod par/ 'dre de dpa' bo'i bu mo nyag rong la yod pa de la sprul ba thug nas rta 'phang du bzhon nas phyi ltas slog pas rdzigs nyams ston nas med par gyur/sprin dpa' bo glang la chibs nas rdzong sna ru slebs skabs/ sbra nag phub pa'i dud tshang lta bu zhig dang 'phrad pas gnas tshang g.yar bar gsungs nas bsdad/ dpa' bos gzim mal du khro ril zho yi gang ba zhig bcug nas dpa' bo mchog mda' gzhu khyer nas brag gseng du bsdad/ srod 'khor tsam na 'dre mo de nyid zangs kyi mchu 'dom bco brgyad dang bcas slebs pas khro ril la mchu brgyab pas/ a mi mgo de yi mkhregs pa dang / mi klad de yi skyur ba la zer ba'i skabs der phyag mda' bgreng bas 'dre mo de nyid du 'dul/ phung po dong du sbas nas mchod rten nag po mgo 'jug ldog nas bzhag de'i mal sa phung steng du shug pa dang skyer pa thon min la rtags pa yod par gsungs/'di ni sog gi 'dre mo rta 'tsher bya ba yin par bshad/197
