spyi lo 1717me bya lor sog po jun gar gyi dmag gis bod la btsan 'dzul byas nas rnying dgon dang bon dgon rnams gtor skabs/ sog po'i dmag sgar nyang gzhung du brgyab nas nags shod stod smad bar gsum nang nas 'gom dgon gsar du 'gro grabs yod skabs/ glo bur du dmag sgar gyi mthar sprang rgan lus la ra tshags/ zhabs la ko lham gyon zhing / glang rgan la chibs pa zhig byung / sog dmag gis ya sprang rgan sa cha gang nas yong /'gom dgon chos 'khor byams gling der/ sa thag nye ring ga tshod yod/ sprang pos ma gsang rgyas par shod zer bas/ sprin smyon dpa' bos/ ha ha/ mi snyob gnam snyob mkhal ma'i gsang thag chad zer ba'i dpe ltar/ 'gom dgon chos 'khor byams gling de/ rta lam rtsis na bco brgyad yod/ mdzo lam rtsis na nyi shu yod/ rta sha rgyags yin na de 'dra yin/ mdzo phyug yag yin na de 'dra yin/ sde btsan thog la dpon btsan yod/ dmag bu rta lcags kyi ser ba red/ lha chos bsrung gnam lcags thog mda' red/ khyed log smon can de don mi 'grub/ nga nags shod 'gom sde'i gral mtha' ba/ rgyu med sprang po kher 'khyam yin/ dpa' rtsal drug rtsal dang grub rtags dang / mtshul kha dog sogs nga las zhan pa med/ khyod dang nga gnyis rtsal zhig 'gran/ gsungs pas/ sog dpon nas ya dang po ngas khyod tshar gcod dgos zer nas/ rgyug ting rdzong dkar mtshams la byas/ rgyug 'go kang la'i la rtsar byas nas rta dang glang gnyis bang 'gran pas/ sog pos pho rkyang brag gcig sa mtshams nas phyi bltas bya ltar sngon la song / sog dpon the tshom gyi dra bar tshud nas rgyugs/ kong lar slebs pas dpa' bos/ ya sog gi dpon po rta khra can/rtsal 'gran na do ya e 'dug lags/ sha zos pa'i rus pa 'di na yod/ ja bskol ba'i ja ro 'di na yod/ nga mi rgan grod pa 'grangs nas song / glang 198

rgan rtsa yis 'grangs nas song / da nga rang mar la log rtsis yod/ zer nas bya rgod po nam 'phang gcod pa ltar mtho nam mkha'i bya lam gong ma nas phebs/sog dmag gis 'gom la 'gran mi phod/ sprang rgan de la de 'dra na/ bu dpa' bo thug na ci 'dra zer nas ma yong / de nas sog pos khyung rgyal nang chen grags pas bzhengs pa'i 'bum rje'i shel mkhar smug chung ngam shag rdzong dkar zhes pa la dmag gis rgol bas/ rang phyogs nas phi gu rgod dkar gtsos pas phar rgol drag po byas kyang ma thub par/ rdzong dkar gtor nas khyung se bo zhes pa bon la grub pa thob pa de nyid sog dmag gis shag sbang ngu zam nas gson por chu la g.yugs pas/ kun slong ngan pas shi 'dre mthu rtsal can du gyur/ kho nyin mtshan med par sna lo kham yu la rdza ma mang po bkal nas 'gro zhing / mi rnams srog gcod pas 'dre kham yu zhes 'bod/ de'i skabs 'brong ngur chos rje sku phreng bcu pa dkon mchog bstan 'dzin bzang po dang /rang grol sku phreng dgu pa bla ma chos dkon mchog chos grags/ dzam dmar sku phreng dang po bsod nams rgya mtsho bcas kyi sku dus su yin 'dra/ chos rje dang dzam dmar gnyis nas 'dre de 'dul ba sprin spyon la babs/ nga gnyis kyis rogs bya'o gsungs/ dpa' bos de ltar byed zer nas glang tshe skyabs la bzhon nas rdzu 'phrul gyis glog 'khyug pa ltar bsag thang du phebs/ 'dre des dpa' bo mthong ma thag sprang rgan 'di la ya lan mi thogs snyam nas bros/dpa' bos drag sngags kyi hūṃ sgra dang / glang rgan gyi rmig sgra/ 'brug stong gi sgra ltar ldir bzhin mthu rtsal chen pos ded pas/ shag wa thang 'dre 'gag tu sbra phyed der lhungs nas bros pa dang / bla ma gnyis kyis bkag ma thub par shor ba dang ri 'gul nas yul lha gzhi bdag rnams dgod shor bas/ phyis su cig leb ces ming chags/ 'dre de shag sbang ngu zam kha'i phar kha 'dre bo ngo skya khug199

'dre yi gnas khang pha bong zhig yod pa de la gab nas mi snang bar gyur pas/'dre bo ngo skya zhes thogs/ sprin smyon rdzu 'phrul gyis brag rdo dmar gtor gyi dbyibs can de 'phangs bas/ pha bong de khag gnyis su gyur/ 'dre phos nga ma bsad dpa' bo rin po che/ srog snying 'bul la dam bca' zhu zer/ wa thang go thal spangs la ma 'gyur bar/ sbang ngu zam so gnya' sga ma sprad bar/gnyags pha bong dkar nag phan tshun ma thug bar/ 'gro ba sems can la gnod mi byed par dam la btags/ da lta pha bong dang gtor ma bcas mjal du yod/ de ltar dpa' bo chen po de nyid kyi rtogs brjod mtshon tsam las/sngon rten gtso lnga dang rten rabs sum cu re la gong dang mtshungs pa'i rtogs brjod re yod kyang khungs 'pher de tsam bshad srol nyams pas ma bris/ rten gtso lnga ni bla ma'i gtor ma/ ma hwa gser sbal/ dngul sbal/ rus sbal/ rdo yi phyag rdor bcas yin/ da lta bzhugs pa dpa' bo'i ring bsrel/ dbu klad/rigs lnga/ rten sgam/ bla ma gtor ma/ sil snyan/ glang tshe skyabs kyi rwa co'i nang du g.yu yi nya mo kha sprod bcas sprin byams pa'i khyim du bzhugs yod/dpa' bo sku phreng rim byon ni dang po gong du zhus grub pa dang / gnyis pa dpa' chung g.yang 'dzin/ gsum pa dpa' bo a sdong / bzhi pa dpa' bo g.yang 'bum/ lnga pa dpa' bo byams pa bcas yin/'bri gung gdan rabs nyer bdun pa skyabs rje don grub chos kyi rgyal po khri gsol mdzad sgo la 'gom dgon nas gnyan sde bcas kyi 'bul tshan rten 'brel zab rgyas zhus/ sa bya lo hor zla drug pa'i tshes nyer dgu la 'gom dgon nas 'dus pa sum bcu'i skor 'bul skyes dang bcas mjal phyag la 'byor bas/ tshes lnga la zhabs brtan shis brjod 'bul rgyas zhus/ rtsa gsum gtor dbang / 'chi med dpal ster/ 'chi bdag zil gnon/ 'phags pa 200

'jig rten dbang phyug gi rjes gnang sogs 'dod chos bstsal/ nags shod 'gom bla che rgyud sku skye dang gnyan sde bcas 'byor bas 'bul zhabs bzang /rje yab sras zung 'gom dgon du phebs par zhu nan phul kyang / rje nyid phebs mi grub tshul dang / sku tshab tu mchog sprul bstan 'dzin 'gro 'dul phebs par zhal bzhes mdzad/ rje 'di'i skabs su 'gom bla rog 'do mkhas btsun/ che rgyud tshang / bla ma nor bu sku skye/ brgyad ra sku skye dkon mchog chos kyi dbang phyug sogs 'bri gung bu chen rnams res mos kyis gdan sa bskyangs/shing glang lor dgon gsar grwa a rgod chos dar gyis mchod khang rdo gdan du dkar me'i rdong rkong la mar khal lnga bcu'i rgyu nor phul/ chos rje don grub rgyal po gnas 'angir sku dngos ma phebs kyang / dge tshul slong la sdom pa dang zab chos khag gi dbang lung bcas bka' drin che/ rje nyid dgung grangs lnga bcu nga gcig sa zla'i tshes bcu dgu la dgongs pa chos kyi dbyings su thims pa'i tshul bstan/ de skabs 'gom bla brgyad ra dkon mchog chos kyi dbang po mchog bzhugs skabs yin zhing / 'gom sde dgon nas dgongs rdzogs mchod 'bul zab rgyas dang gdung rten yang bzhengs/'bri gung gdan rabs nyer brgyad pa snying rje'i rang gzugs phyag na pad mo dkon mchog bstan 'dzin 'gro 'dul ni spyi lo 1724rab byung bcu gnyis shing 'brug lo tha skar zla ba'i tshes dgu la mtshan dpe'i bzhad/ sku chung ngu'i dus su rnam rig bkra zhing skyes sbyangs gi yon tan kun la ma thogs pa dang / lhag tu lha bris la shin tu mkhas pas 'bri lugs zhes pa'i srol rgyun ri mo gra rgyas su btang / spyi lo 1727rab byung bcu gnyis me sbrul lor rje nyid dgung lo bcu bzhir phebs skabs/ 'gom bla che rgyud dang gnyan sde rgan gral bcas 'byor nas skyabs rje rnam gnyis gdan 'dren zhus kyang rje nyid dgung 201

lo bcu bzhi la phebs kyang skyabs mgon don grub chos kyi rgyal pos zhal bzhes ma grub/ me sbrul zla ba drug pa'i tshes bcu gsum res gza' zla ba rgyu skar lha mtshams bzang po'i nyin/ mchog sprul rin po che'i yongs 'dzin rgyal sras sprul sku mkhan zur rog mdo dkon mchog mkhas btsun dang / sde pa dga' 'dzin sogs 'dus pa bzhi bcu'i skor zhabs btegs te/ lam zhor gter sgrom gnas gzigs dang gzhu rong brgyud byang lam nas rim bzhin chos 'khorakhyams pa gling du phebs/ rang phyogs sde dgon nas bsu ba ser sbreng zab rgyas dang brtan bzhugs bcas grub nas rtse gzim chung du gdan drangs/'dus pa dang skye bo'i tshogs chen la pad gling zab gter bla ma nor bu rgya mtsho'i rtsa ba'i dbang chen dang / bla med bcu gsum gyi bka' dbang sogs gsar rnying gi dbang chos du mas 'dul bya'i skye bo rnams gsang sngags zab mo'i smin grol gyi lam la bkod/ de nas chos 'khor byams pa gling nas mchod pa rnam pa gsum gyis mnyes par phul nas/ mchog gi sprul sku'i phebs lam la bde bar mdzad/ lam bar du dad ldan ris med skye dgu rnams la chos char tshims par bstsal/ zla ba bcu pa'i yar tshes bcu gsum la rdzong gsar bkra shis tshugs su phyag phebs/ rten rnams la mchod 'bul rgyas par phul/khams nang chen bla ma 'phrin las dbang phyug gi sku skye dang nang chen dpon gyi ja sang nas 'bul zhabs dang / rje 'gro 'dul mchog nang chen du spyan 'dren gsol ba btab par zhal bzhes grub/ 'bri gung du lo ltar byed sgo khag grub nas/ sgar sgrub grwa brje len bka' chos mnyam du gsan/ hor zla lnga pa'i tshes bcu dgu gza' skar 'phrod sbyor bzang por mkhan zur rgyal sras 'phrin las tshe bdag sde pa dga' 'dzin bcas ser skya brgyad cu skor gyis zhabs btegs nas khams phyogs su chibs kha bsgyur/ gangs dkar la brgyud byang 202

sbra kha che 'brom bcas nas chibs bsu bzang / ba ra'i mdo lo 'brong ngur bla ma bstan pa rab rgyas kyi sgar thog tu gdan drangs/ nags a sbong du nags shod 'gom sde shog kha shas/ tsha thang du rong po dgon pa'i chibs bsu skyes 'bul zhus/ shag wa thang bla ma chos rgyal kyis gdan zhus dang / bka' dbang bskang bshag sogs rgyas par gnang / zla ba drug pa'i tshes nyer gcig la sgar mkhan las thog pa bla ma tshul khrims zla ba 'phrin las mkhyen brtse dang dbus 'gom bla bcas ser skya sum cu skor chibs thab bsu ba dang bcas nyang khu 'thil du phebs/ 'gom dgon chos 'khor byams pa gling gi sde pa sogs che dgu kun gyis zhabs brtan 'bul rgyas zhus/ me mo la rgyud bong chu kha dang /ser shul/ 'brong pa/ dge rgyas sogs rim par nang chen du 'byor/ lho mgar chos gsum sogs kyi gdan sa dang / nang chen rgyal blon bcas la gsang sngags gsar rnying gi chos 'khor mtha' yas bskor nas khams phyogs rang dgon kun la zhabs kyis bcags/ lho rin po che las chos bka' 'ga' zhus/ khams phyogs nas chibs bsgyur bong chu kha'i rab nas me mo gnas nang du phebs nas gnas gzigs dang / yang zab kyi tshogs brgya phul/ nyang khu gad dmar du chos srung khag la gsol mchod rgyas par mdzad/ 'gom bla dang ser skya bdun cu skor gyi chibs bsu 'byor/ rje nyid kyi zhabs gras bla khag mang ba dang / 'gom sde nas 'bul zhabs bzang / khrom la bka' dbang yang bstsal/ rim bzhin ba lag thang brgyud spyi lo 1740rab byung bcu gnyis lcags sprel zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes nyer lnga nyin slar yang chos rje'i zhabs kyi pad mo nags shod 'gom dgon du phebs/ rang dgon 'dus pa rgya mtshos ser sbreng dang zhabs brtan rgyas par bstar/ dam pa'i chos kyi lus can kun yid tshim par mdzad/ rwa khyim dgon gyi gdan zhus ltar phebs nas rten la 203

phyag nas dang khrus gsol gnang / ka rong la rgyud smre ti kha nas rim par khem la nas phebs/ 'bri gung bla grwa mi sde nas phebs bsu gra rgyas zhus nas gdan sar zab mo rim gnyis la rim/ rje nyid zhing du phebs skabs/ rang dgon nas dgongs rdzogs mchod pa rgyas par phul ba dang gser gdung yang grub/'bri gung nas dgongs rdzogs la rang dgon du spyi 'jog bstsal ba 'dod lha'i sku thang bdun tshar spus legs dang / spub chal/ gos 'phan bcas 'byor/ /'bri gung gdan rabs nyer dgu pa dkon mchog bstan 'dzin chos kyi nyi ma mchog 'jang yul du spyi lo 1755rab byung bcu gsum pa'i shing phag lor sku 'khrungs/ phyag na padmo bstan 'dzin 'gro 'dul sogs bla chen rnam pa khag gis rje don grub chos rgyal gyi yang srid du ngos bzung nas dbus su gdan drangs/ dam pa'i rang rtags ngom bzhin skyes sbyangs gi yon tan phul du phyin/spyi lo 1771lcags yos lo'i zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes lnga la nags shod du gdan 'dren zhus pas de skabs bka' brgyad sgrub chen skabs yin pas phebs rgyu'i zhal bzhes zhabs phyi la brda rgyag mdzad/ zla ba lnga ba'i tshes lnga yi nyi dros trem la nags shod kyi phyogs su chibs bskyod/ klung shod brgyud rtse ba dang khra ba kha'i 'dus tshogs nas gsol ston dang sger 'jal zhus/ rwa sgreng / seng gling rgod tshang / stag lung bcas su phebs pas 'brom ston sku dbu sku can mjal bas sku g.yo ba'i rnam pa mdzad/ stag la'i la nas thang lha dang / 'dam snying drung nas gnam mtshor phebs/ sngon ma mthong ba'i ngo mtshar rnam pa du ma dang / lhag tu mtsho la o rgyan rin po che'i phyag rjes yod pa kun gyis gsal bar mjal/ klu rdzas sogs phul/ rim bzhin hor/ na dmar/ so hruga.a mdo/ rdza dmar sogs kyi che dgu kun gyis gtsug tu ma bkur ba med pas 204

zab rgyas chos char gang 'dod bstsal/ de nas nags shod pa'i sde sne zin/rje nyid kyi sbyin bdag mgon po chos srung sogs kyis mjal nas dad ldan khag la tshe dbang bstsal/ rang dgon nas chibs bsu khag gsum 'byor/ sog ru dar tshugs kyi dbang gzhi la rta mgrin gyi bka' dbang mdzad/ stag drug pa'i dad ldan 'gas mjal kha zhus/ tshes bco brgyad la bre skyong sum 'dor 'gom bla zhogs pa gtsos sde dgon yongs kyis chibs bsu tshar du mngar ba bstar/dge tshe dbang dang 'jang 'dra o rgyan gyi sbra la phyag nas gtor/ bshag pa be rkyang nas 'bul zhabs bzang zhing mi tshogs brgyad brgya tsam la tshe dbang bstsal/ phyi nyin mi tshogs dgu brgya tsam la rta mgrin gyi dbang mdzad/ sbyin bdag khag gcig la rnam 'joms dang / sgrol dkar/ gu ru zhi ba'i bka' dbang mdzad/ rta nor mar lug sogs 'bul tshan shin tu mang ba 'bri gung du skyel bar btang / tshes nyer bzhi la nyang khu'i thang du phyag rdor bka' dbang gnang / rang dgon nas ston mo gang rgyas phul/ de dus bod zla bdun pa'i nang yin pas dbyar skyid nyin bzhi gnang ba'i skabs su/ tshes nyer lnga la nags shod tsho drug gi dga' ba'i rnam par rta rgyug btang / dgra lha dpa' stod/ yul skyong nags lha dzam pa'i gsol ka zhib rgyas gnang / 'jang 'dra o rgyan la bka' dbang bstsal zhing bo ngan bhe cang gi chibs bsu 'byor nas 'bul tshan bstar/ de nas dar lung gzhung chu grong mdor bzhugs sgar btab nas tshe dbang bstsal/ bdun pa'i nyer bdun la 'dam sne thang la 'gom bla'i thab bsu la sgar babs/ der 'khod rnams la tshe dbang gnang /gnam gang la gnyags rong rgyud sog ru lha rjes gdan 'dren zhus/ tshes gcig la tshe dbang bstsal zhing man ḍal 'bul sbyor bzang / gnyags mdo'i mi tshogs rnams kyis mjal kha zhus/ zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes gnyis la nags 205

chu'i ko ba'i grur bzhugs nas rang dgon gyi ser sbreng gi bsu ba dang bsang gi dud sprin/ rol mo'i snyan 'jebs bcas dregs ldan skye bo kun kyang rang dbang med pa zhum par gyur/ rang dgon 'du khang du 'gom bla zhogs pa chos dbang grags pas gsol ston dang man ḍal brtan bzhugs phul nas tshogs dmangs la phyag mjal gnang / de nas rtse gzim chung du gdan drangs/ tshes gsum la tshogs dmangs kyi zhabs brtan dang gsol ston phul/ be cag a yungs nas dngos po'i 'bul tshan gya nom pa phul bas tshe dbang bka' drin gnang / tshes lnga la gnyan sde spyi nas bka' brgyad kyi dbang chen dgos zhes gsol ba btab pa rjes su gnang / tshes drug la chags ri bla ma dang mjal/bdun pa la spyi'i zhabs brtan dang rgyal tho btsugs/ tshes brgyad la chos srung khag gi bsang gsol rgyas par bstsal/ rang dgon du spyi 'jogs pad 'byung a ti ma/ sa gsum ma'i sku thang / ka 'phan/ rnam sbyar bzhi/ gan dril/gdugs gnyis/ rnga 'cham rgyab dar/ rten rol 'phyar dar/ rgyal mtshan cha bcas gnang / dge mdun re la phyag 'gyed sman sgrub dang / na bza'/ kha btags/ dngul bal tram re bcas gnang / tshes dgu dang bcu la sa chogabacu la rnal 'byor rgyun dbang / bcu gnyis la skyabs rje mchog rnga 'cham la phebs nas rgyal tho dang sgo byang phyi nang dang dam sri mnan/ tshes bco lnga la yid ches kyi lo rgyus dang dam tshig gi rnam bshad/ me 'chongs dang gral 'dzin/bcu drug la 'dzab tshugs/ che mchog gi 'dzab skabs che mchog dang yang dag gi bdud rtsi khol ba dang / yang dag 'dzab skabs yung dkar gnam du 'phar/nyer gcig la chags ri gu gu bla ma sogs la lnga ldan dang chos drug yid bzhin nor mchog sman bla seng gdong bcas kyi bka' dbang bstsal/ nyer gcig ma mo'i 'dzab skabs 'brug dang glog dmar khyug nyer gnyis la dge 206

slong kun dgas rdzas kyi mchod pa spros/ nyer gsum la 'jang 'dra dge slong mchog gyur gyi rtogs 'bul dang rdzas mchod phul/ de skabs 'ja' kha dog lnga ldan rgyal tho byang shar sbrel/ nyer drug la rdza dmar dpon stobs rgyas bza' tsho dang chags ri sprul skus mchod/ nyer dgu la tshe dbang skabs mi tshogs stong phrag 'ga' 'dus/ gnam gang la rdzas dbang / tshes gcig la dbang chen bstsal skabs ches mtshar ba'i lha pa zhig gis dus gsum lung bstan 'ga' gsungs/ sprin bkra shis kyi dngos 'bul tshan chen phul/ tshes bzhi la rta mgrin bka' dbang gi skabs su rdza dmar chos mdzad/ ba log sku phreng bzhi pa mkhyen brtse dbang phyug bcas kyis ('di dgon gsar du sku tshe gang por bzhugs pa de min nam snyam/) dngos po'i mchod pa phul/ bka' srung dbang skabs 'gom bla zhogs pas smon lam tshig bcad rgyas par phul/ rang dgon la zla 'dzin sgo byang 'gor lan war phyag bris mdzad/ tshes dgu la skyabs rje nyid 'cham chen dang / rnga 'cham/ zur 'cham bcas la phebs pas kun gyi sku 'cham bde ba'i bstod dbyangs sgrog tshes bcu la gsar ma'i 'cham phud 'bul bar rang lugs kyi bla grwa nas sngar srol ltar phul/ rdza dmar dpon gyi sras skra phud bzhes/ 'du khang du khro rol gyi rdor slob la phebs/bcu gnyis la gtor rgyag bcu gsum la dkyil 'khor spyan drangs nas gtsang po'i 'gram du klu 'bum dang klu gtor btang / bcu bzhi la rnga 'cham dang gtor 'bul byas te las kyi mjug bsdus/ bsngo ba chen mo gnang /nags shod shug lding dgon gyis gtsos pas ri bo dge lugs pa'i 'dus pa 'gar phyag mjal bstsal/ dgon du sgra can 'jug pa'i sgo byang btab/ rang dgon du mang ja dgu tsam dang / nags shod lung par dgon pa tshang mar mang bskul bcas phul/ bcu bdun la kha bskang sbyin bsreg gnang / nyin 207

gsum ring rang lugs kyi zab chos khag gtsos pa'i cho ga khag khrid lung dang sgar gra sgrig a jo bkra shis dang nang zan bsod nams tshe ring la dos 'go brgyad brgya dang bco brgyad brtsis sprad/ tshes nyer gcig la rang dgon nas chibs bskyod sngar ltar ko bar phebs nas/ shel dkar 'bum par zhag bzhugs mdzad/ nyer gnyis la 'bum par khrus gsol dang rab gnas rgyas par mdzad/ ri spun dang gnas shod kyis 'bul tshan bstar/ sgam po'i bla ma la rtse ba dang mjal kha gnang / ba ro a rgyal gyi nang du gdan zhus ltar bzhugs/ nyer gsum la stag lhas chu mig khar zhag bzhugs mdzad/ stag lhas dang / ko sna/ la ti la 'og gong gi grong pa rnams kyis 'bul tshan dang /star mo'i dgon dang rab brtan dgon gyi che drags rigs dang / bhe hu bhe cang bcas kyi chibs bsu brgya dang bzhi bcu skor slebs pa la tshe dbang bstsal/nyer bzhi la dgon nyin srib gnyis kyi mkhan po sogs nas sger mjal mdzad/'du khang du gdan drangs nas 'bul sbyor bzang po phul/ rta smon dgon du sku rten thub dbang gser sku/ gsung rten nyi khri/ thugs rten pad spungs mchod rten/ rab brtan dgon du sku rten thub dbang gser sku/ gsung rten nyi khri/thugs rten pad spungs mchod rten dang gnas rten bcu drug zhal thang spus ldan/ gos bzang sgrig gi rten thong cha/ theg chen gan dril shubs ldan/bzang gos mchod rdzas rigs kyi bla bre spus legs/ 'phyar dar cha gnyis gnang / de nas dgon khag gnyis kyis chibs skyel zhus nas/ zho chen sum mdor bo ngan dpon bstan 'dzin 'khor bcas kyis chibs bsu zhabs tog dngos 'bul rgya chen spros pa dang sbra la phyag nas gtor/ rgyas ram sum mdor sgar btab te tshe dbang bstsal/ nyer drug la gsol tshigs khar ar rgod gu ru dbang phyug shog dud nyi shu skor la rta mgrin gyi bka' dbang bstsal/ nyer 208

bdun la nags lha'i sbos rdzongs mer nag la phebs nas bsang gsol dang /nags lha'i rten rdzas la lha rta gro zhur gcig dang lha g.yag rog po/ lha lug dkar mo dang / gter bum dang mtsho la ral gri/ klu bum bcas phul/ sgar thog nas nyang khu gzhung yan gyi mi rnams la bka' dbang bstsal/ tshes nyer brgyad la lo a spangs mdo nas ru rnying dpon 'khor nas chibs bsu zhus/ lo o chung du 'brong ngur bla ma bstan pa dang bla ma phur dga'/ bla ma zla 'od bcas kyis phebs bsu zhus nas 'brong bla'i sgar thog nas ser sbreng rgyas par bstar nas 'brong ngur tshogs gur du zhabs brtan phul nas gu ru zhi ba'i bka' dbang bstsal/ 'brong ngur bla mas brgya 'bul dang tshur 'dus tshogs la phyag 'gyed/ dgon la byams pa/ phag gru'i gser sku/ pad ma spungs ba'i mchod rten/ gnas rten bdun thang / dung chen dung dar cha tshang /theg chen gan dril/ rgyal mtshan cha bcas gnang / skyabs rje mchog la 'bul tshan rta nor brgya 'bul sogs mtha' yas/ tshes gsum la chibs bsgyur 'brong ngur dgon 'debs yul gyi sa gzhi dang / brtsegs rmang / bum gter yo byad/ shing cha bcas la phyag nas dang ri khrus gsol/ rje'i zhal nas ri 'di sa dpyad phun sum tshogs shing rgyab ri seng ge 'dra zhes gsungs pa dang byin rlabs/ sa yul der dung dkar byin can yang bris/ spyi lo 1771rab byung bcu gsum lcags yos lo'i zla ba bcu pa'i tshes gsum la dngos su lo 'brong ngur dgon phyag btab/ de sngon sgar pa yin/ de nas che 'brom dang /so hrug smre ti gling mthil du nags shod pa'i mi sde nas zhabs tog gang rgyas zhus/ sbra kha sogs nas 'bri gung du gdan sar 'khod/ rje 'di'i sku ring la rang dgon du dam chos mi nub dar rgyas yongs phyir dang rgyun bzhugs gdan sa'i khur len pa/ 'bri gung bu slob sum cu'i nang bsal mkhyen gnyis kyi yon 209

tan rgyas pa ri dbang dkon mchog nor bu rgya mtsho mchog rdo rje'i lung gis rang dgon du btang nas gdan sa bskyangs/ de yan sku thog gang tsam phebs pa ma gsal bas rjes su dpyad par rig de rjes ri dbang dkon mchog 'jigs bral mchog sgro ba tshang du sku 'khrungs nas sku tshe hril por rtswa zho gangs gsum dang / lho gnas sogs mdo dbus stod smad kun tu bya bral dka' thub kyi rtul bzhugs tu phebs nas/ rtogs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam/ gangs ti ser rje padma'i rgyal mtshan gdung 'bum bzhengs bas 'bri rdzong nas gzigs gsos gnang / de rjes ri dbang dkon mchog dam chos bstan pa'i nyi ma mchog ni skyen pa yab tshang du shag be stod du sku 'khrungs/ khong ni rang lugs cho ga chos spyod la slob sbyong rang skya 'pher ba'i mkhas pa'i phul du byung ba ma tshad/ bcu phrag rig gnas kun la mkhas pas rgyud 'dzin dang bcas spel bas grags pa che la/ ba lag 'bum chen gyi bcu gsum 'khor lo nyi zla zar rwa tshag bcas gser zangs kyis bskrun pa dang / nyams gso zhus/ thel bla dang sgar bla mdzad skabs/ sde pa rgan gras rba rgan 'jam dbyangs/ sde pa gzhon pa sprin lhun grub/ bla mkhyen sog ru dge slong g.yang 'phel/ mgron gnyer ke ru bstan rgyas/ phyag mdzod skyi ru thogs med/ ja ma 'do ba tshul khrims dang blo gros che ba/ a drung tshul khrims dang / blo gros chung ba bcas mdzad nas gdan sar snyan grags che/ skyabs mgon mchog shar phyogs mngon dgar gzigs skabs 'bri gung dgon spyi dang khyad par 'gom dgon du phyag mdzod dga' 'dzin phebs nas mang 'gyed dang / 'dod lha'i sku thang bdun tshar gos 'phan bcas gnang zhing / rang dgon nas mchod 'bul gang rgyas dang gdung rten yang bzhengs grub/'bri gung gdan rabs sum cu pa skyabs mgon bstan 'dzin padma'i rgyal 210

mtshan phyag na padmo de nyid spyi lo 1770rab byung bcu gsum lcags stag lor kong por sku 'khrungs/ rim bzhin gdan sa'i khrir 'khod nas bka' brgyud pa'i chos srol kun gyi mnga' bdag tu gyur/ lcags bya lor 'gom sde dgon nas skyabs rje mchog gdan zhu phul bas zhal bzhes thob/ spyi lo 1rdo04rab byung bcu gsum shing pho byi ba'i lo ste rje nyid dgung lo so bdun sku skeg tu song ba'i zla ba lnga pa'i tshes dgu la chibs bsgyur nas klung shod/ rwa sgreng / stag lung nas brgyud gnyan chen thang lha'i mdun du gzigs snang mang / snying drung chu tshan dang 'dam la rgan brgal nas gnam mtshor phebs/ bkra shis dor klu sman dang klu bsang rgyas par phul/ zla drug pa'i tshes bcu la na dmar 'khor tsha dang nag chu mkhan nang bcas su 'dod chos gang mtshams gnang / rim bzhin dgon gsar gnyan sde bla grwa mi sde thab bsu snga phyi rim par 'byor/shag wa thang du 'brong ngur chos rje sku phreng bcu gcig pa dkon mchog bstan 'dzin don grub kyis bsu ba ser sbreng dang bcas gdan zhus nas nyin gnyis bzhugs/ mos blo bzhin dbang dang rjes gnang yang bstsal/ dgon ming zhus pas shag wa thang bka' brgyud 'phel rgyas gling zhes mtshan gsol/ shag nyang khu rtsib lung chos khri thang du zhag bzhi bzhugs nas khrom dbang dang bsang gsol rgyas par gnang zhing / 'gom sder gtsos pa'i nags shod tsho drug rang gi lung pa'i dus ston ltar rta rgyug gi gzigs mo phul/ de nas chags rtse dar lung gzhung brgyud ba lag thang nas rim bzhin zla ba bdun pa'i tshes bzhi'i snga dror 'dus pa rgya mtshos ser sbreng rgyas pa dang bcas 'gom dgon du phyag phebs nas bsus ston gra rgyas phul/ bla grwa rnams kyis mjal kha zhus nas bzhugs gral du gsung phebs rgyas par zhus/ 'gom bla sde pa sogs rang dgon gyi che dgu kun gyi 'dod chos mdo dbang chen mos smin par mdzad/211

dang po sgo 'gyed phyag rdor ngan song kun 'dren nas dbu bzung rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor steng nas dbang gi chu bo chen po bzhi sogs dang / mtha' rten tshe dbang bcas nyin dgu la grub par mdzad/ bar seng du seng gdong dang gza' yum/ nā ga rakṣa sogs rjes gnang yang bstsal/ rtsa gsum zhi rgyas sbyin bsreg rnam sras zhi ba bde byed phywa 'phrin nor bu mchog rgyal gyi g.yang bskyob/bka' brgyad khro rol dang nyin gsum gar 'cham/ rgyal ba 'bri gung pa'i thun min gyi zab chos khag sogs mos blo bzhin yongs su bskang / skyabs rje mchog gis rang dgon du tshes bcu'i 'dus tshogs su zhi khro rigs bsdus kyi bskang bshags btang zhing bsnyen bkur phyag 'gyed gya nom pa dang / dgon la spyi 'jog bzang gos kyi snam sbyar lnga/ bla bre che legs/ phod ka bzhi/ rten khebs cha sogs spyi 'jog gnang / rang sde dgon nas zhabs brtan dang 'bul ba dpag tu med pa phul ba dang / sger so so nas de bzhin phul/ rang dgon du zhag nyer gsum tsam bzhugs nas tshes nyer bdun la chibs bskyod gnang pa'i lam bar du 'khod pa'i dge dgon lta smon dang / rab brtan dgon du gdan zhus chibs bsu ser sbreng dang bcas 'du khang du bsnyen bkur 'bul zhabs bzang bar zhus/ 'dus pa la 'gyed/ bzang gos bla bre spyi 'jog bstsal/ rab brtan dgon du 'jam dbyangs kyi rjes gnang bstsal/nags lha'i lha mkhar du zhag gsum bzhugs shing / bsang gsol rgyas pa dang /lha rta/ lha g.yag sogs btsan pa gnang / gnas 'dir khrom dbang kha shas dang 'dod chos bstsal/ lha chen nags lha dgyes pa'i mtshan ma bzang lo a spang la brgyud ru rnying sde thog nas phebs bsu dang / 'brong ngur du bla ma 'od zer sogs nas chibs bsu dang bcas 'dod chos bka' brgyad bde sna'adus kyi dbang chen dang / khro rol khyung dgu ma/ bum gter sba ba/ rab 212

gnas sbyin bsreg zur dbang rjes gnang gang zhus re ba bskangs/ gangs dkar/ 'brang nag spo ba bcas 'dod chos bstsal nas 'bri thel du phyag phebs/ de'i phyi lo 'gom grwa gsar bu rnams la skyabs sdom dang rang dgon gyi grwa skyen pa bstan rgyas dang dge padma ngo g.yog gi 'dod mos ltar gson byang /rtsa gsum gtor dbang bcas gnang / khong rnam gnyis nas zhabs brtan rgyas par phul ba dang dgyes bzhin bzhes/'bri gung sgrub grwa'i slob dpon khri thog nyer gsum pa grub dbang yon tshang chos ldan ni rje 'gro 'dul sku tshe'i smad tsam du nags shod du sku 'khrungs/yang ri sgar du grwa sar bzhugs nas nges 'byung drag pos bskul bas sgrub grwar phebs/ yongs 'dzin rdzogs chen grub dbang rab 'byor dang / grub dbang ye shes/ grub dbang dge 'phel bcas bzhi ka la bsten nas phyag chen chos drug dang / dgongs pa yang zab/ bla sgrub/ rlung khrid sogs 'bri lugs khrid chos yongs grags kun gsan nas grub pa thob/ rje padma'i rgyal mtshan gyi na bza' gnang bas mi rgod spyang mos dad nas 'bul tshan phul/ de nas skyabs mgon padma'i rgyal mtshan gyi zhabs nas gshin rje'i gdams pa zhus nas bsnyen pas ka pā la khol/ sku tshe phal cher rdzong du skyabs mgon zung gi bka' khrid gnang tshe gang gnang dgos tshang ma'i khrid gnyer mdzad pas/ sku tshe smad du 'bri gung sgrub grwa'i slob dpon mdzad/ slob tshogs shin tu mang /sprel lo bka' chos skabs dbang gzhi len pa yang mdzad/ spyi 'jog mang /rje 'di'i bka' drin las khrid srol mang po zhig byung te/ slob ma spang mda' ba nas rgyud pa bla sgrub/ seng phrug tshe thar nas rgyud pa gshin rje/ a grags chos 'phel nas rgyud pa chos drug drod tshul khrims nas rgyud pa rdzogs chen dang dzo ki rlung khrid/ mang yul grub dbang nas rgyud pa phyag chen sogs 'bri 213

lugs gsar rnying gi gdams pa yongs rdzogs lta khrid thams cad kyi 'byung rtsa yin pas bka' drin shin tu che bas/ chos brgyud 'di rnams ma nyams par gnas pa ni grub dbang mchog gi thugs rje'i mdzad pa las gzhan min/ spyi lo 1〈20rab byung bcu bzhi lcags 'brug lor rdzong zhol du ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas sku gshegs/ khong gi brtsams chos ni/ chos drug gi man ngag padma'i zhal lung bya ba rgyas bsdus gnyis/ bla sgrub dmigs rim zhib rgyas/phyag chen khrid kyi lung sbyor sogs mang /rje 'di'i slob ma 'bri gung sgrub grwa'i slob dpon khri thog nyer bdun pa grub dbang a grags chos 'phel mchog ni nags shod a grags kyi 'brog sder sku 'khrungs/ sku tshe stod du phal che ba khyim du bzhugs/ de nas 'bri gung du phebs nas skyabs mgon padma'i rgyal mtshan gyi zhabs la gtugs pa dang /grub dbang yon tshang rin po che'i zhabs la gtugs nas rang lugs sgrub grwa'i chos srol khag zhu ba'i dbu tshugs/ pha yul nas rta zhig khrid yod pa de shi bas lo bzhi lnga la yang skyabs rje zung la bsngo ba zhus pas/ chos 'phel nas yang rta phul gsungs bzhad/ rje nyid thugs dam rtse gcig la 'jug pas 'khrul ba zhig pa'i grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por gshegs/ skabs re dngos po phra mo la yang gces par 'dzin/ skabs rer dngos rdzas kun thal ba bzhin bor/btsun chung 'gas dri chen rdo leb la gzhag nas bug sgor phul bas/ 'o de ring rten 'brel legs gsungs/ khro ba tsam yang mi byed par yar bsnabs/gser dang bong ba mnyam pa'i rtogs pa mthar thug dgra gnyen dbyer med pas lta spyod gcig tu 'dres kyang / thos pa chung ba dang thugs rdzob pas 'gro rnams bsod nams skal ba zhan pa dang bcas 'gro don che ba ma byung / /rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i nang rang dgon du grub dbang dam chos dang /214

grub dbang chos 'dzin rin po che/ mtshams grub pa'i rdo rje/ mtshams brtson 'grus rnams kyi mtshan tsam spyi deb las byung ba las rnam thar rgyas par mi snang / skyabs mgon chos kyi rgyal mtshan khri bzhugs mdzad sgo la 'gom bla rog mdo dang sde dgon spyi/ ya ho bzod pa sogs nas brtan bzhugs khri gsol 'bul zhabs bstar/ skyabs mgon dgung lo sum cu lhag trem las ma bzhugs pas rang dgon du gdan 'dren zhu ma thob/ de skabs 'bri gung sgrub grwa'i khri rabs nyer brgyad pa no no dkon bstan pa'i skabs su nags shod 'gom dgon chos 'khor byams pa gling dgon nas chos bzhugs grwa rgyun mang bar bzhugs te/ dbu rab rgyas/ dbu bzang po/ tsha bo/ gzung rdor/bstan 'dzin dar rgyas/ blo bzang rin chen/ nags shod pa rje dkon mchog chos skyabs/ rtsi blang mchog sbyin/ nor 'grub/ — a mchod rdo rje sogs ni rang lugs cho ga phyag len la mkhas shing grub dbang rin po che'i zhabs la gtugs nas rim gnyis phyag chen chos drug la dbang 'byor ba'i bka' brgyud pa rin po che'i sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin la zla bral gyi skyes bu kho na'o/lhag tu 'bri gung sgrub grwa'i slob dpon nyer dgu pa grub dbang dam chos nyi ma ni/ rog mdo ba chos grags dbang po'i sku'i gcung du nags shod chos 'khor byams pa gling gi nye 'dabs su spyi lo 1ṭwāṃ0ṭwāṃs 'brug lor sku 'khrungs/ rgyal tshab lho chos kyi blo gros las rab tu byung zhing / yang ri sgar du chos zhugs mdzad nas klog bzang zhing klog kho nar phebs pa dang zhal dkar bas a mchod dkar ril zhes 'bod/ yang ri'i mtshams grwar phebs nas nags shod dge slong a grags chos 'phel bsten nas phyag chen chos drug zhus/ sgrub la brtson zhing lhag par rtsa rlung la nan tan sbyangs/ bla ma la mos gus che bas sku gshegs skabs sku phung rgal par khur nas dur khrod du gdan drangs/ chos 215

'phro 'ga' no no rin po che las zhus/ sku btsun zhing thugs dam 'phel ba dang thugs gtum pa zhig yod/ no no rin po che gshegs nas sgrub grwa'i khri thog pa mdzad/ rgyud dang mthun pa'i chos bka' la gsang bar mdzad nas chos bka' dog pas slob ma ha cang mi mang yang mtshan nyid dang ldan pa 'ga' byung / rje thugs rje'i nyi ma dbu nyes dang po phog skabs rab gsal nas mchongs kyang nyes skyon ma byung / rdzong du log tri'i sgrub pa mdzad/ yang rir lo bdun them spangs mdzad/ rje thugs rje'i nyi ma dbu nyes mjug ma'i skabs 'bri gung du bzhugs ma spro bar sgam por phebs/ zhabs drung skal bzang phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi drung nas chos mang du gsan/ yo byad thams cad spangs dag lan gsum btang / kong sprul ri khrod rnams su lo shas bzhugs/chu lug lor 'bri gung du phebs nas rje thugs rje'i nyi ma dang chos rje zung dang mjal/ mkhan g.yu sgra dang / dung dkar sprul sku/ nor bu sprul sku sogs 'bri gung bstan pa'i sgor bzhugs che phra kun la lnga ldan gyi khrid bstsal/ gzhan yang la phyi rdor 'dzin bya btang sde ba/ chos lung ma gro chos 'phel/ rje bla ma dkon mchog chos skyabs bcas kyis zhabs la btugs/ rje chos skyabs mchog dang / yab yul lung pa gcig yin pas sne len dang 'go 'dren bzang por gnang / de la sogs pa 'gro don mtha' yas mdzad nas mthar spyi lo 1〈rdo6me khyi lor sku mya ngan las 'das/'bri gung gdan rabs so sum pa skyabs mgon chos nyid nor bu mchog khams nang chen sa skyong mchod yon gyis rang re'i dgon gnas rnams su gdan drangs nas gsang gzhung dang nag chu brgyud nas nang chen du phebs skabs rang re nags shod 'gom dgon du gdan 'dren zhus nges kyang rnam thar rgyas par mi snang bas de tsam mo/216

'gom dgon gyi dbu bla rang grol rin po che mchog ni/ sngon 'gom stod shag wa thang dgon gyi dbu bla yin pa 'og tu shag wa thang gi lo rgyus nas gsal la/ rang grol sku phreng bcu gnyis pa sprul sku nyis zlos su gyur nas gcig 'gom smad chos 'khor byams pa gling du khrir 'khod pa yin te/ khong gi mtshan gsal bar ma nges kyang / sku 'khrungs ba'i yul ni nags stod yul skyong nags lha'i nye 'gram dpa' yu nyin du yab sgro ba bla ma skyabs dang yum sgrol dkar gnyis kyi sras su sku 'khrungs bas ngo mtshar ba'i mtshan ltas shin tu mang zhing dam pa'i rang rtags ngom pas/ rtsod med kyi rang grol rin po che'i sku skye yin par ngos chod de the tshom dang bral bas mtshan yang sku skye rin po che zhes zhu/'gom dgon chos 'khor byams pa gling du gdan drangs nas khri gsol mdzad sgo gang rgyas zhus nas bzhugs su gsol/ skyes sbyangs kyi yon tan phul du byung bas/ mdzad 'phrin shin tu rgyas pa dang rab tu byung nas 'dul ba 'dzin pa'i mnga' bdag tu gyur/ thun mong dang thun min gyi dngos grub rnam gnyis thob pas mi min lha 'dre 'dul ba dang / hab ha me 'od 'khyil chen gyis mi min lha 'dre bzung nas bka' bsgo ba sogs rdzu 'phrul shin tu mang bar gsungs kyang /rnam thar rgyas pa dang / bka' 'dri zhu yul nges pa can ma byung bas re zhig de tsam las rjes su dpyad pa bya rgyu yin/nags shod grub dbang stobs ldan rin po che ni nags shod du sku 'khrungs/ chung dus rang dgon pa'i sgrig zhugs mdzad nas/ grub dbang no no rin po che'i zhabs la gtugs pa dang / rje btsun dkon mchog chos skyabs dang / 'gom dgon du grub dbang 'ga'i zhabs zin par mngon/ tshe gcig sgrub la gzhol nas grub pa brnyes/ chu glang lor rgya sngo nyig ces bod sdod a ban nus pa shor nas lu'u cun dmag phyir 'bud skabs/ bod dmag lo rdzong 217

sku 'khor bcas rang dgon gyi 'chams po khang du bsdad nas/ zab zab ma byas pas g.yag gseng nas me stag mdzo mo rwa bar lhungs nas skad cig la me lce drag po mched/ dgon pa'i gzhis ka 'jig la nye skabs/ dgon gzhung nas grub dbang la skyabs 'jug zhus pas khyed rnams yar song gsungs/gzim khang ni da lta rgyal sgo mar sne'i thog tu yin zhing / bar 'khyam du mar phebs nas 'ding ba dang chos gos gsol nas/ rnam snang chos bdun dang bcas zad pa me yi ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pas/ khang pa ldib pa lta bus skad cig la me zhi/ grub dbang mchog steng sgo rnam grol gyi gdams pa nyams su blangs nas shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba'i zhing du phebs/ 'dus pa rnams dbug dbyung nas snyan gsan phyir mar song bas grub dbang dang mjal/ lo rdzong 'khor bcas the tshom dang bcas mjal bas dad pa'i sa la bkod/ gdung rten dur khrod kyi rtser bzhengs/grub dbang ngam rin po che ni dkar gzhung bong tshang du sku 'khrungs/chung nas dam pa'i rang rtags tshang zhing / mngon shes dang nus mthu sogs mnga' la/ rab tu byung nas rang dgon tu sgrig bzhugs mdzad/ 'bri gung du phebs nas grub dbang tshe brtan rin po che'i zhabs la gtugs nas phyag chen dang chos drug nyams su blangs/ rang dgon du phebs nas ka mchog dang /rgya phug sogs su sgrub par brtson/ 'khrul zhig chen po yin zhes kun gyi gleng /'bri gung gdan rabs so bzhi pa dkon mchog thugs rje'i nyi ma ni spyi lo 1ra2rdorab byung bcu bzhi pa'i sa byi lo zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes sum cur byang gnam mtsho'i nye 'dabs kyi gnam rur sku 'khrungs/ 'brong ngur bla ma bkra shis kyi gzigs lam ltar byung nas ngos 'dzin byas/ 'bri gung du gdan drangs nas rig pa'i gnas la sbyangs brtson gnang 'go tshugs/ bka' chos 218

gnang ba dang / gser khang du grub dbang dkon mchog bstan pas bka' brgyud pa'i phyag chen lnga ldan sogs phul/ gso rig mkhas dbang du ma las gso rig la mkhas par bslab/ phyi nang 'gal rkyen sna tshogs la brten nas rje nyid khrir zur nas gtsang srad rin chen sgang du phebs dgos byung / sa lug lor rgyal tshab lho sprul zhi bar gshegs pas/ rje nyid 'bri gung du chibs bskyod nas skyabs mgon zung dang mjal dar rtse sprod dang bcas thams cad dga' ba'i bro ston mdzad/ spyi lo 1ṭwāṃ62chu khyi lor nags shod 'gom dgon gyis sngon zhus ltar 'bri rdzong nas btegs/ rwa sgreng / gsang gzhung / nag chu sogs brgyud nas lo 'brong ngur dgon du zhabs sor 'khod nas lung khrid rgyas par bstsal/ bslab khrims yang dag dgos tshul sogs zhal gdams gnang / rim bzhin chos 'khor byams pa gling du chibs bskyod/ dgon sde nas chibs bsu dang ser sbreng bstar nas bsang dud dang spos rol gyis gang zhing gdan sa'i 'du khang du mi 'jig seng ge'i khri la 'khod/ 'dus spyi nas zhabs brtan dang 'jal 'bul zhus/ rtse gzim chung gsang sngags theg mchog nyi 'od rtser gdan drangs/ 'dus pa rgya mtsho la lnga ldan gtor dbang dang rtsa gsum gtor dbang / zhi khro'i dbang / mi 'khrug pa'i dbang / kun rig gi dbang / bde mchog gi bka' dbang sogs kyis smin par mdzad nas/rgyab chos grol byed khrid kyi rim pa 'ga' gnang bas/ gnas 'dir bka' brgyud pa'i bstan pa nyi ma shar ba ltar gnang / lhag tu rang dgon gyi dur khrod rtsa ri'i rngams pa sgra sgrog dang dbyer med pa 'di nyid phyag btab/ 'og tu bskang bshags dkyil 'khor dang steng du rdo cal thog ngan song skye sgo 'gog phyir zhabs rjes bzhag mdo khams zhig po bco brgyad kyi nang gses 'bru sher sku'i gdung sras dgon gyi rtogs ldan du bskos/ zhib par dur khrod kyi lo 219

rgyus la gzigs/ dgon spyi la phyag gnang dang bcas chibs bskyod gnang /che 'brom/ so hrug sogs nas brgyud 'bri rdzong du phebs/ spyi lo 1rdo7ṭwāṃs stag lor sgom sde nang chen nas spyan drangs pa ltar phebs nas spang chig dgon dang nags shod dgon gsar bcas su phebs nas slar 'bri gung du phebs/skyi ru dge slong dkon mchog phan bde'am dge slong gral skyob ni skyi ru grong du 'khrungs/ chung dus nas rab tu byung nas chos phyogs la brtson/skyabs mgon thugs rje'i nyi ma mchog gi zhabs la gtugs nas rtsa ba'i bla mar bkur/ nyid kyis zhus pas skyabs mchog gis mdzad pa rnam sras tshogs sogs mang ba dang / phyogs 'dir dpe rgyun gyi ngal ba sel phyir/ bsang gsol dang / tshes bcu pad ljon/ dzam dkar g.yang sgrub/ nyer mkho'i chos spyod pod chung gcig bcas gsar bskrun gnang / ba lag 'bum par dri med mchod rten dang tshes bcu lha khang / ru rnying ba ra'i mdor mchod rten dang lha khang / rong po'i tshes bcu lha khang dang mchod rten bzhengs nas sku tshe smad du rong po'i phyogs su bzhugs yun ring /nags shod grub dbang dbu mdzad bstan 'dzin rin po che ni/ nags shod skyi ru gong mar sku 'khrungs nas/ rang dgon du sgrig bzhugs mdzad/ skyi ru dbu mdzad ngang rgan gyi sku mched yin zhing / 'bri gung du phebs nas grub dbang tshe brtan rin po che'i zhabs la gtugs/ ldeng rgyal du phebs nas sgrub pa nyams len mdzad nas sku tshe gang po der bzhugs/ nags shod mtshams pa bstan 'dzin rin po che zhes kun gyis bkur zhing / phyag rgya chen po la dbang 'byor ba'i grub pa'i dbang po zhig yin/ mthar gnas de nyid du sku bshegs/'gom dgon du gdung rten la gser gdung cha brgyad bzhengs/ da lta 'bri gung sgrub grwa'i slob dpon so bdun pa dge slong bkra shis rab brtan mchog rje 220

'di'i yang srid yin zhes gsungs/ rje nyid kyi sring mo tshang du sku 'khrungs so/skyabs mgon chos kyi blo gros mchog rang dgon du phebs par ma gsal kyang / rje nyid kyis/ nga da res phebs ma grub kyang 'di rnams phul gsungs/phye phur chung chung zhig gis gtsos nyer mkho 'ga' gnang /'bri gung gdan rabs so drug pa skyabs mgon zhi ba'i blo gros ni/ chu 'brug lor gdan sa'i khrir bkod nas/ gzhung nas gser zhwa dang rta ber dang bcas mtshan gnas phul/ spyi lo 1909rab byung bco lnga pa sa byi lor nags shod 'gom dgon du chibs bskyod gnang nas rang dgon du 'dus pa gzhis byes la rang lugs chos brgyud khag gi bka' dbang dang bka' khrid bcas legs par bstsal nas 'bri rdzong du chibs bskyod/ zhib par rnam thar mjal bar ma mchis pas de tsam mo/nags shod 'gom dgon chos 'khor byams pa gling dgon pa'i grub dbang dkon mchog bzod pa mchog ni/ spyi lo 1ra72rab byung bco lnga chu bya lor yab mdan ma 'phel len dang yum mtshan ldan ma gnyis kyi sras su 'gom leng drug las dkar gzhung du sku 'khrungs/ ri dbang dkon mchog 'jigs bral las rab tu byung snyam/ rang dgon du phebs nas spyi chen khag dang zhabs zhu'i las gnas rnams yongs su thon/ 'don dbyangs dang 'don rgyun bzang ba'i dbu khri pa'i las gnas dang / dgon gyi bla tshab bcas yongs su thon nas/ rta sna'i sras dar ma las 'ja' tshon sngon 'gro zhig zhus/ 'bri gung thel du phebs nas sgrub grwa'i slob dpon khri thog so sum pa tshe brtan 'og ma'i zhabs la gtugs nas phyag chen chos drug dang dgongs pa yang zab sogs rang lugs sgrub grwa'i khyad chos kun dang thun min zab chos khag rnams zhus/ de skabs 'bri gung du 'di yin med pa'i snyung gzhi cung zad byung bas 221

sku khams ma bde/ tshe brtan rin po che nas khyod la yul lha'i rjes 'bem zhig 'dug pas nags shod dgon gsar du bzhugs na 'gro don che bar lung bstan/ rje nyid tshur phebs pas sku khams ma bde ba ci yang ma byung / rang dgon du phebs nas them spangs 'dag sbyar gyi tshe mtshams su bzhugs/ rang dgon du phyag chen chos drug yang zab sogs kyi khrid lung bstsal nas slar yang 'dir sgrub pa'i phyag rjes bzang po bzhag nags shod stod smad bar gsum gyis gtsos sa phyogs rnams su grub dbang bzod pa rin po che zhes kun gyi mchod gnas su gyur/ ma 'ongs sngon gzigs mnga' bas rnam rgyal nyi ma rje nyid kyi chu len byed skabs/ khyod da lta rgyu med bsam gyi 'dug gam/ ma 'ongs pa na rgyu chen po 'ongs gsungs pa dang / dbu rgan mthar phyin la/ kho rjes ma rma swa gcig 'don dbang med skabs phung po ga ti tshar re gnyis gsungs na 'grig ces dang / dbu bstan pa dar rgyas la nam zhig tshig 'bru re 'dri sa mi rnyed pa 'ong gsungs/ des mtshon thun mong du ma 'ongs sngon gzigs mang bar gsungs/ thun min du sa lam drod rtags sogs mtha' yas mnga' yang de tsam mo/ slob ma ni rang grol rin po che dang / ri dbang dkon mchog bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang / bo ngan mtshams pa bsam gtan dang / mtshams pa nges don sogs slob tshogs mang / mthar spyi lo 1956me sprel zla ba dang po'i tshes nyi shu dgu la grub dbang rin po che nas/nye gnas 'do pa dge rgan la/ kho de ring nga'i dbugs 'di ma 'dra tsam mi 'dug gam zhes gsungs pas/ ngas mi shes zhus/ da khyod song la 'tsham pa nges don lan gcig phul/ gzhan rang dgon pa'i dgu gtor la zing ma slong gsungs/ 'tsham pa nges don phebs nas rje nyid sku drang por srang thugs mnyam pa chen po chos kyi dbyings su thim mo/ mtshams pa nges don nas thugs 222

dam gsal 'debs zhus nas bdun gcig thugs dam ma grol/ zhal chems ltar sku gdung bya gtor du phul/ gdung rten gang yang ma bzhengs gsungs kyang / sku mched nas rten 'brel ma legs dgongs nas/ dngul dkar sogs yo chas rnams bsags kyang dbu chen nas tshur ma 'byor bar lnga bcu nga dgu'i dus 'gyur byung nas ma grub/ rje nyid kyi ma 'ongs mngon gzigs yin par da gzod rtogs/ rje nyid kyi dbu thod da lta rang dgon du bzhugs/dbu dkon mchog rig 'dzin rin po che ni ka mdo grong du sku 'khrungs/chung dus nas rang dgon du bsgrig bzhugs mdzad nas rang lugs 'don chos khag la dpyid phyin par mdzad pa dang chos phyogs kyi sgrub pa nyams su bstar bas rtogs pa mngon du gyur/ sbas pa'i rnal 'byor chen por gyur/spyan snga dang mngon shes lnga dang ldan zhes sprul bsgyur nus shing mngon shes mnga' ba'i rnam thar mang bar bzhugs yod/ 'bri gung thel du phebs skabs sbra kha ru grub dbang dpa' chung rin po che phyugs rdzi mdzad bzhin mchis pa dang / dgongs mo nang la 'byor skabs/ dbu rig 'dzin gyis mdo bsdud pa gsungs ba'i skabs dang 'khel bas/ tshig 'bru gsal zhing gdangs dbyangs snyan pas yid dbang 'phrog pa dang / chos la 'jug pa'i bag chags sad pas/dper na ri mtho po zhig nas bltas pa lta bu'i zang thal chen po'i spro ba ster/rje dpa' chung rin po ches dbu rig 'dzin ni gzhan las khyad du 'phags pa'i skyes bu dam pa yin zhes gsungs/ sku tshe smad du spyan long yang sngar ltar mchod pa bzhengs pa dang kha lag bzo ba bcas la thogs pa med zhing ngo mtshar mtha' yas/bo ngan mtshams pa bsam gtan ni dkar gzhung bo ngan tshang du sku 'khrungs/ chung dus tshong las dang rgyu nor gsog pa la mkhas/ de nas nges 223

'byung gi bskul nas rdza dpa' sprul rin po che'i sku mdun nas chos 'brel gang zab dang / de rjes grub dbang bzod pa rin po che las dam chos dgongs pa yang zab kyi chos skor zhus nas sgrub la gzhol pas rang dbang thob pa'i grub pa brnyes/ sku cung zad snyung ba'i tshul bstan nas grub dbang mchog gi yab tshang du mgyogs po yong dgos pa'i bang chen btang / dbu mthar phyin nas bka' dbang 'ga' phul/ khong gis de ring dbu rgan ngag dbang phebs 'dug pas gdan drangs shog gsungs pas phebs/ dkar gzhung nas spun mched cig phebs pa de rnga yang gi yar 'og der dro tshugs brgyab pas/ da kho slebs ma song gsungs nas 'ding ba dang chos gos sku la gsol nas sku drang por bsrang /yi dam lha'i bsdu rim gyi ngang du dgongs pa chos kyi dbyings su thim zhing sbas pa'i rnal 'byor chen po yin pas/ rang dgon 'dus pa rnams kyis de tsam yod pa zhes dad pa'i sa la bkod/ nyin gsum la thugs dam bzhugs pas zhal mdangs sngar las legs shing / byang sems dkar dmar dang chab sogs babs nas thugs dam grol/ sku phung dur khrod du gdan drangs nas lus sbyin du btang /spu tsha mtshams pa nges don rin po che ni/ song khog tu sku 'khrungs zhing /chos khungs 'gom dgon du yin pas sgrig bzhugs mdzad/ mi thog kun la grwa rgyun ma chad pa zhig yin/ dgon pa'i las sne dang thon sgo yongs rdzogs thon pa dang / dbu bzod pa rin po che rtsa ba'i bla mar bkur nas dam chos rdzogs pa chen po yang zab kyi chos skor rnams zhus nas sgrub pa la brtson pas rtogs pa mngon du gyur/ tshe dang sgrub pa mnyam pa'i thugs bzhed yod kyang / spu tsha tshang du ri dbang rin po che sku 'khrungs bas yongs 'dzin mdzad/ khong ni rig gnas kun la mkhyen rgya che zhing / gdams ngag gleng mol tshul du gsungs ba'i 224

khyad chos can zhig yin pas da lta dgon gyi lo rgyus dang / rten gsum gyi bkod pa bcas zhal rgyun mang / mthar spyi lo 1kha57me bya lor dgongs pa chos kyi dbyings su thim pas thugs dam nyin shas bzhugs nas de skabs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas bzang du ma byung /dbu mdzad 'od srung rin po che ni yab mdan ma 'phel len sras su dkar gzhung du sku 'khrungs/ lce la a rang byung yod pa g.yog mo'i nu ma nud nas med par gyur/ rang dgon du phebs nas rab tu byung bas mi brjed pa'i gzung thob/ cho ga chos spyod la thugs 'dzin mdzad nas/ rang dgon pa'i dbu mdzad kyi khrir phebs/ 'don chos sogs slob dpon ar rgod dbu mdzad yin zhing / gsung skad snyan zhing nyan pa po yang dbang med du dad pa'i mig chu 'khor zhing dge ba la 'god pa'i mthu mnga'/ 'gom dgon chos 'khor byams pa gling dgon pa'i cho ga rgyud sde kun gyi gzhung gtug sa dang gzhi 'dzin sa zhig yin pas/ sgrub mchod khag la phebs nas 'don dbyangs la do khur dang gsar bu la zhib slob sogs mdzad kyi yod pas/ dbu mdzad khong rnams pa'i sku ring la/ dbugs kyi gtong mtshams/ lus po'i stangs stabs/gre ldeb kyi dam lhod/ 'gyur khug gi snyan 'gyur/ gdangs dang dbyangs kyi bye brag zhi drag gi gshis dang / mdor na mdo dang rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i phyag len ma 'khrul ba bzhugs pa ni 'bri gung bka' brgyud pa'i chos srol thub bstan yang ri sgar dang dbyer ma mchis shing / snyan brgyud gdams pa 'di rnams gra ma chag zur ma nyams par gnas/ lhag tu bka' brgyud pa'i bla mar mos gus gdung ba'i gsol 'debs res/ rgyud la bla ma'i byin rlabs 'jug cing mos gusagater kha rdol ba sogs khyad chos thun min mang po bzhugs/ dbu 'od srung mchog sku tshe'i smad du rang dgon pa'i slob dpon mdzad nas/ slob ma 225

rnams la slob khrid skabs rgyud la zhi gnas ldan pas zas spyod sogs yid la med par slob rgyud smar/ de skabs su dbu mdzad rnams kyis gcig gyur 'don chos bzang bas/ dper na bde mchog gi 'char gshis dang / chos spyod mi 'gyur chos sku/ bde gshegs dgra bcom/ yang zab bskang zlogabastan ma/ de bzhin bskang gso khag re re ltar khyad chos phun sum tshogs pas dbu mdzad rnams pas phan tshun 'di lta bu dbu mdzad khong gi sku mdun nas zhu dgos/ 'di dang 'di lta bu dbu mdzad khong gi mdun nas zhus zhes/ rjes su dbu rgan rnams pas gsan nas gsar bu pas rgyug 'bul skabs skyon sel mdzub btsugs kyi slob ston yang gnang gi yod/ sngon dus su 'gom dgon pa'i dbu mdzad ces snyan grags che ba byung ba ni gong gi mdzad bzang las byung ba shes dgos la de ltar slob sbyong dgos pa nges par shes dgos/ slob ma ni grub dbang dkon mchog chos bzang mchog dang / dbu mthar phyin/ dbu dkon mchog tshul khrims/ dbu lha srung sogs de skabs slob rgyud thams cad yin/ mthar rig gsar gong du dgongs pa chos kyi dbyings su thim/bang sba rgan dbu mdzad bstan 'dzin ni/ yab rgyal chung dang / yum 'o ma gnyis kyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ chung nas rang dgon du rab tu byung nas dbu mdzad kyi khrir 'khod/ thugs rig bkra ba dang gsung skad snyan pas/'don rta dbyangs sogs la shin tu mkhas pa'i tshad du 'dzin zhing dbu 'od srung dang mtshungs par phugs gtug sa zhig yin la dbyangs pa'i dbu mdzad sogs mdzad nas rang dgon du bka' drin che/ /'cham dpon skal bzang ni 'og mar 'khrungs/ khong gi sku gzugs la bde rgyug dang ldan pas rang dgon gyi gar 'cham la mkhas shing lo 'brong ngur dgon pa'i 'cham gyi dge rgan mdzad/ de skabs lo thub dbang rin po che nas/226

skabs 'gar 'brong ngur grwa pa rnams dgon gsar du yong nas 'chams lo rer 'cham dpon gcig gdan drangs nas 'brong bu dgon du 'cham pa sogs gcig mtshungs du mdzad nas 'cham rnams khungs 'gom dgon du gtugs/ de min sgrub brgyud dgon sogs mdo khams rang lugs dgon gnas khag gi gar 'cham 'di nas sbyangs zhes gsungs/ya ho byang chub bla rgan ni gnas shod du sku 'khrungs nas rang dgon du sgrig bzhugs/ thugs sems drang zhing / dkon mchog la mi phyed pa'i dad pa ldan/ dbon po sprul skus thub pa chen po zhal mjal ba'i gang zag khyad par can zhig yin par lung bstan/ rang dgon pa'i bla grwa yongs kyis byang chub rin po che zhes gus bkur bla na med par zhu/'bri gung gdan rabs so brgyad pa brgyad ra mchog sprul dkon mchog thub bstan dbang po ni/ spyi lo 1kha24shing byi lor sku 'khrungs nas skyabs rje rnam gnyis las rab tu byung / 'gom dgon chos 'khor byams pa gling du 'gom bla'i khri 'dzin du phebs nas lo gsum bzhugs/ shing sprel lo'i cho 'phrul zla ba'i yar tshes brgyad la rgyal tshab tu mnga' gsol nas gdan sar bzhugs pas 'phrin las che/nags shod dbu mdzad chos grags ni nags shod du sku 'khrungs nas rang dgon pa'i dbu mdzad kyi khrir phebs/ 'bri gung du tshe brtan rin po che'i zhabs la gtugs nas bka' brgyud chos srol khag gi mnga' bdag tu gyur/'bri gung lcang lo mkhan pos gdan drangs nas bka' 'bum khag dang /dgongs gcig khrid lung sogs zab chos rnams bka' khrid gnang / zhib par rnam thar rgyas par ma mjal kyang / grub dbang dkon mchog skal bzang mchog gi rnam thar du rje nyid dang lcang lo mkhan sprul rnam gnyis kyis bla mar 227

bkur bas rang lugs bshad sgrub la mkhas shing dam pa'i skyes bu zhig yin par smos ma dgos/ /skyen pa dbu mdzad dkon mchog shes rab ni spyi lo 19rkya7lo rab byung bco lnga me lug lor nags shod nyang khu gzhung du mtshan dpe'i bzhad/ chung dus nas rang dgon du sgrig bzhugs mdzad/ rnam rig bkra bas 'don chos la sbyangs brtson gnang / ar rgod dbu mdzad dang / dbu 'od srung bcas slob dpon du bsten nas dgung lo bco lnga la dbu khri pa'i khrir 'khod/ de rjes dbyangs pa'i dbu mdzad gnang / thugs nges brtan pas thos pa tsam gyis don rtogs nus pa'i khyad chos ldan/ de skabs rang dgon du chos spyod cho ga khag gi khung gtugs sar gyur/ de tsam gyis thugs ma tshims par sog ka chen mtshams pa las sman gzhung rgyud bzhi'i gzhung lag len dang bcas pa sbyangs pa mdzad/ 'bri ru rdzong stag brag lde 'chang gi drung yig sku mdun nas sum rtags dag gsum dang / snyan ngag bcas zhus pas/ lan gcig khrid pa tsam gyis thugs su chud pas drung yig ha las/ de nas 'gro ba nad pa rnams la mgon skyabs lta bur gyur nas 'gro don che yang / 'bri gung nyi ma lcang rwa'i bshad grwar phebs/ gzhung chen bcu gsum la sbyangs pas shin tu mkhas par gyur nas dga' ldan pa'i dge bshes rnams dang rtsod pas bod gzhung nas pha yul du 'gro dgos pa'i bka' btang / yongs 'dzin a yang thub bstan sku mdun nas 'bri lugs sman sbyor khag dang zab gnad mang po'i lung khrid rgyas pa dang / lha ldan sman rtsis khang gi mkhas dbang mkhyen rab nor bu'i sku mdun nas rgyud bzhi dog sel bcas rgyug 'bul zhus nas legs so ster/rang dgon nas dbu shes rab grongs pa 'dra zer nas nyer spyod rnams tshogs mdo la 'bul grabs byed dus rang dgon du phyag phebs/ zas dug dang 228

bcos dka'i nad rigs la shin tu mkhas pa dang / rgyu med pa'i nad pa la yang zas sman gos gsum gnang ba dang / skyes rabs dpag bsam 'khri shing sogs zhal thang mang bar bzhengs/ mkhas dbang mchog gis rang dgon 'di nyid 'dus sde mang zhing dar rgyas che ba'i skabs 'di la sgrub mchod khag gcig pus chog par mi 'dzin par rang dgon du rig gnas slob gso mtho ru gtong phyir/ bshad grwa 'dzugs pa'i 'dun ma shar/ rgyal tshab brgyad ra mchog sprul rin po che gdan zhu dang / mkhan po 'bri gung nas gtong rgyu bcas mdzad/ 'du khang gi rgyab rwa khang du bshad grwa khang bzhengs rgyu'i sbyin bdag nang chen dkon mchog tshul khrims nas zhus/ grwa pa khag gcig sman sbyong rgyu dang / khag gcig gzhung sbyang mkhan gyi grwa sgrig mdzad kyang / bod spyi dang 'dra bar lnga bcu nga dgu'i dus 'gyur byung nas rang dgon pa'i dbu shes rab kyis gtsos pa'i bla grwa rnams 'bri ru sbyong brdar 'dzin grwar zhugs dgos pas/ btson du cung snyung bas lha dog yin pa 'dra gsungs/ nyin bzhin snyung gzhi sdug ru phyin nas gzhung gis sman khang du khrid kyang ma phan par dgung lo lnga bcu nga gsum la 'bri ru rdzong khrims mun du sku gshegs/ dbu ngag dbang mchog gis rang gi slob dpon sku gshegs par shes nas skad sgyur brgyud sku phung bdag pa'i chog mchan thob nas/ yid sdug bsngal gyi khung bur chud pa las thabs gzhan ma byung bar/ sku phung bya gtor bya rgyu'i gnang ba byung nas 'bri ru'i dur khrod brag yog der gdan drangs kyang nam mkhar bya rgod gcig kyang ma byung / sems skyo ba ni tshad las 'das/ dgong mo nyi ma zhud la nye skabs der/ gang byung med pa'i rgod thang dkar zhig gis sna drangs nas skad cig la gtsang mar byas nas dbu ngag dbang ni dga' skyo 'dres ma'i ngang du mar phebs/ de ltar skyes bu dam pa de nyid thugs dam ma grol ba'i rang 229

rtegs yin pa gzhi nas shes so/sku gsung thugs rten/'du khang khyams chen nang gi rten gtso thub dbang bstan 'byung rgya gar shar li las grub pa byis tshad tsam khri rgyab yol dang nor bu'i phra rgyan sna tshogs kyis mdzes pa dang / gser zangs las grub pa'i chos sku rdo rje 'chang gi sku mi tshad tsam dang / gzhan yang te lo dang / nā ro/ mar pa/ mi la/ dwags po/phag gru sogs bka' brgyud gser phreng gi bla rabs rnams bzhugs/ 'du khang gi dkyil gyi rten gtso rje dkon mchog ratnas spyi lo 1620lcags rta lor bzhengs pa/ rje skyob pa'i dar sku chen motsho de yin la/ gzungs bzhugs khyad par 'phags pa dang / lhag tu nor gzi byis drod ma dang / ye shes pa bzhugs pa'i rtags su drod dang ldan/ sngon dgon du thog lhung skabs skyob pa'i sku nas thog chu sa la 'gril ba bcas ngo mtshar/ g.yas su skyabs mgon 'phrin las bzang po'i sman sku de bzhengs nas/ rje nyid rang dgon du gdan 'dren zhus pas/ skyabs mgon nas khyed tsho'i sku de nga 'dra po yod pas gsungs nas bzhad pas rang dgon gyi 'dra sku yang bzhad/ rje nyid kyis khyod rnams phar log la zla ba gsum pa'i tshes gsum la rab gnas mdzad 'ong gsungs nas khong rnams tshur log pas/ rab gnas kyi me tog dgon pa'i steng shod bar gsum du babs nas ye shes pa bzhugs pa'i rtags su 'ja' 'od kyi gur phub pa sogs ngo mtshar che bar byung / g.yon du skyabs mgon rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa rang dgon du bzhugs skabs bzhengs nas nyid kyi rab gnas mdzad/ khyed nga dang e 'dra gsungs pas/ skus nga 'dra zhes/gsung byon nga 'dra ma de rje nyid dang dbyer med pa'i sku byin can de bzhugs/230

de min gnas rten bcu drug gu ru mtshan brgyad/ tshe lha rnam gsum/ sgrol dkar sngon/ sman bla/ rigs gsum mgon po sogs gser sku dang li ma/sman sku bcas brgya phrag 'ga' bzhugs/ khyad par du gnam lcags las grub pa gshin rje tshe bdag sku gru tshad ma byin can dang / 'du khang sbug g.yas rigs gsum mgon po'i sman sku thog tshad ma dang / 'du khang gi ldebs bris thub pa'i mdzad pa bcu gnyis/ sangs rgyas byang sems dang / chos srung khag bcas tshon mdangs rnam par bkra/ thog 'khor du bka' brgyud bla rabs rnams dang rgyan drug mchog gnyis/ skyabs mgon bstan 'dzin 'gro 'dul mchog gi phyag gnang 'dod lha'i sku thang bdun tshar/ sbub chal/ gos 'phan/rje chos kyi nyi ma'i phyag gnang pad 'byung a ti ma dang / sa gsum ma'i sku thang /theg chen gan dril/ ka 'phan/ snam sbyar bzhi/ gdugs gnyis/ rnga 'cham/rgyab dar/ rten rol 'phyar dar/ rgyal mtshan/ 'dod lha'i sku thang bdun tshar/ gos 'phan bcas dang / skyabs mgon pad ma'i rgyal mtshan gyis phyag gnang bzang gos snam sbyar/ bla bre che legs/ phod ka bzhi/ rten khebs dang / gnas rten bcu drug bcas bzhugs/ 'du khang gi shar nub gnyis su rin thang bral ba'i rin chen sna lnga'i bka' bstan tshar gcig dang / bka' 'gyur bris ma tshar gcig 'bum gser bris/ mtshal dpar sogs bka' bstan tshar gsum/ 'bum tshar grangs so sum/ 'gro mgon bka' brgyud pa'i chos srol phal che ba/ rje chos kyi grags pa'i rnam thar pod gcig bcas bzhugs/'du khang gi sbug g.yas gtsang khang ni sngon srung ma khang zhes zhu la/ de rjes mgon po'i gtor khag tshogs pas mgon po khang zhes 'bod/ rten gtso 231

ye shes mgon po phyag bzhi pa de stag phu padma badzra mchog gi zhal nas a tsi de 'dra'i zhed pa la 'di 'dra ngas mjal ma myong gsungs/ na len dra'i mgon po dang dbyer ma mchis pa gtso 'khor gsum dang / g.yas su nam mkha' mthing bzang dang / rga ba dbu mdzad kyi phyag bzo bde mchog yab yum/ de'i g.yon du chos kyi sgrol ma/ zhal bzang dbyings phyug de'i g.yon du skyi ru mtshams pa bstan 'dzin rin po che'i gdung rten mchod rten cha brgyad/ a tsa dpal ldan grags pa'i tsan dan las grub pa'i slob dpon padma'i sku dang tshe bum/ skyen pa a gdong gi spyan ras gzigs phyag stong spyan stong gser sku khra can/ bo ngan mtshams pa bsam gtan nas bzhengs pa'i slob dpon sku dang sgrol ma'i sku bcas bzhugs/ ar rgod gang skyid kyis bzhengs pa'i spyan ras gzigs dngul sku dang gser gdung khra can/ dbu ngag dbang dang dge slong brtson 'grus gnyis kyi gser gdung gru tshad re/ gu ru'i sku li ma bcas bzhugs/ gzhan yang 'bri gung bla rabs gong ma'i gdung rten dang gser sku chung chung mang / gsung rten du rje gong ma'i bka' 'bum pod brtsigs ma dang / gnam lding la sbyar ba'i rten sgam zhes gong sa lnga pa dang / rje dkon mchog rin chen/ chos kyi grags pa/ 'phrin las bzang po/ don grub chos rgyal/ bstan 'dzin 'gro 'dul rnams kyi sku bal ring bsrel dam sbyar ma dang /spyan gzigs dpa' rtul rnams kyi go mtshon cha tshang brgyad/ ldebs bris su chos srung khag dang / lhag tu chos skyong rtsi'u dmar dngos su bzhugs pa'i ldebs bris 'di bskang gso la sogs spyan 'dren skabs su 'gul ba sogs byed/ de min bskang 'dos chen mo dang / mgon po'i gtor khag yo chas cha tshang bcas bzhugs/232

'du khang sbug g.yon gtsang khang ni gdan rabs khang zhes sam kha cig gis rigs lnga'i lha khang zhes 'bod/ phyis su khro bcu'i gtor bzlog tshugs pas khro bcu khang zhes zhu/ rten gtso thub pa'i dbang po gtso 'khor gsum gser zangs las grub pa dang / khyab bdag padma'i rgyal mtshan/ skyabs mgon thugs rje'i nyi ma/ skyabs mgon chos kyi blo gros/ brgyad ra dkon mchog rin chen/ ri dbang dam chos nyi ma bcas kyi gser gdung dang /dngul gdung bcas rin chen sna lnga'i phra rgyan sna tshogs/ phyogs gcig na sgam dam sbyar ma zhes g.yag la thug par brtsegs/ de rnams ban dpon phan tshun dam drug lta ba las nang du rin thang bral ba'i dngos rdzas yin pa bshad pa tsam las mthong ba nyung / nang rten gtso bo gnam lcags las grub pa rdo rje dang phur pa/ phar phyin las bla ma yi dam gyi zhal thang / 'cham chas 'tshem bu med pa sna gsum/ gser skud kyi mdzes rgyan sprad pa'i 'cham gos/ gos chen ring thang bral ba'i 'cham gos gsar rnying sum brgya/ rus rgyan dang phyag mtshan sogs ha cang mang / de min sgrub mchod khag gi mchod chas cha tshang sgam re/ chags ri dbang po'i dngul bum gser tshag can/ se ra thub dbang dngul gyi rkang gling sprel thod can/ 'phen bla bre dang / phye phur rgyal mtshan sogs ser sbreng yo chas cha tshang bzhi/ gzhan yang dngul gyi dung chen dang /zangs dung dngul shan can/ stong dung gser tshag can/ dngul gyi rgya gling dang bsu sna sogs mang / 'du khang sbrug g.yon der thang sgrom nang du bris rgyun sna tshogs kyi zhal thang mang / de min chos gos le'u can dang / sgom zhwa nyis brgya lhag pa/ 'du khang gi ka ba'i ka shubs 'go rnam dmar po spus ldan/de'i 'og spub khang du mgon po'i phan bde snyan grags sam dgra sdig zhes 233

gser khyim can/ a phyi'i srid gsum tshangs dbyangs/ ma yum dgongs rdzogs dkar mo/ khro bcu'i sbug rgan/ drag po'i dmar sgor/ sgro ba smin grol/ sil nyer hor sil chen mo/ hor phrug 'brug ris can/ bskang bshags dkar sgor sogs rol mo brgya lhag yod/ mdun phyogs nas gser rnga 'brug ris can zhes 'bri rnga sum cu/ 'du khang gi sgo 'phyor la rgyal chen sde bzhi'i ldebs bris/ thub dbang rin po che'i phyag 'dud ral gri/ gser bris shan sbyar sgo byang / sga ra nyag sprul sku'i sbos thung / klu'i gnod pa zlog byed bya khyung bcas dang / steng du rdo rje dbyings zhes rgya khra 'khor mar bcas bzhugs/thog brtsegs gnyis par 'bag khang dang / bka' brgyad khang /mgon khang bcas yod pa las/ 'bag khang ni snyan grags che ba'i 'gom sos gter chen mo'i gsar rnying gi zhal 'bag cha tshang dang de'i nyer 'kho sogs mang /bka' brgyad khang ni rten gtso gser gar lugs byas pa'i gshin rje sde drug dang / bka' brgyad thang nag gser bris ma/ gtor khag yo chas bcas bzhugs/mgon khang ni chos srung khag 'phrin bcol zhu yul yin zhing / rten gtso gser gar lugs kyi phag gru dang / chos kyi grags pa bcas bka' brgyud gong ma'i bla rabs sor lnga tsam dang / de min gser gar lugs kyi dzam lha'i sku mtho gang bcas bzhugs/ bskang gso'i gzhung ltar chos srung khag gi sku dang /bskang rdzas dang / spyan gzigs go mtshon dang / khrab rmog rten 'dzugs bcas yod pa dang / rgya bza' kong jo'i sho dang sho gdan sho phor bcas cha tshang / rma bya'i dbu gdugs gser gyi dra phyed can/ gong mas gnang bar 234

grags pa'i dkar yol yu ring gdan khebs cha tshang / bzo dbyibs mi 'dra ba'i sder tshe khag dang / mdo chen dpa' bo bcu gsum gyi sil snyan/ bla ma yi dam chos srung gi zhal thang rtsa chen 'ga'/ de min bsang gsol dang g.yang bskyob nor bu mchog rgyal mchod chas cha tshang bcas bzhugs/sum thog tu rtse gzims chung dang / bar khyams bde yang 'khyil/gsol thab khang bcas yin/ gzims chung gsang sngags theg mchog nyi 'od rtser/ sbug g.yas su rje rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa'i sgrub khang / gshin rje'i mun mtshams zhugs yul yin/ rten gtso thub pa'i dbang po dang / rdo rje 'chang nas skyob pa'i bar bka' brgyud pa'i bla rabs dang / yi dam 'khor lo bde mchog dril bu lha lnga dang / lha drug cu/ gsang 'dus/ gu ru mtshan brgyad/ gu ru gtso 'khor gsum/ gnas brtan bcu drug sgrol lha nyer gcig bcas gser zangs dang li ma las grub/ dkyil du bzhugs khri'i steng du gser zangs las grub pa'i chos kyi grags pa'i sku/ gzim sgrom dang mdun lcog steng du ḍa dril dang rnga rol bcas cha tshang bzhugs/ rje nyid kyi shangs khragagis bris pa gu ru drag po/ de min gshin rje'i zhal thang dang / mtshan brgyad/ tshe dpag med/ rta phag yab yum/ tshe lha rnam gsum ldebs bris su bkod yod pa dang / rje nyid kyi sgrub gtor bzhugs pa'i gtor sgrom dang /chos srung khag gi zhal 'bag zhal thang su/ rje btsun mi la'i rnam thar/bde chen zhing bkod dang / spyan ras gzigs kyi zhing bkod/ rta phur gshin gsum dang zhi khro/ shel brag bka' thang gi bkod pa/ rgyud sde so so'i dkyil 'khor zhal thang bcas bzhugs/ bar khyams bde yang 'khyil ni skyabs mgon rnam pa'i zhabs gras rnams bzhugs sa yin/ gsol thab khang ni ja ma 235

sogs gsol chas bzo ba'i thab tshang lta bu yin/ de'i g.yon du bzhi thog dang / dbu rtser gan ji ra che gsum las/ dwags po lcags lung dgon pa'i gan ji ra gser nag las grub pa 'dom phyed tsam dang / gru bzhir gser gyi rgyal mtshan bzhi/ a mgon chos gsum dang grib btsan bcas kyi rten thug bcas rnam rgyal khang bzang la 'gran pa lta bu'i brjid chags rnam par bkra/shod du bde ba'i rab gsal zhes steng 'og rnams 'gom bla'i bzhugs yul dang / 'cham po sgang zhes spyi gso khag gi bzhugs yul dang / dgon gzhung gi thab tshang ka ba bzhi dang khro dang zangs bcas thab chas gra rgyas phun sum tshogs po bcas bzhugs/chos spyod nyams len dang sgrub mchod khaganags shod 'gom dgon chos 'khor byams pa gling dgon ni 'gro ba'i mgon po rgyal ba bka' brgyud pa'i nang gses/ gangs ri'i khrod na sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa'i mnga' bdag dpal 'bri gung bka' brgyud pa'i ring lugs dri ma med pa 'dzin skyong gnang ba'i chos sde che gras shig yin pas/rang re'i chos srol ni/ ston pa nas sgra can zin las rgyud pa'i so thar dang /'jam mgon klu sgrub nas rgyud pa zab mo lta rgyud/ byams mgon thogs med nas rgyud pa rgya chen spyod rgyud/ 'jam dbyangs nas zhi ba lhar rgyud pa rlabs chen zung 'jug gi rgyud pa bcas jo bo bka' gdams pa la brgyud pa yin te/de la yang gzhung pa dang / gdams ngag pa/ lam rim bcas rgyu mtshan nyid theg pa'i brgyud pa dang / rdo rje 'chang nas bka' babs bzhi'i brgyud pa bka' babs nyams kyi brgyud pa/ rdo rje 'chang nas te lo ba la brgyud pa rtogs pa don gyi brgyud pa/ mar mi dwags gsum las nyams len byin rlabs 236

brgyud pa bcas brgyud pa drug ldan don gyi brgyud pa las tshig gi brgyud pa ma yin pas/ lta ba rnam dag dbu ma'i brgyud pa/ sgom pa rnam dag gsang sngags kyi brgyud pa/ spyod pa rnam dag pha rol phyin pa'i brgyud pa/ tshang la ma nor pa tshe gcig lus gcig rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang dam par bgrod pa'i gdams mchog bla na med pa yin te/ klu sgrub gnyis pa skyob pa 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po yab sras nas mdo sngags lam rim thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan zhes dang / zab lam nā ro'i chos drug gnyis la gnad du bsnun nas/ rgyab chos la bka' brgyud gong ma'i zab chos khag dang / lhag tu dam chos dgongs pa gcig pa/ theg chen bstan pa'i snying pos gtsos 'brel yod gzhung 'grel khag la sbyang brtson dang / zab mo rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor las mi 'da' bar mdzad pa'i sgrub pa'i srol bzang rnams mi nyams par 'dzin skyong bya rgyu yin pa'i thog rang dgon du sgrub mchod khag rim par dar/ /lo ltar sgrub mchod sogs las bya rim pa/thun mong ma yin pa'i lhag pa'i lha mchog dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi sgrub mchod btsugs nas bzung rim par dar ba mngon/ hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes nyer lnga la 'gro mgon bka' brgyud pa'i yi dam dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi sgrub mchod thig chog gsungs/ thig pa bzhis rdul mtshon grabs nas skya thig dang rdul mtshon dkyil 'khor zhib tshags par bzhengs/ chab ra bas 'du khang phyi nang tshang mar gad phyis dang / phye phur sogs mchod rdzas gra rgyas bshams/ hor zla dang po'i tshes gcig gi zhogs tshogs skabs bla brang nas 'dus pa la lo gsar 'bul/ dbu chos nas sa chog dang rdul mtshon 237

mchod bstod/ 'dus pa nas bla brang la lo gsar 'bul/ phyi dro gral 'dzin byas/ nyin ltar cho ga dang chos spyod khag gi gdangs dbyangs gra rgyas dang sgrub po rnams zab 'phyor legs par bzhes nas dus ston gtso bo zhig yin/ ser sbreng dang bcas tshes bcu la dkyil 'khor chur sbyangs/ 'cham dang dung kha rgyang gling gsar pa rnams 'cham yig sgrog tshes bcu gcig nas nyin bdun la 'cham sbyangs/ tshes bco brgyad la gsar bu'i dung rgyang gling dang 'cham bcas las sne yongs la rgyug sprod 'bul nas chad gcod dang gzengs bstod bya/ /rang dgon du sngon sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzugs pa'i srol las de tsam rgyun tshogs gra rgyas dang bsrung zlog khag de tsam med kyang / rje rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa'i rang rnam las/ gzhan yang gnas skabs de rnams su rang srid nyams dma' zhing sog po kha dan sogs bod sog kun gyi za rgyu 'bri gung par byed pa zhig yod pas zla ba ngo re bzhin 'byed dkrug bskrad mnan drag po mngon spyod kyi las sbyor kho nar rgyab 'tshol dgos pa zhig yod ces gsungs pa ltar/ rgyal dbang rin chen phun tshogs nas bzung bka' brgyad dar nas/rim par 'bri gung pa'i chos brgyud khag rnams la de dang mtshungs par gtor bzlog khag mang po 'dzugs pa'i srol dar/ de skabs su phyogs khag gi dgon pa rnams thub bstan yang ri sgar pa'i sgrig srol dang / chos lugs byed sgo rnams til la til mar tshul du gnas pa yin te/ dper na sngon yang ri sgar du rgan mos zhing phul nas tshogs gseng du ma ṇi 'don par zhus pas/ tshogs dus re'i mjug tu ma ṇi gsungs pa de yang rang dgon du ma nyams rgyun gnas kyis mtshon thub pa yin la/ rang re chos bzhugs khag yang ri sgar du 'gro srol yod pas rgyud sde'i phyag len sogs la mkhas pa'i grags can dbu mdzad 238

mang po yod nges kyang lo rgyus ma mjal/ de dang gcig mtshungs gsar rnying gi gar 'cham dang gtor zlog rnams rim par dar zhing zla ba dang po'i nang /'gom sos gtor chen mo zhes stod smad kun tu grags/ tshes nyer gcig la mchod gtor rnams bzhengs/ phyi dro bka' brgyad chab ril nas rnga brda btang nas gral 'dzin byed/ tshes nyi shu bzhi la chu srin dang / nyer lnga la bka' brgyad gtor chen/ 'cham yig sgrog bla brang nas char can chu bo rgyun 'bab zhes pa gsungs/ dar chen bslangs ba dang rab gnas zhu/ bsrung ba'i skabs su snga dro mgon po'i dbu mdzad la bka' 'dri zhu rgyu dang / phyi dro dang zlog pa'i skabs sogs gtso bo bka' brgyad dbu mdzad la bka' bskor nas ja dang tshogs dus rnams tshod 'dzin bya dgos/ nyis shu bdun nyin gtor mjal zhes zlog gzhung skabs rgya che'i dad ldan rnams kyis phyi nang rten gsum rnams mjal kha zhus nas 'dren byed kyi yul du ngo mtshar che bar 'dzin/phyi dro sgo dbye lta bu/ a tre ra dang / dzam sger don/ a tsa ras so nam las ka lta bu rten 'brel 'ga' dang / shā ba gnyis/ ma he gnyis/ bya seng gnyis de nas gser skyems phebs/ nyi shu brgyad kyi tho rengs su a tsa ra dang / rnga 'cham/ mgon po sger don/ bka' srung sger don/ a phyi'i sger don skabs mi tshogs che bar zab 'phyor dang dga' gus dad gsum gyi spro ba dang bcas mjal kha zhu skabs dad ldan mang tshogs rnams kyis 'phrin bcol zhu/ de nas rnam sras sger don/ zhing skyong sger don/ rgyal skyong sger don/ de nas 'don gong 'og bcas gsar ma'i gar 'cham khag rje 'phrin las bzang po'i sku dus nas gra rgyas byung ba nas bzung dar ba yin/ nyi shu dgu nyin gyi tho rengs su dbyangs pa'i dbu mdzad nas 'cham gtor gdan 'ding rdul mtshon 'bri/ 'cham gtor gdan 'dren/ dbyangs pa'i dbu mdzad nas drang srong 239

dmod ring rgyas bsdus gsum la/ sgo ma bzhis nya bo mgon po khang nas tshugs gsum dang bcas gling du mar 'khyer/ a tsa ra/ dzam gnyis dang rtsed sna/'go brnyan bzhi'i rtsal mchongs/ ma he sger don/ che mchog sger don/ zhwa nag brgyad/ zor 'cham/ rgan khog gnyis/ 'cham rtsa/ sgral 'cham/ rlung nag 'tshubs ma bcas mjug bsdu/ de nas gtor khag rnams kyis gtor chen khag gling du gdan drangs nas/ shin tu 'khrug cha dod la skye g.ya' zhing 'jig zhum pa zhig yod/ dad ldan kun gyi mjal kha phebs mkhan shin tu mang / gnam gang la snga dro so so'i gtang rag dang / yo chas rnams bsdu nyar bya/ phyi dro tshe dbang gnang / 'di ni bsad zlog gi sgrub rim yin zhes gsungs/ dgong mo chos khrims gnyis nas grwa shag tu phebs nas khrims bsdom/ de nas zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes gsum nas bcu bar kun rig tshes brgyad la kun rig bzhi pa dang / tshes dgu la lnga pa/ bcu la bka' dbang bcas gnang / dbu chos nas 'dus grwa yongs rdzogs blo 'dzin rgyug len/'don phog sprod/ dbu khri pa gsar skos blo 'dzin dang 'don dbyangs rnams 'gom blar rgyug 'bul/ ma ṇi sgrub pa nyin bdun nas zla ba gcig bar rim par 'phar ba dang / nyin mtshan chad med mjug tu bka' dbang dang / lo gsum rer dbang chen thengs re bcas yin/ de'i skabs su tshes cha bzang ba'i nyin 'gom bla brang dang las sne bcas bka' gros mdzad nas rang babs las ka'i bkod sgrig gi srung 'dud ja thun bdun par gnang / de rjes gza' tshes skar gsum bzang ba'i dur deru dbu chos gsar pa khri 'don byed rgyu yin pas/ snga nyin mchod khang khag la mchod mjal dang / bca' yig 'gom bla brang nas rtse gzim chung du gdan 'dren/ dbu chos khri 'don gyi nyin der dang po rgyun phyag sogs tshogs thengs gnyis pa tshogs nas thun mtshams bzang 240

por/ dbu chos rnams phyogs gtsang du zhal gzigs nas gdan 'dren zhu/'du khang du mchod mjal zhus nas gral la bzhugs/ bstod pa nyi shu mas dbu bskul nas 'gom bla brang nas bca' yig sgrog dbu chos gsar pa rnams bla brang khag dang las sne sogs nas ja 'dren zhus pa ltar phebs/ dbu chos gsar pas 'don phog sprod rgyu dang / chad gcod bya dga' bcas byed dgos/tshes nyi shu la badzra sgrub pa'i sa chog dang 'khor chen skar me/ phyi dro gral 'dzin bya/ zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes bcu la bka' dbang / bcu gsum nas ser skya pho mo gang bzhugs chog pa'i smyung gnas/ tshes bcu drug zhogs par grol/ gtsug dgu chen mo sngon nyin bdun/ nyin dang por zhal ngo khri pa nas tshogs gtam zhes lugs gnyis kyi bslab bya rgyas pa gnang zhing / dung pa gnyis sogs zab 'phyor gang rgyas/ gtsug dgu 'di skyabs mgon (padma'i rgyal mtshan mchog )gyi dgongs rdzogs yin zhes gang rgyas gtong srol yod/ tshes nyi shu lnga nas bskang bshags nyin bcu gcig tshogs nas lnga pa'i tshes drug la bka' dbang /tshes bdun nas bka' 'gyur dag 'don tshar gnyis dang / rnying ma rgyud 'bum nyin bdun/ tshes bco lnga nas a phyi'i bskang 'dos chen mo tshogs nas bskang gral pa rnams tshogs la phebs dgos/ nyin brgyad par bskang 'dos 'bul/ lo tog dang char chu bzang phyir nyi shar mdor rgya nag chu 'khor 'dzugs rgyu dang / lo gtor 'go 'dzugs nas dbyar zhag don lnga bar chad med gtong dgos/ nyi shu gsum nyin rab gnas dang / dgon gyi rten gsum phyi nang tshang mar khrus gsol dang rab gnas bcas byed/ nyi shu lnga nas spyi gso bcu gnyis gyis mgon khang du g.yang bskyob nor bu mchog rgyal tshogs nas g.yang bskor byed/ de nyin rdor dbyings su 'bum chen sde lnga dag sgrogazhal ngo gral pa nas chu gtor dang brgyad stong gsungs dgos/ ltung bshags 241

cho ga nyin gsum/ tshes brgyad la rnam rgyal stong mchod nyin gnyis/ tshes bcu la sgrol chog tshes bcu gsum la dbyar bsang btang nas 'dus pa mang che ngos dbyar 'brog zhes so so'i pha yul du phebs/ drug pa'i tshes bco lnga nas dbu chos bzhis gtsos pas dge slong bcu dbyar gnas bzhugs/ sngon dus su tshogs bla nas dam chos dgongs gcig sogs khrid srol yod pa 'dra yang da lta dag sgrog lta bu dang / nyin ltar gnas brtan phyag mchod/ de min rang lugs cho ga khag res mos ltar gsungs/ dgon nang du 'dul gzhung ltar bud med ni dgon du 'gro mi chog pa ma gtogs ser skya mchog dman su zhig yin kyang dbyar bdag bla ma dang stobs po la dgongs zhu brgyud dgos/ zla ba bdun pa'i nyi shu dgu la dgag dbye byas nas dbyar shing bsdu/ rgyang grags gcig gi sar phyin nas gnam gang la bla mchod/ tshes gcig la bsang gsol/tshes gnyis la dzam dkar g.yang bskyob bcas byed/ de'i ring la 'dus pa rnams dbyar 'brog 'dus nas dbyar skyid rtsed rigs mang po rtse srol mchis/ston dus su dmigs gsal sgrub mchod gang yang med kyang / dad ldan rnams kyis shi gson dge rtsar rkyen sel dang gnyen bkur nyin tshogs gang byung rnams tshogs srol mchis/ zla ba dgu pa'i nyi shu'i gnyis kyi lha babs dus chen la tshogs dus gnyis dang / 'dus pa yongs nas gtsug lag khang la sku dkar gsol/ nyi shu dgu la dgun bsang 'bul zhing dgun 'brog grol/ zla ba bcu gcig tshes nyi shu nang dgu chung zhes khro bcu'i gtor khag spyi ltar tshogs nas nyer dgu la gtor rdzogs bcas yin/ zla ba bcu gnyis kyi nyi shu'i nang du dbu chos bzhis dbu khri pa'i 'don rgyug cha tshang len/ de ltar lo 'khor sgrub mchod khag gi rim pa rags bsdus tsam zhig bris pa'o/rmabe'i dus mchod khag zla rim ltar nya stong gnyis la gso sbyong dang /242

tshes gsum dang bco brgyad sum cu la bde mchog tshes brgyad dang nyi shu gsum la bla ma mchod pa/ tshes bco lnga dang bcu gnyis/ nyi shu lnga la 'du khang du zhi khro/ nyi shu lnga la gdan rabs khang du bka' brgyad/ tshes bcu la khro bcu/srung ma khang du pad ljon/ tshes bcu gsum dang bcu bzhi la kun rig tshes bco lnga la gur drag tshes bcu drug dang nyi shu tham pa/ nyi shu dgu la gtsug dgu/ tshes bcu dgu dbu khri pa'i bskang gso/ gdan rabs khang du gshin rje bcas zla rim ltar chag med gsungs dgos/'gom bla draja / 'gom bla brang zhes pa 'bri gung skyabs mgon rnam gnyis nas bsko bzhag mdzad/ 'bri gung bu slob sum bcu zhes pa tshang ma lo gsum re bzhugs dgos/ de ni rang dgon gyi chos srid gnyis kyi do dam dang yar rgyas gtong mkhan zhig yin/ sngon dus su 'bri thel dang 'bri rdzong nas chos brgyud khag la gdan sa'i khri 'dzin dang / ri khrod khag la rdor 'dzin zhes bla grwa gang rung zhig rang lugs rkang 'phel ba re gtong srol byung zhing /nye char du 'bri gung thel/ yang ri sgar/ 'gom dgon pa gsum la bu slob res mos ltar lo gsum re/ thel bla/ sgar bla/ 'gom bla zhes dgon pa rnams la gtong sgo gang 'tsham re 'bul dgos pa dang / 'gom bla ni rang lugs chos brgyud khag gi dbang lung khrid gsum dang rgyud sde khag gi rdor slob/sgrub mchod khag la tshogs dbur bzhugs nas bka' dbang dang / nyin ltar tshogs dus gsum pa nas bdun pa bar phebs dgos/ bla brang nas rtse gzim chung mar me yon chab sogs gzigs dgos pa dang / rtse rgyal mtshan dang /thang dar/ lo gsar bcas gtong ba dang / dgu gtor skabs bka' brgyad kyi rdor slob mdzad dgos/ phyogs phebs skabs sde dud rnams kyis dad 'bul phud nyin mar dang nyin phyur re 'bul dgos/ 'gom bla'i 'og tu sde pa 243

dang bla mkhyen gnyer phyag mdzod/ thab bsu mgron gnyer bcas yod/ spyi lo 1612 rab byung bcu pa'i chu glang lor 'gom dgon khyung ri'i klad du spos nas gdan sa'i khri 'dzin rim byon gyi mtshan rnams bka' 'bum dang rnam thar du bzhugs pa ni/ skyabs mgon rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa/ rong 'do khri chen bla ma shākya rin chen/ be ru rtogs ldan/ bla ma rin chen tshul khrims/thugs sras nor bu/ che rgyud sku skye/ rong mdo mkhas btsun/ bla ma nor bu sku skye/ brgyad ra sku skye chos kyi dbang phyug rgyal sras 'phrin las tshe bdag bla ma tshul khrims zla ba/ zhogs pa chos dbang grags pa/ ba log mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug ri dbang sku skye/ rang grol sku skye/ rog mdo sku skye/ rgyal sras sku skye/ lcang lo mkhan sprul/ dung dkar mkhan sprul/ ri dbang mkhan sprul/che rgyud mkhan sprul/ yongs 'dzin brgyad ra khri chen/ rang grol mkhan sprul/spyi dkar mkhan sprul/ sog mkhan sprul/ ri dbang dkon mchog bstan 'dzin bcas bzhugs/ spyi lo 196༷lcags byi lor dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur tshugs nas mkhan sprul phebs pa'i srol dang 'gom bla brang zhes pa skabs shig med par gyur/'gomaji sda/ sde pa ni 'gom bla'i 'og gi srid don bya ba sgrub mkhan zhig yin te/ phag gru'i skabs dang / dga' ldan srid gzhung gi skabs su sde srid ces pa dang / 'bri gung du sgom pa zhes pa rnams don gcig ming gi rnam grangs shig yin/ 'gom sde pa ni rang dgon gyi chos brgyud rnams mi nyams par dar spel gtong ba'i thabs shes dang / dgon pa'i sgrig srol lam lugs la blta skul/ sde tsho phan tshun bar don rkyen la thugs 'gan bzhes rgyu/ de min phyi nang don rkyen gang byung la tshod 'dzin dang thag gcod bya rgyu/ 'gom las sne bcu gcig 'dzoms skabs stag gdan gyi thob thang bcas yod/244

banadapon rnam gnyis/ ban dpon ni 'dus grwa yongs kyi dpon dang /rang dgon gyi spyi nor la bdag skyong / rjes su gang dgos sgrig srol dang gang spyi'i thog la blta rtog byed mkhan zhig yin/ gtso bo nam rgyun phyag las spyi gso khag la brje 'then dang rtsis len rtsis sprod las ka byed dgos la/ 'gom bla brang gi sde pa'i gzhogs 'degs zhu rgyu bcas yin/ bla brang sde pa dang ban dbon bcas la rtse drung gi thob thang yod pas/ chags ri chags gzan/ phur shubs can dang / chab ril/ ko lham dang zam chen sogs thob thang cha tshang yod/ dgon 'di sngar dus khrims sgo rang btsan dang / bka' gtan btsan pas gzhung dpon 'ga' phebs skabs lung phyogs 'ga' la de 'dra bka' gtan yong ba zer ha las/lasasne bcu gcig rang dgon gyi grwa pa rnams kyi grong khung nas yin dgos la/ grong khung gi 'dus pa'i las don dang / dgon gzhung gi gal che'i las rigs khag gi bka' gros la phebs thub pa bya dgos/tshogs bla/ tshogs bla ni gtso bo 'gom bla'am sprul sku'i sku tshab dang /nam rgyun rgyun tshogs khag la phebs dgos/ bla ma ma bzhugs skabs chos phyogs kyi 'gan yongs rdzogs sgrub dgos/ de ni rtsa ba'i cha nas rang lugs kyi chos rgyun khag gi dbang lung khrid gsum dang ldan la/ lhag tu phyag chen chos drug la myong ba thon pa/ dgon spyi'i thon sgo yongs rdzogs thon pa zhig yin dgos pa dang lo gsum rer bzhugs dgos/dmu khri pa/ dbu mdzad ni cho ga chos spyod khag gi dbu 'dren mkhan dang rkang bzung mkhan zhig yin/ rang dgon pa'i dbu mdzad la blo 'dzin/ chos spyod/ zhi khro yang zab/ bskang gso/ kun rig bde mchog gtsug dgu/cho ga chos spyod khag gi 'don dbyangs khag brgya lhag tsam bcas dang sdom blo 245
