'dzin shog grangs chig stong tsam blo la ngag dgos/ de rnams ming tsam ma yin par rang skya 'pher ba/ rje gong ma rnams kyi phyag len dang zhal rgyun man ngag rnams ma nyams pa rang lugs kyi 'bud brdung dkrol gsum/ gar thig dbyangs gsum/ mchod bzo dkar rgyan sogs la mkhas dgos/ zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i nang du dbu chos rnams kyi mdun la rgyug sprod 'bul ba dang / zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gcig la 'gom bla brang du rgyug sprod 'bul dgos/ rtsa ba'i cha nas dbu mdzad lo gsum re yin kyang / dbu gsar 'ga' byung na lo re las mi mdzad par rjes su yang bskyar lan gnyis 'gro dgos/ dbu mdzad la spyi pa lo gsum re chag yang gtong dgos/ rang dgon pa'i lo ltar sgrub mchod khag dang / nyin ltar dung yon/ 'don bskul rnams zhib cing phra ba gsung rgyu dang / nyi nub la dgong 'don bcas gang dgos la phebs dgos pa dang phyi log la gang byung phebs mi chogazhala' rnam gnyis/ chos khrims pa'am zhal ngo khri pa ni 'dul khrims nyis brgya lnga bcu dang rang dgon pa'i bca' yig gtso'i khrims srol khag gi dbye mtshams legs par shes shing / legs spel nyes 'gog gi nus pa dang ldan dgos/ thon sgo ni/ spyi gso lo dgu dang / dkor gnyer nas rim par chos khrims pa'i las thog bar tu slebs pa las/ gang 'dod bsko mi nyan/zhal ngo gral pa ni gong dang gcig mtshungs yin pa dang / rtsa ba'i cha nas 'don yon cung drags pa re yin dgos/ sngon dus su chos khrims pa gnyis kyis/ dgung lo nyer lnga ma slebs pa dang / bskang gso rgyug 'phrod ma thub pa'i ban chung gsar bu yan la nyin dgung la brda dag snyan gsum dang / cho ga chos spyod blo 'dzin bya rgyu/ dgong mo 'don rwar rgyud la byin gyi rlobs phyir gdan rabs gsol 'debs mjug blo 'dzin gtsos rgyug sprod byed rgyu bcas 246
shlau tsākṣiṃ
datā/ //sna ṭwākton

'dri zhus nas dril brda gtong rgyu dang / tshogs ja 'dren rgyu de yin/ de la dkor dpon gcig la/ dkor g.yog gnyis/ ja ma gnyis/ lag bde bcas yod/gamuja'adzin mkhan/ dgon pa'i chos lugs kyi dpe cha blo 'dzin rmang gzhi cung yag pa rnams yin te/ 'go skyabs 'gro dang gser khang / thub bstod/ smon lam cha brgyad/ dgong 'don cha tshang / zhi khro yang zab/gtor brgya rtsa/ 'jam dpal mtshan brjod/ gdugs dkar bcas 'dzin rgyug sprad nas/ tshogs la phebs skabs gdong gral la bzhugs dgos/bskajaspal la/ gzhung 'dzin mkhan gyi yon tshad thog bskang gso blo 'dzin dang lag len/ bsang gsol gyi 'don dbyangs khag rgyug 'phrod thub pa zhig yin dgos/ de nas bzung 'don yig rwa la phebs mi dgos par dgon gzhung nas gzigs gsos gnang ba dang / de nas dbu khri pa'i 'don cha la 'jug dgos pa'i bslab bya yang gnang gi yod/mgonakhang bla ma/ bskang gso rgyug 'phrod thub nas res mos 'khor ba'i zla rer bzhugs dgos/ nyin ltar phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gyi nyams len dang ma bral ba bdag bskyed bde mchog mdun bskyed mgon po byas nas rang lugs gsol kha rnams 'gro dgos pa dang / tshes 15tshes 2la bsang gsol rgyas pa dang / dad ldan sbyin bdag khag gi nyin ltar 'phrin bcol rnams dus thog tu gsung dgos/ nang re 'tshams gcod nam langs snga cha brdung thub pa dang / dgong mo thun gtor nyi ma nub khar dbu khri pa'i zlog pa rnam gsum gyi bzlog pa rgyag rgyu dang rtags 'khel ba dgos/sbyigasoricu gnyis/ chos gzhis dang spyi gso zhes pa ni sngon rgya gar du bstan pa cung gud skabs der byung ba yin pas/ rim bzhin bod yul du yang 249

dar/ rang dgon du spyi gso dang po ni skyabs mgon don grub chos rgyal dang /bstan 'dzin 'gro 'dul rnam gnyis kyi skabs su/ spyi pa dang po mar me dang dus mchod khag gnyis po de byung zhing / de nas bzung sgrub mchod khag rim par dar ba zhig yin pas spyi gso khag ni/ spyi chen bdun dang / spyi chung lnga zhes 'bod de/ spyi mar me/ spyi dus mchod/ spyi dgu gtor/ spyi sgrub mchod/spyi bka' 'gyur/ spyi bstan 'gyur/ ba lag skar me/ tshes bcu/ chos brtsis/ bla brang bcas khag bcu gnyis nang lo 'khor sgrub mchod tshang pa gtong thub pa dang / spyi gso khag dang mar me bcas kyis 'du khang du sdong kong lnga bcu tham pa chad med 'bul thub kyi yod/ zhib phra'i spyi gso'i 'gro gron rnams sbug deb dang lag deb du gsal/ bod rab byung bcu drug sa phag spyi lo 1959dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur tshugs nas dgon pa'i nang gi rgyu dngos dang grwa pa'i rgyu dngos tshang ma dbang med du gyur nas mi med dri za'i grong dang mtshungs zhing bdag 'dzin ma bral kyang bral tu 'jug pa'i dus shig tshes/ spyi lo 1kha62lor 'gom dgon du de sngon khyung po steng chen don gcod las khungs tang srid dmag gsum gyi 'gan 'khur gtso bo de skabs 'bri ru rdzong gi dbu khrid wang shis phebs nas dgon pa'i mchod cha khag gcig dang /tshogs gdan/ thab chas lhag 'phro khag gcig rang 'jags su bzhagadagon gyi bla ma rnam gnyis 59lor lo na chung zhing zing 'khrug tu ma zhugs pas sa zhing dang gzim khang bcas skabs thob bgo bsha'i khungs su ma gtogs par bzhag chos dad rang mos zhes pa grwa pa drug dgon du bzhugs chog pa dang / mjug tu 'dus pa nyis shu'i skor dgon du bzhugs rgyu'i tho bkod tsam las so so'i pha yul du phebs/ dmangs gtso bdag gnyer tshugs nas sngar yod grwa pa'i steng du rwa khyim dgon pa'i grwa kha shas yar zla sgril btang / sngar 250

yod dgon pa'i sa zhing las cung zad sprad/ spyi lo 1rdzo66dus zing de'i 'og tu sngon gyi rig dngos cung srung bskyobs thub pa rnams dang / rtse shod bar gsum rnams do dam yod lugs tsam las/ rig gnas gsar brje/ rnying gtor gsar 'dzugs zhes mi rabs mang pos srung bskyobs zhus pa'i rig gnas kyi nor bu'i bang mdzod lta bu de skad cig gis brlag nas phyi nang tshang mar gad snyigs dang 'dra bar chos chas dpe cha dang zhal 'bag sogs kyis khengs nas bya tshang thal spungs can gyi gyang ral zhig tu gyur/ chos lugs kyi mi sna rnams la lha 'dre gdon 'gegs ces zhwa mo g.yog nas gtor bya rnying rigs bzhi'i khongs su gyur nas gos ngur smrig tsam dang / zhal 'gul tsam yang byed mi phod pa'i dus skabs der nang rim gnyis la dbang 'byor ba rnams ni gegs sel dang bogs 'don lta bu/ rang rgyud la sangs rgyas bstan pa 'phel 'grib med par gnas/ de nas bzung sangs rgyas bstan pa rin po che zhes gang la ngos 'dzin pa dang / bstan pa'i 'phel sgrib ni rang rgyud kyi lta sgom spyod gsum yin pa la sogs mthar thug gi ngo sprod de mdzad do/251

༄7//yang dar bstan pa'i nyi ma slar yang shar ba/'od stong can khyod chu lha'i phang ba ru/yib nas slar yang skal bzang shar ri'i phragashar nas skal ldan pad tshal rgyas pa'i dus/rkang drug bung ba dga' bas 'di ltar thal/197ras rta lo skabs bcu gcig pa'i gros tshogs thengs gsum pa tshogs tshun rig gnas gsar brje chen po'i lo bcu'i god chag skabs kyi srog chad pa yang nyes med du rtsis nas yang dag srid jus la phyogs pa'i 'go brtsams/ 19ra2chu phag lor dgon pa nyams gso'i re ba tsam grub pas dbu dkon mchog mthar phyin gyis bza' tshes dge bar skar 'dzin byed/rnam rgyal nyi ma dang rgyal mtshan gnyis kyis lho byang gnyis su jo dar re sgron/de'i phyi lo skyabs rje mchog sprul ri dbang dkon mchog bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po mchog gi thugs bskyed 'og bod rab lo 95rdorab byung bcu bdun shing byi lo spyi lo 19ra4hor zla bdun pa'i tshes bcu gnyis/ res gza' pa sangs/ skar ma chu smad/ 'phrod sa gnyis/ spyi zla dgu pa'i tshes bdun nyin slar yang rang dgon nyams gso'i mdzad sgo tshugs rgyu'i dus tshod gtan khel gnang ba'i phyag bris dang rje nyid kyis gter bzhes slob dpon rin po che'i sku dang / chos grags kyi sman sku byin can bcas 'byor/ rang dgon du 'dus grwa zhal bzhugs rnam brda rgyag byas nas 'dzoms/ de sngon srid jus dza drags che ba'i dbang gis 'du khang sa mal du/rten 'brel gyi mdzad sgo zhu ma nus par dbu bzod pa rin po che'i gzim khang 252

rnam rgyal nyi mar bzhugs pas der gros mthun tsam byung yang / da lta'i sgo 'phyor g.yon phyogs der ru khag gi dkar khang ka ba gcig dbu mthar phyin la byung bas/ gnas der dbu dkon mchog mthar phyin dang / dbu bstan pa dar rgyas/ sangs rgyas brtson 'grus/ dbu dkon mchog tshul khrims/ dge rgan brtson 'grus/ rnam rgyal nyi ma/ bstan pa'i nyi ma/ blo bzang ye shes bcas tshogs bzhugs dang / rang grol rin po che'i sku mched bstan 'dzin rgyal mtshan gtsos rgya che'i dad ldan mang tshogs kyis rgyab skyor 'og tshes bcu gnyis la bla ma mchod pa/ tshes bcu gsum la sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas phyir rang lugs kyi chos srung khag la bsang gsol rgyas par gnang bas/ tshe bdag e ring gi skabs su spos rang 'bar du gyur nas spos thal rang 'dud du song bas sangs rgyas bstan pa gegs med du rgyas pa'i brda rtags su go de rjes be cag bstan pa'i nyi ma dang / bstan 'dzin rgyal mtshan gnyis rdzong du snyan zhu phebs pas/ rdzong nas sngon chad rjes gcod med la slad phyin tshod 'dzin dgos pa'i bka' gnang / de'i phyi lor rdzong 'dir dgon pa gsum bzhengs chog pa'i chog mchan thob pa'i gral tu tshud/19ṭwāṃ5shing glang lo zla ba gsum pa'i tshes bco lnga nyin skyabs rje mchog gis sa 'dul mdzad nas ka mdo dang sa dmar grong gnyis nas mi tshogs rnams dang bcas las grwa dngos su tshugs/ lo der mgon po khang bzhengs grub/ rang dgon du skyob pa dang po ni a nam kun bzang dpal ldan nas bzhengs pa'i skyob pa tshe 'dzin ma'i zhal thang 'di yin zhes dbu rgan mthar phyin nas gsungs/ 19rdo6me stag lor khro bcu khang bzhengs grub/19〈7rab byung bcu bdun me yos lor gsar bu rnams la blo 'dzin 'don rgyug sprod pa'i srol gtad/ lo der grub dbang dkon mchog chos bzang mchog sgrub pa yongs su thon zhing rang dgon du phebs nas khro bcu khang du 253

bka' 'gyur dang thar mdo/ chos spyod sogs rang lugs cho ga khag dang /ma ṇi la sogs nyer mkho rnams kyi khrid lung gnang / phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gyi khrid kyi dang po rje bla ma bstan 'dzin 'gro 'dul mchog la gnang nas sgrub grwa'i srol gtod gnang zhing dam pa'i chos kyi nyi ma shar bas/ stong gsum gser gyi bkang nas phul kyang bka' drin gzhal bar dka'/ 19rdordos 'brug lor 'bri gung mkhan po blo bzang bde chen mchog dang / nus ldan rdo rje/ 'brong pa bsam gtan/ rgan padma rig 'dzin gtsos pas lho lugs sman sgrub chen mo tshogs/ lo der ma ṇi sgrub pa khro bcu khang du bskyar gso gnang nas/ las sbyang rdor slob ri dbang rin po che/ dbu mdzad grub dbang rin po che/ de min dbu lha srung / bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ tshogs chen dbu mdzad dbu bstan pa dar rgyas/ dge skos dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ de min gsar bu ba mang tsam bzhugs yod/ 1rdzorardos 'brug lor 'gom bla grwa rnams 'bri gung du grub dbang dkon mchog 'phrin las kyi drung nas bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa zhus/ drug pa'i tshes bco lnga la bka' 'gyur dag sgrog dang lo ltar rgyun 'don tshugs/ 1990lcags rta lo zla ba gsum pa'i tshes nyer lnga la badzra sgrub pa bskyar gso gnang / khrid dpon sangs rgyas brtson 'grus dang / bstan pa'i nyi ma/ dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ dbu bsam gtan/ bstan 'dzin nor bu bcas nas 'du khang du bla ma rnams gsum gyi sku mi tshad ma bzhengs nas zla dgu pa'i tshes nyer gnyis la dus ston rab gnas rgyas par gnang / mkhan sprul rnam gnyis nas rang dgon du dge tshul gyi sdom pa gnang /1991lcags lug lor rang dgon pa'i 'dus grwa gsar rnying lhan rgyas thog bca' yig gsar du bsgrig nas sgrig srol lam lugs mthus sgo tshang du btang /dbu chos bskyar gso mdzad par/ 'gom bla ri dbang mchog sprul rin po che dang / sde pa bstan 'dzin phan bde/ tshogs bla dbu bstan pa dar rgyas/254

dbu khri pa grub dbang dkon mchog chos bzang / dge bskos khri pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ dge bskos gral pa bstan pa'i nyi ma dang / chab ra ba bstan 'dzin 'gyur med/ bstan 'dzin blo bzang / dung mkhan gnyis bstan 'dzin rab brtan dang / dkon mchog mthar phyin/ dkor gnyer bstan 'dzin rdo rje/ bstan 'dzin 'phel dar bcas mdzad nas/ zla ba gsum pa'i tshes bcu gsum nyin gza' skar dge bar dbu chos khri 'don mdzad/ smyung gnas dang gtsug dgu chen mo nyin gnyis tshugs nas dge bskos khri pa'i tshogs gtam bcas bskyar gso mdzad/ kun rig nyin bdun/a phyi'i bskang gso chen mo nyin bdun/ rab gnas/ dbyar bsang chen mo/dbyar bzhi gsum cho ga tshugs/ drag po'i gtor khag nyams gso mdzad pas grub dbang rin po che dang ye shes rnam rgyal bcas tshogs bzhugs mdzad/dgun 'brog grol nas zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i nang du dbu khri pa gsar pa'i 'don rgyug blangs/ de rjes lo gsar dang sgrub mchod chen mo bcas bskyar gso mdzad/ de skabs gsar bu rnams lhag bsam che zhing dad brtson snying rje che/ rgan pa la gong du bkur zhing / rgan pas gsar bu rnams la slob sbyong dang bka' slob gang zab gnang bas/ mig ltos bzang zhing ya rabs kun spyod ldan/ sngon dus kyi cho ga phyag len/ 'don rta dbyangs la sogs chos spyod kyi bya ba kun la 'gran bral du gyur/ nags shod stod smad bar gsum gtsos pa'i kha ba can gyi zhing du grags pa byung ba ni/ rje bla ma yid bzhin nor bu mchog zung gi bka' drin las byung ba yin/ spyi lo 1992chu bya lor zla ba gsum pa'i nang du dbu chos gsar pa ni tshogs bla dbu dkon mchog lha srung /dbu khri pa dkon mchog bstan dar/ zhal ngo khri pa bstan 'dzin 'gyur med/gral pa dbu bsam gtan bcas gnang bas sngar ltar 'don chos bzang ba'i tshad du 'dzin/ lo der dbu dkon mchog bstan dar dang / khrid dpon 255

sangs rgyas brtson 'grus gnyis kyi thugs bskyed 'og dbu tshul khrims gdan drangs nas bka' brgyad srung bzlog nyams gso mdzad nas bka' brgyad thang nag gi grwa thang bzhengs/ dbu dkon mchog mthar phyin dang dbu lhun grub gnyis kyi thugs bskyed 'og dbu ngag dbang gdan drangs nas khro bcu'i srung bzlog bskyar gso mdzad/ khro bcu'i grwa thang bzhengs/ mgon po'i gtor khag ni dbu bstan pa dar rgyas dang / dbu bsam gtan gnyis kyi thugs bskyed 'og srung bzlog nyams gso gnang nas grwa thang bcas bzhengs/ de min gtor khag rnams la 'dus grwa rgan gral rnams kyi khur blangs nas mchod pa'i yo chas srid na dkon pa mang po bzhengs/ lo ltar 'gom sos gtor chen mo'i skabs su mchod chas dang 'don dbyangs/ gtor bzo mchod bzhengs la kun gyi yid dbang 'phrog de dang mnyam du dgon gzhung nas sman sku rnams rim par bzhengs/ grub dbang mchog dang rtogs ldan rnam rgyal nyi ma gnyis nas dbu rtser gser zangs gyi rgyal mtshan bzhengs/ spyi lo 19kha6me byi lor zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes bco lnga la grub dbang dkon mchog chos bzang mchog gis shag srib nas sngags 'chang mang po'i 'dod chos su/ ba lag shel dkar 'bum par bka' 'gyur chen mo'i ljags lung dang lnga ldan sngon 'gro/sdom gsum bcas/ der 'dus rab byung ngur smrig gi sde tshogs/ sngags pa gos dkar gyi sde tshogs/ khyim pa lcang lo can gyi sde tshogs bcas stong phrag la nges pa lnga ldan gyi sgo nas dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bar med du bskor/mjug tu rtsa gsum stong tshogs bcas phul nas 'jug bsdus/ zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i nang dgun chos gsar 'dzugs gnang nas/ 'gom dgon chos 'khor byams pa gling dgon pa'i mkhan po rig gzhung spyi dang lhag par dam chos dgongs gcig la mkhas shing 'phags yul byang gling bshad grwa nas thon pa mkhas mchog dka' drin bla na ma mchis pa dkon mchog bstan 'dzin 256

thabs mkhas mchog phebs nas dam chos dgongs gcig gi 'grel ba nyi ma'i snang ba rgyas khrid dang / de min spyod 'jug rtsa ba rgyas 'grel gnang / rgyal sras lag len so bdun ma dang bshes spreng bcas mi pham 'grel ba/ smon lam chen mo'i rtsa ba/ sgrol ma skyabs bdun 'grel ba mkhan chen nor bzang gi mdzad pa/ lam rim thar rgyan dwags po'i chos bzhi bcas bka' khrid smar bar gnang nas rang dgon 'di nyid mkhas grub gnyis ldan slob tshogs rgyas pa'i thugs bskyed mdzad/ spyi lo 1997me glang lor zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes gsum la mchog sprul rin po ches dgun chos su bla ma lnga bcu'i 'grel ba rgyas khrid mdzad pas bka' drin bla na ma mchis/ grub dbang rin po che nas sgrub grwa'i slob dpon du rdzogs chen bka' khrid pa dkon mchog sangs rgyas brtson 'grus/ phyag chen chos drug gi slob dpon du rje bla ma dkon mchog bstan 'dzin 'gro 'dul rin po che mnga' gsol/ spyi lo 199ras stag lor skyabs rje ri dbang rin po che'i thugs bskyed dang grub dbang dkon mchog chos bzang rin po che rnam gnyis ma gros gcig mthun zhes pa'i dper dang /rang dgon pa'i bla rgan rnams skyob pa stong sku bzhengs bar thugs bskyed gcig tu babs pas/ skyabs mgon chos kyi snang ba mchog la skyabs 'jug zhus pas de legs par 'grub pa'i zhal bzang thob/ ri dbang rin po che nas thugs 'gan bzhes/ rang dgon pa'i ser skya dad ldan ris med mang pos rgyab skyor 'og lha bzo ba zla bas stong sku'i ma dpe bzhengs/ khams pa tshe rdor rgyud/ lha tshong pa dar skyobs dang / bkra shis dbang 'dus gnyis/bal yul du stong sku bzhengs pa'i bzo phud sku 'dra cung mi 'dra ba gsum/ ri dbang rin po che mchog chags rtse 'khor chen du chos sgar skabs sleb pas rten 'brel bzang bar byung / spyi lo 1999sa yos lor zla ba gsum par lha sar 'byor/ rtse mkhan po don grub bde chen mchog gis thugs 'gan bzhes nas/257

skyob pa lnga brgya ser gzhung nas 'bri lugs ltar gzungs 'bul dang / sku lnga brgya lhag rang dgon pa'i dbu bstan dar gtsos grwa pa lngas zla ba bzhi'i ring gzungs 'bul yongs su grub/ dgun chos skabs su skyabs rje ri dbang rin po ches 'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi bka' khrid dang / mkhan dkon mchog bstan 'dzin thabs mkhas kyis/ dgongs gcig 'grel chen tshar nyis shu dang / nyi snang brgya ma zin tsam bsnams nas rang dgon du 'grel chen bka' khrid gnang phyir phebs kyang / dus tshod kyis rkyen pas 'grel chen ma grub par nyi snang tshar gcig bka' khrid gnang nas mjug tu btang rag gi skabs su/rjes 'jug 'dus pa rnams la pha chos dgongs pa gcig pa'i khrid gzhung khag la gzigs rtogs dgos pa dang 'dzin skyong gnang ba'i thugs re gang zab gnang / rang lugs dang dpe cha la dag snang yong ba'i 'go tshugs pa ni skyabs rje mchog sprul rin po che dang / mkhan rin po che rnam gnyis kyi bka' drin bla na med pa'o/ spyi lo 2skyu0rkyalcags 'brug lo'i sa zla'i tshes bcu la rang dgon du skyob pa stong sku gdan 'dren du bstan 'dzin nor bu dang / bstan 'dzin 'gyur med rnam gnyis phebs nas rang dgon du 'byor/ nye skor dad ldan rnams kyis gdan drangs shing / 'dus pa nas ser sbreng zab rgyas bstar/bgegs sprad mdzad/ tshes nyi shu lnga la gling du gos sku chen mo'i lnga mchod btsugs nas grub dbang mchog gis rnam rgyal stong mchod bcas tshugs/ de nyin dbu dkon mchog bstan dar skyob pa khang gi mchod dpon chen mo mdzad/skyob pa khang du skyabs rje ri dbang rin po che mchog gi gtsos bla ma mchod pa gsungs/ 'dzam gling du stong sku'i dang po yin zhing gegs med grub pas rgyal dbang skyob pa'i bstan pa ches cher rgyas pa'i mtshan ma bzang / de nas bzung gser yig spar ba dang / bsngo rten 'bul ba/ skyob pa khang du byang bu spar ba'isrol gtod/ de rjes dpal 'bri gung bka' brgyud pa'i chos sde chen mo 258

nags shod 'gom dgon chos 'khor byams pa gling dgon 'di nyid/ skyabs rje mkhan sprul rnam gnyis kyi dka' drin las phyi'i gtsug lag khang dang nang gi rten gsum/ bshad sgrub gnyis bcas rtsa ba'i cha nas legs grub thob pas/7skyabs mgon rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa sku phreng bdun pa skyabs mgon dkon mchog bstan 'dzin ngag dbang thub bstan chos kyi snang ba mchog nags shod du phebs rgyu'i zhal bzang grub/ rang dgon nas drug pa'i tshes gcig la skyabs mgon mchog gdan 'dren du bstan 'dzin 'gyur med lha sar 'byor/ tshes gnyis la skyabs mgon mchog dang sku mched skal bzang nor bu/ a mgon dkon mchog bstan 'dzin chos grags rgya mtsho/ ba log bstan 'dzin rdo rje/ 'bri gung sgom pa bsam gtan phun tshogs/ dkon mchog bsod nams/ dkon mchog 'od zer/ yang ri sgar dbu mdzad mgon po dar rgyas/ bkra shis rdo rje/ rtse ba dgon pa'i mkhan dge slong don grub bde chen dang / de min gter sgrom dgon pa'i 'gan khur phun tshogs sgrol ma/ chab gros/ padma bcas/ skyob pa stong sku'i rab gnas dang dus ston la rten 'brel zhu ched du/ rtse sgar thel gsum gter sgrom dang bcas pa'i khur 'dzin rnams lha ldan nas phebs grur bzhugs nas nag chu'i mgron khang chen mor zhag bzhugs mdzad/ tshes gsum la phebs grur bzhugs nas shag wa thang dgon gyis nyang gzhung thang dkar du chibs bsu dang phra rgyan bcas mi tshogs la phyag mjal gnang / de nas dar lung gzhung du bar ma grong nas thab bsu sgrig zhus su phebs nas de rnams la phyag mjal bstsal/ 'dam la tshur nang du 'gom bla skyabs rje ri dbang dkon mchog bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po mchog gis gtsos 'gom sde dgon dang shang srid gzhung sogs che rgu rnams kyis chibs bsu dang mjal kha zhus/ wag ta'i thang chen du skya ser rta pa sum brgya skor dang 'phrul rta bcas tshar du dngar bas 259

chibs bsu zhus/ ba lag thang bsus tshig dang tshogs gur du gdan drangs nas dga' ba'i gzhas dang zhabs bro'i mchod pa rnams rig ma bcu drug gis gtso bo la mchod pa ltar gyis mchod/ mi tshogs khri phrag tsam gyi bsu bkod dang g.yas g.yon gnyis nas dad pa'i rnam pa dpag tu med par lag tu lha rdzas dkar po lhab lhub tu 'phyar/ spos dang bsang gi dud sprin gyis gang zhing zam chen phar ru nas chibs rta dkar po rin chen rgyan gyis rgyan pa la chibs nas dal bar dal bar zi ru sgang nas rim par phebs/ 'gom dgon chos 'khor byams pa gling gi 'dus pa rgya mtshos ser sbreng bstar zhing / sku la chos gos/ dbu la sgom zhu/ phyag tu mchod pa'i yo chas sna tshogs bcas zhi zhing dul bar glang chen gyi 'gros ltar/ skyabs rje mchog la rma bya'i dbu gdugs dang bcas gdan drangs/ dgon gnas g.yas bskor dang bcas gtsug lag khang du phebs grub nas mi 'jig gser gyi seng khrir bzhugs su gsol/'dus pa rgya mtsho nas maṇḍal brten bzhugs dang mjal bskyar zhus/ bde mchog tshogs 'khor dang sa gsum ma'i sgo nas bstod/ gnam sgo nas rgyud gzim chung gsang sngags theg mchog rtser gdan drangs/ tshes bzhi la yang zab kyi rab gnas bkra shis 'jam klas kyi sgo nas rten gsum stong sku dang bcas pa rab gnas phyogs gcig tu gnang / tshes lnga la rang lugs chos srung khag la 'phrin bcol dang bsang gsol bka' bsgo drag po mdzad/ tshes drug la skyabs rje mchog sprul rin po che nas rten gsum maṇḍal yon bshad dang bcas brgya 'bul dang mi tshogs khri phrag tsam gyis stong 'bul bcas bstar/grub rgyal ma'i tshe dbang bstsal/ tshes bdun la gza' yum gyi bka' dbang /tshes brgyad la ba lag 'bum par bla ma mchod pa'i tshogs brgya dang khrus gsol rab gnas mdzad/ nyin dgung du ba lag thang chen du dbyar skyid du phebs nas grong khag so sos gzhas dang zhabs bro'i mchod pa dang / mi rnams dga' 260

ba'i rtsed rigs sna tshogs la rol/ phyi dro sku 'khor nyung bsdus dang bcas rwa khyim dgon gyis gdan zhus ltar phebs nas rten la rab gnas mdzad/ tshes dgu'i snga dror rdzong tang srid kyi dbu 'dzin yon tan grags pa gtsos 'brel yod dbu khrid dang lhan du bka' mol zab rgyas dang / rang dgon 'dus pa rnams la zhal ta bzang po gnang / phyi dro 'cham phud du a tsa ra dang / skyabs rje ri dbang rin po ches a phyi'i gar 'cham la phebs pas bkra shis mtshan rtags bzang / rje nyid dgon du bzhugs tshe mtshan mo 'ja' dang / nyin mor 'ja' 'od kyi gur khang phub pa sogs mi rnams kyis mthong chos mi 'dra/lo der char chu rtsi shing bzang la nad mug nyung / tshes bcu'i nyi shar snga char bla g.yel du skyabs mgon mchog dbu bzhugs dran brten du sku par skyon/chibs skyel dang bcas phyi dro shag wa thang bka' rgyud 'phel rgyas gling gi thab bsu khag gsum dang / chibs bsu rta pa la sogs brgya phrag 'gas bsus te dgon du phyag phebs nas tshe dbang gnang / tshes bcu gcig la gza' yum bka' dbang gnang zhing brgya 'bul dang brten bzhugs phul/ tshes bcu gnyis la 'brong ngur dgon du phyag phebs nas sngar ltar dbu bstan 'phel gyis sne drangs nas chibs bsu mang bar byung nas dgon du phebs nas brtan bzhugs dang mjal kha zhus/ tshes bcu gsum la tshe dbang gnang / tshes bcu bzhi la gza' yum bka' dbang bcas gnang nas dgon la rab gnas dang khrus gsol mdzad/ tshes bco lnga la lha ldan phyogs su chibs bskyod/ 'gom lho ma'i brgya dpon bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis gsol tshig nag chu'i 'khor chen zam par sgrig zhus mdzad nas lha ldan du rje nyid kyi pho brang du phyag phebs/rtse'i mkhan po don grub bde chen nas 'gom dgon du a phyi gtso 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi zhal 'bag dang 'cham chas gnang / 'og ma shes rab kyis rnying ma'i zhal 'bag cha tshang bzhengs/261

hor zla dgu pa'i nang du mkhan po gdan 'dren dang gzhung gi dbu nas mar bka' khrid zhu rgyu dang / rjes su bshad grwa rgyun 'dzugs yong phyir du/dang po'i mdzad sgo la skyabs rje ri dbang rin po che tshes nyer lnga la rin 'byung brgya rtsa'i lha sum brgya'i bka' dbang dbu tshugs/ gsang sngags gsar ma'i phyogs kyi dbang rgyun dkon pa rnam slar gso mdzad pas/ spyir 'dzam gling dang sgos su bod rgyud nang bstan la dka' drin bla na ma mchis pas slob tshogs ni mtha' yas/ spyi lo 20༷2chu rta lor rje bla ma bstan 'dzin 'gro 'dul dang / dbu dkon mchog mthar phyin/ bstan 'dzin byang chub gtsos pas phyag rdzogs gnyis kyi tshogs zhing gser thang ma zla ba lnga lhag tsam gyis bzhengs/dmar tsha bu chen gyis sbyin bdag gnang nas mgon khang du mchod sgrom cha tshang bzhengs bas bstan 'dzin nor bu nas thugs 'gan bzhes/ spyi lo 2002chu lug lor sgrub grwa'i slob dpon bstan 'dzin 'gro 'dul rin po ches khur blangs nas bstan 'dzin nor bus phyag rogs gnang bas mgon khang du dril bu lha lnga/ tshe bdag bcas bzhengs/ ri dbang rin po che'i sku mched gser bzang nas rnam sras dang / ri dwags chos 'khor rgyal mtshan cha bcas bzhengs/ spyi lo 20rkya2chu rta lo dbu 'dzin bstan 'dzin byang chub dang dbu bstan 'dzin brtson 'grus gnyis kyis mgon po khang nas rtse gzim chung bar gsar du nyams gso zhus/ spyi lo 2005shing bya lo skyabs rje rin po che'i gtso 'gan 'og dbu 'dzin bstan 'dzin mchog grub dang dbu shes rab gnyis kyis 'du khang rgya bskyed las grwa dang / bar gling grwa shag gsar rgyag mdzad nas gling dkyil rgya bskyed gnang / spyi lo 2006me khyi lo rang dgon pa'i sprul sku ri dbang rin po che dang / grub dbang dkon mchog chos bzang rin po che rnam gnyis kyis thugs bskyed dang skyabs 'jug bla na med pa'i 'ogasgrub grwa'i slob dpon bstan 'dzin 'gro 'dul dang / dbu mthar phyin/262

bstan 'dzin byang chub/ bstan 'dzin nor bu bcas nas ngal ba dang du blangs nas brtson pa chen pos/ rgya che'i dad ldan ser skya mang tshogs kyis rgyab skyor 'og skyob pa mthong grol chen mo thog so nyis brtseg dang rtser mthong su bka' brgyud gser gyi phreng ba'i bla rabs dang / sgrol dkar sngon bcas bzhengs pas/ 'dzam gling du skyob pa'i sku tshad che shos kyi gral du gyur/ rten gyi gzungs bzhugs su a mgon mchog sprul tshang gi rang lugs rten 'dus ril bu dang / rtse mkhan po don grub bde chen gyi rang lugs rten 'dus ril bu dang / sangs rgyas ring bsrel phyogs bsdus/ sangs rgyas chos 'phags kyi tshems/ bram ze skye bdun gyi sku sha/ jo bo shākya mu ni'i zhal phyis dang zan ril/phyag nas/ jo bo rje'i thugs dam gyi rten 'jam dpal rdo rje'i na bza'/ jo 'brom yab sras kyi sman bsang gi shing sna/ snye thang jo bo rje'i za ma tog gi sa sna/gangs can sgrub brgyud gtsug rgyan mnyam med dwags po bka' brgyud kyi byin rlabs rten 'dus ril bu/ gling ge sar rgyal po'i ab tshag sru 'brug mo'i sgro tshag mnyam med dwags po'i thugs 'khrul med/ karma pa rol ba'i rdo rje'i na bza'/ rje skyob pa'i sku sha dang thugs kyi ril bu dang phyag gnas/ kha che paṇa ṭi ta'i dbu zhwa/ skyob pa rin po che'i 'ding ba dang na bza'/ klu mal dro gzi can gyis phul ba'i 'bum nag chu yi zil pa/ rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen kyi sku gdung / na ro bkra shis phun tshogs kyi sku chos/ skyabs mgon padma'i rgyal mtshan gyi sku gdung / rje 'phrin las bzang po'i sku stod/ rje don grub rgyal po'i na bza'/ chos nyid nor bu'i dbu lo/ thugs rje'i nyi ma'i dbu lo/rje nā ro pa'i rnam 'phrul dge slong dpa' chung rin po che'i gdung thal/ byang sems dkar dmar/ 'phel gdung / dbu thod/ dbu lo/ sku rus/ dbu klad/ shangs mtshal/ phyag nas dang skyob pa nas zhi ba'i blo gros bar gyi gdung tshwa/ skyabs mgon chos kyi snang ba'i phyag phreng / grub dbang bzod pa 263

rin po che'i maṇḍal tog gi gzungs 'be sa lha rjes gangs ri sgrol ma la nas rnyed pa'i 'phel gdung / dbu bstan pa dar rgyas kyi ma yum gyis 'bum pa nas rnyed pa/ tshogs bdag glang sna'i nor zhes/ gzi/ ma ni ho/ 'chang /shel bcas rgyu bzhi las grub pa'i nor bu rin po che dang bcas dbu bstan pa dar rgyas nas phul/ skyabs mgon chos kyi snang bas grub dbang rin po che la gnang ba'i skyob pa'i sku li phra byin can/ ston pa'i 'jim sku byin can/ sog ru gnyan grags kyis ston pa'i sku byin can sangs rgyas 'od srung ring bsrel bzhugs pa khyad mtshar ba thog sdug ma dang / byu ru'i tshe dpag med mgon/tshe lha rnam gsum dang / skyob pa'i bka' 'bum cha tshang / bstan snying dgongs gcig rje btsun mar pa'i rnam thar/ sangs rgyas mtshan 'bum/mdo bskal bzang / brgyad stong / thar mdo/ phyag chen rgya gzhung / bka' brgyud mgur tshogs/ phyag chen chos drug dang / ston pa'i mtshan sngags sogs gzungs bzhugs cha tshang grangs ldan/ pad 'khor dang seng khrir rtsa zho gangs gsum dang / rgya bod yul gru khag gi gnas chen rnams kyi sa sna/ chu sna/shing sna dang / lnga phrag lnga'i rdzas dang gzi dang byu ru/ g.yu sogs rin po che'i rigs dang / gna' bo'i zangs dkar che chung nyis shu lhag la 'bri mar gyi nying khu dang dkar gsum dang mngar gsum gyis bkang ba'i steng du gnod sbyin pho dgu mo dgu/ tshogs bdag 'khor lo bcas dang / nad kyi bskal ba zhi phyir sman phye sna tshogs/ mu ge'i bskal ba zhi phyir 'bru sna lnga/ mtshon gyi bskal ba zhi phyir mtshon cha'i gnan pa dang bcas/ mdor na rje chos kyi grags pa'i ring bsrel lnga'i bzhugs tshul lag len tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho ltar phul nas grub dbang rin po che dbu bzhugs dang 'dus pa rgya mtshos drug pa'i tshes bzhi la gzungs sgrub dang zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes drug dang bdun la dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi sgo nas rab gnas mdzad/ de skabs su dwags sprul 264

thub bstan gshad sgrub mchog rang dgon du phebs pa dang / ri dbang mchog sprul rin po che bcas mchog gi mkhan sprul rin po che rnams gdan 'dzoms pas sgrub brgyud bstan pa rgyas pa'i rten 'brel bzang / de rjes tshes brgyad la bla ma mchod pa/ tshes dgu la spyan ras gzigs kyi bka' dbang dang / tshes bcu la gu ru zhi ba'i bka' dbang bcas gnang / ka mdo grong gis ma ṇi dung sgrub gsungs nas badzra dung sgrub gsungs pa'i dam bca' mdzad/nye rabs su byon pa'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu rnams kyi mdzad rnam ni/rang grol sku phreng bcu gsum pa mchog sprul nges gsang bstan ma'i nyi ma rin po che ni/ spyi lo 1kha2skyulcags rta lor yab ar rgod skyid 'grub bya ba sman sngags pa dam pa'i rang rtags tshang ba de dang / yum mtshan ldan ma bsod nam dbang mtsho gnyis kyi sras su ba ro (ga rdo ) grong du ngo mtshar ba'i mtshan ltas bzang po dang bcas mtshan dpal bzhad/ yab kyis sras bgres gzhon gnyis rab tu byung na gang bzang zhus pas/ 7'bri gung skyabs mgon zhi ba'i blo gros mchog gis sras gzhon pa rang grol rin po che'i sku skye yin par lung bstan nas rtags tham phab/ rang dgon nas khri gsol mdzad sgo zab rgyas phul nas 'don chos gtor gsum/ mchod bzo dkar rgyan la shin tu mkhas/ yab las sum rtags dag gsum/ sman rtsis la sbyangs pa gnang /dbu shes rab kyi sku drung nas rgyud bzhi'i dog gcod mdzad/ snga phyir skyabs mgon rnams gnyis gtsos mkhas grub du ma'i zhabs la btugs nas rang lugs bka' brgyud pa'i chos srol rnams kyi gdams pas phyug nas gshin rje'i mun mtshams kyi rdor slob gnang / 'gom bla'i khrir lo dgu bzhugs/mthu nus che bas mi rta la khrus dang byin rlabs gnang bas mtshon mi len pa sogs mang / thugs gshis bzang bas dad ldan dngas ba 'dren pa'i mchog sprul zhig yin/ de rjes spyi lo 1954lo 'bri ru rdzong u yon dang / spyi lo 265

1960lo nag chu sa gnas kyi u yon bcas yin pa dang / spyi lo 1969lor btson du bcug spyi lo 1976lor nyes med dag sel thob/ spyi lo 19ra1lor lha ldan du sa zla'i tshes bco lnga'i sa srod du gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos kyi dbyings su bsdus nas thugs dam bzhugs/ gdung chog dang thugs dam gsal 'debs la skyabs rje ri dbang rin po che dang / dge slong mdo sngags gnyis kyis gnang nas/ sku gdung se ra'i dur khrod du gdan drangs nas lus sbyin du btang / gdung rten se ra'i pha bong khar bzhengs/ rje nyid kyi sku phreng gong ma rnams kyi rnam thar ni shag wa thang dgon gyi lo rgyus su gzigs 'tshal/rtogs ldan rnam rgyal nyi ma mchog ni yab nyi ma dar 'bum dang / yum skyen pa bza' 'dzums dge gnyis kyi sras su spyi lo 1rdzo14rab byung bco lnga shing stag lor ka mdor sku 'khrungs/ chung nas grub dbang bzod pa rin po che'i chu len sogs byas nas zhabs la btugs/ rtsa ba'i bla ma bkur nas dam chos dgongs pa yang zab kyi khrid lung zhus/ dred 'dul bla ma'i drungs nas bcod kyi gdams pa rnams thob nas dur khrod brgya rtsa dang chu mig brgya rtsa 'grem nas 'khrul zhig chen por gyur/ dbus la phyag 'tshal du phebs nas gter sgrom ri bskor dang gnas chen khag la phyag kho nas phebs pas rkang thang dang gcig par slebs/ kun gyi phyag 'tshal bla ma zhes gus bkur che/ rig gsar dang ru khag gi skabs su grub thob kyi spyod pa kho na mdzad/ de rjes chos lugs rang mos byung bas rang dgon rten 'phyag nyams gso byas nas nad gcod gdon 'dul la nus pa che bas nags shod stod smad bar gsum du dgon gsar rtogs ldan zhes kun gyis bkur/ rang dgon nyams gso zhu skabs su 'bul sdud thams cad rten sum la sogs gang dgos 'jog sgo mang /sku tshe gang por sbas pa'i brtul bzhugs kho na mdzad shing 'khor 'das mnyam 266

pa nyid du rtogs pa'i grub thob yin pas/ las can 'ga' la/ 'khor 'das lag pa'i phyi nang yin/ dge sdig sems kyi 'khyer so yin zhes/ phyag rgya chen po gdams ngag gi tshul du gsungs/ mthar mdzad pa 'phrin las rnams yongs su grub nas spyi lo 200rkyalcags 'brug lor zla ba drug pa'i tshes bco brgyad nyin seng ge'i nyal stabs dang bcas gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos kyi dbyings su thim/ nyin shas thugs dam ma grol/ de nas sku gdung rten 'phyag tu gdan drangs/ rjes 'jug rnams kyis gdung 'bum khang brtsigs mchod rten sngon stobs ldan rin po che'i gdung 'bum shul du bzhengs/dbu dkon mchog mthar phyin ni yab pu gu dang / yum dung mtsho gnyis kyisras su skyi ru gong mar 'khrungs/ rang dgon du sgrig bzhugs mdzad nas thon sgo khag dang spyi gso bcas yongs su thon/ dbu khri pa'i khrir 'khod nas 'don chos smar/ tshogs pa'i bla ma mdzad/ dgon pa nyams gso'i skabs su 'gan khur dang / bskang gso dang dgong 'don bcas kun gyi khur blangs/sku tshe gang por lhag bsam che zhing / dgung lo mtho bas tshogs la phebs ma grub kyang / nyin ltar dung yon dang 'don bskul khag dang dur khrod du skyabs 'gro bcas sku tshe ma gshegs bar du chad med du phebs/ spyi lo 199ras stag lo zla ba bdun pa'i tshes brgyad la sems can mang po'i don du sku zhi bar gshegs/ri dbang mchog sprul dkon mchog bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po mchog ni/ spyi lo 194ṭwāṃs byi lor lha ri rtswa za ru bzhi las sangs chen du yab spus tsha ka yag dang yum a ye gnyis kyi sras su ngo mtshar ba'i ltas bzang du ma dang bcas sku 'khrungs/ mar sgam du ser chen me tog 'khrungs ba dang / sku chung dus su gzhan las khyad par mtshar ba zhig byung bas/ dbu skra gris kyang mi chod pa'i tshom bu zhig byung bas a nye nas bu ra rnga 267

zhes 'bod/ de rjes smad nas phebs pa'i rnal 'byor ba zhig gis bu 'di khrus byas nas mi gtsang ba la 'dzems dgos pa'i bslab bya dang / mtshan zhus pas rtags mtshan nyi ma zhes gnang ba dang dbu la 'khor lo'i ri mo bkra/ ri dbang sku gong ma dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim nas lo mang bar song bas/rang dgon nas yang srid brtsad 'tshol gyi rtags mtshan bzang por byung ba'i khye'u mtshan ldan rnams mtshan tho 'god thengs gnyis byas nas gtan 'khel ma byung / mjug tu spu tsha ka yag gis sras kyi mtshan 'bul bar zhus pas/mtshams nges don rin po ches sprang rgan khyod la e gsungs kyang rjes su mtshan tho de'i gral du tshud/ bla ma'i 'khrungs lo dang yab kyi mtshan gyi dbur ka dang yum gyi mtshan gyi dbur a yod pa 'dor na gsal byed sum cu'i 'go 'jug yod par gsungs pa bzhin chags ri nyi grags rin po che'i snyan du phab pas 'di yin gsungs/ dgung lo lnga la phebs skabs skyen pa ban dpon bstan pa ngo 'khor bcas sku chas 'ga' dang bcas phebs pas/ rje nyid kyi phreng ba mgul du bzhes nas kun yid ches/ bza' tshes dge bar khrus gsol dang na bza' phul/ 'bri gung skyabs mgon rnam gnyis la snyan gsan phul bas de bzhin gnang bar bstsal/ rang dgon nas che dgu kun gyi khri gsol mdzad sgo'i dus tshes gtan khel gnang nas nags shod du gdan 'dren zhus/ rang dgon nas zab rgyas ngang ser sbreng dang khri gsol mdzad sgo bla na med pa gnang nas grub dbang dkon mchog bzod pa'i drung du gtsug phud phul bas mtshan ri dbang dkon mchog bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes gnang / rang lugs chos brgyud khag gi dbang lung khrid gsum rnams zhus pa dang / rtsa ba'i yongs 'dzin spu tsha mtshams pa nges don rin po che nas mdzad/rang lugs cho ga dang chos spyod la thugs 'dzin mdzad pa na thugs rig bkra bas kun gyi ngo mtshar du 'dzin/ 'bri gung skyabs mgon rnam gnyis kyi bka' 268

ltar 'gom bla'i khrir phebs/ dgung lo bcu gsum la dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur byas nas rang dgon dang kha bral btang nas zhing 'brog las ka dang ar las sogs spyi dmangs dang mtshungs/ dgung lo nyer gnyis la nyes can pa'i zhwa mo g.yog nas 'dzin bzung byas/ 'bri ru rdzong btson khang dang / lha ri rdzong / nag chu sa gnas/ lha sa grong khyer bcas kyi khrims mun du bcugadagung lo so gsum thog khyon dang 'dra ba'i nyes pa dag sel gnang nas btson khrol byung bas nag chu kha gdan bzo grwa dang / mtshon bris kyi las bzo ba mdzad/ dgung grangs so bdun la rang dgon bskyar bzhengs chog mchan dang las grwa'i 'char 'god bcas dus ston mdzad nas khur blangs/ de rjes 'bri gung grub dbang dpa' chung rin po che'i drung nas rang lugs zab chos khag dang man ngag gang zab zhus/ gter sgrom ri bskor skabs su a phyi'i bla mtsho nas ma 'ongs lung bstan du ma mjal/ de min ngo mtshar che ba 'ga' byung yang de tsam mo/ spyi lo 1995lo pe cing nang bstan slob gling du phebs nas slob grwa chen mo'i mtshan gnas thob/ de sngon bod rgyud nang bstan rtsa rlung tshogs par phebs pas rtsa rlung gi mthu nus mnga' bas dad 'dun skye bo'i mi tshogs mang / spyi lo 1rdzo99lo dbu ru stag lung du ris med grub mtha' yongs kyi bshes gnyen mang po la/ ba ri lo tsā'i rin 'byung brgya rtsa'i lha sum brgya'i rjes gnang dang / rin chen gter mdzod dang bsam lhun man ngag bcu gsum gyi bka' dbang bstsal/ spyi lo 2rkya00lor rang dgon du de bzhin rin 'byung brgya rtsa'i bka' dbang dang / spyi lo 2rkya05lor nags shod chos gling dgon du rin 'byung brgya rtsa'i bka' dbang gnang bas gsang sngags gsar ba'i dbang lung khrid gsum rgyud pa stong la nye ba rnams gsos/ lhag tu ngo mtshar che ba'i shel dkar 'bum pa rgyas bskrun mdzad pa dang / skyabs rje mchog gis gtso bo mdzad pa'i skyobs pa stong sku bzhengs pa dang / rang dgon 269

du bla ma lnga bcu'i rgyas khrid dang / 'jam dpal mtshan brjod rgyas khrid sogs mdzad pas dka' drin gzhal bar dka'/ de bzhin mdzad pa 'phrin las shin tu che yang 'dir rjes dran trem las zhib par rnam thar rgyas par gzigs 'tshal/ gang sku gzi dpal rab tu 'phro bas mdzad 'phrin rgyas bzhin bzhugs so/grub pa'i khyu mchog grub dbang dkon mchog chos bzang rin po che dpal bzang po mchog ni spyi lo 1926rab byung bcu drug pa'i me byi lor yab stong ri ga rdo dang yum klu mo skyid gnyis kyi sras su mtshan dpe'i bzhad/dgung lo brgyad nas rang dgon du sgrig bzhugs gnang / dgon pa'i 'don chos rnams la sbyangs pa mthar phyin nas dgung lo nyer gsum la dbu mdzad kyi khrir 'khod pas dbu 'od bsrung dang shes rab bcas kyi drung nas gdangs dbyangs kyi 'gyur khug dang 'don gshis bzang ba'i bstod tshig bzang /dgung lo nyer bzhi la dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur tshugs nas spyi ltar rdzong du sbyang brdar 'dzin grwar phebs/ de min smos khyim shang dang rlan chu shang gis do dam cung zad gnang / mi dmangs kun hri'i skabs su gnyags mdo'i rta rdzi gnang bas rta rnams 'phel kha bzang zhing de skabs cho ga chos spyod kyi gdangs dbyangs la gshar sbyang gnang bas/ nyid kyi tsha mos zhang po ni nyin ltar glu gzhas btang gi 'dug pas spro ba chen po yod pa 'dra zhes zer/ spyi lo 19rdo0khyon dang 'dra ba'i 'gan 'khri'i lam lugs gsar du gnang / rje nyid kyis da sngon dus skabs de 'dra zhig shar bas rang rgyud la 'di phyi gnyis 'tshengs kyi dam chos zhig sgrub par bskul ma gnang ba dang mtshungs pas/ da ni chos yang dag zhig sgrub rgyu'i mdun pa thugs la brtan por gnas pa'i skabs der rje nyid dbu ngag dbang gi sku mdun du phebs pas/ dbu ngag dbang nas kha tsang nags shod stod nas sman len mkhan 'ga' byung bas de 270

rnams kyis 'bri gung du grub dbang dpa' chung bya ba bzhugs nas sgrub grwa gso ba dang mtshams pa yang 'ga' 'dug zer bshad zhus pas/ dge slong rin po che'i mtshan thos pa tsam gyis rtsol med kyi mos gus drags po thugs la 'khrungs/zlog med kyis 'gro ba'i bsam pa drags po skyes shing thabs shes gang grags snyam/ de dus su da dung srid jus lhod po de tsam med/ rlan chu shang ba lag tu yod pa'i shang gi tang kri pu'u g.yang lhug gi drung du zhogs pa snga por phebs nas rgyal sgo brdungs/ khyod snga po 'di 'dra ci yin zer bas/ nga ni cung na gi 'dug pas lha sar sman bcos zhig 'gro ba'i dgongs dkrol yong bar gnang gsungs/ g.yang lhug nas 'gan 'khri'i lam lugs gsar du sprad pas mi rnams phyogs la thon mi chog pa'i bka' rgya dang / de rigs byung na 'gan 'khri gzhung bzhes btang gi yod pas mi yong gsungs/ rin po ches 'gan 'khri gzhung bzhes btang na gtong / cis kyang gnang bar zhus pas/ da khyod song rjes su gnas tshul gang byung ngas 'gan len chog gsungs/ de nas grub dbang mchog gis gsang ba'i sgo nas be cag bstan pa'i nyi ma dang / dkon mchog chos 'dzin gnyis dang bcas nyin bdun la 'bri gung thel zhol du phebs grub/ dge slong rin po che dgong mo mjal bar rten 'brel ma legs dgongs nas de nub der bzhugs/ phyi nyin sgrub khang du nyi zer phog pa dang mnyam du slebs pas/ grub dbang dpa' chung rin po che chu gtor grub pa dang mnyam du mjal bas cung zhig mos gus ba spu sdang bas lhag par tshe 'di'i snang ba tur rer 'gag de nas rjes su 'dzin pa'i zhal bzhes gnang nas khong rnams lho gnas rgyas par phebs/ 'bri thel du tshur phebs pas dpa' chung rin po ches sgrub rgyag yang gnang nas a phyi khang gi gyang ral zhig tu yol ba byas/ rje nyid kyis thod rgal gyi skyes bu yin pas dngos gzhi la 'jug par lung bstan kyang / chos kyi gdung bas thun mong sngon 'gro la 'jug nyin 271

mtshanaganyis la gnyid dang kha zas spyod lam rnam bzhi la chu tshod gnyis tsam las dus tshod ni ches rin thang ldan pas brtson pa drags pos phyag chen dang chos drug yang zab/ rang lugs thun min zab chos bcas kyi gdam pa rnams yongs su thos lo tsam ma yin par thos bsam sgom gsum mthar phyin pa dang / grub dbang dpa' chung rin po ches bsngags pa che zhing don gyi dge slong ngam he ru ka'i dge slong yin zhes rje nyid dang dbyer med par gsungs/gdams ngag rnams la gegs sel bogs 'don dpyid phyin nas/ bka' brgyud gong ma'i gdan sa/ lho gro bo lung / rje mi la'i sgrub gnas khagadapal dwags la sgam po/ rtswa ri tra dang gangs ri la sogs nges med bya bral gyi brtul bzhugs phebs par bzhed kyang / rje bla ma la grub dbang dpa' chung rin po ches nags shod dgon gsar du phebs nas 'gro don mdzad dgos pa'i bka' lung phebs pas rang dgon du phyag phebs nas 'dus pa rnams la rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur dang chos spyod sogs bka' lung gnang / kwa mchog sgrub grwa thar gling nyams gso gnang zhing rje bla ma bstan 'dzin 'gro 'dul sogs la phyag rgya chen po'i gdams pa gnang nas bzung rang dgon du sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs/ spyi lo 19ṭwāṃṭwāṃlo 'bri gung du phebs par lung bstan ltar phebs pas rje dpa' chung rin po che sku mya ngan las 'das skabs/thugs dam gsal 'debs dang / gdung rten bzhengs ba sogs zhabs 'degs bla na med pa mdzad/ gzhan yang dbu dkon mchog tshul khrims mchog dang grub dbang rin po che gnyis bka' gros bsdur nas sngon gyi lo rabs mang po song ba'i sgrub pa dang sgrub mchod khag la nyams gso dang rgyun tshogs la phebs pa dang / 'don dbyangs kyi grangs rim sogs 'gyur khug snyan 'jebs ldan pa'i sngar ltar gra ma chags zur ma nyams par/ dbu dkon mchog bstan dar dang / dbu dkon mchog mthar phyin gtsos pa'i dbu 272

mdzad rim byung la ngal ba 'dzems med kyis bslab bya dang bslab spyong gnang bas sngar las lhag pa'i sgrub mchod khag nyams gso thub/ spyi lo 1rdzo92lor rang dgon du dbu chos sogs sgrig gzhi bskyar gso gnang bas/ rje nyid dbu khri pa'i las gnas mdzad/ de nas tshogs chen khag dang dmigs gsal gyi tshogs khag la phebs pa las gtso cher sgrub pa kho nar bzhugs nas/ grwa tshang gi 'don chos khag dang sgrub pa'i khrid lung kho na mdzad nas bzhugs/ spyi lo 1997lo nas bzung sgrub pa gcig pur la rtse gcig tu bzhugs pas phyi rabs pa'i sgrub po rnams la mig ltos bzang / gzhan yang rang dgon dang phyogs khag la rten gsum bzhengs pa dang / chos gzhis btsugs pa sogs de min ris med ser skya chos 'brel thob pa dang rtse gcig sgrub la brtson zhing nyams rtogs kyi yon tan skyes pa mang yang zhib par rnam thar rgyas par gzigs par 'tshal/ rje nyid sku tshe 'phrin las ches cher rgyas zhing mi shigs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du bzhugs pa lags/byigaso khag rang dgon pa'i bla ma dang mkhan po 'dus grwa rgan gras rnams gros kha gcig tu mthun nas spyi lo 1994shing khyi lor spyi gso khag bskyar gso gnang bas/ ar rgod ban dpon 'phrin las rnam rgyal mchog gis sngon gyi spyi gso'i sbug deb dang lag deb la gzhir gzung nas/ bstan 'dzin zla bas phyag rogs zhus pas spug deb dang lag deb bcas kha gsal gsar du bzos/ lo der spyi sgrub mchod nyin dgu tshugs/ spyi ma ṇi nyin nyi shu/spyi bka' 'gyur nyin bdun/ spyi lo 1995shing phag lor spyi dgu gtor tshugs/ spyi badzra sgrub pa nyin nyi shu dang spyi kun rig nyin bdun/ spyi bskang bshags nyin bcu gcig spyi lo 1996me byi lo spyi smyung gnas nyin gnyis dang spyi gtsug dgu nyin gsum/ spyi lo 1rdzo9ralor spyi dbyar gnas bcas so/shara'u skyol la khang / skyob pa khang ni 'bri gung bka' brgyud pa'i skyob 273

pa stong sku'i thog ma bzhugs yul yin zhing / rten gtso skyob pa ting 'dzin chen mo dang stong sku bcas bzhugs/ gsung rten du skyob pa'i bka' 'bum cha tshang / bla mchod yo chas bcas yod pas gtso bo bla ma mchod pa'i sgo nas shi gson gang gi sgrub rim dang / gser yig bcas 'bul gyi yod/rten snasa'agadangosakhang / rig dngos khang ni sngon dus su 'bag khang yin zhing / da lta zhal 'bag cha tshang dang rig dngos rnams gyi rten rdzas bshams mdzod khang yin/bka'awārgyadakhajakau 'gom sos gtor skabs bka' brgyad gtor khag tshogs yul yin zhing / rten gtso bka' brgyad thang nag cha tshang dang / a mgon chos gsum yul lha sogs gser bris 'bri lugs grwa thang bco lnga bzhugs pa dang / de min 'gom bla'i bzhugs khri/ sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor pho brang nyi ma dgu shar dang sgrub pa'i mchod chas cha tshang bcas bzhugs/mgonakhaja / mgon khang ni chos srung spyi dang rang lugs srung ma khag nyin ltar bskang gso gnang yul zhig yin pas/ rten gtso bka' brgyud gser phreng bla rabs gser zangs las grub pa dang / bde mchog dril bu lha lnga/ gu ru snang srid zil gnon/ 'jam dpal gshin rje tshe bdag rgyal chen rnam thos sras bcas gser zangs las grub pa mi tshad dang che chung sna tshogs/a mgon chos gsum sman sku/ rten gtor cha lnga/ bskang rdzas rgyas pa/ a mgon chos gsum zhal thang bcas bris ma dang / lha chen nags lha'i zhal thang / bskang rdzas/ bsang gsol cha lag dang mchod kong dang ting bu bcas gser dngul las grub pa bcas bzhugs/drag po khaja / drag po khang ni sngon 'du khang du tshogs pas rjes su bshad grwa khang du spos/ rten gtso gur drag thod phreng rigs lnga sogs zhal thang 274

spus ldan cha tshang dang / a mgon chos gsum/ gu ru mtshan brgyad bcas bzhugs/ de min sgrub pa'i cha lag gser dngul las grub pa cha tshang bcas yod/srungarna khang / srung ma khang ngam mgon po khang ni rang lugs chos srung khag gi srung ma khang yin pas/ gtor khag mgon po tshogs pas mgon po khang zhes zhu/ rten gtso rdo rje 'chang dang / thub pa'i dbang po/ phag mo gru pa/skyob pa'i hor sku tshems mur/ rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen/ zhwa dmar chos kyi grags pa/ zhwa dmar sangs rgyas grags pa/ ri dbang rin po che mchog gi gter sku chos longs sprul gsum/ gu ru seng ge sgra sgrog slob dpon padma'i sku/ bde mchog rje btsun sgrol ma/ spyan ras gzigs/ grub thob brgyad bcu'i nang gi bla sku/ gnas rten nags na gnas bcas/ gnam lcags dang / li ma/ gser sku sogs grangs ldan bzhugs/ de min sman 'dam las grub pa'i bde mchog yab yum/ ye shes mgon po gtso 'khor gsum dang / chos kyi sgrol ma/ chos skyong rtse'u dmar dang / gu ru nyi ma 'od zer gser zangs mi tshad ma bcas bzhugs/ mgon po'i gtor khag gi grwa thang dang / gser dngul las grub pa'i mchod ting mchod chas gra rgyas phun sum tshogs/gdan rabs khaja / sngon bka' brgyud gdan rabs kyi ldebs bris rgyas pa dang / gser zangs las grub pa'i gser phreng bcas bzhugs pas de ltar zhu/ de rjes gtor khag khro bcu tshogs yul yin pas khro bcu khang zhes 'bod/ rten gtso mnyam med thub pa'i dbang po'i sman sku thog tshad ma dang /gnas rten brag ri/ mchog zung gnyis/ gu ru stong sku/ spyan ras gzigs li ma/ slob dpon padma'i sku byin can/ gsung rten du/ bstan 'gyur tshar gnyis dang / rnying ma rgyud 'bum/ de min khro bcu'i zhal thang cha tshang spus 275

ldan dang / sgrub pa'i yo chas gser dngul lhad med spus ldan bcas yod/tshoms chena'adukhang chen mo/ rten gtso skyob pa mthong grol chen mo thog tshad gnyis ldan bka' brgyud gser phreng gis bskor ba dang de min mang /skyabs mgon rin po che'i bzhugs khri dang / thub pa'i sku byin can mkhan sprul rnam gnyis kyi bzhugs khri dang / rigs gsum mgon po'i sman sku thog tshad ma/gsung rten du rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur tshar gnyis/ 'bri gung chos mdzod chen mo/ de min dpe tshan mang / thugs rten dngul gdung thog tshad chen mo'i nang du mnyam med dwags po lha rje'i phyag bzo rdo rje 'chang gi sku byin can bcas bzhugs yod/276

༄khya//'gom dgon rten 'phyag nyi gling dur khrod/sngon dus su rang dgon gyi dur khrod brag ser du yin zhes grags/ de min sa cha khag 'ga' bshad srol byung / de'i rjes su da lta'i mchod rten dkar ril zhes pa 'dir yin pas nags shod du phyi ba'i nad ngan mched skabs/ grub thob rin po ches bzhes nas nad chad pas gdung 'bum dur khrod du bzhengs pa yin/ der 'gro lam sogs gnas tshul 'gas/ spyi lo 1rdo2ṭwāṃrab byung bcu bzhi sa byi lor 'bri gung gdan rabs so bzhi pa skyabs mgon thugs rje'i nyi ma mchog phyogs phebs gnang skabs/ 'gom bla dang gnyan sde spyi nas dur khrod kyi sa dmigs gang bzang gzigs par zhus pas/skyabs mgon mchog dbu rtse nas gzigs skabs/ pha gi'i sa 'di ci zer gsungs bas/ sngo 'bul zer zhus pas/ 'o rten 'brel bzang shar phyogs mngon dga' dang mtshungs gsungs/ sa babs ni mngon dgar phyogs shing /rgyab ri la rigs lnga dang rigs gsum mgon po rang byon gi tshul/ mtha' skor du chu mig brgya rtsa/ dur khrod brgya rtsa dang / sri chen bcu gsum non pa'i sa dpyad phun sum tshogs shing / sangs rgyas rigs lnga'i zhing du bgrod khyer lam dkar ser mthing dmar ljang rnams zug chu bo rba long dkar po gaudang bcas rdo bcal thog tu 'bab pa'i tshul dang / rtsa ri'i dur brod rngams pa sgra sgrogs dang dbyer ma mchis pa 'di phyag 'debs par mdzad/dur khrod dkyil 'khor du ngan song sbyong ba'i dkyil 'khor dang / zhi khro dang bskang bshag kyi dkyil 'khor bcas bzhengs nas/ rje nyid kyis 'bri 277

gung rten 'phyag dang dbyer med par gsungs/ ngan song skye sgo 'gog pa dang rje nyid kyis phyi rabs rnams yid ches phyir zhabs kyi re kha gsal bar dad rten du bstsal/ dur khrod mdzad sgo dang stobs ldan gsar pa bsko rgyu'i dus la babs pas/ dgon pa'i dge 'dun pa 'ga' zhus kyang zhal bzhes ma gnang /mdosnad nas phebs pa'i rnal 'byor pa dbu skra spyi bor mdud zhing dung long can de nyid dgon par phebs pa dang / skyabs mgon mchog nas khyod dgon 'di'i stobs ldan bya bar gsungs kyang / khong gis nga mdo smad zhig po bco brgyad kyi ya gyal 'bru shel sku shig po'i gdung sras shig ro bsha' byed dgos gsungs pa de ma babs pa zhig red a bsam nas khas len ma byed/ skyabs mgon mchog nas khyod phar phyin nas thugs bsam bzhes gsungs/ khong ri klung 'gul gnas tshang du phar phebs nas thugs bsam bzhes pas/ pha yul nas yong dus rtsa ba'i bla mas rnal 'byor rgyal khams bskor ba legs kyang nga 'dra ba'i skyes mchog zhig gis bka' gnang 'ong / de skabs sa der sdod dgos gsungs pa thugs la lam mer dran/ skyabs mgon mchog gi zhabs drung du phebs nas khas len zhus/ gza' skar bzang ba'i nyin mor rang dgon nas dur khrod kha 'beb phyir/ 'bri sha rkang pa zhig gra sgrig zhus kyang /nags shod stod nas lo brgya thob pa'i rgan po (kha gcig gis rgan mo zer/)zhig gi sku phung 'byor bas/ skyabs mgon mchog phebs nas 'pho ba dang bsngo smon gsungs/ de nas bzung 'dus grwa rnams rten 'phyag tu phebs pa'i srol byung nas da bar gnas/ rig gsar skabs spyi dang 'dra bar nyams gud du phyin/ spyi lo 19rdorkyalcags sprel lo nas rim par dngos su grub dbang rnam rgyal nyi ma mchog gis bskyar gso gnang nas/ lha khang ka ba gcig thab tshang ka ba gcig rten gtso gu ru padma 'byung gnas/ grub chen sa ra ha/ gnas 278

rten/ skyob pa'i sku sogs mang / gsung rten du 'bum dang / gcod kyi skor/de min 'bri lugs cho ga khag bcas dang / thugs rten du byang chub mchod rten bcas legs par grub/ spyi lo 1991lcags lug lo zla ba drug pa'i nang du grub dbang dkon mchog chos bzang dang / rtogs ldan rnam rgyal nyi ma sogs nas dur khrod du zhi khro'i dang bskang bshag kun rig gi dkyil 'khor bcas legs par bzhengs nas rdo bcal sgrig de min skra chog gi rdor sems dkyil 'khor bcas legs par grub nas/ nyin gcig dur khrod du bskang bshag tshogs nas/ drug pa'i tshes gsum la rab gnas mdzad/ de rjes rtogs ldan dkon mchog bstan 'dzin nas zhi khro dam pa rigs brgya dang lha khang bcas bzhengs/'gom rtogs ldan zhes pa ni bod mi'u gdong drug las a lcags 'bru yi rigs dang / cho 'brangs ni klu mi mgon dkar po'i rgyud pa klu khri'i rgyud mdo khams zhig po bco brgyad gyi ya gyal 'bru shel sku zhig po bla ma'i gdung rgyud yin zhing / (gdung la shel khyung yang zer ) khong nyid mdo dbus stod smad bar gsum du phebs nas nags shod du 'byor/ sa dmar ri klung 'gul du gnas tshang du bzhugs pas gong zhus ltar gyur nas rang dgon du bzhugs/de la sras gsum sku 'khrungs pa ni/ lhun 'grub/ rdo 'gyong / tshe sgrub gsum byung / yab mtshan snyan che bas sras lhun grub lo 'brong ngur dgon du gdan drangs/ rdo 'gyong ni rab tu byung / tshe sgrub kyis yab kyi gdung 'dzin pas sras ma byung / lhun grub la sras skad bzang dang / karma rang grol gnyis 'khrungs shing / skad bzang 'gom dgon du gdan drangs/ de rjes 'brong ngur dgon gyi shel khyung karma rang grol gyi sras shel dkar karma mthong grol mchog rang dgon du gdan drangs/ de ltar 'bru shel sku'i gdung sras rim 279

byon rnams 'gom rtogs ldan zhes kun la grags pa'i nad gcod gdon 'dul dang / 'go nad sogs nad gdon gang gis mi gnod pa dang / mtho dman dang gtsang btsog la sogs ji mi snyam par 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi 'khrul ba zhig pa'i rnam thar mang yang yi ges 'jigs pas ma bris so/280

ro༅//kwa mchog sgrub grwa thar pa gling /bod kyi lo rgyus yongs grags rnams su bstan pa phyi dar gyi skabs su gnas brtan kwa 'od mchog grags 'dul gzhung 'ga' phyir nas khams su phebs zhes 'khod pa'i de nyid kyi bzhugs gnas ni gnas 'di yin par snang ste/ kwa mchog zhes 'dis gsal la/ gzhan du kwa 'od mchog gi zur tsam yod pa mi dmigs pas so/ gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i mnga' bdag dpal ldan dwags po bka' brgyud zhes snyan pa'i dbyar rnga phyogs med ldir ba'i nang bses/ dpal 'brug pa bka' brgyud pa'i srol btod pa gling ras padma rdo rje mchog 'gro mgon phag mo gru pa'i slob ma'i gtso bor gyur nas bzhugs skabs/ zangs ri nas bud med gcig phyag rgyar bsten pa ma legs par dgongs nas/ dpe cha rnams bstar nas phag mor gru pa'i drung du song / bdag sgom ma dang chos ma mthun bsgrub pa gsha' ma zhig bya phyir khams phyogs su 'gro bar zhus pas de bzhin gnang ba bstsal/ rje phag gru'i slob ma zhig gis nags shod du sgrub gnas bzang bar zhus nas/1166rab byung gsum pa'i me khyi lo khams phyogs su phebs te/ dma' bar byon na legs par zhus pas lam du slob dpon sgom pa dang mjal/ myang po nas nags shod du phebs pas 'bul tshan dang chos zhu mkhan yang mang bas/nga bka' brgyud pa'i bla mi 'tshong gsungs nas 'bul tshan rnams ma bzhes paraganas 'dir dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ deb sngon smad cha shog grangs 777las/ nags shod du lo bzhi tsam bzhugs par gsungs snang /281

phyag rgya mo de rje nyid 'tshol du phyin pas zla dgon dang nye ba'i sa zhig tu mi ma yin du skyes/ de nas bzung gnas 'dir kwa mchog 'brug dgon thar pa gling zhes 'brug pa'i gdan sa dang po'i gral yin zhing / dus phyis nyams gud du song bas sgrub khang gi mal 'dir dgon hrul dang / kwa rgyab tu dgon zhig zhes 'du khang dang sgrub khang rnams nyams pa'i shul da lta 'ang yod/ de rjes 'gom dgon khyung ri'i klad du spos rjes bskyar gso zhus nas 'bri gung bka' brgyud pa'i sgrub grwa tshugs/ kwa mchog sgrub grwa thar pa gling zhes mtshan gsol/spyir bka' brgyud spyi dang rgyal ba 'bri gung pa la sgrub brgyud zhes pa ni/gcig pur ri khrod dam dgon pa'am gnas gang rung du bla mas bstan pa'i chos de nyams su len pa la bya ste/ mi la sgrub po/ gnas la sgrub gnas/ phug par sgrub phug khang par sgrub khang zhes brjod/ gcig pur gnas gcig tu sdod pa las mang po gnas gcig tu sdod pa ni nyung / sgrub khang la 'bri lugs la mtshams khang zhes 'bod pas/ sgrub por mtshams pa/ sgrub sde la mtshams grwa zer srol dar/ mtshams pa ni/ sgo gsum tha mal gyi bya ba dag mtshams bzhag ste gcig pur nyams len la gzhol ba'i don yin/ de ltar bgyi ba'i khang par mtshams khang zhes ming chags/ mtshams khang du mi gcig spyod lam rnam bzhi shong thub pa/ chab khang nang du yod la za btung 'dren pa'i bug pa sgo chung phyi nang yod pa la bug sgor zer/ chu skyel sa'i chu wa kha phyi nas nang du btsugs pa la blugs/ sgo sbad de bcad de 'brel gtugs mi bya zhing ngag mtshams bcad de sgrub par gzhol dgos/ lo gsum phyogs gsum ni 'go sngon 'gro nas 'jug phyag chen dang bsngo ba'i bar dang / yang na nā ro'i chos drug bcas lam rim cha tshang zhig sngon du son zin nas dngos bzhi phyag chen kho na la dmar 'jus byas nas lo gsum dang zla phyed gsum bzhugs pa la zer/282

nyi zla grub pa las/ lo gsum zla phyed gsum gyis ni/ mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ zhes gsungs pa ltar yin/ sgrub mchod ni mnyam tshogs nam rgyun ltar yin/ sgrub grwa'i nyams len la snga dus su phyag chen dang chos drugazab lam bla sgrub/ yang zab bcas 'bri lugs spyi dang 'dra bar sgrub grwa rje len sogs yod par mngon/ dus 'gyur gong du rang dgon nas 'dus grwa bzhi re bzhugs nas dgon pas lo phog dang spyi dang 'dra bar 'gyed gang yod 'bul srol yod/ de rnams kyis 'bri gung skyabs mgon rnam gnyis kyi sku tshe'i tshe sgrub gtso bo dang rang lugs phyag chen lnga ldan sogs la 'bad/ lo bcu'i god chags nang spyi dang 'dra bar mi rtag pa'i rang bzhin du gyur/de rjes su grub dbang dkon mchog chos bzang mchog 'bri gung nas phebs 'byor byung nas sgrub grwa nyams gso byed pa'i 'go tshugs nas sgrub khang bzhi la mdo phug gnyis gnyis yod pa dang shag sgor bcas bzhengs/ rje nyid kyis zab mo rim gnyis kyi dus 'da' ba dang / mtshams pa bstan pa'i nyi ma phyag chen dang / mtshams pa sangs rgyas btson 'grus mchog rdzogs chen bzhugs pa nas bzung rim bzhin sgrub pa la brtson pa'i dad ldan ser skya mchog dman mang pos/ phyag chen chos drug gi sgrub pa la brtson pa'i srol tshugs/ da lta dgon du sgrig bzhugs kyi dge 'dun zab mo lnga ldan dang chos drug nyams len byed pa mang / 'di nas yar tsam phyin pas rwa co mdo zhes pa'i grong 'dir dgon shul dang mchod rten shul bcas gsal po yod pas/sngon sog dus su dgon pa zhig yin zhing grong ming la klu phyug grong zhes 'bod/de'i phu la bla ma'i bzhugs khri zhes pa de ri dbang sku gong ma'i bzhugs khri yin zhes shod srol yod/ de nas ke khang grong pa'i mkhar shul 'di sngon bdud ming sring gnyis kyi mkhar yin par bshad pas/ mkhar shul zur gsum dang / de 283

'og rta rwa dang bshas rwa bcas yod cing / ches sngon thon gyi lag rtsal rdo btsig cig yin/ de ni sngon dus su sa btsan dang lung 'dud du dgra mkhar rgyab pa zhig yin las che zhes smra ba'ang byung ba dang / lhag par du rang lung pa'i sngon dus kyi lag rtsal gyi dpang rtags shig yin pas lo rgyus kyi rdo ring zhig dang / dpyad gzhi rin thang ldan pa'i pho brang zhig yin la mi lo nyis stong gi lo rgyus ldan pa'i bod kyi mkhar rnying shig yin/ de nas yer ra nang du khyad mtshar ba'i yer ra jo bo o rgyan sgrub gnas zhes mdun ri phyag rdor/ g.yas ri spyan ras gzigs/ rgyab ri 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi tshul du gnas pa'i sgrub phug 'di chags/ de'i 'og tu o rgyan rin po che'i sku rjes dang zhabs rjes/chos gzhung nas mar phyin pas mkha' 'gro'i khrus gzhong zhes tsha chu gnyis dang /de min tsha chu rnams srib na yod/ gnas der 'khrus dang mthung na nad gdon las grol ba sogs phan nus che/ skyabs rje ri dbang rin po che sku gong ma dkon mchog dam chos bstan pa'i nyi ma mchog ni 'tsho byed sman gyi phyag len la mkhas pa zhig yin pas/ mchog nyid kyis yi ra tsha chu 'di bzang po yod tshul gsungs rgyun yod la/ skyabs rje ri dbang mchog sprul nyid kyang / yi ra tsha khar rig gnas gsar brje'i gong tsam du yab dang lhan du gsang thabs ngang thengs gcig phebs pa'i yi ra tsha kha 'di yag po yod pa dang phan nus che ba yod zhes gsungs kyi yod/284

ro༅//'bar ba dbang gi sgrub gnas me 'bar phuganags klung bkra shis dal 'bab g.yon gyi phyogs/ri brag tshang tshing dbang gi sgrub gnas 'dir/dpal ldan ri ma ti yi pho brang dngos/ma rgyud mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams sprin ltar 'khrigs/zhes gnas mchog me 'bar dbang gi sgrub phug ces byin rlabs kyi tshan kha shin tu che ba 'di nyid/ slob dpon rin po che zhag bdun bzhugs sa dang /dpal ldan lha mo ri ma ti mched lnga'i gnas mchog yin zhing / brag la ri ma ti mched lnga rang byon gyi tshul dang / sgrub phug tu lha mo'i lha mtsho zhes sgrub chu dbyar mi che la/ dgun mi chung ba 'thung ba dang khrus byed na nad gdon bar gcod/ ban bon mthu btad byad gsum/ gza' klu rgyal 'gong gi gnod ngan/ ro dme thab mnol sogs dang / khyad par du dam tshig nyams chag nyes ltung gi dri ma dag nas dngos grub sna re thob pa dang / gnas mchog 'di nyid/ gter chen nyi ma grags pa mchog spyi lo 167shrīs rta lor phug nag tu bzhugs skabs mdzad pa'i sring rdzong gnas kyi gsol 'debs mthong ba don ldan las/ gnas me 'bar phug gi gzhal yas na/ yum mchog dpal ldan lha mo la gsol ba 'debs zhes gsungs pa ltar yin la/ gnas 'di nyid kyi sa dpyad phun sum tshogs shing / khyad par dbang gi sa dpyad rgyud nas gsungs pa ltar yongs su tshang bas 'bar ba dbang gi sgrub gnas zhes mtshan du chags pa yin/ rnal 'byor ba rnams sgrub la brtson pa la gnas dben zhing bsam 285

gtan gyi tsher ma med pa/ dge sbyor 'phel zhing nyams dga' ba/ ting 'dzin brtan zhing rtogs pa skye ba'i yon tan mnga' ba dang / g.yon du sgrol ma sngon mo rang byon/ 'og tu sgrol ma 'bum del dang byang sems dkar dmar/g.yas su bar do'i 'phrang der sgrol ma nyer gcig rgyab kyi ri la gangs sman/g.ya' sman/ spangs sman/ nags sman bcas sman mo nyi shu'i bla ri sogs mtshon pa'i gnas 'dir ma rgyud mkha' 'gro'i gnas mchog zhig yin pas mkha' 'gro ma tshogs sprin ltar 'thibs/ nub tu rigs gsum mgon po rang byon/ phyogs bzhir dur chen bzhi dang dur khrod brgya rtsa bcas kyis skor ba dang / sgrub phug gi g.yon zur du brag dmar gyen langs 'dir gnas mchog shel dkar 'bum pa'i gnas srung / snang mtha'i sgyu 'phrul rdo rje dgra bcom zhes/ sde brgyad gser skyems las/ btsan mchog gri btsan mthu bo che zhes mchog gi sde brgyad las gsungs pa'i btsan mchog zhig yin/ de nyid bsgrub na dngos grub char ltar 'bebs shing / mchod na kha 'dzin glog las myur ba/skal ldan rnal 'byor rnams kyi drod nyul zhing / skal med log lta can sogs gdug can thams cad skad cig gis brlag mdzad/ sa brgyad thob pa'i sems dpa' chen po de nyid grib btsan chen po rdo rje dgra bcom rtsal kyi gnas gzhi yin/ mdun ri btsan rgod rol ba skya bdun dang / ri brag thams cad dag pa'i ngor lha sku dang phyag mtshan yig 'bru sogs mtha' yas/ sngon dus su 'gom ba lag dgon bka' gdams pa'i lugs 'dzin dang / de'i rjes sgrub brgyud 'bri gung bka' brgyud pa'i skabs su ri khrod kun du zab mo'i rim gnyis la dbang bsgyur ba'i rnal 'byor pas khengs pa'i skabs su gnas 'dir sgrub phug gtso bo lnga dang phug phran/ de min phyag 'tshal sgang sogs sgrub grwa'i rjes shul gsal bar da lta'ang gnas/ spyi lo 16ra2rab byung bcu 286

gcig pa chu byi lor gter chen nyi ma grags pa mchog gis me 'bar sgrub phug nas rta mgrin dregs pa zil mnon gyi chos skor gdan drangs/ zangs mdog dpal gyi ri dang / rta mgrin dang 'od dpag med sogs rang byon rnams gtan la phab/ slob dpon padmas mdzad pa'i gnas srung chen po'i gsol mchod zhes gnas bstod dang grib btsan mched 'khor dang bcas pa'i bsang gsol spyan drangs nas shog ser las phabs/ de dang dus mnyam pa gnas srung chen po bzhugs pa'i sprin dpa' bo zhes mthu rtsal nus pa 'gran zla bral zhing / nags shod du dpa' bo phebs pa'i gnas rnams su brag la phyag zhabs rjes sogs shin tu mang / de min gnas srung chen po la rten nas zhi rgyas dbang drag gi sgrub skor mang po zhig yod kyang da lta khams khul du dar khyab cung che ba las gnas 'dir de tsam ma byung / gnas 'di'i bskor tshad dang /phan yon/ rang byung gi bkod pa sogs rgyas par mkhas mchog blo gros gzhan dga' mchog gis mdzad pa'i me 'bar gyi gnas yig tu gzigs par 'tshal/bar skabs shig la gnas 'dir rgyun bzhugs rkang 'dzin ma byung bar cung lus pas/ mtshams pa dbang chen dar rgyas nas 'dzin skyong gnang /khong ni spyi lo 1kha10g.yas g.yon du mdo smad phya phreng ya dkar nas yin pa'i mi rgyud du gnas shod du sku 'khrungs/ dgon gsar ya ho byang chub bla rgan gyi spun yin zhing / 'bri lugs yang zab dang / smyung gnas/ tshes bcu/ seng gdong skor/ gur drag bcas nyams su len pa dang / gnas shod grong gi tshes bcu'i dbu mdzad gnang / gnas shod dpon 'gan khur nas rgan po a rgob zhes mi dpon grags pa che ba dang sras gnyis 'khrungs bas 'gom dgon du grwa pa byas/ sras che de dbu bzod pa rin po che nas thugs rtsis che zhing ma 'ongs lung bstan yang bstsal/ khong gis ri khrod bskyar gso bya phyir/ 'gom 287

dpon lding dang sprin dpon tshang / khyad par du wag ta rgan po 'bu long bcas la rang lugs sngags btsun ri khrod bzhengs par zhus nas/byu ri khrod sgrub khang mchod rten bcas bzhengs/ de'i skabs nyi sprul sku phreng drug pa mchog mkhyen gnyis kyi yon tan rgyas shing / nags shod mi sde kun nas gtsug tu bkur ba'i skabs su zhabs la btugs nas snying thig gi chos skor zhus/ de skabs su 'gom yul grong dang chu srib bcas nas a ne bdun brgyad cig brtan sdod mdzad/ mtshams pa dbang chen dar rgyas mchog gnas 'dir grub pa thob nas sa rdo ri brag dang / bar snang la thog pa med par snang sems 'dres pa'i rdzu 'phrul mnga'/ mthar dam pa de nyid zhi bar gshegs pas ri khrod 'dzin mkhan ngag dbang rdo rje nas khur blangs/ khong ni yab sog ru zis dge dang / yum sprin bza' zhig gi sras su bltams nas chos sde dgon du rab tu byung / grwa sa 'bras blo gsal gling du mdzad nas me 'bar du phebs/gu ru phug gi gter khung ngam thog phung zhes pa nas zhal mthong ba gu ru snang srid zil gnon bzhengs pa dang / de min sman sku kha shas bcas grub/ khong gi 'bur sku bzhengs pa'i lag rgyun ni zhang po mthu chen ye shes yin pa dang gsang sngags nyams len la brtson bzhin pa'i skabs der rig gsar dus 'gyur byung nas/ rten dang brten par bcas pa 'thor zhig tu phyin/ slar yang chos lugs dar ba'i skabs su nag chu zhabs brtan dgon sogs la lha bzhengs bar phebs/ de nas mar byon nas spyi lo 19ra4lo ri khrod sngar ltar nyams gso bya ba'i dbu tshugs/ sgrub phug sogs kha shas nyams gso mdzad nas zhi bar gshegs/de rjes ri khrod bdag skyong gtso bo dkon mchog chos skyabs dang /dkon mchog chos 'dzin gnyis nas gnang / dkone mchog chos skyabs ni rdo 288

mkhar rgya dpon tshe 'grub kyi sras su 'khrungs shing / grub dbang dkon mchog chos bzang gis me 'bar sgrub phug tu gtsug phud bzhes pas mtshan dkon mchog chos skyabs zhes gnang / 'bri gung grub dbang dge slong dpa' chung rin po che las dge slong gi sdom pa zhus/ grub dbang dbu chos bzang gi sku mdun nas phag mo'i dbang khrid gsan nas nyams len mdzad/ chags ri mkhan rig 'dzin chos dbyings las chags ri'i chos skor rnams zhus/dkon mchog chos 'dzin ni chos skyabs dang rab byung dang dge slong sdom pa zhu yul gcig mtshan dkon mchog chos 'dzin zhes gnang / dge slong dpa' chung rin po che dang dbu chos bzang las lnga ldan zhus/ de min chos 'brel rnams ma bris/ khong gis phyi log nas zhal 'debs dang 'gan 'khur/dkon mchog chos skyabs kyis nang du brtan bzhugs mdzad nas las grwa'i rkang bzung bas/ da lta sgrub phug 'du khang dang lha sku/ gzim chung / grwa shagamachod rten bcas legs par grub/ shel dkar 'bum pa gnas bskor phebs mkhan rnams kyis gnas 'di mthong ba tsam gyis dwangs ba 'dren pa'i mig rgyan du gyur/ ri khrod 'di nyid lo ltar byed sgo dmigs bsal med pas gtso bo sgrub pa nyams len bya rgyu de yin pa dang / nyin ltar gnas srung chen po gtso'i rang lugs gsol ka chag med mdzad kyi yod/sku rten/ rten gtso slob dpon padma'i sku dang / skyob pa 'jig rten gsum mgon/ rta mgrin dregs pa zil gnon/ nyi grags gter chen/gnas srung grib btsan chen po bcas kyi sman sku mi tshad ma dang de min li sku sogs mang /gsung rten/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur dang / dam chos dgongs gcigarin chen gter mdzod/ shar gter sogs mang tsam bzhugs so/289

༄khya//shag wa thang dgon bka' brgyud 'phel rgyas gling /gsang sngags gsar rnying kun gyi mdzod 'dzin zhing /'gro drug sems can kun gyi ma mchog dang /mi brjed 'jig rten khams kyi 'dren pa'i gtso/rgyal ba'i dbang po 'brong ngur gangs par 'dud/gang gi thugs sras rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab mchogadaka' spyad snying rus sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin/sa lam mthar phyin mchog gi dngos grub thob/bstan pa'i rgyan gcig rang grol phyag byar 'os/bstan dang 'gro la brtse bas mi 'dor bar/bsam bzhin srid pa'i skur bzhengs gnas mchog 'dir/slar yang sgrub brgyud bstan pa gsal ba'i mgon/dzam dmar chos kyi rgyal po cis mi gus/rnam sum dad pa'i me tog tshig gi phreng /rnam dag mos gus gdung ba bskyed pa'i phyir/rnam nyung yi ge'i ris su bstar ba la/rnam mang mkhyen ldan tshogs la nongs pa'i rgyu/zhes nags shod 'gom sgro ba dpon tshang gi mnga' khongs su bka' 290

dgon gnyis las/ 'gom stod shag wa thang dgon ni/ spyi lo 124ṭwāṃrab byung bzhi pa'i sa sprel lo rje gangs dkar pas phyag btab/ rje 'di nyid ni sngon 'das pa'i sangs rgyas mar me mdzad kyi skabs su nya pa spang leb dang /da lta thub pa'i dbang po'i skabs su bram ze ha lu pa'i skye ba bzhes/ slob dpon padma'i skabs su ye shes snying po/ rje dus gsum mkhyen pa'i sku mdun du rgyal ba gangs dkar pa yin te/ rje 'di nyid sku 'khrungs ba'i yul ni gya pa/yab gsang sngags rnying ma ba zhi khro phur gsum las grub pa thob pa dang / lhag tu phur pa 'di nyid slob dpon padma las paṇa ṭi ta phra la ring mos zhus/ des seng ge rgyal mtshan/ nyi ma 'od zer/ khyung nag tshe tshe/ ye shes snying po/ bkra shis dbang grub/ 'khrul gyi gshog rgod/ rdo rje nag po/ kho de dbang grub/mes po sgya rje/ yab jo nag bar du grub thob kyi zam ma chad pa de'i khang la thod phreng la yi dam rgya mtshos bskor ba/ bar khang la o rgyan rin po che dang chos sku rdo rje 'chang la bka' brgyud bla ma dus mkhyen sogs kyis bskor ba/steng du chos sku snang ba mtha' yas la sangs rgyas rgya mtshos bskor ba dang mjal/slob dpon rin po ches phur pa dang yang phur/ o rgyan nyid kyi mgur phur bcas gnang / khyed byang phyogs su phu yangs ba sla nga 'dra ba/ mda' dog pa shan mchu 'dra ba/ phyogs bcu'i ri la bkra shis rtags brgyad/ rgyal srid sna bdun/ gnam sa chos 'byung kha sprod/ 'phrin las phur pa'i sa dpyad yongs su tshang ba der song la/ byang me mo brag dkar gyi gnas bdag gyis zhes/'gro ba'i don chen po yongs bar lung bstan/ rje gangs pa rin chen 'od zer de nyid sog shod dang / nags shod stod du 'dul bya'i don du spyi lo 124ṭwāṃrab byung bzhi pa'i sa sprel lo zla ba bdun pa'i tshes bco lnga la me mo 291

brag dkar po'i mdun tshogs 'khor phul bas/ gnas bdag gis nyams sad phyir zhi mi sprul nas tshogs rdzas khyer bas/ phyag phreng dor ba dang phyag zhabs rjes rnams khra lam mer bzhugs/ rje nyid phug pa'i sgo ru byon pas gnas bdag dge bsnyen gser mdog can gtso 'khor bdun kyis phebs bsu zhus/ gnas 'dir bka' brgyud bla ma yi dam lha tshogs dang mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs rnams sprin gyi phung po btibs pa ltar zhal mjal nas/phyi ltar ri yi rgyal po ri rab la gling bzhi gling g.yog gi tshul dang / nang ltar yi dam rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor yin te/ chos rje sku phreng dgu pa byang phyogs paṇa ṭi ta dge ba'i dbang pos mdzad pa me mo'i gnas yig 'gro ba 'dren pa'i shing rta las bsdus te 'dren na/bka' thang shel brag las mkha' 'gro'i phug pa zla ba gsum zhes dang /ngo mtshar rong la gter phran sna tshogs sbas zhes gsungs/ ye shes mtsho rgyal 'chi med lcags srog sgrub pa'i gnas mchog khyad par can dang / ston pa thub pa'i dbang po mchog nyid ma dag pa'i skye ba lnga brgya bzhes dus shā ba'i skye ba bzhes pa'i gnas/ rtsa ri dwags pa shel ri dang dbyer ma mchis pa 'di nyid du phebs pas/ rtogs ldan rig 'dzin grags kyis khyed su yin zhes bshad pas/ nga me mo'i gnas bdag 'gro mgon chos rje yin gsungs/ de nas khong gnyis gnas bdag la ma 'chams par brag phug nas su thon thub min rtsal 'gran pas/ chos rje 'phur ba'i rlung gis rtogs ldan mar me shi nas thon ma thub par sku gshegs/ chos rje sa 'og nas rgyud ri glang po che 'dra ba'i sna nas phebs te rdo pha bong la zhabs rjes gnang / dus de nas bzung me mo'i gnas bdag rgyal ba gangs pa yin zhing / dag snang dang rang byung rnams gtan la 292

phab pa de nyid las/ gnas mchog 'di nyid thang chen gsum dang / ri chen gsum/ la chen gsum/ mtsho chen gsum gyi bskor zhing stod la ba gam lnga lnga dang / de la rang byon rdo rje 'chang dang klu sgrub/ dril bu pa/ dza lan dha ra/nag po spyod pa/ til lo ba/ na ro pa/ karna ri pa/ rdo rje gdan/ 'jig med 'byung gnas/ tsa mi/ rga lo/ phag gru dang / dus mkhyen/ gangs pa sogs bka' bzhi brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang / sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi lha tshogs/ 'og gi blo 'bur la mgon po phyag bzhi phyag drug beng 'dzin ma ning stag sham la sogs pho rgyud/ lha mo mu kha li dang bstan srung a phyi sogs mo brgyud kyi lha tshogs rnams bzhugs/ ri bo 'di nas babs pa'i chu bo yan lag brgyad ldan bzhi/ mi 'bab pa'i chu bo bzhi/ brtsegs pa'i ri chen bzhi/ ma brtsegs pa'i ri chen bzhi/ de la brten pa'i la chen bzhi/ bzhugs pa'i phug pa bzhi dang / ma bzhugs pa'i phug pa bzhi/ dbang chen rgyud kyi chu bo bzhi dang / phyogs bzhi rong chen bzhi/ logs bzhi 'gro ba'i 'phrang chen bzhi bcas yod/ shar du zhi ba'i phug dkar du dus 'khor lha tshogs dang rong chen kha ba dkar po/ lho phyogs rgyas pa'i phug ser du 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs dang gangs dkar te si ma pham g.yu mtsho rang byung / nub phyogs dbang gi phug dmar la dgyes pa rdo rje'i lha tshogs dang bya rgod spungs ri chu bo nā ra dza na rang byon/ byang phyogs mngon spyod phug nag der dpal ṭwāsdun gsang ba 'dus pa'i lha tshogs dang dpal gyi rtswa ri tra chu bo dmar nag rakta 'bab/ khrus dang 'thung ba byed na dbang bzhi thob nas sgrib bzhi dag pa sogs phan yon mtha' yas/ de'i mdun du rnam sras rta brgyad/ shar du sangs rgyas rabs bdun/lho ru sman bla mched brgyad/ nub tu tshe lha rigs lnga/ byang du sangs rgyas stong 293

rtsa/ phug sgo g.yas g.yon du gnas srung dge bsnyen rnam gnyis dang / mkha' 'gro phug tu gu ru gtso 'khor gsum rang byon dang 'khor gu ru mtshan brgyad/shel gyi ka ba dang bla bre/ ru tra'i glo grod mchin gsum/ gshin rje pho gdong mo gdong / ge sar skyes bu'i go khrab dang 'brug mo'i sbra 'then rnam gnyis/ shi gson bye ma'i la kha/ de nas yar phyin na rang byon rdo sku dang / bye ma sna lnga/'dzam bu'i chu ser/ la thog la dpa' rtul sum cu/ thur du song bas pha bong dkar po'i steng slob dpon gyis byin gyis rlabs pa rdo a ril byis mgo/ de'i steng shel phug nyi ma rdzong la grub thob brgyad cu'i pho brang / gshin rje'i dkyil 'khor sgo dkyil der 'da' med mar me spun sum dang / g.yon gyi brag phug tu shā ba ri dang lcam sring a tsa ra rang byon/ a stag klu mos byang g.yag 'dul ba'i tshul/ de'i phar kha na dmyal khams bco brgyad/ g.yung drung phug tu lhung bzed dang gnas rten bcu drug rang byon/ ge sar phyag mda' dang / mkha' 'gro'i tshogs gzhong mkha' 'gro bye ba/ mi rkang gling bu/ me tog dkar po'i gur/ yang gsang phug tu rkyang bu'i rjes/ nor sgrub phug tu 'dzam lha rigs lnga dang rta brgyad kyi g.yang khug tshe sgrub phug tu tshe dpag med dang tshe bum tshe mda' rang byon/ mtsho rgyal phug tu mtsho rgyal 'chi med lcags srog sgrub pa'i phug na tshe yi lha mo brgyad dang tshe bum kā pa la rnams yod/ de yi phug pa'i sgo phibs su gangs te si dang ma pham g.yu mtsho rang byon/ phyi skor brag steng du ston pa ma dag pa'i skye ba lnga brgya bzhes skabs shwa ba'i dbu rwa mched gsum/stag sham phug la tsan dan dkar dmar bka' bstan 'gyur/ shar na shā ba ri pa dang mi 'go gson bshus/ shar phyogs skar khung la chos sman phab rgyun/o rgyan phying gur na yang dag lha tshogs/ mdun du phyag 'tshal sgang dang /294

bar do'i 'phrang du spyan ras gzigs/ phyogs bzhir sgo bsrung sbrul glang stag sprel rang byon/ chu 'phyar sked par 'jam dpal dkar po dang nor bu dga' 'khyil dang chibs rjes/ gzhan yang bskor lam phyi nang la o rgyan rin po che'i phyag rjes dang 'bru gsum yig drug rang byon/ gzhan yang dur khrod brgyad dang / gnas chen nyer bzhir rgyu ba'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad til gyi gang bu ltar 'du zhing / lhag tu sprel lo hor zla bdun pa'i tshes bcu dang bco lnga la gangs pa rin po che phebs pa'i dus de nas bzung da lta'i bar shag wa thang dgon gi bla grwa rnams kyis tshogs 'khor 'bul ba sogs chad med rgyun gnas thob/ gzhan yang chos rje'i lung las/ rgya tsha mtshams khang dang /seb bkra rdza rgan/ rag chod/ thang dkar/ gnyen mtha'/ 'dod yon thang / tsha 'gag rkyang ri sogs gnas ri mang po gnas sgo 'byed pa dang rang byung ngo mtshar brtan la phab nas lung bstan mang yang yi ges 'jigs pas ma bris/ gong gsal zhus pa'i rang byon gyi lha tshogs rnams dang ri chu'i bkod pa phug pa'i nang gi rang byon 'di rnams/ zer sgros tsam dang / rnam pa tsam ma yin par dper na 'jim bzo la cung mi mkhas pa zhig gis bzhengs pa lta bu las dbye ba cher med cing shin tu ngo mtshar che/ bod gangs can gyi ljongs su rang byon mang po yod kyang / 'di las ngo mtshar ba dang 'di las lhag pa zhig med ces kha tshon gcod chog snyam/chos rje nyid me mo brag nas 'bri lung rgyud ri glang sna nas thon te/ rdo pha bong la zhabs rjes bzhag nas wa thang sum mdor phebs/ gnas 'dir lung bstan ltar sa sprel spyi lo 124shrīlor 'brong bu dgon gsar bzhengs/ shar rgya stag lho g.yu 'brug nub rma bya/ byang rus sbal/ dbus glang chen 'gying 295

'dra/ o rgyan padma'i sgrub phug yig drug rang byon/ zhabs rjes/ bzhugs khri/ a rang byon sogs gtan la phab/ de nas sog khu ru 'phrang nas thon te sog 'brong ngur dgon nam tsan dan dgon phyag btab/ de skabs 'brong bu'i dgon gnas khag dbon rgyud kyis bskyangs/ de 'og sku thog rim byon nas bskyangs pa yin/ rgyal ba gangs pa nyid spyi lo 1247dgung lo brgyad cu gya gsum la sog tsan dan dgon du zhi bar gshegs/ sku dmar gdung bzhugs pas rig gsar gong du dgon pa nyams gso zhu skabs sku gdung dang /chos rje'i chibs kyi dbu yin nam snyam pa'i rta mgo la rta mgrin rang byon yod pa dang / de min las phur khag gsum/ bka' 'gyur sogs mang po yod zhes sog 'jigs sprul nas gsungs/sku phreng gnyis pa rnal 'byor grags pa rgyal po sog 'brong ngur dgon du phebs nas rang lugs kyi cho ga khag dang dbang lung bcas rgyun 'dzin mdzad/sku phreng gsum pa khyung ston 'od po ni karma pa rol rdor zhabs la btugs nas chos bka' yongs rdzogs nyams len byed/ karma pa rol pa'i rdo rje nas nags shod du dge 'dun stong phrag tsam la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang nā ro chos drug sogs bka' brgyud pa'i chos bka' dpag tu med pa gnang zhes rnam thar du gsungs/sku phreng bzhi pa lhun grub rgyal mtshan ni rje gong ma'i rnam thar bskyangs/sku phreng lnga pa padma rgyal mtshan rten sngags 'chang yin zhing mthu nus che bas snang srid dbang du 'dus/ ṭakki bran du bkol/sku phreng drug pa karma don grub ni/ rig gnas kun la mkhas shing mkhas grub gnyis ldan du song bas rdza dmar stod smad la 'phrin las che bas dad ldan 296

rnamasakyis gsol ba btab pa bzhin du sku yi sras gcig rdza dmar du btang bas/ rdza dmar 'brong ngur dgon phyag btab/sku phreng bdun pa karma dge dbang ni rje gong ma ltar mdzad 'phrin che/ sku phreng brgyad pa gangs pa mchog rgyal ni tshe dang sgrub pa mnyam zhing bka' brgyud bla ma'i pha rabs zin/sku phreng dgu pa byang phyogs paṇa ṭi ta dge ba'i dbang po mchog thos bsam sgom gsum gyis mkhas grub gnyis ldan du gyur/ gong sa lnga pa yang thugs dgyes pas mkhas pa'i tshad du 'dzin/ lnga pa chen po'i sku yi rim gro mdzad pas snyun grol/ de'i legs ster du sku rten thub pa gsung byon/ gsung rten bka' 'gyur gser gdong can/ thugs rten du bya rung kha shor/ rje nyid la rta mgo gser tog dang / bran skya dar/ bsu sna mdo dar sogs thob thang dang / rtse pho brang rta lam gong ma bar chibs thog tu phebs chog pa'i go gnas/rang dgon gyi grwa pa la phral dngul dmag gsum dang / grwa sa yongs gzhis sger khung bkag 'gog mi chog pa dang / dgon ming du zhabs dgon bka' 'gyur ri phug zhes bstsal bas/ rang dgon nas rgyal ba mchog gi zhabs brtan du lo ltar bka' 'gyur tshar gsum re chag med du 'bul gyi yod/ phyi ltar na bla dgon gnyis mtshan snyan dang thob thang mtho ru btang nas spyi tshogs thog grags pa che khul tsam las/ de skabs sog po gu shris gtsang pa sde srid gtor pham btang nas karma bka' brgyud kyi dgon gnas mang po zhig nyams nyes song bas/ de mtshungs kyis sog 'brong ngur dgon nam tsan dan dgon dge dgon du bsgyur/ shag wa thang dgon yang dgon ming bsgyur ba bcas byed nas don du karma gi tshang gi rgyud pa med par byed/ chos rje dge ba'i 297
