dbang po mchog mkhas par gyur kyang thabs zad nus stong du gyur bar mngon/rje 'di yan karma bka' brgyud kyi srol gtso bo 'dzin kyang nyams gud du phyin/ lhag tu rgyal ba gangs pa mchog dang rang grol rin po che gnyis zhing du gshegs nas gdan sa'i khri 'dzin med par gyur skabs der/ 'gom yul rong tsho smad chos 'khor byams pa gling ni 'bri gung thel sgar gnyis dang skyabs mchog rnam gnyis bcas 'brel che ba la brten nas/ 'gom dpon sogs mi che rgu kun gyis bka' gros dang bcas 'di skabs skyabs mgon 'phrin las bzang po dang / don grub chos rgyal gnyis kyi dus skabs yin zhing / shag wa thang dgon gyis skyabs rje mchog gnyis la zhus pas/ 'bri gung bu slob sum cu'i nang tshan/ dzam dmar bsod nams rgya mtsho mchog dgon pa'i khri 'dzin du btang nas/ dpal 'bri gung bka' brgyud pa'i chos srol 'dzin pa dngos su gyur/ sprul sku rnam pa'i mtshan kyi dbur dkon mchog ces gsol pas shes la de sngon karma zhes 'dogs srol yod/ dzam dmar sprul skus yang srid yong bar lung bstan nas zhi bar gshegs/ 'di nas bzung 'brong ngur yab sras 'bri gung skyabs rje rnam gnyis nas ngos 'dzin mdzad srol byung /sku phreng bcu pa dkon mchog bstan 'dzin bzang po ni mkhyen brtse nus pa mchog tu mnga' zhing / bka' brgyud pa'i srol bzang bla na med par rgyud 'dzin gnang / sku phreng bcu gcig pa dkon mchog bstan 'dzin don grub mchog gis gdan sa bzung / skyabs mgon padma'i rgyal mtshan mchog 'gom dgon chos 'khor byams pa gling du chibs bskyod skabs spyi lo 1rdorkya4rab byung bcu gsum shing pho byi ba'i zla ba drug par rang dgon du gdan drangs nas zhag gnyis bzhugs/ mos blo bzhin dbang dang rjes gnang 'ga' bstsal 298

nas/ chos rje rin po ches rang dgon la dgon ming zhus pas/ shag wa thang bka' brgyud 'phel rgyas gling zhes mtshan gsol/ sras phur dgas skyabs mgon chos kyi nyi ma gdan drangs nas lo 'brong ngur dgon sgar pa las dgon par bsgyur/ 'di chos rje bstan 'dzin rnam grol gyi sras yin par bris kyang lo rabs gong 'og song bas 'di yin zhes mi 'grig pas chos rje bstan 'dzin don grub kyi sras yin snyam/ (gzhan yang kha gcig gis gangs pa'i gdung rgyud las yab rta mgrin rgya mtsho dang yum ga bza' klu mtsho'i sras su bltams par gsungs/) chos rje mchog nas rgyal ba 'bri gung pa'i lugs srol phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan nyams len mthar phyin nas yul 'dir 'dul bya rnams smin grol gyi lam la bkod/chos rje sku phreng bcu gnyis pa bstan 'dzin rnam grol mchog mdo sngags gzhung lugs gnyis ka la mkhas zhing nus mthu tshad med mnga' bas log lta can gyi bdud rigs thams cad tshar bcad/rje 'di'i slob ma nyi ma lta bu/ gnas byang gling dpal gyi yang dgon na/rje btsun dkon mchog chos skyabs la gsol ba 'debs zhes 'bri gung gdan rabs bla rgyud gsol 'debs las gsungs pa ltar/ rje btsun dkon mchog chos skyabs mchog yab rdza dmar a grags kyi ru khrod nas chad pa 'jam gsar rgyal lha dang / yum stag drug chin hu'i g.yog mo tshe thar gnyis kyi sras su 1rdo24rab byung bcu bzhi'i shing pho rta lor sku 'khrungs/ mtshan bkra shis rnam rgyal du gsol/ yum bran mo yin pas rmo bo chung skyid kyis sku bskyed bsrengs/ byis pa'i dus su tsog pur bzhugs pa la spro zhing / bya ba gang byed sgom sgrub dang chos mchad rnam pa las ma 'das/ khu bo las klog bslabs pas 299

sgra dag gsal snyan ldan pa'i khyad chos mnga'/ dgung lo brgyad nas phu dung dang rdo dang shog bu sogs la slob dpon med par lan war dang / hor yig dang bod bris khag rnams legs par mkhyen/ lha bri ba dang 'jim pa bzheng pa/rdo shing la brko ba sogs ma bslab par mkhyen/ skyob pa'i mgur chen khag bris nas dbyangs su tsi ri ri len/ dgung lo bcu la shag wa thang dgon 'brong ngur sku phreng bcu gnyis pa bstan 'dzin rnam grol las rab tu byung nas mtshan dkon mchog thabs mkhas zhes gsol/ rgyal ba bka' brgyud pa las gzhan mi bsam pas rdo rje 'chang gi sku mthong bas mos gus rtsol med skye/ bla gnyer nas bka' 'gyur lung gsan/ lcags phag lor tshong pa dang lhan du lha sar phyin/ dgung lo nyis shur stod gangs rin po cher gnas bskor la phebs/phyir phebs nas lo gsum la che hu'i g.yog bsdad/ me sbrul lor 'bri gung du bka' chos gsan bzhed du phebs nas/ rje nor bu'i zhal mjal bas bcos min gyi mos gus 'khrungs/ 'bri gung gi sgrub grwa ba cog sgar du bzhugs pas yid 'phrog grub dbang dam chos nyi ma dang mjal bas pha yul gcig pas rogs gang thub gnang bar zhal bzhes mdzad/ sgrub grwar bzhugs rgyu'i gros btab nas gsol dpon rgyud skyabs mgon la zhus pas gnang ba thob de nas grub dbang no no rin po che mjal nas chos kyi gnang ba bzang po thob/'di dus phyi'i chos rwa nas lnga ldan gtor dbang / thugs bskyed chen mo/bstan snying / bden gnyis kyi dbang / na ro chos drug sogs 'bri gung pa'i bka' chos grags che ba rnams thob/ skyabs mgon nor bu mchog gis mkhan po mdzad nas dge 'dun drug cu dang bcas bsnyen par rdzogs/ bka' chos grub nas rmo bo la phyag rtags dang bcas sgrub grwar yod tshul zhus pas rmo bo mya 300

ngan gyi khung bur chud/ pha yul gcig pa'i nags shod pa nor grub dang dam chos nas sne len mdzad nas sgrub grwa shar du khang pa gcig thob/ grub dbang no no rin po che nas tshe dbang 'chi med dpal ster gnang nas chos sgo phye/skyabs mgon mchog las chos spyod/ gtor chog bla mchod/ ku sa li/ srung 'khor zhal gdams/ ting 'dzin dbang bskur/ bde mchog lnga ldan shel dkar phreng ba dang / grub dbang las phyag chen zla zer bshad sbyar bcas zhus/bde mchog gzhi bsnyen gyi skabs su grub dbang no no rin po che'i phyag dpe g.yar du byon pas/ grub dbang gis phyag dpe co chen de gnang bas dga' drags nas ngu shor/ don du rgyal tshab tu mnga' gsol/ bde mchog gzhi bsnyen tshar nyi shu rtsa gnyis gnang / sku mdun du nam bcar chog la 'dod chos gang zhus gnang bar byung ngo / 'di skabs phyag chen do dha skor gsum sogs gzigs pas ti lo pa dang zhal mjal/ skyabs mgon gyi zhal nas kun rig mi 'khrugs pa dang / bde mchog dbang chen/ smyung gnas/ zhi khro'i chog dbang dang / khyung khra'i dbang / na ga rakka/ chos drug grwa dmangs dang mnyam du thob/ skyabs rje nyi ma mchog las dang po lam rim thar rgyan gsan/sprel lo la rmo bo phebs nas rje nyid mjal bas sku la 'chang nas ngus song /chos yang dag gyis nga'i bsam pa rdzogs pa yin gsungs nas log de nas bka' brgyud pho brang 'og mar zhugs/ rtogs pa phul bas grub dbang nyid thugs mnyes/ rje nyid sham thab dra ba can dang / 'ding ba lhung bzed/chos gos dang chab ril 'dogs pa sogs mdzad pas de ltar rim bzhin byung bas mig ltos bzang / grub dbang no no sku gshegs skabs snyun g.yog mdzad pa dang dgongs rdzogs kyi rim pa rnams legs par mdzad/ grub dbang dam 301

chos nyi ma las chos drug gsan nas nyams bzhes gnang / dwags po lha rje dang phyag na rdo rje sogs zhal gzigs nas mtshan ma bzang / bka' phyag chu bo gsum 'dres kyi bstan pa bskyar gso gnang ba'i skabs su log smra 'ga' yang byung / sa yos lor rtswa ri tra dang dwags lha sgam po sogs su phebs skabs sngon gyi rmi lam ltar mjal bas rje nyid ngo mtshar/ sgam po bskal bzang phyogs las rnam rgyal las phag mo'i dbang dang / phyag rgya chen po dang nā ro chos drugathar rgyan/ chos bzhi'i rtsa 'grel dang sgam po'i bka' 'bum gsan/ bka' brgyud gser phreng dang rgyud pa chu bo gsum sgril bla rabs sku 'dra brgyad cu lhag gser zangs las bskrun pa dang / yongs 'dzin gnya' stag las sgrub thabs nor phreng zhus/ rje nyid sgrub grwa'i slob dpon so gcig pa'i khrir 'khod nas lcags rta lo nas me byi lo bar sgrub sde lo nyer brgyad tsam bskyangs/ bka' brgyud kyi chos bka' grub dbang no nos gsal bar mdzad pa bzhin ches cher spel/ rje 'di nyid kyis bka' brgyud rin po che'i gsung 'bum yongs rdzogs kyi lung dang zab chos khag bde mchog dang phag mo/ mi 'khrug pa/ thugs bskyed chen mo/ bla sgrub/ bstan dgongs/ phyag chen chos drug bcu chos sum chos/ mos gus srog 'khor/ lam rim thar rgyan/ tshe khrid khag sogs mdor na dpal 'bri gung bka' brgyud pa'i chos srol yongs rdzogs kyi khrid lung bar skabs shig cung nyams yang / rje 'dis ches cher gsal bar mdzad pa zhig yin pas/ skyabs rje rnam gnyis nas sar bu pa yan la lam mchog tshang la ma nor ba 'di nyid kyi gdams pas phyug par mdzad/ sngon gyi gral skad nas gral stod smad kun la 'gyed pa'i rmi lam de 'di yin pa 'dra gsungs/sgrub pa bzhugs pa'i skabs su dag snang dang mi ma yin sogs la 'gro don 302

mtha' yas/ sgrub grwa'i dpe rgyun dkon pa sel phyir lnga ldan gtsos pa'i dpen rgyun khag mang po par bskrun mdzad/ rje nyid kyi mdzad pa'i bka' brgyud bstan pa'i rtsal du bka' phyag chu bo gsum sgril kyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang /mar lugs phag mo gsang chen rgya mtsho/ rnam rgyal tshe sgrub sogs le tshan khag nyer gnyis tsam da lta bzhugs/ rje 'di nyid kyis 'bri bstan la shin tu dka' drin che ba gzhan 'ga' yang ma byung zhes gsungs/ mthar dgung grangs re bdunaspyi lo 1900rab byung bco lnga lcags bya lo zla ba gsum pa'i tshes nyer gnyis nyin gzim sgor phebs nas zhabs bcag mdzad/ nang du ku re 'ga' gsungs/ de nas gzim sgrom du sku drang por srang nas mi 'khrugs pa'i gzungs bzla ba'i mus der ri rab 'degs pa'i rgya dang bcas steng sgo rnam grol gyi lam nas mngon dgar gshegs/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas ni brjod las 'das pa dang / spur sbyangs nas rje nyid dka' drin che bas gdung rten rten 'phyag tu bzhengs bar gros mthun nas skyabs mgon zung nas rab gnas mdzad/ rgyas par yang ri'i slob dpon rim byon rtogs brjod nor bu'i ljon shing la gzigs na shin tu rgyas par yod/chos rje sku phreng bcu gsum pa karma bha dra mchog bka' brgyud pa'i chos bka' rnams nyams su blangs pas brtsams chos kyang mang / 'bri gung skyabs rje zhi ba'i blo gros gdan zhus mdzad nas/ dpal 'bri gung bka' brgyud pa'i zab chos sogs lung khrid zhus/ skyabs mgon mchog gis wa thang dur khrod dkyil 'khor bzhengs/ dur khrod 'di nyid 'bri gung rten phyag dang dbyer med ces bsngags pa brjod/ chos rje sku phreng bcu bzhi pa dkon mchog bstan 'dzin ni byang smre ti khar 303

sku 'khrungs/ rang lugs cho ga la mkhas shing mtha' dmag kha snon du zhabs rjes kyang bstsal/chos rje sku phreng bco lnga pa bstan 'dzin 'gro 'dul ni yab rgyal thang dang /yum dpal bzang gnyis kyi sras su spyi lo 1922chu phag lo nag chu ge sor 'khrungs zhing / ngo mtshar pa'i ltas du ma dang khyad par du stag sham dang khyung sen bkra/ sbyangs pa de tsam med kyang / brtsams chos dang lung bstan khag la tshig 'gros bzang zhing don 'bras legs pa'i dge mtshan ldan/ bstan dang 'gro ba'i don du 'gro don mtha' yas mdzad kyang re zhig de tsam mo/'brong ngur rnam gsum zhes pa'i nang tshan rang grol rin po che ni/ gong zhus ltar chos rje gangs pa sku phreng dang po'i sras su rab tu ma byung pa'i gong du sku 'khrungs/ mtshan sangs rgyas rin bsrung zhes gsol kyang / sras kyis nga rang grol yin zhes gsungs pas de ltar thog skyes bu dam pa yin par mkhyen nas yab kyis bla ma rang grol zhes mtshan gsol/ khong gi gdung las rgyal ba 'brong ngur pa'i gdung rabs mang du byon/ de nas rang grol sku phreng gnyis pa rin chen grub yin te 'di nas bzung rnam thar rgyas par mi snang bas rjes su dpyad par bya/ sku phreng gsum pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ bzhi pa shes rab rgya mtsho/ lnga pa karma rgya mtsho/ drug pa karma rab brtan/ bdun pa karma dpal 'bar/ brgyad pa karma 'phrin las rang grol/ dgu pa bla ma dkon mchog chos grags/ bcu pa dam chos kun bzang rang grol/ bcu gcig pa dkon mchog kun bzang rang grol/ bcu gnyis pa dkon mchog gzhan phan dbang phyug bzang po yin te rje 'di sgro ba dpon tshang du sku 'khrungs nas (sprul sku nyis zlos su gyur nas/) gcig 'gom dgon gsar nas khrir bkod nas sku thog 304

gnyis byung /dzam dmar sku phreng rim byon gyi rnam thar rgyas par mi snang kyang / mtshan gyi phreng ba tsam brjod na/ chos rje sku phreng dgu pa paṇa ṭi ta chos kyi dbang po dang / rang grol sku phreng brgyad pa karma 'phrin las rnam gnyis sku gshegs skabs/ rang dgon du 'bri gung skyabs rje 'phrin las bzang po dang / skyabs rje don grub chos rgyal gnyis kyi bka' ltar dzam dmar bsod nams rgya mtsho mchog rang dgon du phebs nas sku tshe gang por bzhugs/ sku mya ngan las 'da' khar yang srid 'byon par zhal gyis bzhes/ de sngon sku phreng ga tshod song min ma shes pas rje 'di sku phreng dang po yin/ sku phreng gnyis pa ngag dbang thub bstan me 'bar/ sku phreng gsum pa nges legs chos kyi dbang po/ sku phreng bzhi pa chos kyi nyi ma/ sku phreng bdun pa dkon mchog bstan 'dzin chos kyi dbang po mchog nags shod dar lung gzhung du yab g.yang rgyal dang / yum 'phags mo sgrol ma gnyis kyi sras su spyi lo 197rkyalcags khyi lor sku 'khrungs/sa stag lo spyi lo 199rdol rang dgon du gdan drangs nas mi 'jigs gdong lnga'i gser khrir bkod/ skyabs rje ri dbang dkon mchog bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal mtshan mchog las skyabs sdom zhus/ rang lugs chos bka' dang zab mo rin 'byung gi bka' dbang lung khrid zhus/ lhag tu grub dbang dkon mchog chos bzang gi zhabs drung nas phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gyi sgom khrid zhus nas sgrub pa la brtson bzhin mchis/ shag wa thang dgon 'di phyis su ser khyim dgon par gyur pas/ dbu mdzad dkon mchog rin chen gyis re ba ltar dang sras chung sogs grwa mang gi thugs re bzhin spyi lo 1992chu sprel lor 'gom bla ri dbang rin po ches dge tshul gyi sdom pa gnang nas gtsang dgon du bsgyur/305

khyad par du rang dgon la phyi lha khang ka brgya bzhengs ba dang / nang rten du spyi lo 2006me khyi lor rang dgon gyi rten gtsor/ sbyin pa'i bdag po tsis lhug dang / yungs dkar bla ma/ gsar rjes gsum gyi/ gser zangs las grub pa'i seng khri dang khri drug mgyogs dang ldan pa'i chos sku rdo rje 'chang chen/longs sku rdor rje sems dpa'/ sprul sku shākya thub pa thog tshad re bcas bzhengs/ bod me phag lor 'gom stod shag wa thang dgon bka' brgyud 'phel rgyas gling gi rten gtso mnyam med rgyal dbang rin chen dpal gyi sku thog tshad ma 'di ni mtho tshad la kung khre gsum dang skar bdun cu dang de min spyan snga rnam gnyis/ seng khri rgyab yol/ rin chen ka ba dang 'brug sha 'gyur/ tshe dpag med/ rgyal chen rnam sras/ a mgon chos gsum bcas pa 'di ni/sbyin bdag stong tsha zis mgo dang / g.yang 'dzoms gnyis kyi dgongs rdzogs dang 'khrungs rtags su bzhengs pa yin/ de ni dgon bla dzam dmar dkon mchog bstan 'dzin mchog la rten gtso gang zhig bzhengs bar zhus pas/chos rje skyob pa yab sras bzhengs bar rjes bzhin gnang ba bstsal bas/ dad sbyin dang rang dgon pa'i grwa dkon mchog tshul khrims gnyis kyis 'gan khur nas/ rgya nag khreng tu'u grong khyer du lugs su bskrun nas sa zla'i tshes nyer gsum la gangs can sa yi rtse mo lha ldan du gdan drangs pa bcas 'gro don rgyas bzhin pa'o/rigagasar sngon du rten gsum dkar chag sku rten gtso bo rdo rje 'chang dang / til lo/ na ro/ mar mi dwags gsum/ karma pa/ skyob pa 'jig rten gsum mgon/ thub pa gsung byon rgya gar shar li las grub pa mi tshad 'bring po/ gu ru snang srid zil gnon gser zangs las grub pa thog tshad gcigathub pa'i dbang po thog tshad/ padma 'byung gnas dang / gu ru mtshan brgyad 306

gser zangs mi tshad re/ li ma'i ltung bshags so lnga khru tshad re/ rigs gsum mgon po dang tshe lha rnam sum/ 'od dpag med sogs li sku lnga bcu nga brgyad dang / gser zangs sku brgya dang bco brgyad/ sman sku che chung sna tshogs dang bka' brgyud zhal thang gser bris bco lnga/ yi dam chos srung khag gi zhal thang gser bris bcu gsum bcas bzhugs/gsung rten du bka' 'gyur gser gdong ma sogs bka' 'gyur cha tshang gsum/ rnying ma rgyud 'bum/ gter nas bton pa'i 'bum nag chu yi zil ma/'bum cha tshang brgyad/ bstan 'gyur/ cho ga phyag len gyi skor sna tshogs/gtso bo rje bka' brgyud gong ma'i gsung 'bum bcas bzhugs/thugs rten du bya rung kha shor/ 'gro mgon gangs pa'i gser gdung thog tshad/ 'brong ngur bla ma rnams kyi dngul gdung mi tshad bco lnga/ gser zangs mchod rten che chung bco brgyad/ li'i mchod rten cha brgyad sogs sdom brgya phrag gu ru'i mgur phur dang / sha za/ khrag 'thung / rus mur sogs mang / rnga sum cu so lnga/ sbob chal so brgyad la sogs mchod chas mang /'cham chas cha tshang / dkyil 'khor yo chas cha tshang / 'du khang gi ka 'phan sogs mang /rig gsar skabs spyi dang 'dra bar nyams gud du phyin/ de rjes spyi lo 19ra5lo nas bzung rang dgon gyi mkhan po dang rgan gral khag gi 'gan 'khur 'og dad ldan mang tshogs rnams kyi rgyab skyor dang bcas 'du khang ka ba so gnyis/ chab ril khang ka ba gnyis/ me khang ka ba bzhi/ mchod rten khang ka ba bzhi bcas kyi rgya khyon yod pa ma zad/ sku rnying 'gro mgon gangs pa mchog karma pakṣi'i yongs 'dzin mdzad skabs gnang ba dus mkhyen gyi sku khru tshad/ gser sku gsar rnying lnga bcu/ sman sku nyi shu/ zhal thang gsar rnying nyis brgya lhag gsung rten bka' bstan 'gyur dang rnying ma rgyud 'bum/skyob pa'i bka' 'bum bstan dgongs dang zab chos/ cho ga chos spyod 'bri 307

lugs cha tshang bcas bzhugs/thugs rten du gser zangs dang li ma'i mchod rten brgyad/ gsar du bzhengs ba che bcu gsum/ slob dpon gyis gnang ba'i mgur phur dang /'gro mgon gangs pas gter nas bzhes pa'i khrag 'thung ngo mtshar can/gter nas bzhes pa'i 'bum nag chu zil/ ma ṇi 'bum chung khra ril/ chos grags kyi mgul phur rtsa chen/ 'gro mgon gter bzhes phyag spub khyad par can dang gzhan bco lnga/ rnga bcu dgu/ sil snyan lnga/ rgya gling cha gsum/dung chen cha gnyis/ dngul rkong cha bcu bcas nyer 'kho cha tshang chos brgyud nyams len gtso bo phyag chen chos drug dang / bstan snying dgongs gcig gtsos pa'i sgrub brgyud pa'i ring lugs spyi dang 'dra/ lo ltar chos lugs byed sgo ni/ zla ba dang po'i nang du na rag don sprugs nyin brgyad/ zla ba bzhi pa'i nang tshes bcu chen mo/ zla ba lnga pa'i nang ma ṇi sgrub pa nyin bdun/badzra sgrub pa nyin bdun/ zla ba bdun pa'i nang kun rig nyin bzhi/ zla ba bcu gcig nang bka' 'gyur/ zla ba bcu gnyis nas dgu gtor zla phyed bcas yin/ 308

༄7//shag glang del dgon theg mchog rnam grol gling /lta ba rnam dag gnyis 'dzin 'khrul ba zhigabasgom pa rnam dag re dog gzhi ma grub/spyod pa rnam dag spangs blangs dgag sgrub bral/rnam gsum dbyer med chu la chu bzhag ltar/zhes dgon gnas 'di nyid spyi lo 1914rab byung bco lnga shing stag lor sog ru 'jig med chos kyi blo gros sam a 'jigs kyis phyag btab/ khong ni 'gom yul grong gnyags mdo sog ru tshang nas chad pa'i yab sog ru tshe dbang bkra shis kyi sras su spyi lo 1ra9skyulcags stag lo zla ba drug pa'i tshes bzhi la/ shag khri dkar lhas mo cher mtshan dpe'i bzhad/ chung dus nas dam pa'i rang rtags sad pas mkhyen pa yang zhing snying rje che/ dgung lo bcu gsum thog 'bri gung ba log sprul sku nas phyag chen lnga ldan gyi khrid lung zhus nas sgrub la brtson/ grub pa'i rang rtags ngo mtshar ba byung nas thugs dam lnga ldan la mdzad/ dgung lo bco brgyad nas dbus gtsang du gnas bskor la phebs pas 'bri gung grub dbang a mgon dkon mchog blo gros mjal nas 'bri gung dpal mo lugs smyung gnas kyi lung khrid zhus/ 'bri gung bka' brgyud pa'i thugs sras lo 'brong ngur thub dbang rin po che'i zhabs drung nas gcod dbang brgya rtsa dang / khong gi bka' ltar ri do phu lha ri dkar po'i nub ngos/dmu ri chu grong skya bo dung seng mkha' la mchong 'dra/ bdud ri glang del smug 309

po lcags phur sa la gtad 'dra/ btsan ri khyung dmar btsan rgod dgra la 'khros 'dra/ shag gi mar 'bab chu bo dmar nag rakta bsham 'dra'i sa der glang del dgon phyag btab/ lo thub dbang nas rgyud 'bri gung skyabs mgon chos kyi blo gros mchog gis dgon ming shag glang del dgon theg mchog rnam grol gling zhes mtshan gsol/ khong gi yab mes rnams chos brgyud 'bri gung bka' brgyud pa yin pas thugs dam phyag chen lnga ldan/ chos srung a mgon chos gsum gyi bskang gso rgyun 'don byed pa'i thog dam pa'i rang rtags tshang bas ris med mkhas grub du ma'i zhabs la btugs nas/ chags ri nyi grags rin po che'i sku mdun nas snying thig gi sngon 'gro zhus/ nags shod bstan pa'i sgron me rnam gsum la 'bul ba dpag tu med pa phul ba dang / spyi lo 1926me byi lo shag stod sku 'bum du kong sprul rin po che dang mjal nas kar gling zhi khro'i dbang khrid zhus/ khong ni khral khung sen sa dang 'gom la 'bul dgos pas rta gcig la sga gnyis kyi dpe ltar gyur/ khra ring dpon la nor bzhi bcu dang lug nyis brgya bdun cu phul/ de'i rkyen gyis 'brong sna dgon la yang nor lnga bcu bcas ma bskul dwangs blangs kyi sgo nas phul/ khra ring dpon tshe ring dbang rgyal gyis rgyal tshab rwa sgreng la 'bul tshan dang bcas pas sa cha dung skad thos tshad nyar chog pa'i bka' gtan dang dgon ming yang bstsal/ spyi lo 1kha52chu sbrul lor sku zhi bar gshegs/ khong la sras rgyud med pas skabs shig 'brong sna sku rten nas bdag skyong cung zad gnang / dgon 'dir btsun ma bdun tsam dang / sngags grwa mang tsam bzhugs/ rten gtso gu ru mtshan brgyad/ rigs gsum mgon po/ g.yas su srung ma khang du a mgon chos gsum/ gsung rten du bka' 'gyur dang / lnga ldan/ gong ma'i gsung 'bum kha shas/ rin chen gter mdzod/ rnying ma rgyud 'bum/ klong chen 310

mdzod bdun sogs mang / dgon gyi mtha' skor du mchod rten cha brgyad/ rdo 'bum bcas bzhugs/ lo ltar chos lugs byed sgo khag ni/ khong gi phyag rdzas zur gcig gtong rtsa bzhag pas/ rgyun 'don 'bri gung bskang gso/ lo ltar smyung gnas/ kar gling zhi khro/ stong mchod/ sdar seng lugs kyi gcod tshogs/tshes bcu rig 'dzin 'dus pa/ tshes bco lnga la bla ma mchod pa/ nges med du smyung gnas brgya rtsa bcas yin/ rig gsar skabs khyon dang 'dra ba gtor skyon du song /sog ru 'jig med blo gros kyi sku mched/ sog ru bsam kho la sras gnyis 'khrungs te/ sog ru bstan 'dzin nas mtsho ris dgon phyag btab nas yab mes ltar rang lugs chos srung khag mchod/ sog ru rta mgrin gyi gtso bo mdzad de sngags pa rgan gras rnams kyis spyi lo 19rdo6me stag lo shag glang del dgon bskyar gso'i 'ugo tshugs/ 'du khang ka ba bzhi dang sbug bcas bzhengs/ de rjes sog ru 'bong rgyal gyi sras sog ru dge slong dkon mchog blo ldan dang sngags pa rgan gras rnams kyis khur blangs/ dkon mchog blo ldan ni nag chu'i bshad grwar 'bri gung mkhan chen blo bzang bde chen gyi sku mdun nas gzhung chen mo bcu gsum dang / dam chos dgongs gcig gtsos pa'i rang lugs dbang lung khrid gsum bcas zhus/ grub dbang dkon mchog chos bzang gi sku drung nas rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur chen mo'i ljags lung dang / lnga ldan gyi sngon 'gro zhus/ sog ru'i rgyud pa rnams kyis yab mes bzang po'i srol rnams ma dor bar chos rgyun dang / chos bsrung khag rnams sngar ltar mchod/ spyi lo 1kha94shing khyi lor ri dbang rin po che gdan zhus ltar glang del dgon du phebs nas bsang gsol dang bka' dbang / bsang gsol gyi phyag len dang dog bcod bka' lung bcas gnang / mgon khang rgyun 'dzugs la skyob pa 311

'jig rten gsum mgon a mgon chos gsum bzhengs ba'i zhal bzhes dang bslab bya bcas bstsal/ da lta dgon du rab byung bcu gcig dang / sngags grwa rgan gzhon mang tsam bzhugs yod pa dang / 'du khang rgya bskyed nas ka ba bcu drug dang / sbug g.yas g.yon/ grwa shag bcas sngar las grwa rgyas phun sum tshogs po yod/rten gtso mkhan slob chos gsum/ slob dpon yab yum/ rigs gsum mgon po/ phyag stong spyan stong / rdor sems dang 'od dpag med/tshe dpag med bcas sman sku mi tshad re/ a mgon chos gsum gyi zhal thang bcas bzhugs/ gsung rten du bka' 'gyur dang de min cho ga chos spyod sna tshogs mang / thugs rten du mchod rten cha brgyad bcas bzhugs zhes thos/312

༄//smre ti mar sgyed dgon/nags shod smre ti mar sgyed dgon zhes pa ni/ lho smre ti lha yi lung mo che'i stod rgyud dam can gyi gnas ri sgyed pu gsum las mar sgyed ces pa'i sa der spyi lo 1925rab byung bco lnga shing glang lor sman sngags pa byams pa chos dbang nas phyag btab/ khong gi yab ni lho kha tsa tri kha'i sde las lha bris dang sman la mkhas pa'i khyim tshang zhig yin pas/ shag rong po'i tshong pa dang 'brel che bas/ rong po dgon du lha bris du gdan drangs pas rong po ru gzhis chags/ sras ming sring gsum byung bas bu che ba bod pa tshe brtan dang yum skyir bza' nor mun gnyis kyi sras su spyi lo 1900lcags byi lor sku 'khrungs nas mtshan byams pa chos dbang zhes gsol/ chung ngu nas rta smon dgon du sgrig bzhugs/ dgung lo bcu gsum la dgon pa'i 'don chos yongs rdzogs phyag len dang bcas yongs su thon/ nam rgyun thugs rig bkra la bya spyod rtseng pas rta smon dgon pas rong po chos rje gtsos la thugs rtags zhus na zer/mthar 'brong sna dgon dang / rwa khyim dgon gnyis kyi sku rten la zhus pas/sras de 'bri gung rgyal sras sku skye yin pas srung ma'i 'phrul yin zhes lung bstan/de don yab yum gyi thugs la ma 'bab par khyim du bzhugs nas 'brong bza' dkon mchog chos sgron khab tu bzhes/ nags shod stod du rtsis la mkhas pa char rgyud 'bas dga'i drung nas dkar nag rtsis dang dbyangs 'char bcas la lo gsum sbyangs/ spyod pa rtseng pas bag rgyas su zhog re la 'bri g.yag bco lnga tsam re yang 'ga' yang shor/ rong po'i nor dpon lha sar 'gro skabs 313

mnyam du phebs nas tshur lam 'bri gudā grub dbang a mgon dang mjal/ sngon gyi bag chags sad nas sgrub par bzhugs pa'i blo skyes/ khong gi sku mched nas lan gcig pha yul la log de nas ngas phar skyel chog zhus nas log slar yang 'bri gung du a mgon rin po che'i sku drung du bcar nas phyag chen chos drug zhus nas nyams su blangs/ sgrub pa'i skabs ne ne nas sku chas dang sgrub rgyag bstsal/ a mgon rin po ches lan gcig shog gsungs pa ltar mjal bar zhus pas/ yar shog gsungs nas lus stangs stabs dang bcas khyod ci mthong gsungs pas/ phyag na rdo rje mthong zhus pas 'o khyod nga la brten mi dgos/ nags shod nyi grags rin po che'i sku drung du phebs rgyu'i lung bstan pas chags ri'i shar gter sngon 'gro zhus/ nags shod bstan pa'i sgron me rnam gsum gyis bka' gros pas/ lho smre ti bya ba chos med kyi lung pa der 'gro don yod par lung bstan nas phyag tham phab/ khral med dang / sngo rgya dang ri rgya bsdam pa'i dbang cha'i she bam gnang / de dus nags shod 'gom sngags 'chang mthu chen ye shes las 'dos gtor dang gto bcos lag len bslab/chos lugs cho ga khag sngon ltar 'bri lugs bya bar zhus pas de ltar gnang /'gom dgon gsar dgon gyi rig pa'i gnas la mkhas pa dbu mdzad shes rab mchog gi zhabs drung nas rang lugs cho ga khag gi khrid lung lag len dang / sman gyi skor yang zhus/ dgon bla ri dbang rin po che las de dang mtshungs par chos 'brel zab/ spyi lo 1925shing glang lor khyung rdzong ri khrod du phebs nas 'du khang ka ba gnyis dang mtshams khang mdo sbug gnyis bcas bzhengs/ skabs der chu mig rdol ba dang / dung dang rgyang gling gi sgra bcas byung / lo ltar smyung gnas tshugs pas nye skor dang nags shod pa'i mi tshogs mang / lo re'i nang chags ri'i tshes bcu thengs re tsam dang / de min 'bri 314

lugs khag gsungs rgyu dang / rgyun du phyag chen chos drug kho na la brtson/skyabs rje ri dbang dkon mchog dam chos bstan pa'i nyi ma mchog lo ltar gdan zhus nas rten la rab gnas dang / rig gnas spyi dang rang lugs khag la dog dpyod mdzad nas rtsa ba'i bla mar bsten/ nyin ltar rang lugs chos bsrungakhag gi gtor bsngos chag med/ ri khrod du rdza sku kha shas dang / sman rtsis dang cho ga khag gi chos chas cha tshang bcas bzhugs/ spyi lo 1959sa phag lor ya nga ba'i dmag 'khrug gi skabs su dmag sar song bas ri khrod de nyid mi dmigs par gyur/ slar yang rdzogs ldan gsar pa bsu ba'i dus der spyi lo 19ra6me stag lo zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes bcu la mkhas dbang chen mo rgan padma rig 'dzin mchog gi thugs bskyed 'og sngar gyi 'du khang dang sgrub khang bzhengs pa'i dbu tshugs/ rgan padma rig 'dzin mchog ni yab sman sngags pa mi rabs brgyad pa byams pa chos dbang dang / yum 'brong bza' dkon mchog chos sgron gnyis kyi sras su spyi lo 1954shing rta lor sku 'khrungs/dgung lo drug dus yab kyi drung du bod yig 'bri klog dang gso rig rgyud gsum nyer mkho dang bcas blo la zin/ gzhung man ngag lag len dang bcas pa sbyangs/ rig gsar dus skabs de'i nang du yang brtson pa lhod med kyi sgo nas nang rig dang sman gzhung la rtse gcig tu sgril/ ngal rtsol las grwa nas sman pa'i go ming du gyur nas spyi lo 1975gtso bcos pa'i 'gan dang spyi lo 19ṭwāṃ2 gespyi lo 2rkyarkya0nag chu sa gnas sman rtsis khang du sman bzo grwa'i grang krang dang yon krang gzhon pa'i go gnas thob/'bri gung grub dbang dpa' chung chos kyi dbang po'i drung nas mi pham gces bsdus dang / chos bka' 'ga' zhus/ mkhan khro ru tshe rnam las bka' brgyud pa'i nang brtag rgyud gsum dang do ha mdzod/ g.yu thog dbang chen 315

dang dbyangs can sgra mdo/ rin chen ril bu khag gi sbyor sde'i lag len zhus/mkhan tshul khrims rgyal mtshan las 'byung rtsis dang / sum rtags snyan ngagaspyod 'jug rgyal sras lag len dang sman gzhung zab gnad 'ga' zhig gi bka'akhrid thob/ 'bri gung mkhan po blo bzang bde chen gyi drung nas gzhung bcu gsum dang / bstan dgongs/ g.yu thog snying thig dang dus 'khor/gcod dbang / nges shes sgron me'i rtsa 'grel dang / snying thig rtsa gsum dbang bcas thob/ ris med mkhas grub mang po'i zhabs la btugs nas gdams ngag rnams bum pa gang byos kyi tshul du mnga' ba'i gzhung lag len dang bcas pa/ lag len man ngag dang ldan pa/ rig gnas kun la mkhas pa'i don gyi mahā pan ṭi ta zhig yin/ lhag tu nag chur spyi lo 1990 —spyi lo 1994bar du rgyal bstan nyams pa gso'i phyir gzhung chen bshad grwa'i 'gan 'khur dang khrid dpon mdzad pas/ chos lugs las rigs mi sna gso skyong byed pa'i las don grub 'bras mngon gsal thob pa'i mtshan snyan thob/ spyi lo 1992lo 'bum ram pa'i mtshan gnas dang spyi lo 2rkyarkyaXlo nas lha ldan du las bsgyur gnang / mkhas dbang nyid nas bod kyi rig gzhung mi nub dar spel ched du dad ldan ser skya brgya phrag nye ba la gso rig dang nang rig gtsos pa'i slob khrid byas pa dang byed bzhin mchis/ spyi lo 1992chu bya lor slar yang 'du khang ka ba bcu gnyis dang sgo 'phyor/ steng thog rab gsal/ rtse mtshamasakhang bcas sge'u chung bzhi dang sgo chen bcas lnga a phyi'i bla mtsho nas gzigs pa ltar bzhengs/ skyabs mgon che tshang rin po cher snyan sgron zhus pa ltar 'bri gung bka' brgyud kyi chos sde rdo rje khyung rdzong gi bca' yig zhes pa dang nang brten du rje skyob pa'i snang brnyan gser zangs bcas bstsal 'byor byung / spyi lo 1990lo la dge slong dkon mchog snying rje nags shod 'gom 316

dgon gsar du phebs nas rang lugs chos srol khag la sbyangs/ de rjes spyi lo 1994shing khyi lo'i zla ba bzhi pa'i nang du dbu dkon mchog rdo rje dang /don grub rin chen gnyis dgon gsar du phebs nas lo bdun tsam bzhugs/dbu dkon mchog rdo rje rang dgon pa'i cho ga chos spyod blo 'dzin rnams mthar phyin/ spyi lo 2khyo0rkyadabu khri pa mdzad nas rang dgon du phyir phebs nas 'gom dgon chos 'khor byams pa gling dgon pa'i cho ga'i phyag len rnams ji bzhin ma 'dres pa 'dzin skyong spel gsum gyi mdzad 'phrin skyong mus su mchis/spyi lo 1996me byi lo dbu bsam gtan mchog mar sgyed dgon du phebs nas dbyar bzhi gsum cho ga dang / de min chog phran 'ga' btsugs/dgon 'di'i rten gtso ni thub pa'i dbang po dang / rgan padma rig 'dzin mchog gis bzhengs pa'i mnyam med rgyal dbang ratna shri ri'i gser zangs kyi sku 'di yin zhing / sku 'di bzhengs skabs dbu chen a sras nas dbu ni zhag gcig gis grub/ dbu chen nas mdzod spu sogs steng nas cung zad brdungs bas 'og nas grub 'gro gi 'dug ngas nam rgyun dbu la zla ba re ma zin tsam las mi 'grub pas da lta zhag gcig gis 'di ltar gyur zhes gsungs/ skyabs mgon mchog la spyan gzigs phab nas legs so ster/rten 'di'i gzungs bzhugs su/ thub pa'i dbang po'i ring bsrel/ rje skyob pa'i thugs dang / skyob pa'i 'ding ba/ mar pa'i sku rus/ te lo pa'i nya sha la ka mad rang byon/ na ro pa'i rgya dpe/ rgyal dbang rin chen phun tshogs kyi tshems/ nyan thos rab 'byor gyi chos gos/ chos kyi grags pa'i dbu sgom/thugs rje'i nyi ma'i dbu lo/ chos rgyal mya ngan med kyi ring bsrel bcas de rnams phab rgyun tsam ma yin par bzhugs/ phab rgyun can gyi rten 'dus ril bu ni so so'i dkar chag tu gsal/ de min slob dpon rin po che'i gzungs 317

bzhugs tu slob dpon rin po che nyid kyi dbu skra nyag ma gcig bcas bzhugs/mgon khang du a mgon chos gsum dang gzhan yang li sku sogs mang / gsung rten du rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur dang / rgyal ba 'bri gung ba'i chos bka' mang che ba bcas bzhugs/ da lta sgrig bzhugs grwa pa brgyad dang / mtha' skor du grwa shag bcas bzhugs yod/ lo ltar zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes nyer lnga la bla mchod/dbyar gnas bzhi gsum cho ga gnas brten phyag mchod/ bka' 'gyur/sgrub mchod bcas dang / nges med du 'gom dgon pa'i 'don chos rnams rim bzhin spyi mtshungs ltar tshugs bzhin yod/ 318

༄khya//sen ris chos 'khor dgon/ser ris chos 'khor dgon 'di ni/ stag phu padma badzra mchog padma sgrub mtsho gnas sgo phye nas skor tshad sogs gtan la 'bebs skabs/ gnas 'dir zhag bzhugs mdzad pas/ ma 'ongs par gnas 'dir dgon pa dang /pad 'khor sbug 'dir dud khrod 'byung bar lung bstan nas rje nyid kyi mtshan dang 'brel bar dur khrod gyi ming gnang / spyi lo 19rdo4lo zi ru sngags 'chang ngag dbang rnam grol gnas 'dir tsha khang dang mchod rten bcas bzhengs/khong ni spyi lo 1947me phag lor yab zi ru dkar sbos dang / yum skyen bza' lug lha gnyis kyi sras su 'khrungs/ chung nas dam pa'i chos la mos/skyabs rje mchog sprul ri dbang rin po che las 'bri lugs kyi dbang chos dang /'bri gung grub dbang dpa' chung rin po che las gdams pa 'ga' dang / lhag par grub dbang dkon mchog chos bzang gi sku mdun nas sems khrid dang /'pho ba sogs mthar thug gi zab gnad rnams zhus/ spyi lo 1rdzo90lcags rta lo 'du khang ka ba bzhi dang rtse gzim chung dang mgon khang bcas bzhengs/skyabs rje ri dbang rin po che nas ser ris chos 'khor dgon zhes mtshan gsol/ lo ltar bka' dbang dang / bka' khrid/ bka' slob gnang ste bsang dang g.yang skyobs gter bum grangs ldan phul bas mtshan ltas ngo mtshar ldan pa mang ngo / spyi lo 2002chu rta lo zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes bco lnga nyin sngon gyi dgon gnas brtan po med pas thog der yar spo rgyu'i gra sgrig byas nas/ dgon gsar nas skyabs mchog phebs ma grub pas/ grwa pa zhig btang 319

nas lto 'phye dang sa bum phul/ sgo gtad phyogs bcas gtan 'khel bcas byas/ rgyab ri sgom chen bzhugs 'dra'i g.yon gyi phyogs der rmang brtsegs nas/ 'du khang ka ba brgyad/ sgo 'phyor ka ba gnyis/ gzim chung ka ba gcig mgon khang ka ba gcig bcas lug lo la grub/ ston khar skyabs rje mchog gdan drangs nas dgon gnas yongs rdzogs phul/ rten gtso ri dbang mchog sprul rin po che'i phyag gnang stong sku'i gral skyob pa rin po che'i sku dang / sman sku gru tshad ma/ mar me gtong rtsa bcas gnang / de min slob dpon rin po che'i sman sku mi tshad ma/ gur drag dang seng gdong / srung ma khang du a mgon chos gsum/ de min 'dra sku khag mang / gsung rten du rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che dang / 'bri lugs cho ga chos spyod khag dang /gcod kyi skor sogs mang / thugs rten du mchod rten cha brgyad bcas bzhugs/ lo ltar chos lugs byed sgo ni/ lo gsar la bla mchod/ zla ba dang por dgu gtor/ lha babs dus chen la bka' 'gyur dag sgrog nges med du gur drag gtor rdzogs dang bsang gsol zhi khro bcas yin/ nyin ltar bskang gso rgyas bsdus gang rung ma chag pa dang / sgrig bzhugs sngags grwa bcu gnyis dang sdom nyis shu lhag tsam yod pas/ khong rnams kyis zab mo lnga ldan gyi nyams len dang ma bral bar chos lugs cho ga khag rnams nyams su bstar/ spyi lo 2005shing bya lo zla drug pa'i nang du zis ru sngags 'chang nyid sku gshegs/de nas rjes 'jug sngags gra rnams kyis rang lugs ma nyams par skyang mus su mchis so/320

༄༅//lha khang khagaskyiru lha khaja / skyi ru lha khang zhes pa 'di sngon dpal stag lung bka' brgyud pa'i dgon gnas skyi ru stag lung dgon zhes grags/ bod rab byung bzhi pa'i nang stag lung rje btsun bkra shis dpal brtsegs mchog nags shod dang / bod sog la 'gro don phebs skabs su byung ba yin nam snyam/ phyag 'debs pa po sngon ldebs bris su 'khod pa skyir dge gzhon nu rgyal mtsho yin/nang rten du rdo rje 'chang li ma mi tshad tsam byin can bzhugs/ nye rabs su 'phrangasreb nyil nas gtsang po nyin bdun bkag pas/ de skabs grong pa chu dang khad nye ba rnams 'jig grabs byed nas gnas spos byas/ chu bo rdo rje 'chang gi pad gdan yan ma rgal bar chu'i 'jig pa las sgrol/ de min bka' brgyud bla rabs khag dang / ldebs bris su sangs rgyas rigs lnga la sogs/bla rabs/ rgyud sde khag mang / 'gom gyi jag pa spun bdun zhes pa ldebs bris kyi lo rgyus yod par gsungs pas da lta yang ldebs bris cung zad sdad yod/gsung rten 'bum rgan gser bris ma/ lo 'khor la tshes bcu dang bskang bshags/ de'i gtong rtsa zhing ya bzhi bcas yod/ rig gsar dus 'gyur ma byung gong / lha khang 'thor ba'i 'go tshugs nas/ rten gtso rdo rje 'chang rkun mas gzungs bsngogs pa dang / de'i rjes su dbu rgan ngag dbang nas dgon par gzungs phul nas nyar zhes thos/ 'bum rgan gser bris gyi glegs thag rnams khur thag byed pas/ shog bu kha 'thor ya 'thor du song / 'o brgyal ba las gshol ba'i khul byas nas gtsang chu la skyur/ lha khang gi shing cha yongs 321

rdzogs zhabs drung rin po ches chos gling dgon pa 'debs par phul/ mi rtag pa'i rang bzhin ston phyir du gyang ral bya tshang du gyur/ slar yang spyi lo 1990lcags rta lo sa khad yangs zhing sa khams gtsang ba'i grong 'go ru spos nas khang pa ka ba bzhi dang / sku rten rdo rje 'chang mi tshad dang / bka' brgyud bla rabs li sku bcas de min mang / gsung rten du bka' 'gyur/ bstan 'dzin 'gro 'dul mchog nas lha khang rnying pa de ar chog zhus/ lo ltar 'bum dag sgrog dang / bsang gsol rgyas pa bcas byed pa'i srol gtod/199rdos stag lo zla 6tshes bzhi la grub dbang dkon mchog chos bzang dang dbu tshul khrims rnam gnyis kyis gtsos pa'i mchod rten sa chog mdzad/mkhan po ni dbu tshul khrims nas mdzad/ lha babs dus chen la grub dbang rin po che gtsos pa'i 'dus pa rgya mtsho nas rab gnas legs par grub bo/ri mug lha khaja / ri phug lha khang ni/ bstan pa phyi dar gyi skabs su gnas 'dir dgon gnas chags shing / da lta yang dgon stod dang dgon smad zhes 'bod/ grub mtha' ni bka' brgyud pa yin snyam/ dus 'gyur sna tshogs kyi khrod du 'thor zhig tu gyur pa de'i shul ma stong tsam zhig yin/ de rjes dgon 'dabs su gnas pa'i grong pa chags pa rnams/ rim par dang po ke ru tshang dgon stod ma'i 'du khang gi thog tu mkhar chags/ dge tshang dgon smad la mkhar chags/ de rjes a thag sogs rim par gnas spos byas pas nye char grong pa spos pa'i shul gyang ral kyang bsdad yod/ lha khang ka ba bzhi dang rtenagatso ni spyan ras gzigs phyag stong spyan stong slob dpon rin po che yab yum/ gu ru sde brgyad zil gnon/ a mgon chos gsum/ gu ru stong sku/gsung rten du 'bum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum/ lo ltar zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes bco lnga la smyung gnas/ zla ba lnga pa'i nang du stag phu gar dbang gi phyag gnang 322

ser bsrung 'dzugs/ zla ba drug par 'bum dag sgrog dang 'bum bskor 'gro/zla rim ltar tshes bcu pad ljon dang / zla ba bcu pa'i nang du/ zhi khro'i tshogs brgya bcas gsungs/ khyad par du grags che ba nags kyi ri rab mchod rten ni ri phug grong gi nye 'dabs su gnas yod/ de ni rgya mo bza' kong jos phyag btab pas mi lo chig stong sum brgya brgyad cu lhag gi lo rgyus ldan pa zhig yin la gsar brjes ma tshes bar du ma nyams par bzhugs shing / nags shod tsho dgu nas bdag skyong gnang / de rjes lha khang dang rten dang brten par bcas pa rtsa 'thor du song / ri phug grong gi mchod rten ni spyi lo 1991lo dbu tshul khrims kyis mkhan po dang sa chog ri dbang rin po che nas mdzad/ spyi lo 2rkya00lo lha khang ka bzhi bzhengs nas grub dbang dkon mchog chos bzang gis rab gnas mdzad nas mar me'i gtong rtsa dang gang dgos gnang / rten gtso skyob pa'i sku li khra ma dang / spyan ras gzigs phyag stong spyan stong li khra thog tshad/ gu ru'i sman sku mi tshad/ de min a mgon gnyis dang ma gcig lam sgron bcas sman sku bzhugs/ gsung rten du 'bum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum/ lo ltar dbyar dgun gnyis la 'bum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum dag sgrog dang / bsang dang tshes bcu bcas chag med gnang gi yod/chagasa'u 'khor chen kha smyung gnas lha khang / sngar ri ldebs su 'u gu dgon zhes bon dgon/ g.yas su pho dgon dang g.yon du mo dgon zhig bcas gnyis las sog po jun gar bas me skyogs kyis gtor/ deng dus dgon shul du rdo dang / rdo rkyan bcas yod/ de'i zhol nag chags rtse sgal du/sngon ke ru tshang zhes 'byor phyug dad brtson ldan pa des bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis rdo la brkos pa dang tshwa khang bcas bzhengs/ da lta chab mdo steng chen nas yin pa bya bral gyi rnal 'byor ba brag rgu rin po che phyag 323

'tshal la phebs pas/ 'bum par gnas mjal mdzad skabs/ gnas 'dir lha khang bzhengs pa'i mtshan ltas bzang po byung / 'bum pa nas gu ru'i sman sku zhig slong nas rten 'brel 'grig bza' skar dge ba'i nyin skyabs rje ri dbang rin po che mchog gdan drangs nas sa chog dang khrus gsol/ ri la gter bum bcas phul/ lha khang ka ba bzhi/ sgo 'phyor ka ba gcig thab tshang ka ba gcig gzim chung ka ba gcig bcas grub/ mjug tu skyabs rje mchog gis rab gnas mdzad/ sum chos gnang ste/ dbang dang / bsang /g.yang bsgrub rgyas par mdzad/ de rjes 'bri lugs kyi rnam rgyal mchod rten chos 'khor sogs gser zangs las grub pa bcas bzhengs/ grub dbang dkon mchog chos bzang mchog gis gnas 'dir smyung gnas tshugs na bzang ba dang / gnas srung a phyi chen mo yin zhes gnas 'di bsrung na dngos grub dang / ma bsrung bar log par 'tshe na phung bar gsungs/ da lta brag rgu'i sras dkon mchog thub bstan gtsos pa'i sngags pa mi lnga bcas bzhugs/ sku rten skyob pa rin po che'i sku de mchod rten bum pa'i nang du bzhugs/ ri dbang rin po ches bka' chos nyin bar ma der bsam lhun man ngag bcu gsum gyi dbang chen gnang skabs/ tshong pa tshe ring rdo rje zhes pa des bal yul lha bzo bas sku rgyu li khra las grub pa'i 'phags yul rgyal ba klu sgrub gnyis pa/ gangs ri'i khrod 'dir rten 'brel mnga' mdzad 'bri gung skyob pa 'jig rten mgon po'i sku brnyan stong sku bzhengs rgyur 'bri gung bka' brgyud pa'i lo rgyus thog dang po de yin te/ nyid kyis dgongs pa la rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas pa dang / sems can rnams kyis mos pa'i skal ba dang mtshams pa'i sku khyad par can 'dra sku cung mi 'dra gsum ste/ de gang legs bka' bstsal zhes zhus/skabs der ngo mtshar gyis mtshan ltas bzang ba/ nyi zer 'ja' 'od char sim 324

bab ste mkha' lam ltas bzang du ma'i khrod du gleng mol byung / de ring 'dir ston gnas dus sogs phun sum tshogs pa yin gsungs te/ dad sbyin tshor stong sku'i sku dang po de rjes sor 'dir phul dgos gsungs te stong sku'i sku de rang chags rtse 'khor chen smyung gnas lha khang du bstsal/ de rjes nyid kyis mar me sdong kong rgyun 'dzugs gnang / de min gser zangs kyi gu ru mi tshad/stag phu rin po che'i phyag gnang thub sku li ma gru tshad/ grub dbang dkon mchog chos bzang nas gu ru rin po che li sku gru tshad/ bdud 'dul nas 'od dpag med/ lha rgyal nas rdor sems/ dbu bsam gtan gtsos pa'i sbyin bdag khag gis smyung gnas rten zangs lugs ma'i spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal gser sku byis tshad tsam dang / mtha' skor du sangs rgyas stong sku dang / ma ṇi la sogs rdo 'bum bzhugs/ thugs rten du kar thub rin po che nas tsan dan gnyis pa las grub pa'i mchod rten gru tshad gnyis can bcas bzhugs/ spyi lo 1992nas lo ltar badzra dung sgrub dang / spyi lo 2༷rkya6nas dpal mo lugs kyi smyung gnas chag med bcas gnang / lha khang 'di skyabs rje mchog sprul rin po la rang dgon pa'i chos gzhis nag thung gi sbyin bdag khag dang / bra rgu rin po che gtsos pas phul nas rang dgon gi bdag skyong bya rgyu dang / chos srol ni 'bri gung bka' brgyud pa yin/rgyasatsa chen steja mi 'khrug pa'i lha khang yo rgyan gsang sngags chos glija /'gom leng drug las chu srib ma'i nang tshan rgyas tsha chen steng gi mi 'khrug pa'i lhakhang 'di/ rang dgon dang sa thag cung 'gyang ba dang / mi phyugs la mi bde ba 'ga' byung bas/ rdza chu'i lung rtogs mchog la thugs rtags zhus pas/mi 'khrug pa'i sku sa tstsha sogs gang rung gi stong sku bzhengs bar lung bstan nas/lung rtogs rin po che nas sa dbyad gzigs nas tshwa khang ma ṇi sogs rdo rkos 325

bsdu rub byed/ 'gan 'khur shes rab dbang po dang don rab gnyis yin/shing bzo ba dpal ldan 'od zer dang / dad ldan rnams kyi hur brtson 'og lhakhang ka ba bzhi de grub/ rten gtso mi 'khrug pa'i stong sku'i zhal thang bcu gcig dang / skyob pa rin po che'i zhal thang / slob dpon rin po che dang rje btsun sgrol ma'i sku mi tshad re/ stag phu rnam rgyal dbang phyug gi phyag gnang spyan ras gzigs (phyag stong spyan stong ) tshes bcu'i dngul gyis thub pa gtso 'khor gsum gru tshad re/ nags lha bcas mang / gsung rten du rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur/ 'bum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum tshes bcu'i yo chas dung rgya gling bcas bzhugs/ lo ltar 'bum dag sgrog bsang gsol rgyas pa lha babs dus chen la sgrol dkar/ tshes bcu rtsa gsum/ nyer lnga la ma gciganyin ltar ma ṇi dung sgrub tshogs pas dbu mdzad snyan grags dang / tshes bcu'i dbu mdzad 'byung gnas dang dpal ldan 'od zer gnyis nas mdzad/ de min gsar bu brgyad bcas yod/spyi lo 1992chu sprel lor mkhan ye shes 'byung gnas kyis lha khang sa 'dul mdzad/ spyi lo 1995shing phag lor yongs su grub/chushrangawādugig steng gi lha khang / 'du nag steng gi lha khang ni rab byung bcu gsum stod tsam du skyi ru rwa bzo mchog gis phyag btab/ khong ni sngags 'chang nus ldan grub pa thob pa zhig yin pas de'i skor mang zhing khong gis sgrub khang bzhengs pa shig yin de rjes chos dad rang mos byung nas skyabs rje ri dbang rin po che dang / khyung sprul rin po che/ sgrub chen rin po che sogs phebs nas 'od dpag med kyi snying po/ ma ṇi badzra skyabs 'gro sogs khrid lung gnang bas rgyun 'don byed pas dung gsum tsam bgrang ba dang / spyi lo 2rkya0rkyalcags 'brug lor stag phu rnam rgyal dbang phyug lding dpon tshang la ja 326

'dren zhus/ dad ldan rnams la ma ṇi badzra skyabs 'gro bcas lung gnang bas/grong tsho'i dbu khrid dang mang tshogs kyi 'dod mos ltar ma ṇi lha khang gi sa cha thugs rtags zhus pas sngon gyi skyi ru'i mtshams khang du gtan 'khel gnang nas lha khang bzhengs grub kyang rjes su yang sngar las lhag pa'i rgyas bskrun gnang rgyu'i gra sgrig bcas yod/rten gtso ni skyob pa 'jig rten mgon po'i stong sku'i gral byin can dang /gsung rten du bka' 'gyur/ dgongs gcig brgyad stong dang / gzungs bsdus bcas bzhugs yod/gnasargad lha khaja / gnas shod lha khang zhes pa 'di sngon gnas shod dwags po lcags lung dgon dang dus mnyam par bshad srol mchis/ de rjes ya ho byang chub bla rgan gyis khur blangs nas bskyar skrun zhus/ rten gtso ar rgod dbu mdzad kyi phyag bzo tshad ldan kun gyi yid dbang 'phrog pa/ stag phu padma badzra mchog gis lha de 'dra yod na re res chog bcas gsungs pa'i o rgyan padma 'byung gnas kyi sman sku dang / sgrol dkar sngon bcas bzhugs/ tshes bcu la lcags lung dgon ltar dwags lugs dkon mchog spyi 'dus/ lo gsum re'i bar stag phu dang nyi grags kyi bka' ltar gur drag gi gtor rdzogs/de min skabs dus ltar las dmigs bsal med/rig gsar skabs nang gi rten rnams med par gyur/ de rjes spyi lo 19ṭwāṃ5shing glang lo zla bdun pa'i tshes bcu gsum bza' skar dge ba'i nyin/ma ṇi dang badzra mtshan rgyun byed/ de rjes dbu tshul khrims mchog gis rang lugs tshes bcu'i 'don cha gsar du tshes bcu ba gsar bu rnams la/ bka' khrid gnang ba dang mchod rten bcas bzhengs/ tshes bcu'i dbu mdzad tshe rdor gyis mdzad pa'i 'og sngar ltar nyams gso thub/ lha khang rgyas bskrun byas 327

nas ka ba bzhi dang me khang bcas grub/ skyabs rje ri dbang rin po che lha khang 'der phebs nas grub rgyal bka' dbang dang khrus gsol rab gnas mdzad/lha khang bdag gces legs pa dgos tshul bka' slob gnang / dbu chos bzang mchog gis rab gnas dang tshes bcu'i lung dang / 'bum 'don lugs/ lha khang la gang dgos gnang bar gsungs pa dang / mar me'i gtong rtsa dang lugs gnyis kyi bslab bya rgyas par bstsal/ zla rim ltar tshes bcu chag med dang / dbyar 'bum/ dgun 'bum bcas gsungs/ sku rten du gser zangs kyi thub pa gtso 'khor gsum dang / gu ru mtshan brgyad thog tshad ma/spyan ras gzigs phyag stong spyan stong thog tshad ma/ de min li khra'i sku grangs bcu gcig tsam dang zhal thang nyis shu bcas bzhugs/ gsung rten du 'bum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum/ bsang gsol dang tshes bcu'i dpe cha sogs nyer mkho 'ga' bcas bzhugs/sgrol ma spon mo'i gnas ri dang dwags po lcags luja dgon/ gnas mchog 'dir sa padma 'bum ldan/ gnam 'khor lo rtsebs stong dang ldan pa'i dbus su rje btsun sgrol ma sngon mo khri la bzhugs 'dra'i gnas ri 'di/ dpal ldan dwags po bka' brgyud pa'i mtshan ldan gyi gnas ri zhig yin/ rje btsun sgrol ma'i zhabs kyi pus mo'i tshul gyi steng du chags pa ni gnas shod dwags po lcags lung dgon yin te/ kha cig gis lcags lung kan zhes sa ming las dgon ming du 'gyur tshul dang / kha gcig gis rang dgon du bzhugs pa'i dung dkar lcags lung can de'i ming nas lcags lung dgon zhes thogs zer/da lta dgon de'i chags shul 'du khang gi rmang dang brtsegs pa bcas pa yod pa dang / thang dar gyi rdo phung bcas yod pa g.yas g.yon du grwa shag gi shul/'du khang gi mdun du bka' brgyud bla ma'i zhabs rjes zhes dang / mtha' skor 328

du tsan dan sdong po gsum las gnyis rig gsar skabs bcad pa dang gcig da lta bsdad yod pas dus bzhir mi 'gyur gzhan dang ma 'dra ba'i khyad chos ldan/ dgon par chu cung dkon pas bla mas gter nas bton pa'i gter chu zhes chu bo yan lag brgyad ldan 'di kun gyi rtsa cher mdzad/ steng du chos khri steng zhes chos 'khor bskor ba'i bla g.yel lta bu/ tshogs chu steng du dbyar skyid btang yul dang gtor 'bul del khra ril rtser 'bul/ tshes bzang la brag shar dang del khra ril bar 'ja' mtshon gyis sbrel/ brag shar du sgrub grwa'i shul dang sgrub phug gong 'og gsum bcas yod pas/ phyag chen chos drug dang khyad par zhi ba'i sgrub gnas mtshan nyid yongs su tshang / de min zhabs rjes dang phyag rjes/ rta yi rjes sogs mang bar yod/ ri 'dabs su tsha chu 'dis bkrus dang 'thung na nad gdon las grol ba sogs mthu nus che/de rjes dgon 'di nyams rgud du phyin nas dgon gyi gser 'phru ches rin thang ldan pa gser nag ljang rdung yin zhes pa de rang dgon gyi dbu rtser yod/ bshad srol la sog po jun gar pas dgon pa gtor nas gser 'phru dgon gsar nas blangs bar bshad pas dpyad par bya/ gang ltar dgon pa 'di nyid nye char su nyams pa yin te/ lcags lung dgon pa'i ka ba zhes da lta ba log rab gsal gyi ka ba yin pa dang / rang dgon du lcags lung dgon pa'i bka' 'gyur snar thang ma dang / dung dkar lcags lung ma bcas rang dgon du yod la/ de min ca lag sna tshogs yod zhes gsungs/ skyabs mgon chos kyi nyi ma mchog rang dgon du phebs skabs/ gnas shod du sgam po'i bla ma la rtse ba dang mjal zhes gsungs pa dang / nye char su dwags po'i grwa pa gnyis 'dir phebs nas rtsa gsum gtor ma mjal bas dwags lugs yin pa ngo shes nas/ 'o nags shod du dwags po'i gnas dgon dang sgrub phug gong 329

'og bar gsum bcas yod par gsungs pa sogs 'di yin pa 'dra zhes gsungs pa dang / da dung dwags po dgon pa'i zhing kha ru gsar dpon gyis btab nas 'bru dwags por 'bul ba sogs byed pas da lta dngos su zhing kha yod/ de rnams la zhig na nye bar dgon gnas ma 'thor bar gnas par rtogs thub/ rdo 'bum gyi khrod du skyob pa'i rdo sku sogs mjal bar 'dug pas 'bri gung bka' brgyud dang chos 'brel yod pa dang / bka' brgyud nang tshan la brten nas chos khungs 'gom dgon du gyur ba yin/bca'i lha khang / ba ro 'am ga do'i lha khang 'di sngon ar rgod pa ser zhes pa'i sngags 'chang zhig gis rab byung bco lnga'i smad du gnas mal 'dir lha khang thog brtsegs can zhig bskrun pas rig gsar skabs nyams gud du phyin/ slar yang spyi lo 1990rab byung bcu bdun lcags rta lo grong mi yongs kyi re 'dod ltar/ zla ba drug pa'i yar tshes bzhi pa'i nam langs snga char/grub dbang dkon mchog chos bzang gi gsungs bkod ltar bzhengs pa'i 'go tshugs/ lha khang ka bzhi/ sgo 'phyor ka ba gnyis/ thog gzim chung dang /gsol gzim khang dang me khang lhan bcas legs grub byung / rten gtso rgyal ba shākya thub pa'i sku pad 'khor can dang / skyob pa 'jig rten gsum mgon/slob dpon padma 'byung gnas/ rig gsum mgon po bcas sman 'dam las grub pa thog tshad/ a mgon chos gsum sman sku bcas dang / gsung rten du 'bum chen sde lnga/ tshes bcu sogs dpe tshan 'ga'/ phyi nang rten dang brten par bcas pa legs par grub nas/ spyi lo 2002chu rta lo zla ba drug pa'i tshes nyis shu la grub dbang dkon mchog chos bzang dbu mdzad pa'i 'dus grwa bcu skor gyis zhi khro rigs bsdus dkyil 'khor gyi sgo nas rab gnas dang /bsang gsol/ zhi ba'i sbyin bsreg 'bum dang tshes bcu'i bka' lung dang 330

pod dbang bstsal/ sprel lo sprel zla'i tshes bcu la dbu dkon mchog tshul khrims dang bstan 'dzin 'gyur med gnyis nas tshes bcu dbu btsugs nas lo ltar chag med tshugs/ lcags 'brug lo nas bzung 'bum chen sde lnga chag med/ 'brug rgyal dang a 'bo gnyis nas ma ṇi'i dbu mdzad byed nas nyin ltar ma ṇi dung sgrub tshogs/ spyi lo 2rkya02lo shing sprel ston kar skyabs rje ri dbang rin po che phebs nas bka' dbang dang sbyin bsreg rab gnas bcas mdzad/ bskor tshad zhus pas rab la chig stong lnga brgya/ bsdus pa la bdun brgya lnga bcu bcas gsungs/ grong spyi nas rten gyi spyan sngar mchod pa'i yo byad dang / mar me yon chab sogs dwangs ba bskyed pa'i gnas mchog cig go/sadamarashraja gi lha khang / sa dmar grong gi lha khang ni ka ba gnyis can zhig dang / rten gtso rje btsun byams pa mgon po'i li sku zhig yod pa de ni/sngon 'gom dgon chos 'khor byams pa gling zhes mtshan thog pa'i byams pa de nyid yin zhing / sa dmar lha khang la sprad nas/ dgon gyi rten gtso thub pa bstan 'byung de phar rang dgon du gdan drangs zhes gleng / slob dpon yab yum gsum gyi sman sku dang / de min sku 'dra sna tshogs bzhugs yod/ thub sku de sngon dgon stod dgon pa'i rten gtso yin zhes gsungs/ ldebs bris khag bcas da lta lha khang bsdad yod kyang nang gi rten gang yang nyams gso ma thub par lha khang gcig pu las bzhugs med/rdo mkhar gyi lha khaja / sngar grong ltag tu lha khang zhig yod kyang rig gsar gong nas nyams gud du phyin 'dug de rjes spyi lo 19rdo9sa sbrul lo zla dang po'i tshes bcu gnyis la sngar mal du khang bu brtsegs pa'i mchod rten zhig bzhengs/ spyi lo 1rdzo94shing khyi lor grong mi'i 'dun pa ltar grub dbang 331

dkon mchog chos bzang gis bka' slob dang rgyab skyor 'og dbu dkon mchog tshul khrims mchog gis mkhan po'i khur blangs nas mchod rten dang lha khang bcas grub/ grub dbang dkon mchog chos bzang gtsos pas rab gnas legs par grub/ 'ja' gur sogs mtshan ltas bzang / lha khang ka ba gnyis/ grub dbang mchog nas phyag gnang rtse la rgyal mtshan dang rten gtso stag phu rnam rgyal dbang phyug gi phyag gnang thub pa'i dbang po dang gu ru rin po che'i sku li ma gru tshad re/ grong spyi nas slob dpon rin po che dang mkha' 'gro gnyis kyi sman sku mi tshad/ de min gser sku kha shas bcas bzhugs/ gsung rten du grub dbang dkon mchog chos bzang gi phyag gnang mdo bskal bzang /grong spyi nas 'bam rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum lo ltar 'bam dag sgrog 'bri dmi bye ri gi lugs bsang gsol rgyas pa/ a phyi'i tshogs brgya/ zla ba dang po'i tshes bco lnga dang zla ba bdun pa'i tshes bco lnga gnyis la mtshan rgyun bcas chag med bcas yin/ 332

nonobyeo//bskang bshag khagadakaragamujawāskangaldashag 'gom leng drug gi nang tshan dkar gzhung gi zhi khro zhes snyan pa'i grags pa che ba 'di nyid lo rgyus yun ring ldan zhing mi thog drug bdun tsam phyin/ sngon dus su 'gom dgon nas bla sprul dang 'dus grwa 'ga' phebs nas tshugs pa dang / de rjes nye rabs su grags can dbu mdzad rnams kyi yab yul yin pas/ grub dbang dbu bzod pa rin po che dang / dbu dkon mchog 'od srung / dbu dkon mchog thabs mkhas/ dbu dkon mchog lha srung sogs rang dgon du 'dus pa bcu gnyis tsam mchis pas/ sngar las lhag pa'i sgo nas bskang bshag zab rgyas ngang nyin bdun dang de'i ring a phyi'i bskang ba brgya tshar/ nags lha stong tshar/ 'khrug bskang brgya tshar/ mjug tu bskang bshag bka' dbang / bsang gsol dang dgra lha dpa' stod/ gtor 'bul/ g.yang skyobs/ 'bum dag sgrog dus 'khrug gi skabs su dgra bcos dang dgra 'ob bcas bya/ de'i nyer mkho'i yo chas cha tshang bcas yod/ rig gsar skabs spyi ltar nyams gud du phyin/ de rjes spyi lo 1khar5shing glang lo grong tsho'i 'go khrid gtsos bskang bshag skyar gso bya bar dbu bstan pa dar rgyas la bka' 'dri zhus/ dbu mdzad nas 'gom sde dud yongs dang dad ldan rnam bsdus pas bskang bshag bskyar gso zhu rgyu'i gros mthun/ ri dbang rin po che zhi khro'i dbu bzhugs dang bka' dbang dang bka' khrid rgyas pa thengs gsum tsam gnang myong yod/ lo der sog ru dbu mdzad lha srung mchog gi rdor slob mdzad nas 'don chog rnams sngar ltar 333

nyams gso thub/ tshogs pa gang phebs kyis 'bul tshan gang yang mi len bar lo ltar yongs sgo rnams der dgos mkho'i nyer spyad nyos nas da lta tshogs gur che chung lnga dang / dkyil 'khor yo chas cha tshang yod la rjes su bskang bshag lha khang bzhengs rgyu'i gra sgrig byed bzhin yod/'omarnatha'izha khro/ 'om mtha'i rkyen pa brgya dpon 'gro 'dul bzhugs skabs/ 'brong pa'i bar sprul zhes pas g.yag pho bcu gsum gtong rtsa bzhag nas sbra gur du lo ltar zis ru don ldan gtsos sngags pa bzhis kar gling zhi khro tshugs/ de rjes su skyen pa bla ma skar ma bstan 'dzin/ zis ru sngags chung /zis ru mkhan po dar chung / sprin dkar dka' bcas nas 'bri lugs yang zab kyi sgor nas tshugs/ de skabs mgar ba dbu mdzad bzhugs skabs yin/de rjes chos dad rang mos byung nas/ skyen pa bstan chen gyis 'om mtha'i zhi khro gso ba'i re bskul ltar gcig mthun byung / spyi lo 1991lcags 'brug loragrub dbang nam mkha' rdo rjes zhi khro khang sa chog mdzad/ de'i phyi lo lha khang ka ba bzhi grub nas zla bdun pa'i tshes 21la zhi khro phul bas lo ltar dus mchod gtan 'khel mdzad/ tshogs bzhugs rnal 'byor pa/ gtso bo sangs rgyas ye shes/ bsod nams grags pa/ tshe ring dar/ bstan pa yar 'phel/tshe ring bstan pa bcas bzhugs/ sku rten du thub pa'i gos sku/ gsung rten rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur/ thugs rten du grub dbang nam mkha' rdo rje'i gdung rten bcas bzhugs/'omalhug dang lha drag dkar yoji gnas ri/ 'om yag lha brag dkar po'i shar du lcum lung rdza rgan sman gyi ri/ lhor spyang ki zal mo sman gyi ri/ nub zis tshang rdza skya sman gyi ri/ byang 'bo rnga g.yu 'phu sman gyi ri bcas sman ri bzhi dang / shar na kha tsha chu khrus kyi sgo/ lhor tsha sgam tsha chu khrus kyi sgo/ nub grogs 334

gi tsha chu khrus kyi sgo dang klu yi sgyed pu rang byung / byang du gter bum khrus kyi sgo bcas bzhi/ 'om yag ri rgan la g.yu yi mtsho mo dang / de la gnas pa gser nya gnyis kyi mjug ma las byang shag gi tsha chu/ lhor 'om gyi tsha chu bcas rang byung ngo mtshar che zhing 'byung bzhi'i nus pa che ba'i gnas mchog zhig yin/gna' snga mor gnas ri yin par zhal rgyun du/ gter gnas 'om yag kham pa/rgyal po khri la bzhugs 'dra/ nang du g.yu yi mtsho mo/ mtsho la mtsho rnga gnyis gnyis/ gter sgo a sgo brag sgo/ gter bdag gro bu rnam dag gter bsrung lha brag dkar po/ brag dkar grwa tshang lnga brgya/ chu len bkra shis don grub/mu nam gcod rgan kher 'dug bla ri ban de spun bdun/ sras mo chu grong dkar po/ sras po sham bu rgya yu/ zhes zer srol yod/ de min 'phags yul nas 'phur ba'i bya shang pa dang / lho phyogs brag dkar rgyab ngos su rtags brgyad dang sna bdun lha sku sogs mang / shar ngos bar do'i 'phrang dang thar ba'i skam sa/ a 'phu'i gser rnga dang dam can gsang rdor/ chu len pha bong steng dang zho 'tsher du g.yag gi rmig rjes/ mdzod nag brag la phyag rjes/'om yag brag dkar rnga brdungs nas dus bzang la rnga sgra dang / brag mig zhig la rdo 'phang na rgya mtsho'i nang du lhung ba'i skad dang / de mtshungs shar gyi brag mig nas zangs skad grags/ ri dbang dkon mchog 'jig bral mchog phebs pas gnas dang rang byung 'ga' gtan du phabs par gsungs/ bod rab byung bcu bzhi'i nang gnas 'dir khams nas gcod smyon sgom chen phebs nas/ shag nyin lung padma'i ze'u 'brur dgon pa chags pa dang / 'om yag gnas ri yin par lung bstan zhes grags/ bla ri dmar sgam du bzhugs pas da lta gcod smyon brag phug zer/ rdza dmar chos rje mchog gis 'om lha brag dkar po gnas sgo 'byed par phebs kyang / rten 'brel ma 'grig de 335

rjes 'brong pa'i bar sprul mchog 'om lha brag gnas sgo phye bar grags/ sog gu gus 'om yag bsang mchod rgyas pa mdzad/ spyi lo 1941grub dbang nam mkha' rdo rje mchog gis tsha sgam nas spyan ras gzigs kyi sku gter nas bzhes/gnas 'di'i brag tsho 'di mtshan brgyad yin pa dang / rgyab log brag sun de seng gdong dbu skra zhes pa nas rdo rje zhig khrom gter du bzhes/ dgon bla ri dbang dkon mchog bstan 'dzin 'om mthar snga phyir thengs gsum tsam phebs nas 'om bsang mdzad/ 'om spin rgan gyi brag 'di bde mchog yab yum dang /'om gyi gnas ri bde mchog gi pho brang yin par gsungs nas/ de min khrus gsol dang gter bum bcas phugre ba dang dbang chos gang zab gnang nas byin rlabs/sebaldakra bskaja bshag seb bkra chu 'go gong du spyi lo 1990lcags rta lo dbyar dus nas bzung / bskang bshag rgyun tshogs dbu tshugs/ bskang bshag nyin bdun dang / bsang gsol gtor 'bul/ bskung gnas/gtor ma 'bum bcas lo ltar tshugs pas gtso bo sbyin bdag brgyad cu dang /'brel yod dud grangs brgya dang lnga bcu lhag bcas yod/kanasneliskajawāgag lha khang / 'gom leng drug las nyang khu gzhung rgan sno grong gi bskang bshag ni dang po/ spyi lo 19rdordos 'brug lo dbu bstan pa dar rgyas kyis bskul slong dang / grub dbang dkon mchog chos bzang rin po che rgan sne ru dad ldan 'gas gdan zhus skabs bka' 'dri zhus pas/ 'o bskang bshag tshugs na shin tu legs gsungs nas phan yon dang sngags brjod mdzad/ tshogs gur nyo byed sgor drug brgya gnang / de min dud re nas tshar ru sogs gang 'byor re bcas kyis tshogs gur nyos/ dbu bstan pa dar rgyas mchog gis bskang bshag kyi tsag gdugs dang dkyil 'khor bcas 336

bzhengs/ spyi lo 19ṭwāṃ9sa sbrul lo dbyar dus su ri dbang rin po che dbu bzhugs dang rgan sne grong gi dge mdun dang bcas nas bskang bshag rgyun tshogs nyin bdun tshogs/ rin po che nas gzim chung gi ka 'phen dang phye phur sogs bshams nas rten 'brel bzang gsungs/ ri dbang rin po che'i phyag gnang / rgya gling cha gcig dang / zhi khro'i tsag gdugs bzo rgyur zhal bkod mdzad/ bskang bshag tshugs ring a phyi brgya tshar dang / nags lha stong tshar/'khrug bskang brgya tshar/ mjug tu bka' dbang yang gnang srol dang /bsang gsol gtor 'bul rta rgyug 'bum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum dang /badzra mtshan rgyun bcas yin/ spyi lo 1994shing phag lo sri zlog mchod rten bzhengs/ spyi lo 2skyurkya1lcags sbrul lo 'gro 'dul rin po che nas smyung gnas btsugs/ chu lug lor bka' 'gyur dag klog gsum/ spyi lo 20skyu5shing bya lo bskang bshag khang ngam smyung gnas lha khang dang mchod rten 'ga' bzhengs skabs/ gtso bo 'gan 'gro 'dul rin po che nas mdzad/ de min rten rgyal/lha srung / bkra nor/ nor rdo bcas yin/ thab tshang / gnyer tshang / tshogs chen khang / lha khang dang / gzim chung / lcags ri bcas bzhengs/ sku rten gtso bo skyob pa 'jig rten mgon po'i li sku dang / grub dbang dkon mchog chos bzang gi phyag gnang thub pa'i gser sku dang de min kha shas/ gsung rten 'bum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum bcas bzhugs/kanasnetsayog shag nyang khu gzhung rgan sne nas yar tsam phyin pas brag dkar gyi lhun po mang po tho rer mthong / gnas 'dir gling sgrung dang 'brel ba'i rang byung gi bkod pa zhig yin/ ri ma thang der dpa' rgya tsha'i rta lcag gis gter na bton pa'i sgrub chu ngo mtshar ba dang / de min smug bzo la gling gi dpa' rtul zhes rta dmag gi dbyibs can/ sru 'brug mo dang dpa' sga bde 337

gnyis gab mthun byed pas ge sar gyis sga bde'i gsang rdor gris bcad pa'i dum bu gsum dang / 'brug mo'i nu ma zhes nu khung nas mar khu thon/ de'i zur du chos rje'i zhabs rjes/ brag ngos la dpal lha mo rang byon/ lha rta rkyang bu'i zhabs rjes dang stod phur/ 'bru sga bde'i rtsam khug sru 'brug mo'i chang zom zhes brag zom dang 'dra ba'i steng nas chu tshan khol ba/ 'brug mo'i bha ga/ri dbang rin po che'i gzigs snang tshe lha rnams gsum/ che dur dang chung dur/cu gang / chu ghi waṃ/ mtshams ldis brag la mtshams khang / brag log tu yig drug dang a rang byon sogs mang / tsha 'gag mar nang la rang byung chu tshan dang / ge sar zhabs rjes/ brag la khyi sogs rjes 'dra min sna tshogs/ nor lug spyo nad bcod pa'i brag tsha yog sngags pa spun gsum zhes tshes bzang la rnga sgra thos kyi yod/ sru 'brug mo'i mgo sku'i rtsi li zhes rnga pa ris rtse nas gzhung bar dang / tsha zam 'og nas tsha chu 'gro ba khyad 'tshar/ de'i phar ru spang steng su sprel lo la smyug ma tshar/ gser sder du 'brug mo'i g.yu sbra zhes brag khug rta nor mang po shong / 'brug mo'i sgyed pu zhes brag rtsi me yi rnam la can dang /de'i zur du thab chas dang lji ba'i tshul 'brug mo'i sman khug zhes cong zhi des nad rigs 'joms zhes kun gyi len/ de min 'brug mo'i sle po dang /'brug mo'i bsus zhal lam dge bsnyen bsus zhal zhes spang sbug gting ring /g.yon ri brag gdong zhes zla ba bdun par rdza skor du nor lug bcas 'ded/phyi ltar ngo mtshar bkod pa du ma dang ldan zhing / nang du nor bu dbyeg gis khengs ba'i lung pa 'di lta bu rnams dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i nor bu lta bu yin pas kun gyis bsrung bskyob bya rgyu ni 'gan babs yin/ /338

༄//mchod rten khagakarnado'i mchod rten/ sa mal 'dir sngar dus su dgon gyi dur khrod yin zhing / rab byung bcu gcig pa'i dus 'go tsam der grub thob rin po che zhes pa'i gdung rten bzhengs pa yin/ nags shod du phyi ba'i 'go nad drag po zhig byung bas khong gis bzhes nas chad/ spyi lo 1995shing phag lo zla 6tshes 4nyams gso zhu skabs sku gdung gi dum bu 'ga' thon/ ri dbang rin po ches gnas 'di rtsa chen yin pa dang / sa bcud sogs phan thog che lugs gsungs pa'i kun slong la rten nas/ dbu chos bzang gis sa 'dul mdzad/ dbu tshul khrims nas mkhan po'i gtso bo dang ka mdo mkhan chen gyis 'gan khur nas da lta dbyen 'dum mchod rten 'di bzhengs thub/ ka mdo grong nas lo ltar dbyar 'bum dang bsang gsol rgyas pa bcas pa'i srol gtod nas chag med mchis so/sadamar mar grong gi mchod rten/ spyi lo 2002chu rta lo zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes gsum la dpal 'bri gung bka' brgyud pa'i chos sde 'gom dgon chos 'khor byams pa gling dgon pa'i khrid dpon bstan 'dzin 'gro 'dul/khrid dpon sangs rgyas brtson 'grus/ dbu dkon mchog tshul khrims bcas pa'i dge 'dus bzhi sde nas/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi sgo nas sa chog dang lto 'phye legs par brtag nas bzhengs/ gzungs bzhugs ches phun sum tshogs pas dkar chag logs su gsal/ sbyin bdag gtso bo 'gom jag pa skya bdun gi nang gsal skyen pa bu yi thog sdug gi rgyud pa skyen pa grags pa 339

mchog nas gang dgos gtso bo gnang ba dang / rgya che'i dad ldan mang tshogs rnams kyis rgyab skyor gang zab zhus nas zla ba gsum pa'i tshes bco brgyad la rang dgon pa'i 'dus pa rgya mtsho nas dgongs pa yang zab kyi sgo nas rab gnas legs par grub/ gnas 'dir sprin dpa' bo'i mkhar shul 'dab tu gnas shing sa bcad phun sum tshogs/sadamar yar groja gi mchod rten/ rba kha gser nya zhes sngar zhing khas gang zhing 'gro lam gyi zur du gnas pa/ 'bum pa nag rong ni ba lag 'bum pa'i thugs kyi gnas mchog yin yang da lta shang srid gzhung gi sa mal der mchis/ de'i rten tshab du spyi lo 20rkya6shing khyi lo zla ba drug pa'i tshes bco lnga la/ chos 'khor byams pa gling gi khrid dpon bstan 'dzin 'gro 'dul mchog dang / dbu mthar phyin/ bstan 'dzin shes rab/ dbu chos dbyings bcas nas dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi sgo nas sa chog dang lto 'phye legs par rtags nas thig 'dab/ cung zad las kyis rkyen pas ma grub/ de rjes gzungs bzhugs ni bka' bstan dang 'bri gung chos mdzod chen mo/ ma ṇi dung phyur gsum dang / badzra dung gcig yig brgya sogs shin tu mang /bum sgor tshe dpag med/ phyogs bzhir rdo ring seng ge bcas legs par grub pa dang sngon 'bum pa nag rong tshur ar chog zhus nas dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi sgo nas rab gnas legs par mdzad/b.lig 'amum chung dkar ril/ mchod rten 'di'i thig rtsa 'bum pa rang yin zhing / 'bum pa'i gsung gi mchod rten yin zhes grags/ spyi lo 1995shing phag lor ba lag grong gi re mos ltar 'go khrid tshe ring rgyal bstan nas dbu chos bzang la zhus pas/ 'o mchod rten gsar pa bzhengs pa las rnying pa gcig nyams gso zhus na legs gsungs nas dngul dang bka' slob 340

bstsal/ dbu dkon mchog tshul khrims nas mkhan po mdzad/ mchod rten dang khang brtsegs mchod rten yang grub/ dus tshes dge bar dbu chos bzang mchog gtso bzhugs thog rab gnas legs par grub pas/ chu log gi 'jigs pa dang nad pa yang nad las grol zhing dge mtshan bzang /wagata'i mchod rten/ sngon sa mal 'dir tsha khang zhig yod pa'i grub dbang dkon mchog chos bzang mchog gi thugs dgongs ltar/ khong gi sa 'dul mdzad nas dbu tshul khrims kyis mkhan po mdzad/ lha babs dus chen la rje nyid kyi gtsos pas rab gnas mdzad/ lcags 'brug lo khang rtsegs mchod rten dang / 2002chu rta lo mchod rten cha brgyad bcas bzhengs nas gser zangs gi tog dang bcu gsum 'khor lo bcas grub/gnyags mdo'i mchod rten/ gnas 'dir sngon mchod rten zhig yod pa dang nyi grags kyis sa gnad mchod rten gyi gral du bgrang 'dug kyang / mchod rten rnying pa'i srog shing gi nang du gzungs bzhugs bla rgyud dang bcas pa 'bri lugs cha tshang dang / lhag tu skyabs mgon zhi ba'i blo gros mchog gi mtshan sngags mang po snang bas/ gang yin the tshom mi dgos/ kha cig gis nyag mdor tshes bcu lha khang zhig bzhengs bar bshad kyang / da lta shul tsam yang mthong rgyu med pas sngon nas ma byung ba 'dra snyam/ de nas nyams gso ni spyi lo 19raras 'brug lor lha babs dus chen nyin dbu tshul khrims gtsos ar chog dang mkhan po mdzad/ grong pa'i 'go khrid gnyis kyi thugs 'gan 'og grub dbang dkon mchog chos bzang gtsos grwa bcus gzungs sgrub dang / sa sbrul lo dbu lha srung gtsos dge slong bzhi sde nas rab gnas mdzad/ lcags rta lor khang bu brtsegs pa'i mchod rten bzhengs/ lo ltar bsang gsol chag med bcas so/341

ཿ༅//mjug gi sbyar byang /rnam mang sngon byon lo rgyus shel gyi phreng /rnam mang yi ge'i ris su star ba la/rnam mang mkhyen rab sa ru ma 'khod pas/rnam mang ra ris sgrib par bzod par gsol/'on kyang lhag bsam rab dkar tshigs kyi phreng /phreng star rgyud pa'i mes po'i mdzad rnam bzang /bzang po'i lam nas drang bden gnas pa'i srol/srol bzang mi nyams phyi rabs mig ltos bzang /dge ba 'dis mtshon 'khor 'das dus gsum dang /dge ba bla med yod pa'i dge ba 'dis/bde bas skyong mkhas ma gyur 'gro ba rnams/bde nas bde bar byang chub 'thob phyir bsngo/ 'dzam gling spyi dang bye brag gangs can ljongs kyi gnas mchog khyad par can dang mi sna grags can dang gnas dgon bcas tshang ma la lo rgyus dang /chos 'byung / rnam thar/ rtogs brjod sogs shin tu mang bar bzhugs kyang /lung tshan re'i lo rgyus de tsam ma byung bas/ kun gyis mi shes pa dang yul de'i mi rnams shes med dang / gnas dgon la byin med lta bu rin thang med pa zhig chags 'gro 'dug pas/ rang re nags shod pa lta bu la sngon dus su 'gom lding dpon tshang la 〈sum pa chos 'byung 〉bya ba pod gcig yod pa de nye 342

char su lung rtogs rin po ches mjal bar gsungs pas/ de'i nang bod khamasaspyi dang sngar sum pa'i lo rgyus dang nags shod pa'i dgon sde'i lo rgyus rgyas par yod 'dug kyang rig gsar gyi nang du med par gyur/ de min dbu thang char rgyud tshang la li tho'i bstan rtsis 〈sangs rgyas bstan rtsis 〉bya ba de bod kyi lo rgyus don chen dang lhag par nags shod pa'i dgon gnas dang mi sna grags can bcas kyi lo tshigs gsal ba 'khod pa yin kyang spyi ltar med par gyur/de min gnyags mdo sog ru tshang gi yig tshang / skyen pa'i yig tshang /sheladakar 'bum pa'i gnas yig shug lding dgon 〈jo bo'i dkar chag〉phag mo gru pas brtsams pa dang / rje rig 'dzin chos grags nags shod du bzhugs pa'i rang rnam pod gcig dang / de min dgon pa khag dang / khyim dud che khag la lo rgyus re gnyis yod nges kyang de skabs ma dpe bris ma gcig rang yin pa dang / shin tu bka' rgya che bas mjal bar dka' ba dang de bzhin gna' gtam bu la 'jag pa'i go skabs dben/ de rnams rig gsar skabs su brlag gtor du song bas dpyad gzhi'i yig cha de tsam med pa dang /'brel yod kha shas bzhugs yod kyang g.yar ba'i thabs shes ma thub pas lo rgyus gra rgyas shig ma grub pas klog pa po rnams la bzod par gsol/ phran ni grwa rkyang kyus ma zhig yin pa las/ lo rgyus ched las mi sna dang / 'byor ming dbang gsum ldan pa'i mi grags shig de bas min pas/ lo rgyus slob tshan nyan rgyu lta zhog gzhung gi dpe mdzod khang dang slob chen khag gi dpe mdzod khang la 'gro ba'i skal ba de bas dben pa dang / lo rgyus mkhas dbang mi sna yang 'jal ba'i go skabs dben pas dpyad gzhi phun sum tshogs po zhig ga la thob srid/ rtsom yun zla ba bcu gnyis tsam las ma phyin pas rjes su sa cha khag la 343

dngos su phyin nas 'dri rtsad dang par len bcas bya nas yar rgyas btang rgyu yin/ da lta rgan rabs dang rgyus yod kyis grags can mi sna dang / gnas dgon/ rig gnas sog gsungs rgyu yod na dus deb khag sogs gang rung du 'god thub na phyi rabs la bzhag pa chen po zhig yin par nges/ deb 'di'i nang du lo rgyus ma 'khod pa dang phyogs ris dang zhe tshig med pa sogs ma gus pa'i rigs byung na/ bdag gis kun slong ngan pas ma yin par rig gzhung la sbyangs pa med pas yin par thugs la mi 'dzin par zhu/ 'di'i nang brda rnying dang snyan tshig gis ma rgyan par nyog tshig nyung ba sogs kyis gzigs pa po rnams la gzigs bde ba yongs phyir gtsor ston bcas byas yod/ deb 'di'i sngon mjug tu rtsa ba'i bla ma 7skyabs rje ri dbang rin po che dang mched grogs rnams dang / pha yul gcig pa'i grogs mchog mang pos gang spyi'i thog rogs skyor gang zab gnang bar dka' drin che zhu rgyu yin/ces pa 'di gangs can kha ba'i ljongs kyi zhing khams/ mdo khams shod chen bco brgyad kyi nang bsal/ nags shod sman ljongs phyug mo'i mthil du lte khrag bor ba dge ming dkon mchog bstan 'dzin chos dbyings kyis rang lo so gcig tu son pa bde mchog stod 'brel du mi zad pa dang / bod me khyi lo/rang lugs ston pa 'das nas 255rkyaspyi lo 2006cho 'phrul zla ba'i yar tshes bco lnga nyin 'gom dgon skyobs pa stong sku'i drung du 'go btsugs nas rgyal zla'i rdzogs pa gsum par res bza' pa sangs skar ma rgyal la bab pa lha ldan du grub par bgyid pa 'dis/ rgyal bstan dar zhing de 'dzin skyes bu'i zhabs pad brtan pa dang / 'gro rnams 'tshe med zhi bde'i dpal la spyod pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig gu/ margalo// / /344

༄7//'gom dgon chos 'khor byams pa gling gi chos khrims bca' yig bshad sgrub bstan pa nam mkha'i nor bu bzhin/ yid srub chu 'dzin stug pos sgrib gyur kyang / bca' khrims dri bzhon shugs kyis rab gsal nas/phan bde'i 'od stong 'bar ba deng 'dir gsal/ de yang mi mjed zhing las/lho rgyal 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis kyis 'dul ba mdzad pa'i zhing mchog khyad par du rnam 'dren bzhi pa mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po'i bstan pa rin po che yun du gnas pa'i dus der/ dal 'byor gyi lus thob nas/ bstan pa'i sgor bzhugs/ rab tu byung ba'i rtags cha lugs bzung nas/ lus ngag yid gsum chos phyogs su gang 'gro byed pa ma gtogs/ 'jig rten phal ba'i tshul bzhin du/ dug lnga hrag cing longs spyod/dkon mchog dang dad rdzas kyi dkor la ngom pa med pa spyod pa ni/ ngan song gi gting mtha' med pa'i rgyur 'gro ba/ bdag cag gi ston pa dang / skyes mchog gong ma rnams kyis yang yang gsungs ba'i phyir/ lus ngag yid gsum gyis chos spyod bcu la brtson pa lhur len dgos shing / slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis/ ston pa'i dam chos rnams gnyis te/ lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid do zhes gsungs pa ltar lung gi bstan pa ni/ sde snod rin po che rnam pa gsum du gnas pa dang / rtogs pa'i bstan pa ni/ bslab pa rin po che rnam pa gsum du nges pa'o/ de nyid 'dzin pa byed pa'i gang zag rnams kyi 345

klog pa thos bsam dang / sgrub pa bsam gtan gyi 'khor lo gnyis la brten nas/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa la 'dzin skyong / mthar thugs kyi rang gzhan mtha' dag 'bras bu don du gnyer dgos pa/ lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan phun sum tshogs pa de mtha' dag thog mar skye ba dang / bar du gnas pa/ mthar 'phelab la rten pa la gzhi tshul khrims kyi bslab pa kho nar yin te/ bshes spring las/ khrims ni rgyu dang mi rgyu'i sa bzhin du/ yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten lags par gsungs zhes gsungs pa ltar/ tshul khrims kyi bslab pa la nan tan du bya ba gces so/ lhag tu rang re ni/ 7rgyal ba 'bri gung pa chen po'i gdan sa drug gi ya gyal/ 'gom dgon chos 'khor byams pa gling 'di nyid/skyu ra'i gdan rabs nyer gsum pa/ 7sgrub rgyud ke la sha ri'i phrag pa nas/'jig med smra ba'i dbang phyug seng ge'i sgras/ nag phyogs gcan gzan tshogs rnams 'dar byed pa/ skyur ra chos kyi grags pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ rje rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba sdes gdan sa dngos skyong gnang ba'i gnas gsang sngags theg mchog rdo rje'i spor zhes pa gnas mchog 'di nyid/ dus phyis su rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs su/ bstan dgon nyams rgud phyin nas chos gzhis gtor skyon du song / 'on kyang tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa tshogs tshun/ chos dad rang mos kyi srid jus la zhig nas rgyal khab kyis chog mchan dang / 'gron dngul rgyab skyor 'og dgon gnas 'di'ang nyams pa slar yang gsos/ de bzhin dge 'dun rnams gnyen po stobs zhan gyi dbang du song ste/ phyi 'dul ba lus kyi tshul khrims/ nang byang chub sems dpa'i bslab khrims/ bar gsang ba sngags kyi sdom khrims theg pa chen po'i dam tshig 3slo

rnams rtswa skya bzhin du bor nas skya zad sngo sdug zhes pa'i dpe ltar/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che nyams dma' bas de bzhin du 'os ma mchis shing /de las ldog pa'i chos tshul dang mthun pa'i chos khrims yin te/ de'ang rang khrims la gnas nas gzhan khrims su btsud dgos pa'i bca' lam sgrigs srol dgos gal che yang / da lta lhag gnad cha shas gtsor bton ste/ dge 'dun rnams sgrig srol 'di ltar bgyi ba la/ 'dus pa mtha' dag gsan 'tshal/ de'ang / 7rje 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i rdo rje'i gsung brgya lnga bcu las/ gsang sngags la ni tshul khrims med ka med yang sdom gsum gong nas gong du dog tu 'gro zhes gsungs pa dang / rje btsun chos skyabs kyis bstan pa'i gzhi ma 'phags pa'i dge 'odun ste/ so thar byang sems sngags kyi sdom pa rnams/ ma nor tshul bzhin spyod la bag yod pa'i/ srung sems gnyen pos thub bstan dar ba shog zhes gsung pa de ltar/ bstan khrims du ma'i sgo nas gsungs pa ltar/ spyir yul khams bde zhing bkra shis pa'i ched dang /rang rang gi dal 'byor don ldan/ tshe rabs phyi ma bde ba nas bde bar 'gro ba'i phyir/ bcas pa'i khrims yin pas chos khrims dar gyi mdud pa 'jam la dam/ rgyal khrims gser gyi gnya' shing sgram la lci/ zhes gnas skabs dang mthar thugs kyi dgos gal che bas ched du 'di bzhin spyod pa rig ste/ rang re rnams bdag cag gi ston pa'i chos kyi sgor bzhugs shing / bslab pa rgyal ba'i 'dun khrims nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum bsrung bya dgos pa dang / khyad par du/ pham lhag bcu bdun mig 'bras ltar bsrung dgos pa ste/ delpung /sdom rgyu'i khrims kyi rnam grangs rang gi ma shes na/ sdom rgyu dang khrims 'jog rgyu gnyis ka med de/ dgon 'dir thog mar rab byung 'jug tshe/ brtags pa 347

bya rgyu gal che ba yin/ dgon pa'i dmangs gtso bdag gnyer gyis nye dga' phyogs lhung du ma song ba gros thag gcod dgos/ mi chog pa ni gsham gsal/1 dgon pa gzhan nas sgrig 'gal gnas las dbyung ba dang / 2chad las bu lon ma byang pa/ 2 dbang po skyon can dang nad gzhi che ba/ 4 mi gsad pa dang rku rdzun lang shor blo lad dang / za 'dod las 'tsher byed mkhan/ 5 gzhan dbang song ba/ pha mas gnang ba ma thob pa dang / chos la phug rten mi 'gel ba sgrub ru mi 'jug de las ldog pa'i yong khung gsal ba dang / rgyal gces chos gces yin pa/ rig gnas chu tshad nges can yod pa/ gzugs gzhi bde thang / ya rabs kun spyod bzang ba/ mthun sgril yag pa/ rang mos kyis grwa par bzhugs pa sogs gros bsdur dang chog mchan rgyud nas skra breg rgyu dang / rab byung dge ba tshul du slong ba bya/ lo nyi shu lon na/ dge slong sdom pa thob pa dgos/ bslab bya phra rags kun tshul bzhin srung dgos pa dang / mtshams grwar zhugs pa rnams phyag rdzogs gang rung sngon 'gro nas bzung grangs gsog gtsor bton ma yin par/ sgom khrid nyams len thob pa bya dgos/ lhag par nā ro chos drug tshul bzhin nyams len dkon pa yin stabs/ phyis ji lta ba myong ba thon pa zhig dgos gal che/ 2 grwa tshang rnams nyin zhag phrug cig la/ nam gsal nas dpe 'dzin gtso bo byed de/gsar bu rnams cho ga chos spyod/ bskang ba gsar rnying yod rigs rnams blo la 'dzin dgos/ gzhan yang snga thun rgyun 'khyer gang rung 'don sgom sbrag ma dang / yi dam sgom bzlas rgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dang / gtor chogadagongs thun nas nyal kha bar gtor bsngos/ ku su la'i tshogs gsog srung 'khor zhal gdams ma/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur/ bsngo ba smon lam 348

sogs ci rigs nyams len bya dgos/ dge sbyor gang byed pa bsre lhad ma 'dres pa bya dgos/ rang lo nyer lnga ma zin par nyin dgung yig rwa slob sbyong dang / dgong mor 'don rwa bcas rgyun ma chad pa dgos/ bskang gso rgyug 'phrod thon na/ 'don yig rwar bzhugs mi dgos/ 2 tshogs kyi kun spyod la/ thog mar dkon gnyer gyis dbu mdzad la dgong skor rgyud dril brda gtong ste/ chab ris kyis ting ting dang mkhar rnga'i 'og so so'i mchil lham phud nas 'du khang sgo phyi la 'jog pa las bzhugs gral sar 'khyer mi chog de rjes 'du khang sgo nas chab blangs te tshogs gral du 'du dgos pa dang / dung mkhan gnyis kyis dbyangs gsal blangs ste dung ring ba thengs gsum btang dgos/ dung brda dang po gtong nas dung 'gying bya ste dung brda bar ma'i skabs dbu mdzad kyis 'don pa skul nas/ dge bskos nang du byon dgos/nang du tshogs pa'i gdong gral du 'don chos spyod gdangs dbyangs skad sogs yod rigs dang / gzhung 'dzin pa bzhugs dgos/ gral gzhan du bslab gras rgan gzhon go rim chos khrims pa gnyis kyi ngag bkod ltar 'khod pa ma gtogs/ nga che nga gnyen/ slebs snga rim gyi ham pa mi byed/ gsar rnying thams cad 'ding ba dgos/ dge tshul slong rnams chos gos tshang nges dgos/ pags rigs dred gdan la sogs 'ding mi chog 4 thams cad kyi 'don chos spyod dang / rol dbyangs sogs dbu mdzad la bstun pa ma gtogs ngan khyer dang mi 'don pa sogs gtan nas mi byed/ 'don pa gdangs 'dur gang skul dal snyom/ snyan 'jebs sems rgyud gang 'gre bya dgos/ 'don chos tshig dang dbyangs rol sogs 'don rkang bzang zhing gsal ba/ tshig cha dbyang rol/ gtor mchod bzhengs sogs rang lugs 349
