gtan la gang phab/ lhad med do dam rnam kun rgyun bsring bya dgos/ sbyin bdag tsho'i 'don dung yon shi gson rim 'gro gang dgos/ 'don rgyun smar ba/ tshogs yun ring ba/ rang nyid dkor byang ba/ sbyin bdag blo kho rdzogs pa bcas bya dgos/ tshogs gral du bzhugs skabs su/ 'go 'og lus tshud dgos pa las/ gcig rgyab gcig brten/ gnyid yur mgo sbrel/ rtsed mo gru srub/ shab shub smra brjod/ 'chil snabs gang sar dbyug pa sogs mi bya/tshogs gral du phor ba sgra bcas 'jog par mi bya/ tshogs grol skabs chab gtang nas dge bskos sngon la don rjes dal bur grol dgos/ 5 gling nang du grwa ba rnams spyi las nges can skabs chos khrims pas gnang ba ma thob par grwa chas gtan nas skyur mi chog spyir dgon phyi nang gang thad grwa chas med par 'gro mi rung la lhag tu 'du khang nang du phyin mi chog rgyal sgo yan zhwa mo gyon pa dang / grwa chas med pa phyin mi chog skra sor gang yan la 'jog mi bya/ grwa gri sor gsum yan la 'dog mi chog 'go ba rgan gzhon yod rigs kyis gos ngur smrig ma yin pa/ dor ma dang phu dung can/ grwa lham rigs ma yin pa/lham sna tshogs dang / sked pa gri ring dang phor shub/ a cor/ khab 'bug sogs glo cha'i rigs 'dogs pa mi bya/ 6 mda' sogs mtshon cha'i rigs dang / sho dang / mig mang / rgyal blon dgu sgrig rdo skor sogs rtse ba dang /bang 'gran rgyug mchong / 'ur kha rdo 'phen/ dpa' ngom dpung shed/ rang ngo bstod/ gzhan dma' 'bebs/ sgrung glu len/ pho mkhyud lag sbrel gyis 'gro ba/ sdod dus rkang pa rkyong ba/ khyi dang sems can la rdo dbyug rdeg pa/'gro dus 'tshang rgyag pa/ bre mo'i gtam smra ba/ hab shar mtshang 'bru/ ku co ngan smras/ 'phya khrel brnyas 'dog 'chal gtam cal sgrog mtshan mo long 350

gtam smra ba dang / dgon dang dur khrod nye 'dabs su/ ri klung srog chags che chung rigs gnod sems bcang nas gsod pa dang / gsod du 'jug pa/srung skyob byas pa'i shing nags gcod breg byed pa/ 'u lag khral skul rigs dang / rgyu mtshan med par dbang yod shod pa/ gong rim dang rtsa 'dzugs kyi bkod sgrig la mi nyan pa dang / 'gogs rkyen bzo ba/ sgrig nyis 'dzin/rang gar gyis dgon pa nas bral te gang sar 'khyams pa/ rdzun dang 'go skor gtong ba/ dgon pa'i rig dngos dang spyi spyod sgrig chas rgyu dngos sogs rku 'khyer ham bzos byed pa dang / chag skyon gtong ba/ ma nyes kha g.yog dang nyes 'gal 'geb srung byed pa/ sku gsung thugs rten sogs rku 'khyer dang /lkog tshong rgyag pa/ bla ma dang grub mtha' bzang ngan dbye ba/ yon mchod sbyin bdag bsnyen bkur bzang ngan dbye ba/ sde dpon rigadang / ban rtsa ngo shes mang po'i kha mchu zhal lce dang / phyogs lhung ngan g.yo/ rgyab bdag sne shan/ 'phrin skyel sun 'byin/ nyan rna gros 'don sogs pher rgya chen po byed pa de yang dge 'dun spyi yi zhabs 'dren du 'gro bas zab dgos/ ma tshad slebs snga ba thon sgo med pa/ gral brtsod che ba/ phor ba che ba/ skyid na sdod/sdug na 'gro bsam pa de dag phyir gtong dgos/ gzhan yang dbyar gyi za shing gi 'bras bu/ lab nyung rtswa shing yan chad/ sder slong ma gtogs thog gzan mi chog lo tog ldan pa'i zhing rwa rnams lam gtod pa sogs gnod pa mi bya/de ltar spang bya ldog pa'i rim pa rnams las cung zad sna re 'gal rung do dam 'go byed dang / chos khrims pas btang snyoms su ma bzhag par thog mar ngang rgyud 'jam pos slob gso dang / kha ta bslab bya byed dgos/ mi nyan mkhan dang cung nyesahwa 'gal che ba rnams 'os 'tshams kyis thag gcod bya dgos/ 7351

1dbu chos bzhi dang / chab ril gnyis/ dung mkhan gnyis/ dkor gnyer bcas dang gzhan yang shar rtse'i mchod dpon che mo dang / rab gsal tshoms chen khang gi las bya sne len pa lo rim las thog 'gan babs tshe rgyun du dgon par bzhugs dgos/ phyi la gang byung 'gro mi chog 'gal 'dzol byung na nyes chad gtong dgos/ chab ril gtsos pas 'du khang phyi nang khor yug steng shod bcas dang so so'i brang khang sogs phyag brdar gtsang sbra legs par byas te so so'i yo byad dang / mchod pa sogs bkod legs par 'jog dgos/ gang byung gis bshang gci dang / mchin snabs mi dbyug gad snyigs mi 'geng /gling nang rgyang skad 'bod pa sogs ku co mi bya/ gal te de dang 'gal na phyag brgya phyag dang / gtsang risbra gad phyis/ 'du khang thig sa bcas chad gcod lag bstar bya dgos/ 2 gling phyi nang du kha 'thab tshig rtsod lag thug byas na/ chad gcod/ mang ja dang / brgya phyag (tshan re sgor lnga re rtsis pas )dgon pa gzhung la 'bul tshan/ bla ma spyi chos la dar kha 'bul nas ngos len yig cha bzo dgos/ 2 thag rang gis gcod/ dgongs zhus dang 'gro lugs ma rgyud par gang sar bskyod pa dang / rdo dbyug sdeg mo sogs kyi khrag bton pa byung na/ mang ja dang / brgya phyag gsum dung dar/ skar me snyan dar/ dgon gzhung la lnga tshan/ bla ma spyi chos la sum tshan re/ lag phyi ma lan byed pos de'i phyed cha dgos/ phyogs gnyis kyis ngos len yig cha bzo dgos/4 lhag tu spyi tshogs thog rgyag res dang rtsod 'dzings byed pa'am/ gri bton pa khrag phyung pa byung na/ mang ja dang / stong phyag dung dar/ skar me snyan dar/ dgon gzhung la bdun tshan/ bla ma dbu chos la lnga tshan re lan byed po de'i phyed cha sgrub nas/ gong rim khrims khang la btugs dgos6 5 tha mag 352

dang / sna tha 'then mi dang / khyung ri dang / rta rong nyag slebs nas/ gling nang rta dang lcags rta sbag sbag bzhon nas yongs mi chog gal srid dbu chos la dgongs zhus med nas gang byung de rigs rta dang lcags rta sbag sbag bzhon pa sogs byung na/ mang ja dang / stong phyag skar me snyan dar/ dgon gzhung la dgu tshan/ bla ma spyi chos la bdun tshan/ ngos len yig cha bzo dgos/ 6 rtsa bzhi chang lnga las pham pa dngos su byung na/ mang ja dang / khri phyag dgon gzhung la bcu gsum tshan/ bla ma spyi chos la dgu tshan re/gser rkong brje nas/ slar dgon du sdod na/ sdom ro phul nas bslab bskyar tshad ldan dang / mi sdod na gnas nas dbyung / mi gsod khrims 'gal nyes can tshabs chen byung na rdzong khrims khang la skyel dgos/ 7 dgon pa'i rtsa 'dzugs dang / bla ma spyi chos rnams kyis spyi don las ka gang yod rigs/bkod sgrig la brtsi bkur mi zhu ste/ rtsa 'dzugs la kha len/ lag len slog pa/lkog g.yo ngan jus byed pa ni/ mang ja dang / khri phyag dung dar/ snyan dar/skar me/ gser rkong brje nas gnas nas dbyung / dgon pa'i 'go 'dzin dang / dbu chos sogs/ rgyu mtshan med pa thag ring la 'gro sdod sogs mi byed cing / mig ltos gang phan byed dgos/ lhag par chos khrims gnyis dang rang 'gul gyi sgrig 'then byed mkhan la sgor gcig brgya dang skar me snyan dar/phyag lnga stong / gser rkong brje nas gnas nas dbyung / dmangs gtso bdag gnyer do dam thun mong nas/ rtsa bzhi chang lnga gtso'i 'gal ba byung rigs rna thos tsam byung 'phral/ rtsad zhib thog chad las khrims kyi bya ba la nan tan bya dgos/ de yang / do dam mi snas 'gal na/ phyag lnga brgya re/ dbu chos kyi 'gal na stong phyag re 'bul dgos/ ra gzhan yang 'bum dgon gnyis 353

kyi mgon khang rgyun bskang rnams res skor ma chad pa dang / dpyid ka nas zhig gso dang / ar las/ dbyar thig tshag dgun gang 'phyag spyi ba'i rgyu noragaces 'dzin bdag skyong bya dgos/ 'du khang phyi nang gi zhal ba ldebs ngos su lag dal gyis ri mo bris pa/ sgo dang sge'u khung shel khra gtor ba sogs byas na gud gsab dang skyin tshab len dgos/ mdor na/ do dam las 'dzin khur yod thams cad kyis/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi srol bzung / dus babs dang / chab srid/ khrims dang bstun/ phyogs ris dang ngo bsrung sogs ma song par drang por zab dgos/ gzhan yang / 'dul ba las khro yang slar mi khro ba dang / gshe yang slar mi gshe ba/ rdeg pa la slar mi rdega'atshang 'dru ba las/ slar 'tshang mi 'dru zhes pa de ltar 'dir bzhugs kyi 'dus sde rnams kyis bstan 'gro spyi dang khyad par du rgyal bstan 'dzin skyong spel ba'i thabs la phan bde'i thugs bskyed bzang por mkha' ltar yangs pa'i blang dor gyi gnas la 'jug don du mkhas btsun bzang gsum/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum/ thos bsam sgom gsum ste dam pa'i tshul dgu dang ldan dgos pa de'i ched du rnam par 'byed pa'i yi ge 'di bkod par zhib tu brtag shing / tho co ma song ba/ 'gan 'khur khur len dang bcas pa mtha' dag gis rang rang gi 'gan babs khur yang du ma song ba'i bsam pa phyogs gcig tu sgril/ dper na/ bka' rgyab la dpon dgos zhes/ dpon med na bka' gtan shog yan red/ rgyu rgyab la mi dgos/ mi med na dri za'i grong khyer red/zhes pa ltar/ srol yig 'di yang bag med yal bor 'gal ba byed pa sogs byung rigs thog mar rtsa 'dzugs kyi 'go khrid dang / spyi chos tshos slob gso gtong dgos/ gal srid mi nyan mkhan tsho zhib gsal gyis yig thog bkod pa 354

'di bzhin lag thog bstar thub pa dgos/ bzang po la mig bltos dpe 'gran byas te gzengs bstod bya dgos/ de ltar bslab bya 'di rnams phra rags kun la rgan gzhon gsar rnying thams cad kyis dran shes ldan pa'i snying khong rus pas gting dutsho'ajog pa 'tshal/'gro kun phan bde 'byung gnas rgyal ba yi/ / bstan srid khrims gtsang thos bsam sgom brtson pa/ / tshul 'chal nyes brgya byi dor legs byas kyi/ /phan bde'i snang ba dpal du 'bar ba shog / mchog gsum lhag pa'i lha dang chos bsrung gis/ / phan dgongs nus mthu srung skyob mi g.yel ba/ / dge 'dun thugs mthun chos spyod bcur brtson pas/ / 'gro rnams bde skyid dpal la 'god par shog / myu/dgongs pa rnam dag guka' dang mthun pa yi/ma nor lam bzang dge ba ci bsgrubs pas/ sa bcu'i mgon po 'bri gung rin chen gyi/ bstan pa dar zhing yun ring gnas gyur cig ces pa nags shod 'gom dgon chos 'khor byams pa gling gi chos khrims blang dor gsal byed nyi ma bya ba 'di dgon pa'i dmangs gtso bdag gnyer 'go byed gsar rnying rgan gzhon bla grwa thun mong dang / shang srid gzhung dbu bzhugs thun mong gros bsdur thog rab byung bcu bdun skyes bdag lcags lug lo sbrul zla ba res gza' pa sangs skar ma snon/ 'phrod sa 2nyin der bris pa dge'o/355

༄7//'gom dgon chos 'khor byams pa gling gi bca' yig kha gsab/dgon pa'i gling nang gnas pa'i grwa shag so so'i nang du btsun ma dang bud med rnams gnas sdod byed mi chog rgyu de yin/'dul ba'i gzhung las/ la la'i tshul khrims bde ba ste/ /la la'i tshul khrims sdug bsngal yin/ / tshul khrims ldan pa bde ba ste/ / tshul khrims 'chalab sdug bsngal yin/ / zhes gsungs pa dang / gang zag su zhig yin rungakhe bas nyen che ba lags/ pham pa ni shin tu sdig pa rang yin / spyod 'jug las/ /'di 'dra'i dal ba nyid gyur nas/ / bdag gis dge skol ma byas na/ / 'di las bslun pa'ang gzhan med do/ / 'di las rmongaso pa'ang gzhan med do/ /zhes gsungs shing / rang cag tsho don snying po ngo ma ji ltar len tshul la yang bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' srol bzhin du phyin ci ma log par lag len du 'khyol ba byed rgyu de gal che ba yin/ mdo las/ dge slong dag srog dang bral zhing shi ba ni sla ba yin/ / tshul khrims nyams shing gzhig pa de lta bu ma yin no/ / de ci'i phyir zhe na/ srog dang bral zhing shi ba ni tshe 'di nyid kyi skye ba zad par 'gyur/ tshul khrims nyams zhing gzhig pa de ni skye ba 'bum khrag brgya'i bar du rigs dang bral zhing bde bar spang te rnam pa kun tu ltung ba chen por 'gyur/ / zhes so/ / de bzhin rang dgon 'di nyid dam chos 'dul ba la bsre lhad dang dam sel ma song pa byed rgyu de ni rang gzhan 356

tshang mas 'gan 'khri yin zhing nges par du 'khur dgos pa de yin/donatshan dang po/ dgon 'di ni lo rgyus thog 7rgyal ba 'bri gung pa'i gdan sa drug gi ya gyal gtsang dgon zhig yin/ dgon pa'i gling nang sngar srol bzhin du chos khrims la srung brtsi zhus nas btsun ma dang bud med dgon pa'i nang du gnas sdod byed mi rung /don tshan gnyis pa/ grwa btsun bar phan tshun 'gal ba dang / rtsod gleng / bstan srid la gnod pa'i bya ba che chung brnyas 'dog gang yang spel mi chogadon tshan gsum pa/ gal srid btsun ma dang bud med su zhig dgon pa'i gling du zhag sdod dgos dbang (nad g.yog lta bu )'dug dgos tshe/rlan chu shang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi mchan bkod ngo sprod zhus nas dgon gyi zhal ngo dang rtsa 'dzugs la snyan zhu dgong 'khrol dgos pa las/ rang 'tshams gyis dgon nang bzhugs na 'gan 'khri rtsad gcod byed rgyu yin/don tshan bzhi pa/ btsun ma dang bud med su zhig yin rung dgon pa'i nyams gso'i las grwa dang chos lugs byed sgo che rigs ma gtogs dgon nang zhag sdod byed mi chog nyin gzhung du su zhig yin rung lugs mthun gyi chos zhu gnas 'jal phyag bskor byed chog pa yin/don tshan lnga pa/ btsun ma dang bud med rigs dgon pa'i gling nang nyin rer zhogs pa chu tshod 1༷nas dgong mo chu tshod 6bar chu tshod brgyad las brgal mi chogadon tshan drug pa/ bud med rigs kyi las don byed mkhan 'go khrid dang / slob khrid byed mkhan/ sku mgron dmigs bsal can dang / de min 357

grwa btsun su 'dra zhig yin rung sgrig srol dang mthun dang mi mthun ni rang rang gi 'gan srung byed dgos/don tshan bdun pa/ dgon pa'i sgrig gzhi lam srol 'di gtan la phab nas bzung / grwa btsun su zhig sgrig srol 'di las 'gal ba dang / brtsi bkur mi zhu ba gtor bshig gi bya ba byed mkhan la nyes spyod ltung ba 'dul gzhung dang sgrig srol la zhig nas phyag 'tshal ba dang / bshag pa 'bul/mar me/ snyan dar/ gad phyis sogs nyes spyod chad 'gel byed rgyu yin/don tshan brgyad pa/ grwa ba sgrig 'then byed mkhan shag de dgon pa gzhung la dbang rgyu yin/ so so'i bdag byed mi chog rang tshab grwa ba yod na sdod ru 'jug rgyu yin/ 'gom dgon chos 'khor byams pa gling dgon dmangs gtso bdag gnyer u yon lhan khang nas spyi lo 2004zla 2tshes 25nyin nas/ 358

ro༅//dpyad gzhi'i yig cha /karma pa sku phreng rim byon rnam thar/ shing par/bka' chem bka' 'khol ma 19〈9 kan su'u mi rigs dpe skrun khang /lcags par/bka' gdams chos 'byung gsal ba'i sgron me/ 2༷༷2bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe rdzun khang / lcags par/klong chen chos 'byung / bod ljongs bod yig dpe rnying dpe skrun khang /1991 lcags par/bka' thang sde lnga/ 19ra7 mi rigs dpe skrun khang / lcags par/khams stod lo rgyas thor bsdus/ 1995 kan su'u mi rigs dpe skrun khang /lcags par/gangs ljongs gso rig bstan pa'i nyin byed rim byon rnam thar/ 2rkya0rkyami rigs dpe skrun khang / lcags par/dge 'dun chos laphel gsung rtsom pod gsum/ 1999 bod ljongs bod yig dpe rnying dpe skrun khang / lcags par/rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/ 19/5 si khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang /lcags par/gu bkra'i chos 'byung / 199rkya krung go'i bod kyi shes rig dpe skrun khang /lcags par/gong sa lnga pa'i rnam par/ 19ṭwāṃrdzo mi rigs dpe skrun khang / lcags par/rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long / 20༷5 mi rigs dpe skrun khang / lcags par/359

snga rabs bod kyi srid khrims/ 2༷04 mi rigs dpe skrun khang / lcags par/chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston/ 19ra6 mi rigs dpe skrun khang /lcags par/chos 'byung me tog sbrang rtsi'i bcud/ 19rar bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang / lcags par/jo bo nags lha'i gsol mchod 'dod 'byung nor bu'i bang mdzod/ bris ma/tun hong nas thon pa'i bod kyi lo rgyus yig cha las byung ba'i bod ljongs sa ming / 2༷༷5 bod ljongs bod yig dpe rnying dpe skrun khang / lcags par/bstan rtsis gsal ba'i nyin byed/ 19ṭwāṃ7 bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang / lcags par/tā la'i bla ma'i rnam thar/ 19rdo6 mtsho sngon mi dmangs dpe skrun khang /lcags par/stag lung chos 'byung / lcags par/thun kwan grub mtha'/ 19ṭwāṃ5 kan su'i mi rigs dpe slun khang / lcags par/thang yig gsar rnying las byung ba'i bod chen po'i srid lugs/ 19ṭwāṃ2lcags par/mdo smad chos 'byung / 2002 krung go bod rig pa dpe skrun khang /lcags par/dung dkar tshig mdzod chen mo/ 2rkyaX2 krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang / lcags par/ bdud 'joms chos 'byung / 1996 si khron mi dmangs dpe skrun khang /lcags par/360

bhe lde'u chos 'byung / 1khardo7 bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang / lcags par/deb ther sngon po/ 19rdo4 si khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang / lcags par/sde dge rgyal rabs/ 19ṭwāṃrdzo bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang /lcags par/nags shod 'bri ru'i lo rgyus/ 2rkya02 bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang / lcags par/nag chu srid gros deb tshogs/ lcags par/nags shod stag phu'i gsungs 'bum phyogs sgrig pod gnyis/ bris ma/nags shod nyi ma grags pa'i gsungs 'bum pod nyer gcig bris ma/nags shod 'gom dgon pa'i bskang gso dang bsang gsol chos spyod/ shing par/dpal don grub rgyal gyi gsungs 'bum/ 1997 mi rigs dpe skrun khang /lcags par/bod kyi lo rgyus deb ther khag lnga/ 1rdzo90 bod ljongs bod yig dpe rnying dpe skrun khang / lcags par/'bri gung chos 'byung / 2rkya04 mi rigs dpe skrun khang / lcags par/'bri gung chos mdzod chen mo pod brgya dang lnga bcu/ 2005 lcags par/bod kyi lo rgyus g.yu yi phreng ba/ 19shrī9 bod ljongs dpe rnying dpe skrun khang / lcags par/'brug pa chos 'byung / 1992 bod ljongs bod yig dpe rnying dpe skrun khang / lcags par/bod kyi lo rgyus don chen re'u mig rgyas pa ke ta ka/ 2༷rkya5 mi rigs dpe skrun khang / lcags par/361

bod kyi lo rgyus don chen re'u mig 19rdzo1 mi rigs dpe skrun khang /lcags par/sba bzhed/ 19ṭwāṃ0 mi rigs dpe skrun khang / lcags par/'bri gung gdan rabs gser phreng / 19〈9 bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang / lcags par/mi dbang pho lha'i rtogs brjod/ 1rdzoṭwāṃ1 si khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang /lcags par/me 'bar gnas yig lcags par/tshal ba deb dmar/ 1rdzordo1 mi rigs dpe skrun khang / lcags par/zhabs drung mkhas grub bstan 'dzin gyis nags lha'i bsang gsol/ bris ma/zhesmochen rgyal tshab chos 'byung / 1994 si khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang /lcags par/yar klung jo bo'i chos 'byung / 19rardo bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang / lcags par/rlangs kyi po ti bse ru/ 19ra6 bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang /lcags par/rin chen gter mdzod chen mo/ klog par/ sum pa chos 'byung / 1992 kan su'u mi rigs dpe skrun khang / lcags par/sa skya'i gdung rabs/ 19ṭwāṃ6 mi rigs dpe skrun khang / lcags par/sa dpyad phyogs sgrigs/ lcags par/lho rong chos 'byung / 1994 bod ljongs bod yig dpe rnying dpe bskrun khang / lcags par/362
